name: Pollyanna Brewing Company
description: Pollyanna Brewing Company is a craft brewery and distillery that offers a beautiful taproom where you can enjoy craft beer, spirits and the highest quality local, regional and national entertainment. This local hotspot is made for gathering with friends and family, to create memories and simply enjoy the moment.

name: Taco Bueno
description: Taco Bueno is a fan-favorite chain serving up delicious tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and more. With delicious meats and vegetarian meals, they have an option here for everyone. Enjoy freshly prepared, mouthwatering food handcrafted in their kitchens, made with real ingredients and customized to your liking.

name: Jimmyz Original Hibachi House
description: Always cooked to order using only the highest quality ingredients, why wouldn't you want to eat at Jimmyz Original Hibachi House? Combining the hibachi restaurant concept with fast casual dining, you place your order at the counter and your meal is grilled up quickly while you wait. Dinner plates come complete with fried rice and vegetables, with protein options that include chicken teriyaki, shrimp, steak, grouper, scallops, Korean beef, and tuna. Mix and match your meats for a custom-made combo, or opt for a rice, noodle, or low carb veggie bowl for something a little different. Lunch specials in the form of plates, bowls, wraps, and salads are available, and you can't go wrong with their famous $5 lunchtime chicken rice bowl. Rounding out the menu are small bites like yakitori, spring rolls, chicken wings, and a small selection of sushi. Whether dining in, getting delivery or carry-out, or looking for someone to cater your next event, Jimmyz Original Hibachi House has you covered.

name: Mojo Taqueria Lyons
description: Mojo Taqueria Lyons is a local staple that serves fresh Mexican food, drawing on flavors of Oaxaca, Yucatan, Baja and other regions of Mexico. All of their dishes are made from scratch using traditional Mexican chiles and spices. There is no debate when it comes to the freshness and quality of this restaurant.

name: The Triple Knock
description: Discover your inner pinball wizard at the Triple Knock. An arcade bar dedicated to the game of pinball, the Triple Knock houses dozens of different machines, from refurbished old school classics to newer games featuring characters from popular movies and TV shows.Their bar is fully stocked with craft and domestic beer, classic and original cocktails, and boozy slushy drinks that will remind you of childhood while still providing an adult kick. Happy hour specials are available daily, and events like pinball tournaments and charity drives are regularly hosted, so be sure to follow them on social media to stay up on the latest happenings. The Triple Knock's warehouse-like space provides plenty of room for large groups to gather, so assemble your squad of 21+ partiers, and get your game on.

name: The Port of Peri Peri - SF
description: The Port of Peri Peri invites diners on a flavorful journey through Portugal with its vibrant ambiance and tantalizing Peri Peri-infused dishes. From succulent grilled chicken to spicy peri peri sauces, it's a culinary destination where Portuguese cuisine comes alive with every bite.

name: Yucatan Taco Stand Tequila Bar
description: Yucatan Taco Stand offers Oklahoma City diners the big, bold flavors usually found only in the Yucatan region of Mexico and Central and South America. This unique spot offers a casual ambiance and great views of the Bricktown Canal -- an ideal backdrop for enjoying the growing chain's award-winning tacos, signature nachos, and world-class margaritas. Begin your meal with a tasty appetizer like the Latin caterpillar roll, habanero chicken quesadilla, or fried plantains with garlic aioli. Craving tacos? Sampling Yucatan's signature tempura fish taco is a must, as are the spicy-aged chorizo, garlic shredded beef, grilled vegetarian, and other fillings. The burritos and bowls are just as varied, and the kitchen piles their nachos with everything from spicy shrimp to tequila-lime chicken to pork. The menu also features delicious sandwiches, plates such as the chimichanga pollo verde, fajitas for two, and a handful of items suitable for the youngest of diners. Enjoy your favorites with a premium artisan cocktail, imported Mexican beer, excellent wines, or any of the dozens of 100% agave tequilas and award-winning, made-from-scratch margaritas!

name: TCBY - Blakeney
description: In the mood for a sweet treat? TCBY has a full-on swaggy yogurt bar with 10 different flavors and 35 toppings to decorate your delectable treat. They are a bright chain yogurt shop serving up varied frozen treats and chilled coffee drinks. No matter what pick-me-up you need, they've got you covered.

name: TruBoba Cafe
description: TruBoba Café is your new favorite go-to spot for all things cool and delicious! Their eclectic bubble tea menu is sure to keep you coming back for more. They also have great food options such as their famous Bahn Mi, bubble waffle, garlic parmesan wings, lemon pepper and much, much more! What are you waiting for? Come by today!

name: Silverlake Ramen - South Pasadena
description: Passionate about good ramen, the talented staff at Silverlake Ramen invite you to boldly slurp away. Come enjoy delicious bowls of ramen made with traditional ingredients. The environment here is designed to mix street-inspired visual twists with rave-worthy flavors sure to satisfy every family member.

name: Teresa's Mexican Restaurant
description: Teresa's Mexican Restaurant offers a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere with a menu full of authentic Mexican dishes. Guests can enjoy a variety of flavorful options, from traditional tacos and enchiladas to sizzling fajitas and homemade salsas. Known for their friendly service and delicious margaritas, Teresa's provides a delightful dining experience for all.

name: The Crazy Mason Milkshake Bar
description: The Crazy Mason is where calories don't count! Whether guests are on vacation craving a delicious treat or in need of something cold and sweet to get through the week, Crazy Mason has it covered. As the new go-to dessert destination, they offer everything from scoops of ice cream and dessert nachos to crazy waffles, cobblers, and their indulgent crazy milkshake desserts in mason jars. Come indulge in life's sweetest moments at The Crazy Mason Milkshake Bar!

name: Aspen Creek Grill - Lubbock
description: With a reputation for friendly service, delicious food and reasonable prices, Aspen Creek Grill is the kind of restaurant that you can go back to again and again when headed out to dine. This full-service casual restaurant and bar features comfort casual food that taste home-cooked, and that are made from scratch and prepared fresh every day. You'll find hand-cut steaks from family farm-raised corn-fed premium beef, freshly chopped salads, fall-off-the-bone house-smoked ribs, rich and creamy pastas, and of course, their juicy and hearty burgers. And, with a lively mountain lodge theme, you can escape the daily grind, kick-back and enjoy a meal out while someone else does the cooking. Take the family and start your meal with a bang and their famous pow wow shrimp appetizer. Then, feast on the fried chicken, shrimp & grits, country fried steak, fall-off-the-bone tender baby back ribs, succulent salmon, or the juicy double double burgers with all the fixins. Finish your meal with an order of indulgent fried cheesecake topped with vanilla ice cream. There's more on the menu, and to go with your meal, ask about the freshly-squeezed Texas-size lime margaritas or the craft brews on tap. Pull up a chair at the bar for a drink before your meal, and no matter when you go, be sure to ask about any daily specials. With a great selection of home-made dishes, terrific service and a vibe that makes you feel like you're miles from home, Aspen Creek Grill can be your new go-to when dining out! Please note: For your convenience, call-ahead seating is available at (806)553-7930.

name: BurgerFi
description: You won't find bland and boring fast-food burgers here; instead, the tasty eats are created in a gourmet kitchen by gourmet chefs. Enjoy a selection of amazing burgers, grilled or fried chicken sandwiches, and more, because BurgerFi is the place to be! For lunch, dinner or late-night eats, better burgers are waiting for you at BurgerFi.

name: Pac Rim Sushi & Asian Cuisine
description: Pac Rim Sushi & Asian Cuisine serves a variety of fresh and delicious dishes. They offer a great selection of lunch specials, including wok and grill, a lunch bento, and express sushi, all for affordable prices. Their all-day menu is also full of delicious options from entrees and appetizers to rice dishes, noodles, soups, and more.

name: The Star Portland
description: The Star Portland is a dynamic dining destination renowned for its innovative approach to classic American cuisine. Boasting a menu curated with locally sourced ingredients and creative flair, it delights diners with dishes that are both familiar and inventive. Situated in the heart of Portland, The Star provides a welcoming ambiance, making it a beloved spot for locals and visitors alike to gather and enjoy exceptional food and hospitality.

name: Texas Roadhouse Grill
description: Texas Roadhouse Grill is the gold standard in steakhouse excellence, and at this eatery, not only will you find superb steaks and other fare, but you can enjoy a bona fide Texas dining experience. Open since 1993, this is a family owned and operated eatery that should not be confused with the corporate-run franchise by a similar name. Here, you'll find plenty of warm woods and a friendly "howdy" which is all just part of the charm of its charm. This is a great spot for lunch. Meet co-workers or friends for a tasty and affordable lunch special, or rustle-up the kids and go for dinner. Meat lovers LOVE their chargrilled steaks, and with cuts like New York strip, filet mignon, and a colossal 20-ounce T-bone to try, there's something for everyone. There's no doubt that the steaks are the star of the show, but there's plenty more to love about this meat-centric eatery. Baby back ribs, BBQ pulled pork, seafood, hearty hand-pattied and freshly ground burgers, chicken dishes and more are all tempting options. There's even a kids menu for young cowboys and cowgirls, and with a full-service bar, Mom and Dad can sip on their favorite brew, wine or a frosty cocktail. And, if you're a Happy Hour fan, be sure to check out the specials at the bar from 4-7 p.m. With great food, friendly service and a diverse menu, you can get a taste of the Lone Star state at Texas Roadhouse & Grill!

name: Ama Raw Bar
description: Ama Raw Bar focuses on classic Asian flavors, offering delights such as oysters, shrimp cocktail, bao buns, and lobster ramen. Their bar complements the dining experience with seasonal craft cocktails, well-priced wines, and a rotating beer list. Situated in East Village, Ama Raw Bar also provides outdoor seating, a tropical patio, and a private lounge, the "Kiki Room," making it an ideal space for private parties and events.

name: Vin 90
description: Looking for the perfect place to enjoy a delicious meal? Be sure to check out Vin 90 for an all-around wonderful dining experience. They are an American gastropub with Asian flair, offering a full-service wine bar and an extensive menu of food and located at the Arboretum Golf Club in Buffalo Grove, IL.

name: KINSmoke
description: Established in 2015, KINSmoke is a fan-favorite for non-denominational barbecue from the pit or off the grill! Some of their incredible meats include brisket, pork ribs, pork shoulder, chicken, burgers, steak, chops, and even seafood. Stop by today for a satisfying meal and bring the whole family for a great time!

name: Carroll Place
description: Carroll Place may be the new place on the block, but this fabulous Italian American Winebar & Gastropub is an old soul. This stunning bi-level and multi-room venue features a long and spacious bar, communal seating and plenty of space for both diners and drinkers, which makes it ideal for groups, date night and even private dining. Join them today for cocktails, dinner, brunch or just stop by for the live music, but while you're there be sure to peruse the menu. Showcasing wood-oven fired pizzas by famed pizzaillo Federico Crociani, pastas, bruschette, and entrees like the braised short rib or the roasted branzino, the meals are delectable. And of course, each dish is made from only the very best quality ingredients, including those which are imported directly from Italy. Also be sure to peruse the selection of libations -- from the extensive wine selection on tap, by the bottle and by the glass (with a far greater selection of wines by the glass compared to other restaurants, Carroll Place offers wine lovers 20 different varietals to try), to microbrews, Italian beers and signature cocktails, there's enough for all tastes. With a charming decor and plenty of character, not to mention outstanding food and drinks, there's no place quite like Carroll Place!

name: Domenico's Italian Restaurant
description: Domenico's Italian Restaurant brings you the same wonderful experiences they grew up on, from warm Italian hospitality to authentic aromas. Their flavorful handmade recipes have been passed down for more than three generations! This is the place for a romantic dinner for two, watching the game with your buddies, or company meetings!

name: Benares Indian Restaurant
description: Named for a city in Northern India, Benares is the result of a culmination of decade's worth of experience. Experienced restaurateur Inder Singh and acclaimed chef Peter Beck collaborated to create this amazing eatery which features an upscale dining experience and some of the most authentic, traditional and delicious Indian cuisine around. By using the exotic spices and abundant diversity of Indian ingredients, the menu at this eatery is simply spectacular. Head over for an outstanding lunch and choose form prix fixe meals like the Vegetarian Lunch (pick from a variety of different dishes), the Seafood Special (with your choice of appetizer and main dish) or the Tandoori Platter. Or, order a la carte from the diverse menu which ticks all the boxes when it comes to delicious and flavorful Indian cuisine. From familiar appetizers like the Chicken Tikka to hearty meals like the Lamb Korma or tandoori specialties like the Aamiya Jhinga (marinated jumbo prawns), there are plenty of scrumptious dishes to try. Signature dishes include delicious fare like the Sevai Tomato Kurma (a variety of seafood in a garlic tomato sauce) and the Tandoori hen (whole Cornish game hen). Of course there is a variety of freshly baked breads and condiments to go with your meal, so you can dine as authentically as you choose. Enjoy your fabulous meal in the glorious dining room which evokes the sights and sounds of India with mustard-colored banquette seating, plenty of dark woods and decorations like traditional saris. Perfect for power lunches, romantic dinners and everything in between, there's even a private room for slightly larger groups. The next time you're craving a delicious meal and want the best Indian cuisine, check out Benares where you'll be welcomed with a smile and treated to a world-class meal.

name: B66 Brunch Brew & Bar B Que
description: B66 Brunch Brew & Bar B Que is known to serve up some of the best barbecue with great service in their area. Their staff are there to make sure that all of your needs are attended to. They make cool and exciting drinks that you can enjoy with friends and family. Their environment is perfect for a good time with good people.

name: Kosher Deluxe
description: With a menu simply overflowing with favorites, you won't go hungry at Kosher Deluxe. A cozy fast-casual spot, this is a great place to take the whole family for a delicious meal. Enjoy tasty Chinese favorites like beef and broccoli, chicken lo mein, or curry chicken. For classic American fare, try a juicy burger, BBQ chicken wings, or a chili dog. Other popular menu choices include homemade soups, exciting shnitzel dishes, and shwarma. Health-conscious diners can enjoy wholesome fare like healthy grilled salmon, grilled chicken wraps, or the falafel platter. Specialty sushi rolls are also sure to please. Shabbas specials are available on Thursdays and Fridays and party platters will make your next event a hit. For glatt kosher food that everyone will love, there's no place like Kosher Deluxe.

name: Marcellino
description: A cozy and attractive restaurant with Old World charm, Marcellino is an excellent locale for a fun and memorable romantic date. Begin your meal with traditional appetizers like calamari fritti with marinara sauce and lemon, Polpette de la Nonna (homemade meatballs in tomato sauce), and antipasti for two with assorted cold cuts and cheeses, wood-fired vegetables antipasti, olives, and bruschetta tomato. For the main event, enjoy delicious entrees like veal Parmigiana, seared salmon with white wine-mustered sauce, and wood-fired chicken served with wood-fired potatoes and broccoli rabe. Popular pasta dishes include spaghetti pomodoro, rigatoni Siciliana, and fettuccine carbonara featuring flat fresh pasta and classic Roman sauce with pancetta, egg yolk, cream, salt, and pepper. Wood-fired pizzas like the Margherita, pesto, and Bianca with creamy ricotta, mozzarella, Parmesan, and Gorgonzola cheese are also not to be missed. Complement your meal with a cold beer, glass of wine, or an expert-made cocktail. Impressive service and an amazing meal are waiting for you at Marcellino.

name: Let's Yo
description: Let's Yo, situated in Montclair, NJ, specializes in frozen yogurt, offering customers a plethora of delectable combinations to choose from. With a wide array of toppings available, patrons can customize their frozen delights to their heart's content. Payment is based on weight, ensuring that customers have the flexibility to create their perfect treat without limitations.

name: Jersey Mike's Subs
description: Jersey Mike's Subs has become a fan-favorite chain for subs since their opening in 1956. They offer a sub above - one that's measured in more than inches or seconds 'til served. They carefully consider every aspect of what they do - every slice, every sandwich, every store - and provide customers with sustenance and substance too.

name: Blue Ribbon Bakery and Cafe
description: Blue Ribbon Bakery is a delightful haven for pastry enthusiasts, where the aroma of freshly baked goods welcomes guests into a cozy and inviting space. Renowned for its artisanal approach, Blue Ribbon Bakery crafts an array of mouthwatering pastries, bread, and cakes using high-quality ingredients, ensuring each bite is a delectable experience.

name: Alchemy Aqua Vitae
description: "Hand crafted with love and served with pride," Alchemy Aqua Vitae has been serving Lincoln since November 2017. Alchemy is about creation; about taking what might not be, what might not even be possible, and transforming it into reality. With a stellar lineup of hand-crafted food and drinks, there's something for everyone to love about Alchemy!

name: Magpie's Den & Pen
description: When looking for a fun and cozy atmosphere to eat some great food and enjoy a cold beer or crafted cocktail with friends and family, Magpie's Den & Pen is the place for you! Enjoy 16 beers on tap, canned beers, craft cocktails, a uniquely curated food menu, plenty of TVs for sports, and a jukebox for playing all the hits!

name: Gino's Pizza & Sports Bar of Mystic
description: Gino's Pizza & Sports Bar of Mystic is a vibrant establishment nestled in the heart of Mystic, exuding an inviting atmosphere that effortlessly blends the thrill of sports with the comfort of authentic Italian cuisine. Boasting a lively ambiance, it's a popular haunt for locals and visitors alike, drawn in by the tantalizing aromas of freshly baked pizzas and the excitement of the latest sports matchups. The menu at Gino's Pizza & Sports Bar is a testament to classic Italian fare, featuring an array of handcrafted pizzas, generously topped with premium ingredients, as well as hearty pasta dishes, flavorful sandwiches, and crisp salads. Each bite is a symphony of flavors, crafted with care and served with a smile.

name: Bigoi Venezia
description: In the small towns in the Veneto region of northern Italy, family kitchens prepare natural, wholesome food. It was this notion, to bring the flavors of home kitchens in Veneto to hungry diners in New York City, that inspired Bigoi Venezia. Featuring bigoi pasta, a traditional pasta that dates back to the 1600s, this incredible pasta is made on-site from scratch and topped with a variety of sauces. This fast-casual eatery is designed for diners on the go. There are a few counter seats, but this is primarily a take-out location. Get your pasta fix here with hand-crafted sauces that celebrate the flavors and ingredients of Italy. Try the classic al pomodoro with garden-fresh tomatoes and Grana Padano cheese, or try the meaty Bolognese. There are other varieties to try, and each is reasonably priced making Bigoi Venezia a great choice when craving pasta or whenever you're in the mood for a hearty and oh-so good meal!

name: The Gate House
description: The Gate House features traditional Neapolitan wood-fired pizza, gourmet burgers, innovative sandwiches, fresh salads and homemade desserts - all served in a beautiful European cafe atmosphere. The restaurant's deliciously crispy wood-fired pizza is made with Italian flour, imported San Marzano tomatoes and the freshest meats, produce and cheeses money can buy. But the 1/3-lb. fresh-pressed, made-to-order burgers are just as tempting, expecially since their named after local heroes, like The Wease topped with smoked mozzarella, fried onions and a tangy horseradish steak sauce. The Gate House also offers a Wagyu Beef upgrade for all burgers. And, of course, look for plenty of favorite local noshes, such as Buffalo Chicken Wings, tender wood-fired Ribs, outrageous Garlic Rosemary Fries, and even more outrageous Pigs-in-a-Blanket made with Zweigle's White Hots and served with sweet onion relish and spicy mustard sauce. PARTY & MEETING FACILITIES: The Gate House now offers the amenities of a private room, fully outfitted with A/V equipment, that seats up to 35. If a party, sales meeting or club luncheon is on your upcoming agenda, keep The Gate House in mind to ensure a successful event that fits your budget to a tee.

name: Blind Pig Tavern - Campus
description: Since 1998, the Blind Pig Tavern has been known as the area's best place to go when looking for fun, relaxation and a delicious meal. Head over today and catch the big game on any of their TVs, or just unwind over a great meal and drinks. Perfect for lunch, dinner, late-night eats and drinks anytime, this outstanding neighborhood bar and grill really does have it all. Go hungry and feast on any of their specialty burgers, or build your own creation. Or, try any of their subs, wraps, dogs, sandwiches, and entrées like the BBQ Plate with finger lickingly delish smoked pulled pork. Another great option is to make a feast out of eminently munchable favorites like their plump and juicy Wings, Fried Dill Pickles or the Gravy Cheese Fries. Combine all this and more with friendly service and a comfortable and casual ambiance, and you've got the Blind Pig Tavern!

name: Filippou's Twisted Pizza
description: Looking for the perfect place to grab a delicious slice of pizza? Come on down to Filippou's Twisted Pizza for an option that is sure to hit the spot! They know how to do it right with fresh and delicious pies crafted to absolute perfection. Stop by today to build your own from the best quality ingredients available.

name: District 6
description: District 6 Gastrobar and Kitchen is a trendy and eclectic eatery known for its innovative Indo-Chinese fusion cuisine. District 6 caters to those looking for brewpub bites or something a little more. Check out their weekday happy hour deals and one of the 14 TVs in their dining room or bar area to catch the game. Hit some pool, order a drink, and grab a bite at this lively spot.

name: Rio Mambo - Colleyville
description: Rio Mambo serves quality Tex Mex cuisine with a Mexico inspired interior design. With 2 full dining rooms, two separate bars and a large patio that is temperature controlled, there are no tables too small or no tables too large. Set with a cosmopolitan décor, it can be as elegant or as casual as you like- you decide!

name: Casa de Pancho - Anaheim
description: Craving Mexican cuisine? Check out Casa de Pancho, a tasty spot right inside Anaheim GardenWalk. Right next to Disneyland, you can feast on flavorful and authentic fare made from the finest ingredients. Wash down your pick with a fruity margarita or icy-cold cerveza. Indoor and outdoor dining is available here, along with private party space.

name: Jeff's Country Cafe
description: Breakfast ... Lunch ... Dinner ... Dine-in ... Takeout ... Whatever your druthers, Jeff's has got the goods. In fact, here's how one loyal patron put it, "No, Jeff's Cafe isn't fancy and the waitresses are strictly business. But what you WILL get is great food at an incredibly low price. I ordered a chicken fried steak with mashed potatoes, corn and a side salad. My daughter got the meatloaf. The steak was tender enough that I could have cut it with a spoon. The mashed potatoes were REAL potatoes, and the sweet corn was delicately seasoned. My cost for both meals? Around $12! I've eaten at restaurants all over the world and the USA, and this is the one that I'll keep coming back to. The food is cheap, hot, and tastes like Grandma made it. I can't imagine not being satisfied with that." So there you have it. This weigh station is a find! The all-day breakfasts are absolutely amazing. But rest assured, Jeff's Homemade Soups, Salads, Burgers and Sandwiches are every bit as good. And talk about value! Jeff's features Steak, Chop and Seafood Dinners (with 2 veggies, a dinner salad and roll) for under $10, and we're talking about 10-oz. Ribeye Steak or 6-oz. NY Strip with 4 Jumbo Shrimp.  Additionally, look for Daily Dinner Specials (Polish Sausage & Saurkraut, Liver & Onions, Turkey or Roast Beef & Dressing) for just $4 - $5.40, and you can add on a drink, salad and slice of cake for just $3 more. Raved yet another loyal fan, "Jeff's is the place to go if you're on a budget! Quality food for low, low prices with wonderful service. The wait staff is great. This place has regulars for a reason."

name: Meet Fresh  Manhattan
description: Meet Fresh serves products that are made, cooked, and served fresh daily to ensure the best and healthiest desserts. Try their handmade Taro Balls, traditional Tofu Pudding that will melt in your mouth, or their Herbal Jelly! Apart from traditional desserts, they also serve a wide range of drinks so you can have a variety to choose from!

name: New Orleans Daiquiri Bar and Grill
description: The New Orleans Daiquiri Bar and Grill is a beloved establishment nestled in the heart of the bustling city. Known for its vibrant atmosphere and delectable offerings, this hotspot attracts locals and tourists alike with its enticing array of frozen daiquiris and authentic New Orleans cuisine. The menu boasts an impressive selection of Creole and Cajun delights, from savory po'boys overflowing with seafood to hearty bowls of gumbo brimming with flavor. Each dish is a testament to the rich culinary heritage of the region, prepared with care and served with a side of Southern hospitality.

name: Dudley Cafe
description: Dudley Cafe is an award-winning gem that's a popular destination for breakfast, brunch, and lunch. This local spot is dedicated to crafting wholesome food, and it is a big supporter of the community and the arts. Check out the all-day breakfast picks, or dig into hearty sandwiches, rice bowls, tacos, burritos, and so much more.

name: The Mad Greek
description: A Lawrence institution for over 20 years, The Mad Greek is family owned and operated, and uses family recipes straight from Greece and Italy to bring you authentically delicious meals you won't soon forget. Open daily for lunch and dinner--with a buffet on Sundays--The Mad Greek has something that is sure to please everyone in your party. For a taste of Greece, choose among options like gyros, spinach pie, chicken sharas, leg of lamb, souvlaki, and moussaka. If you're more in the mood for Italian, selections include the spaghetti trio, gnocchi carbonara, chicken alfredo, shrimp fettuccine, and beef or cheese ravioli. The Mad Greek's bar offers a wide selection of beer, wine, and cocktails, and has happy hour specials from 4-6 p.m. Monday-Thursday. A family business who treats their guests like one of their own, The Mad Greek is eager to serve you some of their unique dishes and introduce you home cooking like you've never experienced.

name: Cork Crush
description: Cork Crush is a wine and beer house designed to provide a community-focused experience for enjoying wine and craft beer in a relaxed atmosphere. The establishment showcases a variety of unique wines from lesser-known regions across the U.S. and around the world, as well as a selection of craft beers. They offer wine by the glass, bottle, and tasting flights, along with a menu of light fare such as charcuterie, paninis, and flatbreads. Cork Crush also features a comfortable indoor lounge and a dog-friendly outdoor patio, enhancing its appeal as a casual, inviting spot for locals and visitors alike.

name: Jersey Mike's Subs - Tigard
description: Everything about Jersey Mike's is high quality. Their certified Angus beef top rounds are trimmed and cooked right in the store. The meats and cheeses are all top-quality premium brands, and the bread is baked fresh each day on the premises. Plus, everything's prepared right in front of you, exactly the way you want it.

name: Vanilla Gorilla Cafe
description: Vanilla Gorilla Café is an authentic NYC coffee shop. Our barista bar serves the highest quality artisan crafted coffee and specialty signature drinks. Home of the Original Pastrino, their creative kitchen uses the world's best ingredients with a touch of creativity. Enjoy their Pastrinos and specialty sandwiches all made fresh on the spot!

name: Caffe Dello Sport
description: Located in Boston's North End "Little Italy" neighborhood, Caffe Dello Sport is THE spot for Italian locals, soccer fans, coffee aficionados, and anyone who loves friendly service, good food, and authentic European charm. This cozy cafe will satisfy any kind of thirst with their full espresso bar and selection of wine, beer, and cocktails. Open from early morning until late in the evening, stop in any time of day to enjoy a fresh, expertly-made espresso made more delicious when paired with light and sweet pastries like puffy profiteroles.  For hungry visitors looking for more than coffee and pastries, an item from their menu of sandwiches and salads is sure to satisfy. Try the prosciutto panini, a winning combination of Parma prosciutto, fresh mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil stuffed between two slices of bread then grilled to perfection. When it's time to meet the demands of a sweet tooth, the salted caramel souffle, a chocolate cake with a warm caramel center and served with vanilla gelato, is the perfect choice. With a full menu of  Italian pastries and gelatos, there's no better place for an afternoon or after-dinner treat. Ample window seating indoors and outdoor seating make Caffe Dello Sport the ideal location to sit and enjoy the flavors of Italy with the sights and sounds of historic Boston.

name: Fired Pie
description: If you love pizza, then Fired Pie needs to be on your radar. Their motto is, "You inspire, we fire" and they offer fast, casual rich in flavor customizable pizzas and salads. Always made from scratch from the best quality ingredients, this is customized dining at its best. And now with more locations than ever before, you can get a tasty meal in minutes. Build your own pizza creation from the dough up. Each 11-inch pie can be topped with a variety of sauces, cheeses, meats and veggies. Or, pick from signature pies like the pesto chicken with fresh mozzarella, chicken, tomato and red onion, or the meaty Italian that's loaded with pepperoni, salami, capicola and sausage. The salads are also customizable, and like the pizzas, there are tasty signature greens to try. Quick, convenient and oh-so tasty, the pizzas, salads and brews at Fired Pie are always tops!

name: Richardson's Downtown Sports Bar and Grill
description: Richardson's Downtown Sports Bar and Grill is a lively hub, pulsating with the energy of sports enthusiasts and food aficionados alike. With its inviting ambiance, patrons can relish in a diverse menu boasting classic bar fare alongside innovative culinary delights, all while catching the latest game on multiple screens. Whether it's unwinding with friends over a pint of craft beer or savoring their signature burgers, Richardson's promises an unforgettable experience for every visitor.

name: The Hyderabad Indian Grill
description: The Hyderabad Indian Grill is the perfect place to enjoy all your favorite hand-crafted and oh-so flavorful Indian dishes. There's plenty to tempt you, including tasty picks like masala dosas, garlic naan bread, chicken biryani, and plenty of vegetarian dishes. Open for dinner, go hungry and go often to try everything at this popular eatery!

name: Lefty's Pizza Kitchen
description: Lefty's Pizza Kitchen is home of the caramelized crust! Originally based in Chicago, this famous pizzeria now has locations opening up across the country. They serve fresh thin-crust and pan pizza. This fan-favorite destination is a go-to neighborhood pizzeria committed to providing a satisfying and convenient dining experience!

name: South Boston Candlepin
description: For more than 20 years, South Boston Candlepin bowling alley has been a meeting place and a great spot for family fun. In addition to plenty of bowling lanes, you'll find a huge variety of microbrew craft beers to sip on while you bowl. With good prices and a laid-back vibe, this no-frills spot is a local hangout for having a great time!

name: Ama Raw Bar West Village
description: Ama Raw Bar focuses on classic Asian flavors, offering delights such as oysters, shrimp cocktail, bao buns, and lobster ramen. Their bar complements the dining experience with seasonal craft cocktails, well-priced wines, and a rotating beer list. Situated in East Village, Ama Raw Bar also provides outdoor seating, a tropical patio, and a private lounge, the "Kiki Room," making it an ideal space for private parties and events.

name: American Prime
description: American Prime Steakhouse is your new favorite go to spot for all things high class and delicious. This local hotspot is known for making all of their dishes using only the freshest ingredients, so you're guaranteed a great meal every time! Stop by today for an extraordinary selection of seafood, steaks and other steakhouse options. Ask about their private event room and catering.

name: The Blind Pig of Westchester
description: With amazing hand-crafted cocktails and a lively vibe, The Blind Pig of Westchester is a speakeasy that'll make you feel like you're in Manhattan. One step through the door and you'll be in another world where a classy and casual vibe blend to create an ambiance that's perfect for catching up with friends over a drink or two.

name: Humming Bird Jerk Center
description: Get a taste of the islands at Hummingbird Jerk Center, a casual spot that's dishing up authentic Jamaican eats. From oxtails and curry goat to ackee and saltfish, there's plenty on the menu to tempt you. Always hand-crafted from the best ingredients, you can skip the airfare and take a trip to this local gem instead when craving a delish meal!

name: Melinda's Coffee Corner & Cafe
description: Melinda's Coffee Corner & Cafe is a charming coffee shop known for its high-quality coffee and delightful homemade pastries. The cafe offers a variety of breakfast and lunch options, all made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. With its cozy and inviting atmosphere, Melinda's Coffee Corner & Cafe provides a perfect setting for relaxation, work, or casual meet-ups.

name: Sinigual
description: Sinigual is your urban haven, tucked away in the center of Manhattan City and just three blocks from Grand Central Station. Sinigual makes dishes that are unmatched and irresistible by using only farm-fresh ingredients and traditional Mexican cooking methods.

name: Hub Thai
description: Hub Thai restaurant is New York's latest place to savor the exquisite and mouthwatering traditional dishes from Thailand. The restaurant has an air of a French Café or an English bistro. With friendly, attentive staffs and delightful aroma from the kitchen, Hub Thai is all about delivering a unique Thai ambiance.

name: Geo's Fine Wine & Champagne
description: Geo's Fine Wine & Champagne is a family-run fine wine and champagne bar located in Ybor City. They take pride in offering a wide variety of selections and charcuterie boards. Try wine and champagne imported from countries around the world, and pair with a vast array of meats and cheeses from the same regions.

name: DBL
description: DBL bar and lounge in New York is a sophisticated nightlife destination, renowned for its chic ambiance and extensive cocktail menu. Featuring a selection of premium spirits and expertly crafted cocktails, the bar offers a stylish setting for socializing and relaxation.

name: Black Iron Burger
description: Wherever you join them in NYC, Black Iron Burger will always feel like home! They have been voted the Best Burger in NYC and are committed to staying true to that title. Stop by today for fine dining, chef-based burgers, craft beer, and cocktails! This is the perfect place for sports watching, private parties, or late-night DJs.

name: The Lazy Donkey
description: Treat yourself to mouthwatering Mexican cuisine at The Lazy Donkey. The lively eatery has a fun, colorful atmosphere perfect for celebrating any occasion with delectable bites and refreshing margaritas and cocktails. Choose from a variety of tasty selections including sizzling fajitas, fresh chicken, pork and seafood dishes, loaded nachos, and so much more.

name: Jimboy's Tacos
description: There are tacos, and then there are TACOS, and when you want the best of the best, check out Jimboy's Tacos. For more than 50 years they've been creating the tastiest, the best and the most fabulous tacos, and now with more locations than ever before, getting your hands on their amazing food is easier than ever. Their Ground Beef Tacos are legendary, but if you want something a bit different, there are always plenty of options. Try the Shrimp Tacos, Bean Tostadas, Chile Rellenos, Enchiladas and more. Can't decide? Don't stress over all the tantalizing dishes, opt instead for one of their amazing combination plates and make a full meal out of some of your favorites. Plus, there are always plenty of vegetarian options, which makes this eatery ideal for everyone. Don't be fooled, however, this isn't your typical fast food joint. Everything at this eatery is made fresh each day - this means that you're going to get the very best tasting and authentic tacos each and every time you visit. The next time you're craving an outstanding meal and some of the freshest tacos and other Tex-Mex delights for breakfast, lunch or dinner, check out Jimboy's Tacos - stop by today!

name: Balkan Taste
description: Traditional Balkan cuisine is all about hearty stick-to-your-ribs fare like burek (meat pies), skewers of grilled meat, and thick and juicy chops. You'll find all this and more at Balkan Taste, a place which specializes in not only Balkan dishes, but also modern European cuisine. The diverse menu offers something for every taste -- from Italian specialties to fresh seafood and Mediterranean fare, you can dine on something new every time you go. And, if you're looking for even more variety, ask about the Chef-prepared daily specials. With a family friendly dining room along with private rooms for your next special event or meeting, from the food to the service, there's everything to love about the Balkan Taste restaurant!

name: Over Easy - Queen Creek
description: Over Easy is serving up classic American breakfast selections that are sure to brighten your morning. Featured on the Food Network, the welcoming eatery invites all to indulge in its scratch-made cuisine and friendly staff will make you feel right at home. Choose from a variety of tasty options including fluffy omelets, waffle dogs, and zesty chilaquiles.

name: LemonShark Poke - Culver City
description: LemonShark Poke takes its name from the lemon shark, a particularly discerning shark who only feeds on the highest quality of fish. With this inspiration in mind, LemonShark created a "fine casual" dining experience that features deliciously healthy dishes prepared with high-quality and sustainable ingredients. Following their step-by-step process, you can build your own perfect poke bowl by choosing a base (rice, greens, noodles, crispy wontons), a protein (ahi tuna, salmon, shrimp, albacore, octopus, tofu, lemongrass chicken, and more), fresh veggie and fruit toppings, a sauce, and an element of crunch. If you're not feeling creative, LemonShark has signature bowl creations to get you started, like the California Roll Bowl and Maui Heat Wave. Their menu also offers Hawaiian katsu grill plates, finger foods like egg rolls and tempura shrimp, and a collection of craft beer and hot or cold sake. The casual dining space is perfect for enjoying a meal with friends or family, or you can have your order packed up for an on-the-go meal that's actually good for you. Always fresh and fantastic, LemonShark Poke will redefine how you think about fast casual dining.

name: Jack's Slice
description: Whether you're a few strokes from getting a PGA invite or just looking for a great meal, Jack's Slice is a great find any way you cut it. Conveniently located on the Allentown Municipal Golf Course in the city's west end, Jack's Slice is the perfect place for a mid-round bite or just to enjoy a drink, some great food, and the most amazing view in Allentown. Many already know their incredible pizza from their other Jack's Pizza locations, but this spot offers a lot more than those classic tastes. Here you'll find a pair of outdoor patios that are perfect for unwinding and for watching your favorite game on the big screen. The comfortable indoor bar includes multiple flat screen TVs too, and when paired with the remodeled dining room and large comfortable patios, ensures there's not a bad seat in the house. Open seven days a week to both golfers and the public, Jack's Slice keeps things rolling from 6 a.m. until 10 p.m., turning out fine breakfast, lunch, and dinner fare that is impossible to pass up, whether it's one of the famed pizzas, an Angus burger, hot sandwich, or other tasty bite. Quick service is always a priority for those looking to tee-off or a convenient mid-game meal.

name: Radio Coffee and Beer
description: Radio Coffee and Beer is a vibrant Austin hotspot, where the aroma of freshly brewed coffee mingles with the lively hum of conversation. With its eclectic decor, comfortable seating, and a diverse menu of craft beers and specialty coffees, it offers a welcoming space for both remote work and social gatherings. Whether you're savoring a rich espresso or enjoying a cold brew on the spacious outdoor patio, Radio Coffee and Beer is a must-visit destination for those seeking a laid-back atmosphere and quality beverages.

name: Dao Dim Sum & Chinese Cuisine
description: Nestled in the vibrant core of a bustling city, Dao Dim Sum & Chinese Cuisine beckons as a culinary sanctuary, providing a genuine experience of traditional Chinese gastronomy. Central to the essence of Dao Dim Sum & Chinese Cuisine is its meticulously curated menu, a testament to the expansive tapestry of Chinese culinary heritage. Each dish, whether it be the intricate flavors of delicate dim sum or the robust authenticity of cherished main courses, reflects the dedication and artistry of the skilled culinary team.

name: Station Tap
description: Station Tap is a place of pure enjoyment and utter relaxation in one of the most vibrant areas of Delaware County. Enjoy modern comfort cuisine and healthy options, along with fine craft beers and seasonal cocktails. The quality lies in the composition of the best products at this must-try destination.

name: The Tav
description: Drink, dine, relax and unwind over at The Tav. This local hotspot is a cozy, casual neighborhood bar and grill. You can dine in for lunch and dinner with friends and family, and make sure to check out their happy hour menu for all kinds of refreshing deals! Whatever you're in the mood for, you can count on this place to be a good time.

name: Applebee's Grill + Bar
description: Applebee's Grill + Bar is a popular American casual dining restaurant chain known for its diverse menu and vibrant atmosphere. Offering a wide range of dishes, from signature burgers and appetizers to hearty steaks and salads, Applebee's caters to everyone's tastes. With a welcoming ambiance, friendly service, and locations across the United States, it has become a go-to destination for those seeking a relaxed dining experience with familiar favorites.

name: Kahwa Coffee Roasting
description: Since they first started roasting coffee back in 2005 in sunny St. Petersburg, Kahwa has combined passion and expertise to provide discerning establishments all over Florida first-rate coffee products. But, there's no better way to enjoy these delicious brews than at the source, and that's why a visit to Kahwa's own cafe can provide a perfect way to kick off your morning at a local coffee chain that roasts its own coffee. Here, you'll find plenty of great coffees and high-quality coffee drinks whether you're heading over in the morning hours, need a pick-me-up to get through the rest of the afternoon, or heading back home after a full day's labor. While you sip on a latte, tea, fresh juice, or one of the other masterfully created drinks, grab something to eat from a lineup that includes fresh baked pastries, muffins, sweet treats and more. You can also get coffee by the pound to take home and enjoy. Casual, fast, and full of flavor, Kahwa continues its mission to bring Florida locals and travelers the finest coffee around. It all adds up to make Kahwa Coffee Roasting a great destination, and it is why it is continually winning awards year after year!

name: The Cove Brewery
description: The Cove Brewery is a trendy hotspot known for its craft beers and laid-back vibe. With a spacious outdoor patio and a stylish interior, it's the perfect place to unwind with friends or enjoy a casual date night. Their rotating selection of unique brews and delicious pub grub ensures there's something to satisfy every beer aficionado's palate.

name: La Palapa
description: La Palapa is the home of authentic Mexico City-style and regional home cooking.  It is named after a palm-thatched shelter often found on Mexican beaches where you can relax with your feet in the sand looking at the ocean while you sip an ice cold drink or eat a spicy meal.  The restaurant uses this concept to focus on its authentic cuisine through dishes like tacos al pastor, mol enegro oaxaqueno, salsa pibil and many other specialties from different regions of Mexico.  Their salsas and sauces are rich and spicy, created from fresh and healthy ingredients.  Also enjoy their fresh fruit margaritas, sangrias and extensive tequila selection!  Happy hour at the bar is Sunday through Friday from 5-7 p.m. with two-for-one margaritas, sangrias, draft beer and food from the special bar "Bocadillos" menu.  La Palapa's offers a new bento box Monday through Friday from noon until 7 p.m., and La Palapa waives the corkage fee every Monday so you can bring a bottle of wine to enjoy with your favorite Mexican meal.

name: RJ's Pizza
description: RJ's Pizza is a family-owned pizzeria and restaurant serving delicious New York style pizzas made from only the freshest, highest quality ingredients. They make their mozzarella fresh in-house, as well as their bread! They also serve fresh hot and cold subs, soups and salads, tasty appetizers, lunch specials, and delicious dinners.

name: Herbie's - Clayton
description: Herbie's, a delightful fusion of New American and French cuisines, beckons diners into a world where culinary artistry meets refined elegance. With a menu expertly curated to blend contemporary flavors with French culinary traditions, Herbie's promises a dining experience that harmoniously bridges the best of both worlds.

name: San Remo Pizza
description: A family-owned and operated pizzeria, San Remo Pizza has proudly served the central New Jersey area since 1969. They have the pizzas and pastas that you're craving, as well as appetizers, salads, dinners, calzones and sandwiches. Their hand-tossed pizzas are made fresh to order, and their sauces are packed with authentic flavor!

name: Saldivia's South American Grill
description: Saldivia's South American Grill is a family-run restaurant that offers diners a truly original culinary experience, specializing in dishes crafted from timeless family recipes culled from Uruguay and Argentina. The neighborhood atmosphere is warm and inviting, a mood the staff works hard to create for each dinner passing through Saldivia's doors. The menu is brimming with Uruguay- and Argentina-style grilled steaks, chicken, and seafood items that bring fresh flavors and classic tastes to your dining experience every time you visit. While the South American-style steaks are great on their own, there's a selection on the wine list that can add a bit of perfection to each meal. Pick from an assortment of Parrillada/Spanish varietals, as well as fine Malbecs and Chilean wines. With such great food, superb staff, and an excellent wine list, it's easy to see how Saldivia's ended up rated as a Top 20 Restaurant in Houston. If you're planning a special event, Saldivia's has a private room to accommodate your party. The restaurant is open for lunch Monday, lunch and dinner Tuesday-Friday, and dinner only Saturday and Sunday. If you can't find the time to relax for a while, just grab Saldivia's finest to-go and enjoy the food at your convenience.

name: Crab Du Jour - Savannah
description: Check out the amazingly fresh Cajun-style low country boils and more at Crab Du Jour Cajun Seafood Restaurant. This is a comfortable and casual spot where big flavors and fresh ingredients combine to impress every diner. Crab, crawfish, calamari, lobsters and more are just-off-the-boat fresh and served a variety of ways here.

name: Jerry's Pizza
description: Jerry's Pizza has been a staple of dining in Longwood, Florida for over 30 years. Family owned and operated, Jerry's Pizza has served thousands of homes and businesses in Seminole County with authentic Italian recipes, premium ingredients, and an unbeatable taste you simply cannot find anywhere else.

name: Johnny Rockets
description: Johnny Rockets is an international restaurant franchise that offers high quality, innovative menu items including fresh, never frozen 100% beef cooked-to-order hamburgers, Veggie Boca® burger, chicken sandwiches, crispy fries and rich, delicious hand-spun shakes and malts. This dynamic lifestyle brand offers friendly service and upbeat music contributing to the chain's signature atmosphere of relaxed, casual fun. Founded in 1986, Johnny Rockets operates more than 350 franchise and corporate locations in 28 countries around the world. For more information, visit www.johnnyrockets.com.

name: Tremendo Taco
description: Tremendo Taco is a must-try destination for flavorful, exciting tacos. Their menu is chef-driven with the collaboration of Chef Jorge Guadiana. Stop by today and grasp the street feel of a taqueria that brings people together. Their tacos come with a double tortilla, your choice of meat or veggies, and chopped onion and cilantro on the side.

name: Carl's Jr.
description: In the mood for a convenient and satisfying meal? Come check out Carl's Jr for an option that hits every single time. This classic American favorite is known for their delicious angus burgers stacked with bacon and onion. They also serve breakfast! Come try their Monster Biscuit or the Breakfast Burger to start your day off with a bang.

name: Fresh Baked Cafe - Elm Grove
description: Fresh Baked Cafe is a family-owned business that strives to share the authentic European Cafe experience. They have a unique menu with staple items that are available everyday as well as new creations that change regularly. Step into their welcoming atmosphere and grab a cup of coffee with one of their signature croissants!

name: Ella's Public House
description: Ella's Public House is proud to be part of Delafield's growing food scene. They feature a chef-driven kitchen, providing a casual environment with quality food and drink, including WI craft and microbrew beers, specialty cocktails, traditional WI fish fry, and American pub food. Make a reservation online to ensure your spot at this local popular destination.

name: Longhorn Barbecue
description: Longhorn Barbecue, born in 1945 in Houston, serves authentic Texas-style barbecue cooked in brick-fired pits. Today's pitmasters honor these traditions, offering a cozy dining room perfect for both intimate dates and family gatherings. Indulge in delicious appetizers like Longhorn Nachos or chicken wings with various BBQ sauces, followed by popular entrees such as baby back ribs, brisket sandwiches, or rib eye steak, all washed down with draft beer and capped off with desserts like hot apple pie or Grandma's Bread Pudding.

name: Caramba Bar & Grill
description: Looking for the perfect place to grab a delicious and convenient meal? Come on down to Caramba today, where they specialize in a variety of authentic Latin cuisine! Everything they serve is made from the freshest ingredients and absolutely packed with flavor. You can count on them for excellent service and a cheerful atmosphere!

name: Great Wall Express
description: Great Wall Express is renowned for its delicious Chinese cuisine served in a fast and convenient manner. Located in a bustling area, it attracts customers with its fresh ingredients and authentic flavors, satisfying cravings for those seeking a quick yet satisfying meal. With a diverse menu offering a range of classic dishes and serving Louisiana Fried Chicken, Great Wall Express is a go-to spot for locals looking for a flavorful dining experience on the go.

name: One Two Thai
description: One Two Thai is serving Far East soul food in New York City. They use only the freshest ingredients and produce to bring you quality Thai cuisine whether you're dining in, carrying out, or choosing delivery. The vibrant atmosphere, traditional decor, and exotic aromas carry you away to southeast Asia the moment you step through the doors. Pick appetizers to share like flavorful fried chicken gyoza, chive dumplings, and fried tofu served with sweet chili sauce and crushed peanut. Flavorful, freshly-made salads, soups, noodles, and curries abound on this tasty menu. Try one of their chef special's like the kaw nar kai -- marinated chicken with juicy shitake mushrooms, bamboo, Chinese broccoli, and soybeans smothered in delicious gravy sauce. Or create a unique dish that's all your own by choosing from savory sauce and vegetable bases and then selecting your meat and level of spice. And don't forget to save room for dessert -- banana dumplings and pumpkin custard are among the scrumptious selections. One Two Thai is open for lunch and dinner, so drop by and get your dose of tasty Thai cooking today.

name: Dickeys Barbecue Pit
description: Dickey's Barbecue Pit is an absolute YES! All their signature meats are smoked overnight, every night at their BBQ restaurant location. When the craving for authentic barbecue hits, just know that you have a Dickey's nearby that will serve you Texas-style BBQ just how you like it. Make sure to load up with their homestyle sides!

name: Stir House Atlanta
description: Stir House Atlanta in Atlanta, GA, offers customers healthy vegan options. All meals are gluten-free. Some of the popular food options include the Fried Buddha Basket, Wicked Fried Shrooms, fried shrimp, and Stir House Boxes.

name: Hana Matsuri Omakase - Glendale
description: Hana Matsuri Omakase in Glendale is a culinary gem known for its exquisite Japanese cuisine. Nestled in the heart of Glendale. From impeccably crafted sushi and sashimi to artfully presented omakase tasting menus, Hana Matsuri Omakase offers a dining experience that is both authentic and innovative. Whether patrons are seeking an intimate dinner or a special occasion celebration, Hana Matsuri Omakase promises a memorable culinary journey through Japan's culinary heritage.

name: Cattle Baron Steak & Seafood Restaurant
description: At Cattle Baron Steak & Seafood Restaurant, they know all about what it takes to serve dishes that will make you feel like a million bucks. Since 1976, diners have enjoyed the best steaks and seafood this side of the Pecos at this eatery, where all the beef served is hand-cut from quality, aged stock, and steaks are charbroiled to order. The house specialty prime rib will melt in your mouth, or you can sink your teeth into juicy and perfectly prepared steaks like the New York strip, filet mignon, or rib eye. Ready to try something new? Add some surf to your turf with lump crab and shrimp (Pontchartrain style), or top it off with sauteed mushrooms for a classic combination. Seafood options include deep-fried catfish, Australian lobster tail, Alaskan king crab legs, and the orange bourbon salmon. There's plenty more on the menu including fall-off-the-bone, tender baby back ribs; pastas; hearty salads; and burgers. Take a trip to the salad bar to complement your entree, or start with any of their tantalizing appetizers. After the first sip of your drink from the full-service bar, you'll agree that a spectacular meal complete with friendly and proficient service is only an order away when you dine at Cattle Baron Steak & Seafood.

name: Bigg's BBQ
description: Bigg's Barbecue likes to tout its "sports, ribs, and rock 'n' roll" theme, offering up a mix of sports bar atmosphere and casual comfort fare. Situated in the space that once housed Molly McGees, Bigg's now provides a simple and family-friendly scene, where a variety of guests can settle in to sample the restaurant's starters, salads, soups, sandwiches, and more for lunch and dinner.  From the pulled pork nachos to the Texas pot roast, Bigg's serves up hearty portions. Selections from the "Bigg Time Barbecue" include beef brisket, St. Louis cut ribs, and even burnt ends, and come with two of the more than a dozen options. Bigg's differs from traditional Kansas City-style barbecue by serving their meats without sauce, instead presenting them on the side, allowing diners to savor several different flavors. With 16 television monitors, Bigg's makes it easy for sports fans to keep up with their favorite game.

name: Apna Indian Kitchen
description: Apna Indian Kitchen is a restaurant specializing in authentic Indian cuisine, offering a diverse menu rich with traditional dishes such as biryanis, curries, and tandoori items. The restaurant is known for its use of fresh, high-quality ingredients and aromatic spices, creating flavorful and memorable dining experiences. With a warm and inviting atmosphere, Apna Indian Kitchen provides a perfect setting for enjoying a genuine taste of India.

name: Inday  Nomad
description: Featuring build-your-own bowls, Inday is a modern and inviting Indian eatery with counter service. Stop by and mix and match from a variety of proteins, bases, sides, and sauces. Signature bowl creations offer tried-and-true flavor combinations. Perfect for quick meals, dine-in or take something terrific to-go today from this popular spot.

name: Sunrise Waffle Shop
description: Since 1991, Sunrise Waffle has been serving up delicious home-style breakfast that is sure to make your mouth water. From omelets and waffles to soups and sandwiches, this casual eatery has all your breakfast and lunch needs covered. In a rush? Order online for delivery or pickup and treat yourself to a meal unlike any other.

name: Happy Chicks
description: Happy Chicks is a popular eatery specializing in crispy, flavorful chicken tenders and sandwiches. The casual and welcoming atmosphere makes it a go-to spot for comfort food lovers, with a menu that also includes fresh salads and tasty sides. Their focus on quality ingredients and bold flavors has made it a favorite among locals looking for a satisfying meal.

name: T-Swirl Crepe - Carrollton
description: Enjoy something deliciously different today at T-Swirl Crepe, a casual eatery that takes the best of French crepes and modernizes them with Japanese ingredients and techniques, creating food that's fun and tasty to eat. Here, you'll find a collection of sweet and savory eats that all start with their signature gluten-free crepe. Thin, a little bit chewy, and totally delicious, each crepe is freshly made before your eyes. Then, rolled into a cone and stuffed with high-quality and tasty ingredients, this is classy and gourmet food on the go! Love fruit? Try the crepe stuffed with mangoes and raspberries or the fully-loaded T-Swirl fruit cocktail. The tuna Nicoise is a delightful savory combination, and the Angus short rib is stuffed with tender slices of beef. There's plenty more to try, and there's quite a selection of refreshing drinks to sip on, too. It's all fresh, fast and fabulous at T-Swirl Crepe--check it out yourself today!

name: Outback Steakhouse 3222
description: Australia and barbecues go hand-in-hand, and while a trip down under might be out of the question, there's sure to be an Outback Steakhouse near you. Famous for a warm environment, generous portions, and juicy meats for an incredible price, they are a fan-favorite, Australian-inspired steakhouse complete with a full bar!

name: Old Lisbon Restaurant & Bar
description: Treat yourself to something different and dine at the award-wining Old Lisbon Restaurant and Bar. This is an elegant but still casual eatery that showcases the best flavors and dishes of Portugal. Known for humble ingredients and big, bold flavors, this amazing restaurant offers diners two different locations in which to enjoy their amazing food. At this location you'll find a full menu along with a wine list designed to complement the meals. Start with appetizers like the shrimp in garlic sauce or the codfish croquettes, or a classic like prosciutto with Portuguese cheese. Grilled lamb chops, steaks and chicken are on the menu for meat lovers, but if you like seafood, then you're in for a treat. Try the parrilhada de mariscos for one or two people, and feast on a combination of grilled lobster, scallops, shrimp, mussels, salmon and squid. Or, try the Portuguese version of paella which is a savory rice cooked with a variety of seafood and shellfish. There's more on the menu, making this a fun and tasty place to discover some of Portugal's favorite dishes. World class service accompanies every meal, making this a great restaurant for special occasions, date-night, entertaining clients, or for just about any reason at all.

name: Hudson Grille - Tucker
description: A spacious and casual decor, TVs on practically every available wall offering 360-degree views, a spacious and fully stocked bar, sports memorabilia throughout and friendly service are waiting for you at the All American Hudson Grille. Located in the Northlake area of Tucker, there's more to love about this place, including an awesome outdoor patio and a menu with plenty of choice for everyone. Ideal for lunch, dinner and late-night eats, head over today and fill up on tasty meals like the roasted corn lobster dip, the house-made potato chips, the lobster Cobb salad, south of the border fare and American classics like buttermilk fried chicken, peach BBQ baby back ribs, wings in a variety of sauces, sausages & dogs, half-pound and hand-pattied burgers, and more. Weekday lunch specials and other specials throughout the week, amped-up food, friendly service and all the sports you can handle make Hudson Grille one of the best sports bars and restaurants around!

name: Tautog Tavern
description: A culinary love letter to Connecticut, and Black Rock specifically, Tautog Tavern is a classic New England pub that features a menu of carefully curated dishes and drinks (and check out the memorabilia on the walls for a local history lesson). Offering both small bites and full-sized entrees, their plates are all made from scratch and utilize fresh ingredients that are locally sourced whenever possible. Popular favorites include the deviled eggs, chorizo burger, pork belly and brussels sprouts, tavern hanger steak, and a meatloaf sandwich. They also serve mix-and-match sliders in varieties like bang bang shrimp, Philly, fried chicken with sriracha mayo, and grilled chicken with bacon and cheddar. Their full-service bar offers an assortment of local, domestic, and imported beer, as well as wine and cocktails, and happy hour specials are available on select food and drink items Monday through Friday. Local musicians are often performing at Tautog Tavern, so be sure to check out their events calendar to see who's coming to visit, and if you have a special occasion coming up, they are available to host and cater. A laid-back joint where everyone is welcome, Tautog Tavern invites you to unwind over some cold drinks and fresh, local bites.

name: Anjappar Chettinad
description: Fans of authentic Chettinad Indian food can rejoice, for now NYC is home to the amazing Anjappar Authentic Chettinadu Restaurant. While Indian cuisine is celebrated for its plethora of scrumptious vegetarian cuisine, the food from this region of India features a variety of equally delicious vegetarian AND meat dishes. So, when you're craving signature Chettinadu curries like the Pepper Chicken Masala or the tandoori dishes like the Mali Kabab, there is no better place around. From dosais, Indian breads and their famous biryanis, there are plenty of tantalizing dishes on the menu from which to choose. Plus, by using only the very freshest and  highest quality ingredients, it doesn't really matter what you order because everything will be delicious. Perhaps it is the artful preparation, traditional cooking techniques or the judicious use of freshly ground spices - whatever the reason, every dish at this restaurant is full of flavor. While various cuts of meat are certainly a celebrated part of this restaurant, there are still plenty of vegetarian dishes which makes this eatery ideal for just about everyone. From business power lunches to romantic dates and family dinners, head to the Anjappar Authentic Chettinadu Restaurant today when you're craving a scrumptious meal and some of the best Indian cuisine  you can imagine!

name: Dutch Baby Bakery
description: Dutch Baby Bakery is a family-owned bakery that specializes in fresh seasonal pastries, breads, cakes and a delicious breakfast and lunch menu. This local hotspot is one of the few bakeries in their area to bake fresh bread onsite, making it the freshest you can buy! Make sure to try their fan-favorite lemon chiffon layer cake.

name: Salt N Pepper Dine and Wine
description: With Indian and Chinese cuisine hand-crafted from seasonal and local ingredients, Salt N Pepper Dine & Wine is a cozy and inviting place for the whole family to enjoy flavor-packed dishes. This local gem features a welcoming dining room and a big menu where you can mix-and-match between Indian and Chinese dishes to get the meal you're craving. Check out the biryanis, grilled kabobs and lamb chops, chats, and paneer. There are also favorites like butter chicken and tandoor prawns. Or, try something a bit more Chinese, like the  spicy Szechuan fried rice or the fabulous Singapore noodles. There's more on the menu, and each order is made hot and fresh and just for you. Friendly and hospitable, you can dine inside or out at this popular eatery. Craving flavor? Head to Salt N Pepper Dine & Wine today!

name: Libertango
description: What happens when you take the tango and liberate it with a dose of daring flavor and modern elegance? Libertango! Come on in to Libertango for a fine dining experience that is rich in both worldly elegance and savory Argentine flavor. They offer sizzling high-end steaks, mouthwatering barbecue and succulent South American wines.

name: Milk & Hops/Twist
description: Milk & Hops Beer Tap & Bottle shop, located in the heart of Chelsea, offers over 300 bottles selection and 10 draught lines combined with an amazing selection of small appetizers. They are known for their amazing happy hour specials, Monday through Friday from 12 - 4 p.m. and 9 p.m. to close every night!

name: Bayside Lounge
description: With great food, cold drinks, and plenty of fun to be had, Bayside Lounge is a popular place to eat, drink, and have a great time. There's something for everyone here. If you're hungry, drop by for weekend breakfast, lunch, dinner, or late-night eats. There's lots on the menu, including saucy wings, pizzas, house-made crab cakes, big and juicy burgers, their famous fish and chips, sandwiches, and much more. The full bar is stocked with craft beers, premium spirits, and sippable wines, and it's the perfect place to be on game day or any day. Play a game of pool, cheer on your favorite team, or enjoy the live music and entertainment. Ask about the daily specials while you're there, and with plenty to eat, drink, see, and do, Bayside Lounge is always energized!

name: Waltham Pizza
description: Waltham Pizza is an award-winning eatery where you'll find delish pizzas, salads, sandwiches, their famous wings, and so much more. Always crafted from the finest and freshest ingredients, there's plenty here to tempt you. Reasonably priced and with friendly, efficient service, dine-in or take something tasty to-go today!

name: Thai Orchid
description: For more than 10 years, the Thai Orchid Restaurants have been serving fresh, flavorful and healthy food. Now with more locations than ever before, the next time  you're in the mood for a delicious and authentic meal, this needs to be your first stop. Owner Kat Saenguraiporn, the niece of the founder, is at the helm of this Vancouver location. With  a wealth of experience in customer service, your dining experience is sure to be exceptional. With warmth and hospitality in addition to artfully prepared food, you can experience the fresh, flavorful, healthy and award-winning cuisine at this eatery for lunch or dinner.  Starters like the chef's choice of sashimi or the crispy potstickers are terrific choices to begin any meal. Then, dine on maki, sushi, nigiri and more, or skip to the Thai classics like pad Thai, crispy basil duck, pad prik, curries, fried rice dishes, garlic shrimp, and more. To go with your meal, inquire about the selection of carefully chosen wines, then sit back and enjoy the service and what will surely be a terrific meal.

name: Papa Johns
description: Better ingredients really do make better pizzas, and at Papa John's, each hand-crafted and made-to-order pizza is fresh, hot, and delicious. They don't need gimmicks at this coast-to-coast pizza chain, because it's always just that good. Quality is at the core of everything they do, and from the pizza crust to the finishing toppings, it's all the best it can be. Curbside and contactless pickup available.

name: Little Thai Kitchen
description: At Little Thai Kitchen, they only use the best herbs and spices. They believe that getting the right combination of ingredients to create the perfect Thai dish is an art form, and they are committed to providing a relaxing atmosphere for any occasion. Stop by today to try their Pad Thai drunken noodles that are absolutely packed with flavor!

name: LA SANDWICHERIE
description: La Sandwicherie in New York is a charming sandwich shop known for its fresh, high-quality ingredients and an extensive selection of gourmet sandwiches. This cozy eatery, with its friendly atmosphere and efficient service, has become a favorite among locals and visitors alike. Renowned for its unique combinations of flavors and freshly baked bread, La Sandwicherie stands out as a must-visit destination for sandwich enthusiasts in New York City.

name: Riko's Pizza
description: Riko's Pizza is a popular pizzeria chain with multiple locations throughout the United States. They are known for their New York-style pizza, which typically features thin crust, 13 inch pizzas, and a variety of toppings. Focuses on using fresh ingredients and traditional pizza-making techniques to create flavorful and authentic pizzas. In addition to traditional toppings like pepperoni, sausage, and cheese, they may offer gourmet options such as specialty meats, vegetables, and unique flavor combinations.

name: Build My Burgers
description: For delish fries, massive shakes, beers, and of course amazing burgers, head to Build My Burgers. With a passion for creating the best burgers just how you like them, you can get your favorite topped just how you like it. And, every burger is hand-crafted from the freshest ingredients and they're made-to-order so they're always delicious.

name: Mesquite Fresh Street Mex
description: Mesquite Fresh Street Mex is a must-try destination for homemade Mexican cuisine. They are known for their fan-favorite street tacos that come with a variety of options for proteins and toppings of your choice, and they also serve other tasty and fresh options. You can count on them for an unforgettable meal and the quickest service around.

name: Torn Label Brewing
description: Torn Label Brewing is a friendly and casual taproom in the East Crossroads neighborhood. Featuring a stellar selection of craft brews, amazing eats, and good times, this can be your new go-to when going out for some fun. Check out the rotating taps, feast on one of the Chef's specials, or check out the amazing fries and their famous sauces.

name: Firehouse Subs - Belgate
description: People love a good meal, and at Firehouse Subs you can be sure that your meal will be terrific. Built on a legacy of fire and police service, this entrepreneurial eatery started small but has grown to more than 900 locations, all committed to serving the best quality meats, cheeses, and produce in hearty and delicious subs, sandwiches, and salads.

name: Page Plaza Diner
description: Page Plaza Diner is a local diner that specializes in American standards and breakfast served all day. This comfy spot has plenty of booths and counter seating where you can enjoy the excellent service and the delicious meal of your choice. Stop by for an unforgettable meal and a cozy, pleasant atmosphere.

name: 46th St Pizzeria
description: You've tried the rest - now try the best! 46th St. Pizzeria is serving up some of the absolute most delicious New York-style pizza around. Open Monday through Saturday, they are serving up whole pies made from the best quality ingredients, as well as sandwiches, salads, pasta, focaccia bread, and more!

name: Jack In The Box #106
description: Just about everyone knows Jack from Jack in the Box with his telltale ping pong ball head, but what they might not know is just how good the food is at this favorite fast-food eatery. For more than 60 years, this all-American chain has been dishing up burgers, all-day breakfasts and a variety of Americanized snacks like eggrolls and tacos. This is not, however, your typical fast-food burger joint. With dishes only made once you place your order, the menu offers diners a variety of decidedly different dining options. From the Sourdough Jack (served on authentic sourdough bread) to the Bacon Ultimate Cheeseburger with two kinds of cheese, there are enough burger options to cure just about every craving. There's plenty more on the menu, including garden-fresh salads with grilled chicken, Chicken Pita sandwiches, grilled sandwiches, their famous Curly Fries, and much more. Jack in the Box is also known for their real ice cream milkshakes.  Regardless if you order one to go with your meal or to enjoy as a dessert, they really are delectable. Plus, with a rotating selection of seasonal and promotional dishes to try, you can make this your new favorite fast-food restaurant and never tire of the food! Get there today and dine-in or choose a location with a handy drive-thru, but make Jack in the Box your first choice when craving fabulous fast-and-delicious-food!

name: Firehouse Subs - York Marketplace
description: People love a good meal, and at Firehouse Subs you can be sure that your meal will be terrific. Built on a legacy of fire and police service, this entrepreneurial eatery started small but has grown to more than 900 locations, all committed to serving the best quality meats, cheeses, and produce in hearty and delicious subs, sandwiches, and salads.

name: Teaever
description: Teaever has been making refreshing and delightful boba drinks and more since 2017. This trendy spot is on a mission to provide the best quality drinks around, so every fruit drink is hand-crafted with the freshest fruits, and everything on the menu is made from the best. The juices, smoothies, teas, and more are delish--stop by today!

name: Cold Stone Creamery
description: Whatever your favorite ice cream concoction, Cold Stone Creamery is sure to have all the ingredients to make your dream dessert come true! Serving classic and unique versions of your favorite cold treats, Cold Stone is known for its singing staff and marble slab used to prepare each order. Create a masterpiece or choose a signature creation today!

name: Mint Tapas and Sushi
description: Mint is a restaurant like no other. This high-end tapas and sushi spot is known for serving some of the most delicious and elevated dishes in their area. Some of their well-known creations include their incredible wagyu steak, Vulcan roll, cosmos roll, and salmon belly. They also offer sushi classes, so you can bring their kitchen to yours!

name: Jimmy's Tequila & Carnes
description: Jimmy's Tequila & Carnes is a self-styled "house of sports". This place started as a vision to create a place where you can relax, unwind, and enjoy top quality drinks, steaks and more, and of course, sports. At this popular and energized spot, you can hang out at the bar, get cozy at a table, or cheer on your team on the wall-to-wall screens. Sip on hand-selected double barrel blends of tequila, proudly branded Jimmy's Tequila Herradura and Jimmy?s Tequila Anejo Patron, or ask about the beer collection. From micro to macro, lager to stout, there are plenty of cold brews to try. And when you get hungry, check out the bar snacks. Authentic hand-crafted guacamole, jumbo wings, and the fully loaded nachos libre are all great choices. Other palate pleasers include juicy burgers, a hearty salmon BLT sandwich, grilled to-order steaks, and just-from-the-water seafood dishes. And, if you're out for lunch, ask about their weekday quick lunch menu that'll have you back to work in no time.
