Open daily and staying open until late, Jimmy's Tequila & Carnes is the kind of place where once you've been, you'll always want to go back!

name: Hardee's - Bartow
description: Hungry and craving a tasty, breakfast or burger place near you? From fluffy Made From Scratch Biscuits to crispy bacon on their classic breakfast platter, to charbroiled burgers like the Third Pound Original Angus Burger that you can't get anywhere else...Hardee's serves food just the way you like it.

name: Round Table Pizza
description: Round Table Pizza has a storied history, with decades of memories made within their walls. Their new restaurant design acknowledges all that came before, while boldly stepping into the present - providing a contemporary dining experience for friends and family to enjoy today and tomorrow. Come on by today!

name: Two Hands
description: Two Hands is a community-focused café that strives to create nutritious, simple, and delicious food paired with exceptional coffee. They take inspiration from Australia's forward-thinking culinary scene and relaxed beach lifestyle. Their menu along with coastal interiors and caring service leave guests feeling peaceful and satisfied.

name: Padrinos
description: Padrino's Tacos & Cantina meticulously attends to its aesthetics while offering classic dishes from breakfast to dinner along with cocktails. They believe in a passion for their craft and a commitment to excellence. Since its foundation, Padrino's Tacos & Cantina has dedicated itself to delivering high-quality products and excellent dishes to provide the best service.

name: Tiptara
description: Tiptara serves authentic Thai cuisine at very reasonable prices. They are a neighborhood staple that is known for their high-quality food and service. Their extensive menu includes sesame noodles, Thai iced tea, pad Thai, chicken satay sticky rice, red curry, and more. Be sure to check out their lunch specials for a great deal.

name: Giulio's Pizza and Restaurant
description: Giulio's Pizza and Restaurant in North Haven is a family owned-and-operated Italian restaurant offering delicious comfort food like pizza, pasta, salads, and more. Build your own burger from their wide selection of savory meats, fresh veggies, specialty toppings, and zesty cheeses. Grab your whole family and head down for dinner, they're serving up a cheesy and bubbly baked ziti designed with your happiness in mind. Or, perhaps you prefer the pork chops with peppers and potatoes -- whichever meal you order will be sure to please. Veal, chicken, seafood, and tender lamb dishes are also available from this extraordinary home-style menu. For lunch, why not try one of their tasty hot or cold subs on Italian bread? They're sure to fill you up and silence your rumbling stomach. Giulio's Pizza and Restaurant also offers several different catering menus for your corporate or private party or can also host your next special event. They are open for lunch and dinner and offer a happy hour Monday through Friday, so stop in today. Order online for delivery and pickup.

name: Cholanad Restaurant & Bar
description: Get the full South Indian culinary experience at CholaNad. Awarded Best in Class Indian Restaurant for seven years straight by The News & Observer, the contemporary restaurant offers unique, mouthwatering Tamil food carefully crafted by five-star chefs that is sure to excite your taste buds. You can even have your food served on a banana leaf!

name: Papatzul
description: Papatzul's ambiance is warm and inviting, making it the perfect place to enjoy the best flavors from Mexico City. With fabulous art on the walls and a menu that's creative and diverse, dining here is much like being in the heart of Mexico. Feast on hand-crafted picks like birria des res, tacos, enchiladas rojas, flautas, and more!

name: Grata Thai
description: Grata Thai is a hidden gem known for its authentic Thai cuisine and cozy atmosphere. Offering a menu filled with traditional dishes bursting with flavor, Grata Thai takes diners on a culinary journey through Thailand. Located in the vibrant streets of New York City, it's a perfect spot for those craving a taste of Southeast Asia.

name: Dim Sum Go Go
description: A popular restaurant for authentic Chinese cuisine, Dim Sum Go Go serves freshly-made to order dim sum without the chaos of carts. With quality always first, the talented chefs here use hand-picked ingredients to create their dim sum magic. A cool and contemporary restaurant, this is an excellent spot for any occasion including family meals and romantic dates. Enjoy tasty dishes like smoked shredded duck, steamed pork, Go Go Seafood, and cellophane noodles. Other popular dim sum delights include crab meat dumplings, beef balls, spare ribs, and roast pork bun. Complement your meal with a glass of wine, beer, or imported sake. Come enjoy friendly service and unbeatable eats today at Dim Sum Go Go.

name: Shuckin' Shack  Summerville
description: Located in Summerville, Shuckin' Shack is a charming seafood restaurant known for its delectable array of seafood dishes crafted from fresh ingredients. The  diverse menu, which showcases a wide selection of oysters, clams, shrimp, and various seafood delights, all artfully prepared and served in enticing styles like steamed, fried, or grilled.

name: Jersey Mike's Subs
description: Everything about Jersey Mike's is high quality. Their certified Angus beef top rounds are trimmed and cooked right in the store. The meats and cheeses are all top-quality premium brands, and the bread is baked fresh each day on the premises. Plus, everything's prepared right in front of you, exactly the way you want it.

name: Flamin' Stone Pizza & Pasta
description: Piping hot pizzas and other favorites abound at one of Spring's favorite eateries... Flamin'Stone Pizza & Pasta. Kick back in a casually modern space that makes enjoying a jovial lunch or dinnertime a real treat. There are dozens of ways to enjoy a meal at Falmin'Stone like starting off with some of the kitchen's fine wings, available in all sorts of quantities, bone-in or boneless, and with an irresistible lineup of flavors that features everything from chipotle BBQ to turbo hot to lemon pepper. For pizza fans, the selection is a mouthwatering parade of pies available with three types of hand-crafted crusts, specialty options such as the Hawaiian and meat lovers, as well as an abundance of toppings so that creating your own favorite is almost as fun as it is eating it. Flamin'Stone doesn't put all of its culinary surprises in one basket though as the kitchen cooks up an appetizing collection of entree, calzones, muffalettas, flat breads, desserts, and more.

name: Hydeout Cafe
description: Open exclusively for breakfast and lunch, Hydeout Cafe offers a wide assortment of homestyle comfort food that will warm your soul and fill your belly. The dining space is bright and airy, sporting a sleek and minimalist modern design with plenty of natural light shining in. Everything on the menu is prepared fresh to order using only the best ingredients. Start the day off right with some pancakes, crepes, French toast, biscuits and gravy, or farm fresh eggs any way you like them, from a skillet to an omelette to a benedict. For lunchtime fare there are salads, hot and cold sandwiches, melts, burgers, and wraps. There are menu sections dedicated to kids' meals and healthy choices, making it easy for anyone to find something to enjoy, and their selection of coffee, tea, and fresh juices make any order complete. For home cooking that's cooked by someone else and served with a side of Southern hospitality, you can't beat Hydeout Cafe.

name: Benny Marzano's
description: Benny Marzano's is a franchise of the Benny's Pizza chain, and is serving up Benny's iconic 28" pizzas to everyone in town! Benny's believes that no town is too small for giant pizzas and good vibes, and is committed to providing patrons with fresh, high-quality, and mouth-watering pizza. Enjoy easy, breezy, and delicious pizza at Benny's!

name: Al Carbon #1
description: Al Carbon is your new go-to spot for affordable and authentic Mexican cuisine. They are open 7 days a week for lunch and dinner with a convenient carryout option as well as a comfortable dining space. Stop by this casual, family-friendly destination for a chill atmosphere and all of your favorite Mexican dishes!

name: Rincon 38
description: A popular corner restaurant, Rincon 38 boasts an impressive wine list, authentic Spanish tapas, and a warm and welcoming atmosphere perfect for a fun romantic date or get-together with good friends. Mix and match shareable tapas like mero made with seared Chilean sea bass served with piquillo polenta cake, baby spinach, fennel slaw, saffron butter sauce, and pimenton oil; plato Iberico featuring serrano ham, Basque olives, salchichon, spicy chorizo, soria sausage, and Manchego cheese drizzled with lemon oil and 12-year balsamic; and patatas bravas, baby potatoes topped with confit asparagus, Spanish chorizo, roasted artichokes, pimenton, sherry wine, and drizzled saffron aioli. The trio menu offering three tapas and three glasses of wine for one price is an excellent deal. Be sure to save room for tempting desserts like tres leches cake, crema Catalana with fresh raspberries, and citrus Spanish flan with a sherry glaze. Take a trip to Spain today at Rincon 38.

name: Firehouse Subs - Dreher Plaza
description: People love a good meal, and at Firehouse Subs you can be sure that your meal will be terrific. Built on a legacy of fire and police service, this entrepreneurial eatery started small but has grown to more than 900 locations, all committed to serving the best quality meats, cheeses, and produce in hearty and delicious subs, sandwiches, and salads.

name: Semifreddo Italian Cuisine
description: Semifreddo Italian Cuisine is a charming dining establishment known for its authentic Italian dishes and warm, inviting atmosphere. The restaurant prides itself on using the freshest ingredients to create traditional recipes, offering a delightful array of pasta and meat dishes. Each meal is carefully crafted to provide an unforgettable culinary experience, complemented by a selection of fine wines. The cozy ambiance and attentive service make Semifreddo Italian Cuisine a favorite spot for both casual dining and special occasions.

name: Mesero - Prestonwood
description: Mesero is beyond Tex Mex and lives up to its promise of Mexican Spirit American Life. One taste of the iconic Queso Mesero and brisket tacos will keep you coming back for more. Their shrimp loaded ceviche is truly crave worthy. Be sure not to skip the amazing drink list for something incredible to complement your meal!

name: Jet's Pizza
description: Jet's Pizza has been delighting diners for decades thanks to great tasting, high-quality pizzas that are always made fresh and hot and to-order. Jet's is famous for their deep-dish pizza which can be loaded just how you like it, and they have specialty pizzas. They also serve famous Jetzee sandwiches, deli boats, plump wings, and more!

name: Los Abuelos Mexican Grill-Johns Creek
description: Searching for a casual and exciting spot where you can enjoy some delicious and authentic Mexican cuisine? Come check out Los Abuelos Mexican Grill to experience the legendary taste of Mexico, amongst the art and culture of Mexico. Their dishes are made from the heart and crafted with pride from grandmother's recipes.

name: Bonchon
description: Bonchon is renowned for its delectable Korean fried chicken, boasting a perfect blend of crispiness and flavor. With a menu that extends beyond just chicken, Bonchon offers a variety of Korean-inspired dishes such as bibimbap and bulgogi, satisfying cravings for authentic Asian cuisine. Its inviting atmosphere and flavorful offerings make it a go-to destination for both casual dining and social gatherings.

name: Sushi N Pop
description: Dishing up fun and tasty Japanese-Korean fusion cuisine, Sushi N Pop is a tasty place to dine. Featuring great quality food at reasonable prices, you can feast on some of the best sushi in town. Ramen, bulgogi, bibimbap, and more are on the menu. Each hand-crafted dish is made to order, and it's all delish! Craving flavor? Check it out today!

name: Parker Brothers Traildust Steakhouse
description: Trail Dust Steak House is serving up juicy, fresh-cut steaks that are sure to make your mouth water. The spacious, western-themed restaurant has a fun, laid-back atmosphere complete with a full bar, Texas and cowboy memorabilia decorating the interior, and lively music played be three different DJs in the evening. Start off with tasty appetizers to share like fried pickles and onion sticks before devouring your entree. Choose from a wide selection of tantalizing dishes like tender burgers, baby back ribs, catfish, and fresh salads. Trail Dust Steak House refuses to compromise on quality which is why each dish is carefully crafted using fresh ingredients from local farmers' markets and seasoned to perfection with no additives. Stop in daily from 4-7 p.m. and take advantage of amazing happy hour deals on draft beer, margaritas, and appetizers. From cocktail receptions to business lunches, host your next private event in this exciting eatery and treat your guests to an unforgettable dining experience. Open seven days a week grab your family and friends and stop in today.

name: Petali
description: A family-owned restaurant with a focus on consistency and great service, Petali offers high quality, made-from-scratch dishes served in a fast-casual environment. Attractive and comfortable, Petali is an excellent choice for a quick mid-week lunch or a full family feast. Begin with tasty appetizers like bruschetta, cheesy garlic bread, and cup of meatballs. Popular entrees include the chicken Parmesan sandwich, flatbread pizza with your favorite toppings, and pasta bread bowls with your picks of five styles of pasta, five amazing homemade sauces, and seven optional add-ons. The soups and salads here are also fantastic. Quench your thirst with a refreshing fountain drink or bottled craft soda. A kids menu is available for the little ones and diners of all ages will love delectable desserts like tiramisu, cannoli, and Key lime cheesecake. Come enjoy friendly service and unbeatable Italian cuisine today at Petali.

name: Mario's Pizza - Friendly Center
description: Mario's Pizza is a family-friendly authentic Italian restaurant. Their menu includes NY-style pizza, subs, calzones, stromboli, Italian entrees and salads. Likewise, choose from tons of appetizers such as wings, garlic knots, mozz sticks, toasted ravioli, fries, meatballs and more. Don't forget to finish off your meal with an authentic dessert!

name: The Thurman Cafe
description: Family-owned and a landmark in the German Village neighborhood since 1942, The Thurman Cafe offers classic American dishes with full bar service. Open daily for lunch, dinner, and late night service, The Thurman Cafe is best known for their burgers, of which there are more than 20 to choose from. Their specialty is the Thurmanator, a burger that comes with two 12-ounce patties, mayo, lettuce, pickle, banana peppers, bacon, cheddar, sauteed mushrooms and onions, ham, mozzarella, and American cheese. There are plenty of less intimidating burgers to be had, as well as thin crust pizzas, hot subs, chicken sandwiches, hot or cold deli sandwiches, hot dogs featuring their secret recipe Coney sauce, and jumbo wings with 11 sauces to choose from, ranging from mild to extreme. Experience Columbus like a true local (even if you're just visiting) and come to The Thurman Cafe any day of the week to enjoy a great meal, some refreshing drinks, and to take in the collection of local memorabilia displayed around the restaurant.

name: Fonda Tribeca
description: Searching for a convenient destination where you can enjoy some authentically inspired Mexican cuisine with a modern twist? Stop by Fonda Tribeca for elevated Mexican cuisine served in a spacious and festive dining room. Their extensive menu includes a variety of curated dishes and exciting tequila-based cocktails.

name: Dickey's 121
description: Dickey's 121 features fresh, off the smoker meats and appetizers, scratch made sauces and recipes spanning generations, alongside the typical bar grub, signature cocktails and local beers. They host weekly events including Karaoke, Trivia, Not Your Grandma's Bingo, special parties and events, weekly pool tournaments, and several opportunities for pool leagues.

name: 11 Tigers
description: Looking for a great destination to spend the evening? Be sure to check out 11 Tigers, an East Village speakeasy with Thai heart and Japanese soul. They are a magical place where Thai sum yadong meets the Japanese izakaya with a healthy dash of American craft cocktails amongst a vibrant and inspiring atmosphere.

name: AweSum DimSum
description: It truly is all awesome at AweSum Dim Sum, a sleek and modern eatery that specializes in authentic dim sum. Dim sum traditional Cantonese dining at its most delicious, and each hand-crafted portion is different and fabulous. Try classics like har gow (dumplings stuffed with shrimp and bamboo shoots), the hand-rolled house dumplings stuffed with chives, cuttlefish and shrimp, or the light and fluffy pork buns. There are nearly two dozen picks on the menu, and the best way to sample it all is to pick a variety of dishes and dig in! Sip on a hot tea with your dim sum and enjoy everything that this local favorite eatery has to offer! Please note: Catering services are available. Call ahead for details.

name: Chant
description: CHANT is a trendy, upscale and casual dining restaurant featuring global cuisine. Conveniently located within the historic Hyde Park District, the team of talented chefs are motivated to be innovative, to display their flair, and to create recipes with the freshest available ingredients. Through the use of seasonal ingredients, the chef's ensure that the best seasonal featured items, healthy choice selections and budget-friendly specials are on the menu, without ever sacrificing flavor and excitement. The sustainable ingredients used at this eatery are better for you, they entice your palate, and they embody the ideals and practices of obtaining the best quality products. After all, the less your food travels, the less it has to be preserved. Food is not just there to feed the body, but the mind and soul as well. Striving to be better humans and better neighbors is the foundation of CHANT's business model, and their way of caring for each customer equally. This means that no matter when you go, you can enjoy a delicious meal and feel better about what you're putting into your body. Not only are the meals here terrific, but there's also live music each Friday and Saturday from 8-11 p.m.

name: Gotham Comedy Club
description: Looking for the best comedy, food and drinks all under one roof? Just head to the Gotham Comedy Club, where since 1996, New Yorkers have known that this is the place to go to when looking for the most fun out. Drawing upon the charm and spirit of the 1920s, this colossal club has an upscale theater environment which appeals to the city's distinguished tastes. So much so, that guests often feel transported back in time upon entering. The place looks great, but it is the lineup of acts that continues to draw people in. From today's elite comedians to the best local talent, the lineup of entertainment is simply unparalleled. While you're there, order your favorite cocktail, beer or wine, and munch on the Mediterranean platter, the grilled chicken sandwich, charbroiled sirloin burger, or the chicken & mango spring rolls. With top-of-the-line entertainment and a selection of food and drinks which ensures there's plenty of choice for all, the Gotham Comedy Club can be your one-stop destination for a great night out. Please note: General admission is $26 with a 2-beverage minimum per person; VIP Gold is $135 which includes a private table, bypassing the check-in line, an open bar, one appetizer, and gratuity.

name: Tony's Di Napoli
description: Casual and romantic, Tony's Di Napoli offers authentic Italian in a relaxing atmosphere.   Open for lunch and dinner daily, Tony's Di Napoli is waiting any time you get the urge for some authentic Italian taste.  Perfect for a family meal, business lunch or a date, Tony's offers platters that serve 2 to 3 people!  A must-have is Tony's Famous Twin 1 pound New York Cut Sirloins. Delicious! With over 40 years of experience serving terrific cuisine, the owner of Tony's Di Napoli has the winning combination of wonderful food in a great location.  Stop in soon.

name: Red Lion Pub
description: You don't have to cross the pond to to get great British fare, spirits, and fun...at least not when Red Lion Pub is just across town. With a menu inspired by the best of the UK, Red Lion Pub features 100% from-scratch cooking, crafting traditional favorites such as shepherd's pie and hand-dipped-to-order fish n' chips right down to the succulent half-pound, one-of-a-kind pub burger on toasted brioche. You'll find satisfyingly rich Welsh rarebit, the classic ploughman's platter, bangers and mash, veggie curry, and a plethora of sides -- from corn pudding to peas and carrots to brown bread. The unique assortment of beers, ales, and spirits allow each guest to sample the finest British drinks. Whether you try something new, go for a creative spin on your favorite cocktail, or stick with what you know...one thing's for sure, there's always an inviting bar stool waiting for you at Red Lion Pub. If you're looking for a private event space or need to plan a party, Red Lion Pub offers full catering options for any size group and for any occasion. Whether you host an event here or need the Red Lion Pub to come to your place, you'll always get the exceptional service that you deserve. Whatever your needs, Red Lion Pub is proud to offer a taste of the Britain's best in downtown Milwaukee.

name: Lexington Candy Shop
description: Lexington Candy Shop: is it a diner, or is it a luncheonette? Welcome to Old New York--Lexington Candy Shop is most definitely a luncheonette. Soda jerks? Check. Egg Creams? They've got them. Fresh squeezed orange juice and lemonade? Yep, you'll find it at this amazing place which was recently named #6 in "The 11 Best Classic Diners and Luncheonettes in NYC" by The Village Voice (February, 2014) and more recently featured on the Travel Channel's hit show Food Paradise, Lexington Candy Shop takes pride in the personal service and attention to ingredients that has been their hallmark since 1925. The same family has owned this NYC treasure since its inception and they invite you to experience the extra care we put into each and every order. Upon arriving at the Lexington Candy Shop, stop and enjoy the historical Coca Cola display, gathered from around the world. Once in the luncheonette, check out the vintage Hamilton Beach milkshake mixer, the coffee urns and the "goose neck" style soda fountain, all dating from 1940's. When seated, take a moment to enjoy the decor which is painstakingly maintained as authentically as possible. An original menu is on display, as well as pictures of the store as it originally was, along with pictures of the founders. Visit today and you'll understand why the Restaurant News has this to say about the Lexington Candy Shop: "A David among Goliaths in Gotham City, the Lexington Candy Shop is like a page in food service history bringing to life the energy and attentiveness of a bygone era."

name: Smokey Bones
description: Celebrating authentic and savory barbecue offerings with a menu that features a tantalizing array of smoked meats, flavorful sauces, and hearty sides, Smokey Bones has established themselves as a go-to destination for their smoky goodness. Patrons can indulge in an array of barbecue classics in their laid-back atmosphere. Smokey Bones is a favorite among diners for their commitment to quality and passion for the art of barbecue.

name: Socarrat Chelsea
description:
The tantalizing aroma of saffron-infused rice and savory seafood wafts from the open kitchen, where skilled chefs expertly craft traditional paellas in wide, shallow pans known as "socarrats." Each dish is a masterpiece of flavor, featuring perfectly cooked rice with a delightful caramelized crust, complemented by an array of fresh ingredients sourced locally and from Spain.

As diners savor their meals, they are enveloped in the lively buzz of conversation and the clinking of glasses, creating an atmosphere that is both convivial and intimate. Whether gathering with friends for a casual evening or celebrating a special occasion, Socarrat Paella Bar offers an unforgettable culinary experience that transports guests to the vibrant streets of Spain with every delicious bite.

name: Sushi Rock Grill
description: Whether you prefer traditional sushi or adventurous and unique dishes, you will find what you're looking for at Sushi Rock Grill. Contemporary and intimate, this is the perfect setting for any special evening. Start with tasty appetizers like spicy garlic edamame, baked New Zealand green mussels in a creamy spicy mayo sauce, or perfectly grilled chicken satay with peanut sauce. For the main event, try entrees like Vietnamese cubed beef over steamed jasmine rice, yakisoba noodles stir-fried with vegetables and your choice of meat, or fluffy and crispy tempura. Must-try sushi rolls include Godzilla, rainbow, and the Sushi Rock Roll with tuna, salmon, cucumber, and avocado lightly battered, fried, and served with tri-color cream sauce. Be sure to save room for tempting desserts like coconut dream cheesecake, fried vanilla ice cream, and elegant red velvet cake. For friendly service and exceptional food, there's no better place than Sushi Rock Grill.

name: Legacy Pie Co - Tennyson Street
description: At Colorado Cherry Co., they've been making scrumptious pies and creating memories for decades. Since 1929, in fact, the family behind this legendary spot has been sharing joy with every pie they bake. Their signature cherry pie is available along with apple, blueberry, mixed berry, and many more pies. Savory pies are also available here.

name: Bensi Ristorante
description: Bensi Ristorante is your destination for delectable Italian cuisine in a warm, relaxing atmosphere. The casual restaurant offers an extensive menu filled with a wide selection of delicious dishes including hand-tossed pizzas, fresh seafood, tasty pastas, and other Italian favorites. Catering is available and is sure to be the star of your next event.

name: Hurricane Grill & Wings
description: Let's face it. Who doesn't love wings? That said, there's only one place to get the best ... Hurricane Grill and Wings. Since opening its doors, this place has skyrocketed to the top of everyone's list because of their award-winning jumbo fresh wings, which come in 30 outrageous varieties. Here's how it works. First you choose your order size. Then you choose your sauce or rub. And if you want to experiment, combine any two sauces or rubs to create your very own signature blend. Want to mix things up even more? Hurricane Grill also offers a super selection of appetizers, sandwiches, and entree salads, plus shrimp, grouper and grilled mahi combo platters. What's more, with its HDTVs, this is a great place to watch your favorite team annihilate the competition. And now, with a new tiki bar featuring a full menu of all your favorite drinks and specialty cocktails, you can sip on a tropical drink or nurse a frosty beer as the cool breeze blows through the bar. Dedicated to quality, only fresh, all-natural chicken and certified Angus beef are served. Committed to conservation, wherever possible, recyclable or compostable paper products are used. As if that weren't enough, here are a few more reasons to make a beeline for Hurricane Grill: "Kids Eat Free" on Wednesdays, "Live Reggae Music" every Thursday from 6:30 - 9:30 p.m., "Bucket of Beer" specials (5 Domestic Bottles for $10; 5 Imported Bottles for $12), and "Sunday NFL Ticket."

name: Sin Fronteras
description: Looking for a casual spot to grab a delicious and home cooked meal? Sin Fronteras invites you to dine with them, sharing family recipes from their family to yours. They are a sister location of Las Tres Fronteras, serving an impressive variety of freshly made meals comprised of the best quality ingredients available.

name: Bocca Cucina and Bar
description: Bocca Cucina and Bar is one of New York City's top rated Italian restaurants in the Gramercy district. The space is bright and modern, marked by indigo blue leather banquettes and industrial-chic lighting. In addition to delicious and authentic Italian dishes, they offer an imaginative cocktail menu and impressive Italian wine list.

name: Sister's Cuisine
description: Transport your taste buds to the Caribbean and enjoy a variety of tasty island eats at Sister's Cuisine. The award-winning restaurant's hands on approach to food preparation and customer service not only ensures a plate of the highest quality, but also one customized to your exact needs. Stop by and treat yourself to diverse, healthy bites today!

name: Tender Greens - Santa Monica
description: Tender Greens is a chef-led kitchen serving seasonal and responsibly sourced food to improve the way people eat every day. All specials are guided by seasonal harvests, grown by local farmers, & inspired by unique flavors. Enjoy bowls, plates, salads, sandwiches and more!

name: El Azteca Mexican Restaurant
description: The talented chefs at El Azteca Mexican Restaurant combine the freshest ingredients with well-honed skill to create mouthwatering culinary delights. The cheerful and traditional dining room here is the perfect place to enjoy dinner with the whole family. Start with tasty appetizers like queso fundido, fajita nachos, or fresh guacamole. For the main event, try special entrees like carnitas with green or red sauce, tender carne asada, or spicy pineapple chicken chipotle. Street tacos, deluxe burritos, and sizzling fajitas are also popular choices. Pair your food with a tart and sweet margarita or cold Mexican beer, and end your meal on a sweet note with fried ice cream or creamy flan. Friendly service and fantastic eats await you at El Azteca Mexican Restaurant. For more great deals be sure to check out their Happy Hour specials.

name: La Strada Pizza and Pasta
description: La Strada Pizza and Pasta is an inviting, counter-serve pizzeria that offers a broad menu of delicious pies, Italian cuisine, and comfort food. They share their family tradition with each pizza, crafted to perfection and created with the freshest ingredients. Stop by this laid-back and welcoming spot for a true taste of Italy!

name: Stafili Wine Cafe
description: Stafili Wine Cafe is a Greek inspired wine café located in the heart of New York! They carefully select their wines from the best vineyards in Greece and offer a variety of options to suit every taste. Their cozy atmosphere is perfect for a night out with friends or a romantic evening with your significant other.

name: Dairy Queen Grill & Chill
description: Dairy Queen Grill & Chill truly has it all! They serve their signature soft-serve ice cream in all kinds of ways, from classic sundaes to signature blizzards. They also have frozen hot chocolate and Summertime Sunset Twisty Misty Slush! Top it all off the DQ Signature Stackburgers, including the Backyard Bacon Ranch.

name: Acova
description: Meaning "nest" in Italian, Acova strives to create an inviting and comfortable environment that will become your go-to spot whenever you're craving a great meal. An industrial chic space -- complete with exposed brick walls, wooden-beamed ceiling, and metal furnishings -- you can tuck away in a cozy corner, pull up a seat at the long bar, or grab a table on the outdoor patio. Their menu of eclectic American fare puts a new spin on some classic favorites, such as smoke-brined and flash-fried wings, green goddess deviled eggs, Havana panini, lobster mac and cheese, chimichurri cauliflower steak, and fried chicken with a honey-cayenne drizzle. The full-service bar has an extensive wine and beer list, along with a collection of craft cocktails sporting cheeky names like I'm Your Huckleberry (huckleberry vodka and lavender-mint lemonade) and Smokey & the Bandit (mezcal with herbal and ginger liqueurs). Happy hour happens every evening and offers deals on select drinks and appetizers, and their weekend brunch is the best reason to get out of bed on a lazy day. Equal parts "vintage flair and contemporary charm", Acova looks forward to having you return again and again.

name: Arni's
description: For over 50 years, Arni's has been serving delicious food to loyal customers. Their extensive menu features award-winning thin-crust pizzas, legendary salads, hand-breaded pork tenderloin sandwiches, fabulous wings, and mile-high nachos. They are a member of the National Pizza Hall of Fame with locations throughout the state of Indiana!

name: Jersey Mike's Subs
description: Jersey Mike's Subs has become a fan-favorite chain for subs since their opening in 1956. They offer a sub above - one that's measured in more than inches or seconds 'til served. They carefully consider every aspect of what they do - every slice, every sandwich, every store - and provide customers with sustenance and substance too.

name: Jenkins Quality Barbecue (Southside)
description: The story of Jenkins Quality Barbecue starts like this: with God, a dream and $125, Melton Jenkins Jr. and his wife Willie Mae opened the first restaurant in 1957. Armed with the family's secret barbecue sauce recipe and with plenty of hospitality, the rest became history. Today, they're still known for their delicious sauce, and with tasty eats like ribs and chicken on the menu, the menu might be short, but the food is delicious. Get your hands on their delish fare in any of their locations, then just roll up your sleeves and dig in! Made from the best quality cuts of meat which are cooked low and slow over an oak wood-fired pit until perfect, you can order the slab of ribs, beef or pork on a bun, or their irresistible chicken. Top it with your favorite sauce, and you've got everything you  need for a delicious meal! This family owned and operated business has been serving Jacksonville for more than 55 years -- check it out yourself today!

name: Mexicali Cantina Grill - Randolph
description: Mexicali Cantina Grill provides a space that is from their family to yours, serving authentic Mexican cuisine. Their welcoming ambience, friendly staff, eclectic menu and reasonable prices are sure to keep you coming back for more! Some of their popular dishes include their guacamole fresco, street steak burrito and arroz con pollo.

name: Santo Taco
description: Santo Taco is a beloved local spot known for its authentic Mexican street tacos. With fresh ingredients and a vibrant atmosphere, it offers a wide range of traditional tacos, burritos, and other Mexican favorites. The friendly service and flavorful dishes make it a popular destination for both locals and visitors looking for a genuine taste of Mexico.

name: Minsky's Pizza
description: With more locations than ever, Minsky's Pizza continues to introduce new patrons to its Zagat-rated, award-winning pies each and every day across the Kansas City region. These pizzas are raved about far and wide because Minsky's has spent four decades perfecting the recipes and techniques behind their crusts and sauces to make the best pizzas around. You'll taste their efforts in every single mouthwatering bite. With the promise of being "gourmet, and going to stay that way", Minsky's never wavers from offering up the finest ingredients they can get their hands on, such as 100-percent mozzarella cheese from Wisconsin, fresh-cut veggies, and high-quality meats that add just the right touch when layered upon the hand-rolled dough. There are dozens of ways to enjoy your pie here, starting with gourmet pizzas like the Philly cheesesteak and barbecue chicken. There's also the tostada: your choice of hamburger or chicken with a spicy re-fried bean sauce, which is topped with Monterey Jack and cheddar cheeses, before finally being crowned with lettuce, red onions, and tomatoes...plus a side of salsa. They don't just pizza here, so you'll also find some mighty fine sandwiches, pastas, fantastic daily specials, and a gluten-free menu that ensures everyone gets in on Minsky's famous eats.

name: Art's Skillet
description: There really is an Art at Art's Skillet, and he's often in the kitchen or chatting with diners at this casual, family-friendly and tasty breakfast and lunch eatery. At this popular spot, it's about hand-crafting fresh, fabulous and oh-so tasty home-style meals. Go first thing in the morning for breakfast favorites like stuffed omelettes, skillets filled with delicious ingredients, hot-off-the-griddle pancakes or French toast, and Art's personal favorites like the bagel breakfast sandwich. There's lots more on the menu, and for lunch, be sure to feast on hearty sandwiches like the BLT max with bacon, avocado, Swiss cheese and tomato, or the house-made chicken salad. Juicy burgers, crisp and green salads, soups and more round out the lunchtime offerings. Delicious, affordable and always friendly, Art's Skillet is a must-try for breakfast and lunch!

name: QDOBA Mexican Eats
description: QDOBA Mexican Eats is a fast-casual restaurant chain that offers a wide variety of Mexican-inspired dishes, including burritos, tacos, and bowls, all customizable with fresh ingredients. Known for its flavorful, hand-crafted meals, QDOBA allows customers to personalize their orders with a range of proteins, toppings, and salsas.

name: Blind Pig Tavern - Eastside
description: Since 1998, the Blind Pig Tavern has stood apart as the area's best place to kick back and enjoy a delicious meal. With several locations already cranking out some of the finest barbecue, burgers, and beers in town, folks at The Blind Pig Tavern decided it was time to expand the brand again. Now, Blind Pig's fun and food is available to locals and visitors alike in Athens' Eastside neighborhood. Located in the Kroger shopping center, this place is a convenient stop-in for anyone visiting the State Botanical Garden of Georgia, UGA Golf Course, or other points of interest. Feast on a specialty burgers or build your own creation -- either way you're in good hands. The collection of subs, wraps, dogs, and sandwiches give everyone something to sink their teeth into. In the mood for BBQ? The BBQ plate, loaded with finger-lickin' good smoked pulled pork sounds like the choice for you. Another option is to share a selection of smaller favorites like the plump and juicy Buffalo wings, fried dill pickles, and chili and cheese fries. With a great outdoor patio, TVs for year-round sports, and the best bar in Eastside, The Blind Pig Tavern is the place to be.

name: Vermont Pub  Brewery
description: Vermont Pub & Brewery opened its doors in 1988 and is proud to be Vermont's original craft brew pub. From Burly Irish Ale to Bombay Grab IPAs, this lively pub's selection of craft beer is sure to impress. Don't miss out on their Vermont Maple BBQ Burger or the Burly Mac & Cheese! Check out their website for details on upcoming events.

name: Pei Wei Asian Kitchen
description: Pei Wei Asian Kitchen knows how to bring the flavor. They serve bold, craveable creations that are sure to impress the whole crew. Whenever you're in the mood for something sweet, spicy, or just plain good, you can count on them for wok'd to order dishes, like their bestselling Firecracker Chicken, created with quality ingredients. Order Now!

name: Karas
description: Karas is a fast casual counter-serve restaurant that serves a delicious variety of food, including signature barbecue, fresh pizzas, and desserts. They offer a curated selection of dishes, whether you are in the mood for something classic, exciting, or adventurous. Stop by for quick service and a casual environment, or take it to go.

name: Huckleberry's
description: Huckleberry's is the place to be when you've got a hankering for a taste of Californian cuisine with a Southern flair. The daily breakfast and lunch offerings are a culinary delight for hungry diners craving comfort food. Huck's griddle heats up mornings with Pappy's Chicken Fried Steak, sweet cream flapjacks, stuffed French toast, and those famous butter-crisp Belgian waffles. Jazz your selection up with fruit toppings like strawberries, bananas, peaches, or huckleberries. Other breakfast favorites include a crab cake Benedict, scratch-made biscuits and gravy, various scrambles and omelets, and Huck's breakfast burrito, which comes with your choice of ham, hot link, bacon, or sausage. Lunchtime features an all sorts of appetizing picks, including a Monte Cristo, turkey melts, a build-your-own burger option, and cheesesteaks in original and "super" styles. Wash your favorite, Southern-inspired bites down with a Mason jar lemonade or iced tea, espresso shot, premium juice, or other complementary beverages.

name: Mughlai Grill
description: Mughlai's mission is to keep their customers happy and well-fed with delicious Indio-Mughlai cuisine. Similar to modern Northern Indian cuisine, Mughlai cuisine features dishes developed in the medieval Indo-Persian centers of the Mughal Empire and represents a mix of Indian food with cooking styles and recipes from Central Asia and Iran. Known for their appetizers, kick off your meal with seasoned chicken or vegetable samosa, Pathar ka gosht (thin slices of lamb marinated in yogurt), or fried vegetable pakoras. A variety of chicken, lamb, and biryani dishes are available, all made with halal meats, including chicken vindaloo cooked in a true Goan style, lamb and goat curry, and Jhinga biryani with jumbo shrimp cooked with delectable aromatic spices. Vegetarian and vegan dishes are also available. Stop in for lunch and order a vegetable, lamb, or chicken lunch box. All lunch boxes come with fresh vegetables, nan, rice, and raita to create a meal that is sure to fill you up! Mughlai is eager to cater your next event and will ensure that your guests feast on a authentic meal they won't forget. Order online or dine inside the intimate restaurant and admire the breathtaking artwork lining the walls.

name: Empanadas Monumental
description: Empanadas Monumental is your destination for delicious Latin cuisine loaded with flavor. The quick-service restaurant features a variety of carefully crafted, mouthwatering empanadas including Philly cheesesteak, shredded chicken, as well as tasty vegetarian options. In a rush? Order your food for delivery or pickup and savor delectable bites wherever you go.

name: Salsa Perucha
description: A charming local restaurant with friendly service, Salsa Perucha specializes in homemade-style Peruvian food made with a passion for flavor. Come and enjoy juicy grilled meats, sensational seafood, and more made with fresh ingredients and served with style.

name: Straight Outta Philly
description: Searching for the perfect place to grab a convenient and fresh meal? Be sure to give Straight Outta Philly a try for a meal that is sure to satisfy. They are famous for their delicious pizza, flavorful cheesesteaks, and other Italian and American classics including stromboli, hoagies, hot dogs, burgers, tasty sides, and more.

name: Urban Pie
description: Housed in a transformed filling station, you can't miss Urban Pie. Recognizable by the blue umbrellas on the patio and the unique exterior of the building, once you've discovered this eatery in the heart of the bustling Kirkwood neighborhood, you'll never forget it. This is a lively spot to eat, drink, and have a great time. Take the family, meet some friends, or go with someone special and enjoy a great view of the kitchen and the hand-tossed pizzas from any seat in the house. Specializing in pizzas, there are lots to choose from including the Greasy Monkey, a meat-loaded masterpiece, or the Urban Beets pizza with cauliflower, beets, goat cheese, and more. Also on the menu are subs, pastas, garden-fresh salads, and more, oh, and don't forget about their amazing desserts! Wash it all down with a drink from the full bar, then sit back and enjoy the ambiance and your company. With a fabulous patio, events like Drag Bingo hosted by Brent Star each Thursday from 8-10 p.m. and Atlanta Poker Club Fridays at 8:30 p.m., for meals, drinks, and good times, check out Urban Pie! Please note: Catering services are also available. Call ahead for details.

name: Capt'n Chucky's Crab Cake Co
description: Seafood lovers rejoice and order up excellent hot-and-fresh, take-and-bake, and catering fare from Capt'n Chucky's Crab Cake Co. A friendly take-out joint, Capt'n Chucky's Crab Cake Co. has everything you need for a great meal, whether you're feeding one or 100. The several varieties of crab cakes are of course a must-try, but don't miss out on some of their other top-sellers like Maryland crab soup, lobster bisque, and New England clam chowder. Take-and-bake appetizers include stuffed mushrooms, bacon-wrapped scallops, and shrimp sliders. Also to discover are fresh breads from Marchiano's Bakery, assorted cakes from Pellman's, and buttery pound cake from Stock's Bakery. All take-and-bake options come with full cooking instructions so your home meal comes out perfect. Hot food is made to-order so call ahead to avoid a wait. Let Capt'n Chucky's Crab Cake Co. take care of dinner tonight.

name: Texadelphia
description: The home of the Original Texas Cheesesteak, Texadelphia specializes in mouth-watering Texas-style cheesesteaks infused with the legendary taste of Philadelphia. They also offer breakfast options, burgers, sandwiches, chips & dips, salads, and more! Stop by for a great signature sandwich along with an extensive lineup of beers and wines.

name: Bareburger
description: Bareburger is where you can have it all: the best ethically sourced ingredients, an allergy-friendly kitchen (yes, they have dedicated fryers), big flavor, and big fun. All you carnivorous, veggie-heads, and gluten-haters can come hang at any of their restaurants, and allow them to serve you delicious, satisfying, and ethically sourced food.

name: Charleston Sports Pub - Mt Pleasant
description: A place for family, friends, and sports, Charleston Sports Pub offers amazing food, drinks, and all the sports entertainment you could ask for. Sit outside on the breezy patio or indoors in the hip dining room. They use the freshest ingredients to create everything in-house, from scratch, and cooked-to-order, from heavenly tacos to Buffalo shrimp!

name: San Jose's Tacos & Tequila
description: Ask anybody who has recently dined at the San Jose Mexican Restaurant what they thought of their experience, and you'll likely hear comments like: "... this is our new 'go to' Mexican restaurant - fantastic!" or "Absolutely the best Mexican food I've ever tasted!" The comments about this outstanding eatery are indeed terrific, but don't take other people's word for it, check it out yourself. Go hungry, however, for dishes like the tableside Guacamole, the Southwest Eggrolls, the Chilaquilles Mexicanos, the enchiladas Poblanas, the Grilled Steak Burrito, Shrimp Tacos, sizzling fajitas and the Steak Chipotle are simply divine. There's much more than just these few standout dishes to try, and regardless what you choose it's bound to be scrumptious because everything is made fresh to order and from only the very best quality and freshest ingredients. Enjoy what will surely be a delicious meal in the comfortable and casual dining room that has plenty of room for all. Plus, with tasty margaritas and enough cold beverages for all, there is even more reason to check this amazing place out. The next time you're craving the best Mexican cuisine, excellent service and an all around great time out, head to the San Jose Mexican Restaurant!

name: Umbertos Clam House
description: Umbertos Clam House serves Italian cuisine at its finest, in the heart of Little Italy. Their unpretentious flair and professional service combined with the freshest most authentic products possible keep customers coming back for more. They are a family-owned restaurant serving dishes like short rib ragu over penne and spiedini a la romano.

name: Johnny G's
description: This is Italian done right! Johnny G's goal to provide authentic Italian food and delicious specialties to area diners is the driving force that sets it apart from the rest. From an award-winning sauce to the friendly staff, there are plenty of reasons that Johnny G's can quickly become a favorite stop. Settle down into an unfussy space that keeps your lunch and dinner visits casual and inviting. Whether you're dining with friends or family, Johnny G's has dish for everyone, no matter your tastes. From the appetizers and pizza to subs, wraps, and pastas, this place is brimming with mouthwatering options. For pizza fans, a trip here is a chance to indulge in gourmet pies like the Florentine, Cheddar & Spinach, Breakfast, Stuffed Crust, and others. You can always choose your own toppings, put these specialty pizzas are pretty hard to resist. Dishes like the Veal Picatta, Chicken Francese, Shrimp Marinara, and Zuppa Di Clams are just a few of the headliners you can savor. If it's a hearty plate of pasta you came for, Johnny G's never disappoints. With delectable selections like the Baked Ziti, Lasagna, Penne a la Vodka, Spaghetti in Meat Sauce, and others, you'll never run out of Old World favorites to treat your taste buds to. If you like a bit of a challenge when you're dining out, look no further than Johnny G's Jumbo Pizza Challenge! You'll have one hour to eat a 32-inch pie. If you can do it, you'll get $250 cash on the spot...and the pizza is on the house! From a simple lunch with coworkers to a dinner with the kids to a catered affair with the best Italian food around, Johnny G's is one of a kind.

name: Jalapeno & Rocoto Pepper
description: With several locations, you can enjoy a scrumptious hand-crafted meal of authentic Mexican fare at Jalapeno & Rocoto Pepper. This casual eatery is serving traditional dishes from the many regions of Mexico. Every dish is made from scratch with delicious cheeses, sauces, fresh tortillas, and more. Don't forget about the cervezas!

name: Hurricane Grill & Wings
description: The forecast always calls for a 100% chance of happy at Hurricane Grill & Wings thanks to an unbeatable combination of great decor, casual vibes, and a massive lineup of delicious eats. It all starts with their chicken...all-natural, fresh, and never frozen. You won't find better variety anywhere, no matter what you're after -- sweet, savory, or as spicy as you can handle.

name: El Lechon De Negron
description: El Lechon de Negron is a quick and casual spot to get your fill of roasted pork and other authentic Puerto Rican dishes. This popular spot has a big menu that's loaded with tasty picks like their famous pernil, pollo guisado, garlic shrimp, and more. Customize your plate with rice and a side, then dig in to something delicious!

name: Barrio BX
description: In the Throgs Neck area of The Bronx is Barrio BX, a hip and modern restaurant and bar serving up authentic Puerto Rican and Latin fusion cuisines that will dazzle your taste buds and leave you eager to return for more. Their dining space is relaxed and inviting with simple decor and ambient lighting, plus sidewalk seating for dining al fresco. For smaller appetites there are salads, sandwiches, and classic Puerto Rican street food like sweet corn fritters, stuffed potato croquettes, and pastelillos (turnovers stuffed with meats and cheeses), or when you come hungry you can dive into some mofongo, chicharrones fresh from the fryer, or house specialties such as chicken and rice, sauteed steak with rice and beans, or chuleta (fried pork chop with rice and tostones). The full-service bar is famous for its fresh and creative cocktails--like the Pina Colada with freshly blended pineapple or the Piragua that adds rum to the classic shaved ice treat--as well as its selection of wine, imported and domestic beers, and Latin soft drinks.

name: New York Slice Company
description: Sure, the New York Slice Company dishes up gourmet, hand-tossed New York-style pizzas, but that's not all. With a lifetime of creating (and eating) the best Old World Italian cuisine, the owners of this eatery know that you've got to have a killer sauce and a crust that's better than any others out there to make the best pizzas around, and that's what they've got (using locally sourced ingredients whenever possible also adds to the yum factor). Their pizzas are also cooked the traditional way, in a scalding-hot oven that cooks the crust to a deep, rich brown. The slightly smoky flavor enhances the entire pizza, making it delish from the first bite to the last. From tasty specialty pies like the NYSC Margherita with fresh basil, sundried tomatoes and more, to the white Italian chicken Alfredo, there's something for every craving. Of course you can also create your own, topping it however you like (in-house made gluten-free crust also available). Not in the mood for pizza? Their 13-layer colossal serving of baked lasagna will surely tempt you, or try a calzone, stromboli or crisp salad. With a great décor that is perfect for both family dinners, date night and power lunches, the next time you're in the mood for a taste of the Big Apple, head to the New York Slice Company.

name: Firehouse Subs - One Loudoun
description: People love a good meal, and at Firehouse Subs you can be sure that your meal will be terrific. Built on a legacy of fire and police service, this entrepreneurial eatery started small but has grown to more than 900 locations, all committed to serving the best quality meats, cheeses, and produce in hearty and delicious subs, sandwiches, and salads.

name: Sushidelic
description: SushiDelic transcends the norms of traditional dining, ushering in a captivating era of culinary marvels. Each dish is a masterpiece, where flavors blend into an artful canvas, sparking imagination with every bite. Indulge in a realm where delectable tastes intertwine with charm, leaving an unforgettable impression on both your senses and recollections.

name: Ginza Town
description: Restaurants may come and go, but Ginza is here to stay. For sushi lovers, it's nirvana. The menu offers tremendous selection, and the sushi chefs here turn every dish into something that dazzles the eye as well as the pallate. Ginza offers an equally well-rounded choice of hot dishes as well, plus creative combinations of hot and cold dishes. Popular for lunch, dinner and late-night dining, the ambiance is trendy and both takeout and delivery are available. Sushi, maki, sukiyaki, tempura and teriyakis ... Ginza prepares Japanese cuisine with a style and grace reflective of the restaurant's fashionable décor and equally fashionable crowd. Full bar, takeout and delivery available.

name: Salem's Fresh Eats
description: You've always got lots of options at Salem's Fresh Eats. This fast-casual eatery is dishing up big and juicy burgers, wings, tenders, and gizzards, bowls, salads, seafood, and more. It's all made fresh and to-order, and with reasonable prices and great service, plan on going back to try it all. Need a bite of something tasty? Head to Salem's!

name: Symposium Greek Taverna
description: Symposium is renowned for its authentic Greek cuisine, offering a diverse menu that includes traditional dishes such as moussaka, souvlaki, and baklava. The restaurant features a warm, inviting atmosphere with décor reminiscent of a classic Greek taverna, providing an immersive dining experience. Known for its friendly service and high-quality ingredients, Symposium has become a beloved spot for both locals and visitors seeking a taste of Greece in the heart of the city.

name: Charcoal
description: Charcoal invites you to experience modern American cuisine that makes you feel right at home! Their inviting ambience is perfect for a night out with friends and loved ones to take in this truly adventurous culinary experience. Some of their delicious creations are their Dungeness crab linguini, Cornish game hen and their charcoal grilled steak.

name: Baskin-Robbins
description: Baskin Robbins® has churned out more than 1400 unique and delicious flavors of high-quality ice cream since opening way back in 1945. With more locations than ever before, getting your hands on their amazing ice cream, ice cream cakes, seasonal favorites, and more, has never been easier. Discover a new favorite flavor today!

name: Lolo Hawaiian BBQ Draper
description: At LoLo Hawaiian BBQ, they want to give you the warm welcoming of the island with everything they provide. They are dedicated to bringing you the best Hawaiian dining experience by serving a delicious selection of "plate lunch" foods and Island cuisine along with exceptional service in a comfortable atmosphere.

name: Le Botaniste Soho
description: Le Botaniste is a plant-based, organic restaurant offering a menu inspired by botanical and global cuisines, emphasizing sustainability and environmental consciousness. With its apothecary-themed decor and focus on fresh, nutrient-rich ingredients, Le Botaniste provides a unique dining experience that caters to both health-conscious and eco-friendly diners. In addition to the menu, they have seasonal specials always available.

name: Bronx House Pizza - Hammock
description: Bronx House Pizza is a beloved pizzeria. Their known for crafting delicious and authentic pizzas. Using only the finest ingredients and time-honored recipes, Bronx House Pizza delivers a taste of tradition with each slice. The menu extends beyond pizza, offering a variety of Italian-American favorites, from pasta dishes to calzones. With its inviting atmosphere and dedication to quality, Bronx House Pizza continues to be a go-to spot for pizza enthusiasts and food lovers alike.

name: Tailgaters Sports Bar and Grill
description: Jake's Gameday is a bustling sports bar renowned for its energetic atmosphere and extensive menu of classic bar food favorites. Featuring numerous large-screen TVs, it's the perfect place for fans to watch live sports events while enjoying a cold drink and delicious bites. With its friendly staff and lively ambiance, Jake's Gameday provides an ideal setting for sports enthusiasts and casual diners alike.

name: Stony's Pizza
description: Stony's Pizza is a family-run food destination baking New York-style pizza since 2007 and offering excellent catering services. Come try their most wanted pie, the Kitchen Sink, or their famous pasta dishes and delicious gyros. Regardless of what you are in the mood for, you can count on them for a fresh homemade meal.

name: Saint Valentine
description: FAR OUT West Texas meets Old East Dallas, infused with the spirit of a renegade. Saint Valentine, from award winning bartenders Gabe Sanchez and Ryan Payne, is a world class cocktail bar serving amazing food in a relaxed neighborhood bar setting.

name: Family Bagels
description: Open early each morning so that you can get your bagel fix, at Family Bagels, you're always welcomed like family. Here, they scratch-make delicious eats each day in their kitchen so that you can feast on something fresh and something delicious. And, there's plenty more to enjoy--not just bagels! Breakfast is served all-day here with tasty picks like one of their famous bagels that's toasted and topped with your favorite spread. Or, feast on a hearty omelette, just-off-the-griddle pancakes, eggs Benedict, or a delish breakfast sandwich. Also available are salads, sandwiches, home-made soups, knishes, and more. Each one of their gourmet sandwiches can be made on one of their famous bagels, bread or a roll, so you get what you want, just how you want it. And, with terrific catering options, meals at the office or for a party or gathering have never been easier or tastier! Craving something fabulous? Check out Family Bagels today!

name: Banh Cuon Tay Ho
description: Banh Cuon Tay Ho is the best in the game when it comes to Vietnamese cuisine! Their dishes are made from select, locally sourced fresh herbs and ingredients. They also feature expertly made in-house items such as their rice crepe sheets and traditional dipping sauces. This local hot spot is nothing but great, so come on down today!

name: Aura Bar & Kitchen
description: Over at Aura Bar & Kitchen, they are in the business of good vibes and serving them out to all of their customers. Come on down to enjoy a fresh pasta dish or a great appetizer with their selected wine and cocktails! Their vibrant ambience is perfect to bring friends and family to have an intimate and exciting evening together. Come explore their happy hour from 4p.m. to 7p.m. to try their $8 wines and $7 beers. Guests can also receive a complimentary cheeseboard when purchasing a bottle of wine!

name: Lou's Woodfire Pizza
description: Craving pizza? Check out Lou's Woodfire Pizzas where each hand-made, hand-tossed, and perfectly cooked pizza is delicious. This is a friendly spot where the very freshest and best toppings are used to craft each fabulous bite. Build your own pizza just the way you like it, or opt for one of the many specialty pizzas at this popular eatery.

name: Uncle Paulie's Deli Studio City
description: Uncle Paulie's Deli is an Italian-American deli store, with heroes and other goods available by the pound at the counter. They are famous for their freshly made sandwiches like the Italian combo, the Cousin Bobby, and a selection of breakfast sandwiches. Stop by for a satisfying meal and a family-friendly feel.

name: Lang's Bowlarama/The Nelson Restaurant
description: Lang's Bowlarama is the perfect spot for you to grab a meal and enjoy a great night out! This entertainment spot is great for all ages, offering quality bowling lanes as well as delicious food and a full bar. Stop by for fun and colorful vibe, a night of bowling, and a great selection of food and beverage.

name: Good Kitchen & Market- Marietta
description: Good Kitchen + Market is a top-rated Healthy Eatery and Market who know the power of nutrient-dense food. They?re located across from Kennestone Hospital in Marietta, Georgia, just one mile off the Historic Marietta Square in a quaint 1930's cottage. Super accommodating to any and all dietary restrictions, there?s plenty of Vegan, Vegetarian, & Gluten Free yummy dishes! They serve Breakfast all day-anything from avocado toast, to breakfast bowls, to breakfast burritos, to pancakes, they got you covered. And for lunch or dinner, they?re serving up appetizers, fresh salads, stir fry, zoodle bowls, burgers, sandwiches and wraps, and seasonal specials. They also do offsite catering for your office, group, or special event. Be sure to visit their new Smyrna location at Village Green!

name: The Boozy Pig
description: Get your meat fix today at The Boozy Pig! This is a local butcher shop and kitchen where it's all about the art of cutting, cooking, and serving the best cuts of meat around. Go for a butchery class, stop by to pick out something delicious to take home to cook later, or get your hands on a meal that's ready to eat. Here, they're preserving the art of butchery by selecting, cutting, trimming and packaging for you only the very best of the best. And, if it's instant gratification you're after, check out the lineup of tasty eats. The house made charcuterie board, the B.L.T. filled with choice cuts of smoky bacon, and the Boozy Burger which is about as good as a burger you'll ever have! There's more on the menu at this fun meat-centric eatery, so when your inner carnivore is demanding satisfaction, head over to The Boozy Pig! Please note: Catering services are available.

name: The Melt
description: Melty comfort food fast. Enjoy handcrafted, angus-wagyu blend MeltBurgers, great takes on grilled cheese, melty mac 'n' cheese, handspun milkshakes, crispy fries and much more. The Melt aims to deliver an "I Love It Here Experience" to every guest.  Don't forget to try The Melt's new Classic and Hot 'n' Spicy Crispy Chicken sandwich.

name: Don Pepe Restaurant  Freehold
description: Don Pepe Restaurant is dishing up fabulous Peruvian cuisine in each made-to-order dish. You'll find a big menu at this casual and inviting eatery. Go hungry and feast on ceviches, their amazing charcoal rotisserie chicken, grilled kabobs, and so much more. It's all made fresh from the finest ingredients here, so go hungry and go often!

name: Surcheros - Waycross
description: Surcheros offers a vibrant dining experience centered around customizable Tex-Mex cuisine. From build-your-own burritos to fresh salads and flavorful bowls, Surcheros caters to every taste bud with a fusion of bold flavors and fresh ingredients.

name: Playa Bowls- Athens
description: Playa Bowls offers a vibrant array of delicious and nutritious açaí, pitaya, and smoothie bowls, each bursting with fresh fruits, granola, and other wholesome toppings. With a laid-back beach vibe and a commitment to using high-quality ingredients, Playa Bowls provides a refreshing and energizing experience for health-conscious foodies and casual snackers alike. Whether you're craving a tropical escape or a guilt-free treat, Playa Bowls serves up a taste of paradise in every bite.

name: BurgerFi
description: You won't find bland and boring fast-food burgers here; instead, the tasty eats are created in a gourmet kitchen by gourmet chefs. Enjoy a selection of amazing burgers, grilled or fried chicken sandwiches, and more, because BurgerFi is the place to be! For lunch, dinner or late-night eats, better burgers are waiting for you at BurgerFi.

name: Spice Affair Indian Cuisine
description: Welcome to Spice Affair, where the goal is to introduce the authentic flavors of India to Pittsburgh. Since its establishment in 2017, Spice Affair has delighted patrons in Aspinwall and neighboring areas with its delectable and genuine Indian cuisine crafted from the freshest ingredients. The establishment offers a welcoming, family-friendly ambiance, making it an ideal choice for various occasions and family get-togethers.

name: Viva Italian Pizza
description: Nestled within the vibrant streets of Little Italy, Viva Italian Pizza exudes an aura of authentic culinary excellence. Behind the counter, adept pizzaiolos skillfully toss dough into the air, meticulously crafting each pie with precision and care. Whether it's the classic Margheritas embellished with plump tomatoes and aromatic basil leaves or the gourmet creations adorned with artisanal toppings, every pizza emerges as a masterpiece of culinary artistry. For the busy urbanite, Viva Italian Pizza also provides convenient takeaway options, ensuring that customers can savor a taste of Italy on the move.

name: Pigsty BBQ
description: Pigsty BBQ is a family-owned barbecue joint committed to customer satisfaction. All their meats are hand-picked by a resident pit master and slowly smoked to absolute perfection. Everything on the menu is prepared fresh every day. Their impressive menu includes Texas-style prime brisket, Carolina-style pulled pork, ribs, wings, BBQ, and much more.

name: Patricks North Shore Eatery
description: Patricks North Shore Eatery is a cozy and welcoming restaurant known for its delicious offerings and friendly atmosphere. Located in a charming area, the eatery provides guests with a delightful dining experience, featuring a menu that showcases a variety of flavorful dishes crafted with fresh, high-quality ingredients. Whether you're stopping by for a hearty meal or a light snack, Patricks North Shore Eatery ensures that every visit is memorable with its warm hospitality and inviting ambiance.

name: Drop the Bop
description: Drop the Bop offers a modern twist on traditional Korean cuisine. Known for its vibrant and cozy atmosphere, the restaurant invites diners to enjoy a variety of authentic Korean dishes, including classics like bibimbap and bulgogi. The fusion of traditional flavors with contemporary cooking techniques makes Drop the Bop a favorite among locals seeking a unique and flavorful dining experience.

name: Narbona Key Biscayne
description: Narbona in Key Biscayne, FL, offers a delightful blend of Uruguayan and Italian cuisines, showcasing an extensive menu that includes breakfast, brunch, lunch, and dinner options. The restaurant is known for its sophisticated atmosphere and high-quality dishes ranging from seafood and pasta to gourmet pizzas and risottos. Narbona provides a chic dining experience with options like their popular Vuelve a la vida Croissant, Avocado Toast, and a variety of fresh, artistically presented starters and main courses.​

name: Manje Caribbean Cuisine
description: Manje Caribbean Cuisine serves Caribbean cuisine for everyone! Their recipes are fresh, flavorful, and authentic, made from the absolute best quality ingredients, herb mixtures, and palatable spices. Stop by today for a dish prepared with culinary precision and to enjoy exciting flavor packed into every bite!

name: Biscuits Cafe - Tigard
description: Open for breakfast, brunch, and lunch, Biscuits Cafe is a cozy and inviting eatery that's serving hand-crafted and oh-so delicious eats. Specializing in home-made biscuits and gravy, stuffed omelettes, and other tasty lunch picks, there's plenty on the menu here to love. Friendly service and reasonable prices add to the appeal at this busy eatery!

name: Vanilla Gorilla Cafe
description: Vanilla Gorilla Cafe is a lively Artisan Coffee Shop in the heart of Manhattan with a great atmosphere, lots of comfortable seating and Free Wi-Fi for ALL! A relaxing environment where people can come in to take a time out and decompress, maybe share a nice conversation while enjoying a hot cup of artisan-crafted coffee and feasting on one of our specialty dishes made fresh to order. Our philosophy is simple... We Make it Fresh, We Serve the Best and We Love our Customers!

name: La Gioconda
description: It might be in the middle of Midtown, but this gem is still of the undiscovered cut, waiting for diners to savor the alluring food and great prices. La Gioconda, the widely used name in Italy for Leonardo Da Vinci's Monalisa, evokes the idea of utmost classic beauty. The legendary smile of the Monalisa has, also, forever spelled on the onlookers an aura of mysteriousness. That is why this Italian restaurant thought the name La Gioconda would best define their commitment to bring to the table a cuisine of classic Italian recipes. And, at the same time, as they bring to each guest newer and more modern versions of the ever-evolving Italian culinary panorama, they would like, perhaps, for every diner to think of La Gioconda Italian restaurant as a "Temple of Renaissance Cuisine". Indeed, from pastas to dessert, you will experience at La Gioconda the same feeling of merriment that the Monalisa exudes through her beautiful smile. Inside brick walls, white linens, and light colors give an unpretentious atmosphere, one which every guest will enjoy when sampling the menu choices and wonderful wine list.

name: Papa Johns
description: Better ingredients really do make better pizzas, and at Papa John's, each hand-crafted and made-to-order pizza is fresh, hot, and delicious. They don't need gimmicks at this coast-to-coast pizza chain, because it's always just that good. Quality is at the core of everything they do, and from the pizza crust to the finishing toppings, it's all the best it can be. Curbside and contactless pickup available.

name: Alfredo's Restaurant
description: Alfredo's Restaurant is a beloved local spot known for its delicious Mexican cuisine and cozy, welcoming ambiance. The menu offers a wide range of traditional dishes, including flavorful tacos, enchiladas, and hearty burritos, all made with fresh ingredients. With its friendly service and vibrant decor, Alfredo's Restaurant provides a delightful dining experience that captures the essence of Mexican hospitality.

name: Burger By Day
description: Burger By Day is a convenient and exciting spot where you can grab a meal that is sure to satisfy. They are proud to serve a variety of fresh American classics to the local community! They specialize in their famous burgers, but their menu also includes chicken sliders, a variety of sides, and delicious shakes and ice cream.

name: Mojitos Mexican Bar & Grill
description: Mojitos Mexican Bar & Grill in Odessa, TX, offers a unique blend of traditional Mexican cuisine with influence from their roots from Central Mexico. They are an exciting destination perfect for any occasion, committed to serving the best quality meals possible, made from seasoned chefs using the best ingredients.

name: The Bird 2
description: The Bird is San Francisco's ultimate fried chicken sandwich shop, serving up crispy, free-range dark meat with a unique berbere spice blend. This is your new go-to for indulgent food made with integrity, sold for one low price. The Bird has set out to prove that a really satisfying lunch or dinner doesn't have to eat up the paycheck!

name: Skillet2Plate Bistro
description: Skillet2Plate Bistro is proud to serve delicious soul food to the community. They have both indoor and outdoor seating where you can enjoy your meal amongst great company and excellent service. Stop by and check out their impressive menu full of tasty soul food favorites, all fresh and packed with flavor!

name: TRAILDUST STEAK HOUSE SALOON
description: Trail Dust Steak House is serving up juicy, fresh-cut steaks that are sure to make your mouth water. The spacious, western-themed restaurant has a fun, laid-back atmosphere complete with a full bar and Texas and cowboy memorabilia. Be sure to make a reservation at least a week in advance at this popular spot!

name: Liquid Laughs
description: Liquid Laughs has become the 'go-to' place in town for the most hilarious comedy shows imaginable; laugh with the friendly folk at this venue which is part bar, part restaurant and entirely the best choice when it comes to comedy clubs in the area. Check out their webpage (www.liquidlaughs.com) to find out the current line up of local and national comedy talent, then buy your tickets and be prepared to laugh until you drop. Seats are available on a first come basis, so head on over early and get a great spot. While you're there check out their selection of amazing eats and drinks that include tasty treats like Street Tacos, Fritos Chili Pie, Spinach & Artichoke Dip and much more. Take advantage of the full service bar will be standing by to mix up any of their creative Liquid shots or mixed drinks because everything is funnier when alcohol is involved! Also be sure to check out their highly popular Open Mic Night each Wednesday and laugh with, or at, others as they take their turn at stand-up comedy. The next time you're in the mood for a night out that is a little different, check out Liquid Laughs and you too will be convinced that this is an amazing venue!

name: Edison Chicken Grill El Perucho
description: Edison Chicken Grill El Perucho is a vibrant restaurant celebrated for its authentic Peruvian cuisine. The menu features a variety of flavorful dishes, with their rotisserie chicken and ceviche being particularly popular. Known for its welcoming ambiance and excellent customer service, it's a go-to spot for both locals and visitors seeking a taste of Peru.

name: Jerk Wings Cafe
description: Jerk Wings Cafe offers a tantalizing fusion of Caribbean flavors and culinary creativity. From their signature jerk-spiced wings to their mouthwatering  tostones, beef patties, and oxtail, every dish is crafted with passion and authenticity. This vibrant eatery promises a flavorful escape to the Caribbean with each bite.

name: Kung Fu Tea
description: Fresh. Innovative. Fearless. At Kung Fu Tea, every beverage is made-to-order with real Kung Fu. Quench your thirst with something fabulous today at Kung Fu Tea. You'll find some of the freshest drinks around at this popular spot with a huge menu. Sip on the original Kung Fu milk tea, try a slush blended with fresh fruit, or ask about the seasonal specials. Or, pick your own favorite and add their famous bubbles to every cup.

name: Baires Grill New York
description: Baires Grill is known for its authentic Argentine cuisine, offering a menu rich with traditional dishes and flavors. Specializing in expertly grilled meats, the restaurant also features a variety of classic sides and desserts, all made with high-quality ingredients. With its warm, welcoming atmosphere in the heart of New York's theater district, Baires Grill provides an unforgettable dining experience for those seeking a taste of Argentina.

name: Lovely's Old Fashioned
description: Lovely's Old Fashioned is a charming establishment known for its retro ambiance and classic burgers. Patrons appreciate the warm, inviting atmosphere, complete with vintage decor and friendly service. The menu features expertly crafted burgers and a selection of comfort foods that evoke a nostalgic dining experience.

name: Tabla Indian Chinese  Thai
description: With several convenient locations, you can enjoy all your favorite Indian and Asian fare at Tabla. There's an amazing selection of dishes to try at this polished and modernly appointed restaurant, so plan on going often to try it all. Curries, stir-fries, biryanis, tandoori-baked dishes, and much more are hand-crafted to-order. Check it out today!

name: Hi-life Bar And Grill
description: Hi-Life is a sexy bar and grill that is the embodiment of classic Westside chic sans the snooty uptown prices. What's more, Hi-Life is unabashedly proud of providing "good deals" to a populace hungry for discounts like 50% off sushi and sashimi (Monday and Tuesday), $12.95 selected pasta bowls, flame-grilled hamburgers for $8.95 and much, much more.  Some of these deals occur on a particular day while others are offered every day during early bird times from 4:30-7 p.m.   They've got giant burgers, big plates of meatloaf, chicken pot pie and big bowls of pad Thai, pasta puttanesca and chopped Cobb salad.  But Hi-Life is nothing if not a really great bar, and that means these folks offer some pretty awesome drink specials too - on pints, pitchers, drafts, wine, martinis and champagne cocktails. Sound appetizing? Throw in DJs spinning great grooves every Thursday - Saturday, and you've got an Amsterdam Avenue retreat that cannot be beat.  You can even bring your iPod and play your music for the crowd during the "15 Minutes of Fame" segment also Thursday-Saturday.

name: Tortilla Marissa's
description: Voted "Best Mexican Restaurant 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011 & 2012" by Best Independent Restaurants of America Association, this place shows no sign of slowing down its greatness. When the owners created Tortilla Marissa's, their goal was to create a fun and entertaining family restaurant while also serving the best Mexican food in the area. It's all done in an atmosphere where everyone is made to feel like part of the family, which is why Tortilla Marissa's has amassed a considerable roster of regulars. The menu is unique and interesting with flavors inspired from different regions of the southwest, including Texas, California, New Mexico, Arizona, and Colorado.
