This family-operated establishment boasts a menu full of varied seafood options, from fried calamari to grilled snapper, ensuring there's something to satisfy all seafood lovers. Located at Seabridge Marketplace in Channel Islands Harbor, it offers a relaxed dining atmosphere where patrons can enjoy their meals with a view of the harbor.

name: Papa John's Pizza - Hillsboro
description: Better ingredients really do make better pizzas, and at Papa John's, each hand-crafted and made-to-order pizza is fresh, hot, and delicious. They don't need gimmicks at this coast-to-coast pizza chain, because it's always just that good. Quality is at the core of everything they do, and from the pizza crust to the finishing toppings, it's all the best it can be. Feast on specialty pizzas like The Works which is fully-loaded with meats and veggies, or try something a bit different like the Tropical Luau with pineapple, bell peppers, and more. You can also build the pizza of your dreams in any of the pizza sizes, from the diverse selection of sauces, cheeses, and toppings. There's more on the menu, like fresh and fabulous wings, cheesy cheesesticks, and double chocolate brownies so you can build a meal from start to finish. Call ahead for take-out or order online for delivery, because when you're in the mood for pizza, Papa John's has the flavors you're craving!

name: Wedge Cutting, The
description: Using decades of experience and long-time established relationships with vendors across CT, The Cutting Wedge intends to provide the freshest of ingredients to their customers through their catering and in-house dining, as well as seasonal patio seating. They offer fresh, delicious and healthy breakfast and lunch options!

name: Patiala Indian Grill & Bar
description: Patiala Indian Grill is a cozy spot offering authentic North and South Indian cuisine that is packed with bold and distinct flavors that will have you regularly coming back for more. There are plenty of both meat-based and vegetarian choices, so everyone can find something to enjoy here at this cozy and inviting spot!

name: Melt n Dip
description: Melt n Dip, a cozy cafe, invites patrons to indulge in a delightful fusion of flavors. With its warm ambiance and welcoming atmosphere, Melt n Dip offers a unique culinary experience, boasting a delectable selection of melted cheese and chocolate dips paired with an array of dippables. From savory to sweet, guests can savor the richness of each dip as they unwind and savor the moment in this charming eatery.

name: Le Cafe Gourmet
description: Locally owned and operated by a family that moved from France in order to open their very own French cafe and bakery, Le Cafe Gourmet is just that--a fabulous place to enjoy fresh and authentic French fare. This is a cozy and inviting spot and the perfect place to enjoy artisanal treats like daily fresh-baked bread, fresh and flaky croissants, creamy quiches, garden-fresh salads, delicious crepes, and hearty sandwiches. Open for breakfast and lunch daily, something fabulous is just an order away at this charming and friendly cafe. Plus, Le Cafe Gourmet also caters, so you can treat the office, family, friends, or a group of any kind to something amazing. Hand-crafted from the finest ingredients, at Le Cafe Gourmet, it's all fantastique!

name: China Sails
description: China Sails a dining establishment known for its authentic Chinese cuisine. The restaurant offers a wide variety of traditional dishes, prepared with fresh ingredients and traditional recipes. Patrons can enjoy a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere, making it a popular choice for both casual dining and special occasions. With a commitment to quality and flavor, China Sails Chinese Restaurant aims to provide an exceptional dining experience for all its guests.

name: Sit Lo Saigon
description: SitLo Saigon is taking you back to the alleyways of Vietnam where you will find a truly special array of Pho dishes that are perfect for enjoying with friends and family. Their menu is short and sweet, highlighting the labor of love that goes into each bowl. With creations such as their Pho Saigon and Pho Hanoi, this local hotspot is one-of-a-kind!

name: Racha Thai Cuisine
description: Racha Thai Cuisine has been serving delicious, authentic and contemporary Thai cuisine to their community for several years. They are committed to providing the best customer satisfaction possible. They offer a variety of dishes for vegetarians, seafood and meat lovers alike. Their restaurant is decorated with Thai art and rushed green plants.

name: Cattleman's Roadhouse - Mt Sterling
description: Cattleman's Roadhouse is a locally owned and operated Kentucky-proud family-friendly steakhouse offering great steaks, an unbelievable salad bar and great service. Started by two Kentucky boys with a wealth of culinary experience, they wanted to build a place that families could enjoy lunch or dinner together and be able to find something that everyone in the family would love. From a kid-friendly menu and delicious aged and hand-cut Black Angus beef steaks to mouth-watering burgers, ribs, country fried steak, pork chops and more, Cattleman's Roadhouse has something delicious to eat for everyone in the family. And, don't forget about their unforgettable appetizers and desserts! Wrap all that in with friendly, personal service and you'll quickly understand why they say "Cattleman's Roadhouse is where a great steak is just the beginning!" Stop in any of the seven locations today and give Cattleman's a try!

name: Melt Bar & Grilled - Lakewood
description: Melt Bar & Grilled provides the world's best gourmet grilled cheese sandwiches and the largest variety of quality craft beer in a cool and comfortable environment. Delicious monthly specials ensure there are always new items to try and a wide-ranging and constantly-changing selection of beers is diverse enough to keep any connoisseur delighted!

name: J Burns' Pizza Shop
description: J. Burns' Pizza has been making and serving outstanding pizzas and other delectable eats for more than 50 years! They're making pizza the same way today as they did decades ago, with their signature thin and crispy crust and cut into squares. Gluten-free and cauliflower crust options are available, as well as stuffed subs and fresh salads!

name: Denny's
description: As a name synonymous with family dining, you can rely on Denny's to deliver good food, and plenty of it, at prices that spell "value" with a capital V. But if you haven't visited Denny's lately, you may not be aware of all the new things being cooked up to stay in step with America's changing tastes. For example, one of the restaurant's biggest draws has always been its around-the-clock breakfasts. Well now, in addition to the platters of pancakes, waffles, eggs, omelettes and meats, diners have heart-healthy options made with Egg Beaters®. In fact, Denny's has a whole roster of Fit-Fare™ selections for health-conscious patrons, and each item is yummier than the next. There's a specially-priced menu for the 55-and-older crowd too, in addition to Denny's money-saving kids menu. Happily, however, Denny's remains committed to satisfying hearty appetites with great-tasting sandwiches, salads, entrees and desserts that fit the bill, and do it with change to spare.

name: Franconia Pizza
description: Established in 1975, Franconia Pizza has brought many smiles to neighborhood families over the years. Now it's your turn to enjoy the happiness of great food. Stop in and savor tasty eats made with fresh, high quality ingredients and cooked right on the premises.

name: Paulie's Pub & Eatery
description: For flavorful food and casual, family fun stop by this friendly American restaurant. The accommodating staff at Paulie's Pub and Eatery serves up heaping helpings of lip-smacking meals all through the day. Paulie's Pub is seriously committed to bringing you foods made using the finest and freshest ingredients available. You're sure to taste the difference this kind of devotion to flavor makes in Paulie's sensational chicken sandwiches, overstuffed wraps, bountiful burgers and the many other tasty treats on hand to please your hungry gang. Come in for the food and you just might find yourself staying for the entertainment. Paulie's offers a full bar service along with darts, foosball, golden tee golf, live music and sports on satellite T.V.. Whether you're in the mood to chow down on home-style meals, to snack on finger foods or just for a drink, Paulie's Pub is the spot for lots of "great food to help you through the day." Take out service is also provided at Paulie's Pub & Eatery.

name: JusTini's
description: Justini's is a renowned culinary hotspot, celebrated for its innovative cocktails, small plates, and authentic New Orleans' ambiance. From savory Southern dishes and refreshing drinks, Justini's offers a diverse menu that captures the essence of Louisiana flavors. It's the perfect spot for locals and visitors alike to savor the vibrant culinary culture of the city.

name: Canyon Club Montclair
description: Music meets the soul at The Canyon in Montclair. This is a live music and events center coupled with a fabulous restaurant and bar. Providing a unique 1,300-seat intimate concert space that includes an elevated VIP section equipped with a JBL sound system, you can go for something to eat and drink and then stay for the show. Try one of their multi-course prix fixe meals that includes entrees like grilled steaks, Thai BBQ salmon, and lemon-caper chicken, then settle in for world-class entertainment. Headliners include big-name national bands and performers, or book a night for something a wee bit different like a Rock 'n Roll Murder Mystery. Check out the calendar of live events, sign up for their newsletter to keep informed of all the upcoming shows, or just head over and treat yourself to music and a meal tonight!

name: Zona Caribbean
description: Enjoy the tantalizing flavors of the Caribbean Sea at Zona Caribbean. The restaurant features chic, upscale decor in a friendly atmosphere that the entire family will love. Unwind in one of the large, trendy booths and savor an intimate meal with friends or sit at the bar and watch your favorite sports teams on one of the large flat-screen TVs.  Treat yourself to a wide selection of mouthwatering meals like fried Red Snapper, stuffed Caribbean lobster, delicious burgers and wraps, and tasty Jamaican jerk chicken. Feeling adventurous? Order one of the more unique selections like oxtail packed with Caribbean spices or savory stewed goat. Wash your meal down with a refreshing smoothie or sip on a yummy pina colada that even the kids can slurp down. Zona Caribbean is always trying to elevate your dining experience. Stop in on the weekends and jam out to incredible live music that will have you dancing all night long! Open 11 a.m.-10 p.m. seven days a week, come in today and transport yourself to the relaxing shores of the Caribbean.

name: Mr Capri
description: Inspired by the idyllic Italian island of Capri, Mr. Capri brings the flavors of the surrounding coasts to New York City's West Village. The 75-seat restaurant fulfills a lifelong dream of Capri-natives, owner Alessandro "Ale" Passante and his brother Mario Passante who serves as culinary director.

name: Himalayan Spice
description: Craving flavor? Check out the home-style dishes that are always scratch-made at Himalayan Spice. This locally owned and operated eatery has mastered the art of mixing spices, and with rich and savory curries loaded with flavor, there's something here for everyone. There are meaty and vegetarian picks at this popular eatery.

name: Little Moir's Hibiscus StrEATery
description: With fresh seafood by the pound, regular special menus, and plenty of hand-crafted eats, Hibiscus Street Catering is the place to go for scrumptious eats. Large or small, every event, party, meeting, and gathering is better when the food comes from this spot, and with a regularly changing menu, there's always plenty to tempt you!

name: Bandito's Burrito Lounge
description: Bandito's Burrito Lounge is a must-try local hot spot! This TV-lined sports bar features a variety of delicious Mexican-Californian eats, both classic dining and buffet style. They also host frequent live bands along with DJ sets and a bumping dance floor. Stop by for an unforgettable evening full of great times.

name: The Pho Fix
description: Are you in the mood for a delicious and authentic Vietnamese style dining experience? If so, then look no further than Pho Fix where you can expect each dish to be made with only the freshest ingredients and utmost care. You can build your own bowl or order one of their creations, such as their Surf 'N Turf spring roll.

name: Plump's Last Shot
description: Bobby Plump, who inspired the movie "Hoosiers" with his famed last-second shot in the 1950s to win the state high school basketball title, is the source of this great bar's name. Plump's Last Shot is an extraordinary place to enjoy refreshing drinks and tasty eats all night long while chatting up friends and strangers alike! With a few in-house games available to keep you occupied, a fabulous patio, daily specials and a lineup of great events, Plump's is sure to always have something to entertain you and put a smile on your face. While you're there, nosh on Justin's Buffalo wings, the award-winning Hoosier tenderloin sandwich, great burgers, fish & chips, and more. Stop by today with all your friends for a casual evening of stiff drinks, great food and scintillating conversations!

name: Johnnie's Hamburgers & Coneys
description: Looking for a classic and reliable spot to enjoy a satisfying and convenient meal? Johnnie's Hamburgers & Coneys has been home of the onion fried burger since 1946. They have stood the test of time in El Reno, remaining a local favorite known for their efficient service and menu of tasty and exciting American options.

name: Carl's Jr 1101601
description: In the mood for a convenient and satisfying meal? Come check out Carl's Jr for an option that hits every single time. This classic American favorite is known for their delicious angus burgers stacked with bacon and onion. They also serve breakfast! Come try their Monster Biscuit or the Breakfast Burger to start your day off with a bang.

name: Hibachi & Wings
description: With a delicious selection of both hibachi prepared entrees and Asian-inspired wings, it's easy to find plenty to love about Hibachi & Wings. This is a casual and affordable spot with a simple menu. Hibachi or wings--available in a variety of flavors, you can try it all! Udon, katsu, and fried rice dishes are also on the menu at this tasty spot.

name: Nola Poboys
description: Serving more than 45 different kinds of authentic, hearty, and oh-so tasty po'boys, Nola Poboys is a traditional sandwich shop with a reputation for amazing food and a funky atmosphere. It's all old school here, so go hungry, pick your favorite, and get ready to feast on something fabulous. The roast beef po'boy is a popular pick, but there's no doubt that the seafood choices are the stars of the show. Shrimp, oysters, soft shell crab, catfish, and so much more are made fresh and fabulous and stuffed into bakery-fresh bread. But there's more on the menu, and with so many options, you can go back again and again to try it all. Pulled pork, brisket, jambalaya, red beans and rice, and freshly fried spicy seafood are also tempting choices, and don't forget about the da-bris fries! Located on Bourbon Street in the heart of the French Quarter and open late, the next time you're craving a po'boy, check out Nola Poboys! Please note: Catering services are also available. Call ahead for details.

name: 212 The Boiling Point
description: 212 The Boiling Point is a full-service bar located in the heart of Brandon, South Dakota. Whether you're meeting friends for a couple of beers or gathering the family for a sit-down dinner, 212 is the perfect spot with a video lottery casino, Buzztime Trivia and Texas Hold'em, billiards, Big Buck Hunter, and Golden Tee Golf!

name: BOND 45
description: BOND 45 is a renowned restaurant that offers a dynamic dining experience, featuring a menu inspired by classic Italian cuisine. The restaurant is celebrated for its sophisticated ambiance and its commitment to using fresh, high-quality ingredients. Guests at BOND 45 can enjoy a diverse selection of dishes, including hand-crafted pastas, gourmet pizzas, and expertly prepared seafood and meat entrees. The establishment is known for its stylish decor and welcoming atmosphere, making it an ideal destination for both casual meals and special occasions. The attentive and knowledgeable staff at BOND 45 are dedicated to providing exceptional service, ensuring that every visit is memorable.

name: Mi Mexico
description: Mi Mexico has been delighting Minot diners with their take on authentic Mexican cuisine since opening in 2008. Today, you'll find friendly service, a terrific menu, and wallet-friendly prices at this family-run eatery that's perfect for everything from lunch with the office to family dinners and nights out with someone special. This eatery has a fiesta-like vibe with a colorful interior, plenty of seating options, and big murals on the wall. Go hungry and enjoy hand-crafted dishes like sizzling fajitas, chimichangas, carnitas, saucy enchiladas, tacos, chile Colorado, and so much more. There are combination dinners if you're having trouble deciding, and if you're out for lunch, ask about the lunch specials. There's also a full-service bar at Mi Mexico, so sip on a cold cerveza or refreshing margarita with your meal. Delicious, fresh, and always flavorful, when you're craving the big and bold flavors from south of the border, head to Mi Mexico!

name: Nikarry's
description: This place serves affordable American and Italian fare in a casual and relaxed setting.  The menu features a selection of appetizers, burgers, sandwiches, pitas and entrees.  Entrees are widely varied with choices like Stir-Fry Shrimp, Homemade Roast Turkey, Fried Chicken, Veal Cutlet Dinner and Greek Pork Chops just to mention a few.  For something special try one of their popular homemade shakes from the fountain.  This is a fun, family friendly place with a kid's menu that offers plenty of choices.  Nikarry's serves up a great breakfast that is quite popular with the locals and loaded with choices.  Try the Corned Beef Hash Skillet with mushrooms, onions, green peppers and cheese.  Be sure to ask about the daily specials and stop by for take out if you can't dine in.  The prices are very affordable.

name: Basta Pasteria
description: Basta Pasteria offers an extensive menu featuring a variety of traditional and innovative pasta dishes, all prepared with a dedication to quality and flavor. The restaurant prides itself on its warm and welcoming atmosphere, making it a favorite spot for both casual dining and special occasions. With a commitment to exceptional service, Basta Pasteria ensures every guest enjoys a memorable culinary experience.

name: Jade Dynasty
description: Still family owned and operated, the Jade Dynasty restaurant has been dishing up scrumptious northern Chinese dishes to hungry diners since 1985. With a focus on Mandarin and Szechuan styles of cuisine, every order at this eatery is made from scratch and from only the very highest quality and freshest ingredients to ensure that every meal is fabulous. Plus, with service that is friendly and accommodating, you'll be treated like family regardless if you dine in or take your  meal home to enjoy. Head over to this award winning restaurant today and feast on dishes like the Sliced Chicken with Mushrooms & Snow Peas, Shredded Pork with Garlic Sauce, Jumbo Shrimp with Black Bean Sauce, and much more. Also be sure to try house specialties like the Beef & Chicken Hunan Style or the spicy Ginger Chicken. Swing by for their amazing, delicious and affordable lunch specials (weekdays only), where for one great price you can enjoy a full meal. In addition, this amazing venue has a terrific private room which is ideal for your next special event. The next time you're craving the freshest and tastiest Chinese food, head to Jade Dynasty!

name: Spice
description: Before Spice, there were not many great choices for New Yorkers who wished to indulge in Thai food. This restaurant respects the secrets of Thai cuisine and features recipes that combine tropical herbs and homemade spices to create dishes that are simply outstanding.  The chefs infuse classic Thai foods with a newfound sensibility to appeal to both the traditionalist and first-time diner. Spice goes the extra mile by providing their delicious cuisine in a modern, decorative space. The colorful Thai spices and flavors are well-represented throughout the restaurant, which is staffed by a group of friendly people all interested in making sure your dining experience is one-of-a-kind. Unfamiliar with Thai cuisine? Just ask the staff and they will be happy to assist you and walk you through the menu. You will walk out of Spice not only feeling content but also possessing a better understanding of Thai food. Spice is the ideal place to treat your special someone to a pleasant dinner while knowing your wallet will not be empty upon leaving. Reservations are accepted for parties of six or more. A full bar with wine and beer is available and all dishes are prepared with no MSG added. Don't forget to download the Spice app so you can keep up with specials and deals, to find locations, and to order online. Search for Spice Restaurant in the app store and look for the red logo!

name: Park Harvey Sushi
description: Park Harvey Sushi is a fun sushi bar and restaurant that offers artisanal, craft rolls that are always made fresh to order for you to enjoy. They have a contemporary ambience that is stocked full of TVs for you to catch the big game while feasting on an eclectic meal. Come down today to find out what it's like to have truly "great" sushi!

name: Graze Craze Lakeway
description: Graze Craze is leading the charcuterie trend in Sandy, UT with fresh house made charcuterie boards and boxes for lunch time snacking, corporate catering, and casual, and special events. Their hand-crafted personal and picnic boxes, platters, and grazing tables are perfect for every day or making an impression at all social events.

name: Benny's On The Green
description: Benny's on the Green is a quintessential  eatery that embodies the spirit of classic comfort dining with a contemporary twist. From hearty burgers and sizzling steaks to flavorful regional specialties, Benny's delivers a delectable journey through the diverse and delicious landscape of American cuisine, all served in a warm and inviting atmosphere.

name: CAFE FIORELLO
description: Cafe Fiorello is a beloved Italian restaurant located just across from Lincoln Center, making it a favorite pre-theater dining spot. Known for its extensive antipasto bar and classic Italian dishes, it offers a rich and flavorful dining experience. The restaurant's elegant yet cozy atmosphere, combined with attentive service, makes it a popular choice for both locals and visitors.

name: Stromboli Pizza
description: With room to dine-in and a terrific menu, Stromboli Pizza is the place to go when craving all your favorite pizzas, stromboli, and much more! This local favorite is known for great food, reasonable prices and friendly service, so it should be a regular on your dining-out rotation. Stop by for lunch with co-workers, make this your top pick for meals with the family, or share a fabulous meal with someone special. If you're on the go, grab a slice for a quick meal, or stop by and order all your favorites. Build a pizza just how you want it, or try a specialty pie like the fully-loaded meat lovers pizza or the chicken and veggie pizza. Pepperoni rolls, hot and hearty hero sandwiches, and their terrific calzones are also available. Craving pizza and other tasty eats? Check out Stromboli Pizza today!

name: Short Stories
description: Short Stories, aims to provide an extraordinary dining experience that combines comfort with elegance, focusing on meticulously crafted dishes to create a sense of warmth and familiarity for its patrons. Transitioning from its original concept as a California-inspired all-day cafe to an elevated neighborhood bistro under new management by Something Good Hospitality, Short Stories now offers a revamped menu designed by Chef Raph, featuring exciting fusion dishes. This transformation includes a commitment to a high-end dining experience, with plans to introduce a full kitchen and new staff, ensuring a blend of culinary excellence, hospitality, and entertainment​​​​​​.

name: McDonald's - W Lincoln Ave
description: Since 1955, McDonald's has been serving some of the world's favorite food. The golden arches beckon you to a place where you know the food is going to be fast and delicious. McDonald's may be the most iconic fast food restaurant in the world, but it is also the place where you'll find tasty and affordable meals for breakfast, lunch and dinner. From steaming cups of premium blend McCafe coffees to classic Egg McMuffins and fruit & maple oatmeal, mornings have never been tastier. For lunch, dinner and late-night snacks, wrap your hands around hearty and oh-so-satisfying Big Macs, Premium Grilled Chicken Club sandwiches, or the classic Cheeseburger. With sandwiches to make the meal, world famous fries and crisp, garden-fresh salads, you can have a meal that is perfect from the first bite to the last. Kids also love McDonald's -- with their famous Happy Meals, each box is full of child-friendly goodness. The Dollar Menu is also a great choice when needing a snack on the go, or something extra with your meal. No matter when you go, McDonald's will always be there for you with hot, fresh and delish food! Please note: Gift card purchases do not qualify for Rewards points.

name: Jersey Mike's Subs - Bend
description: Everything about Jersey Mike's is high quality. Their certified Angus beef top rounds are trimmed and cooked right in the store. The meats and cheeses are all top-quality premium brands, and the bread is baked fresh each day on the premises. Plus, everything's prepared right in front of you, exactly the way you want it.

name: City Diner
description: Open around the clock, City Diner in the heart of the city is the place to go for all your favorite casual dining favorites. Whether it's a tasty City Diner burger, their jumbo cheese ravioli, or a hearty steak, they've got you covered. And, they're open 24/7 so you can feast on all sorts of breakfast, lunch, and dinner eats at this popular spot.

name: Porkyland Mexican Grill
description: Porkyland Mexican Grill has been serving hungry diners for decades. Still family-owned and operated, this popular spot has been on a mission to deliver an authentic traditional dining experience. Full of freshness and flavor, each hand-crafted dish is spectacular. Breakfast, lunch or dinner--it's all terrific at this popular spot!

name: McALISTER'S DELI  Amarillo  34
description: McAlister's Deli is a popular American chain known for its extensive menu featuring sandwiches, salads, soups, and signature sweet tea. Founded in 1989 in Oxford, Mississippi, the deli has grown to over 450 locations across the United States. McAlister's is celebrated for its friendly service and comfortable, casual dining atmosphere.

name: 1 BBQ  Burger
description: In the mood for something delicious and satisfying? Come on down to 1BBQ and Burger Del City for an option that is sure to hit the spot. This local favorite destination is known for their tasty barbecued meats including brisket, ribs, pulled pork, smoked sausage, smoked fish, and more, along with tasty sandwiches and sides.

name: Kung Fu Little Steamed Buns Ramen-HK
description: Take a journey to China at Kung Fu Little Steamed Buns Ramen in Hell's Kitchen. Made fresh every single day, their authentic steamed buns (xiao long bao) and hand-pulled ramen noodles are not to be missed. A cozy and simple joint, this is the perfect place to take a quick break from exploring the city and enjoy delicious Chinese eats. Hand-pulled noodle dishes and soups are a popular choice here. Try the house special stir-fried ramen (shrimp, beef, egg, and bok choy), spicy beef ramen soup with scallion and bok choy, or cold ramen with sesame sauce. Steamed pork buns, pan-fried dumplings, and amazing dim sum like pork and shrimp wontons, scallion pancakes, and Shanghai spring rolls are also all fantastic choices. Pair your food with a tasty bubble milk tea and treat yourself to delectable desserts like sticky rice balls and steamed red bean buns. Friendly service and outstanding food awaits you at Kung Fu Little Steamed Buns Ramen in Hell's Kitchen.

name: St Augie's Pizza
description: Everybody claims to have the best pizza around, but at St. Augie's in St. Augustine, they're a top contender to be the best of the best. Born to Italian immigrants in Brooklyn, founder and owner Agostino (Augie) knows a thing or two about making pizzas. Taught how to make authentic and oh-so good Italian cuisine by his parents, he and his wife operate St. Augie's which is a bona fide area favorite. They've been making pizzas for over 40 years, and at this popular spot, you can get your hands on tasty creations like a classic supreme or the chicken, bacon, ranch pizza. You can also build your own creation, topping it how you like from the huge variety of toppings. There's more on the menu, even if pizzas are the star of the show. Check out stuffed-end-to-end subs, calzones, hearty pastas like baked ziti, garden-fresh salads, and more. Order online for delivery, call ahead for catering, or dine-in and enjoy a terrific meal today at St. Augie's!

name: Ashford & Simpsons Sugar Bar
description: If you want sweet, Ashford & Simpson's Sugar Bar can satisfy that tooth. Of course you can fill up on your sugar intake anywhere, but the Sugar Bar offers a different kind of sweet. "Sweet" here refers to music, soul-stirring riffs, runs and melodies in a cozy environment with delectable cuisine you can only find here. Presenting a fresh alternative to the mundane, the Sugar Bar is an intimate full-service restaurant showcasing local and international talent from R&B/soul, jazz, and Caribbean to traditional African rhythms.  Take one step beneath a canopy of forged brass into the 2,400 square foot boite and you will be magically transported into the exotic Pan-Africanism of the Sugar Bar.  Intimately immersed in big flavors, live music and performances and the signature Sugartinis, an evening here might begin at the watering well where specialty cocktails and a selection of cultural appetizers set the mood and whet the appetite. You can enjoy your dinner in the main dining room where every table has an excellent view of the stage or in the more intimate setting of the enclosed garden. You can also enjoy a prixe-fixe three-course dinner Tuesday-Friday from 5:30-7 p.m. for only $19.95 per person.  Since opening, the Sugar Bar has been host to various celebrities such as: Bruce Willis, Stevie Wonder, Luther Vandross, Michael Douglas, Patrick Ewing and Eddie Murphy just to name a few. Enjoy 2 for 1 drinks during Happy Hour which runs from Tuesday to Friday, 5-7:30 p.m.

name: Southpark Seafood
description: This stylishly casual seafood eatery, located in the heart of downtown Portland, has been delivering Pacific NW gold in ways that are both sophisticated and approachable for over twenty-five years. Partnered with the Monterey Bay Aquarium Seafood Watch, only seafood that has been fished or farmed in ways that minimize the environmental impact is offered at Southpark Seafood. Oregon Dungeness Crab, King Salmon, Pacific Oysters, Clam Chowder from scratch, and house-made everything; Southpark Seafood utilizes the freshest farm-to-table produce and the best of the best seafood around.

name: District Lounge
description: District Lounge, located in Saint Petersburg, FL, is a sophisticated drink lounge offering a unique and inviting atmosphere for patrons seeking a memorable evening. The lounge is renowned for its extensive drink menu, featuring a wide variety of craft cocktails, fine wines, and local beers, each curated to perfection. Expert bartenders craft each drink with precision, ensuring a delightful experience for every guest.

name: Via Brasil
description: Via Brasil is a popular Brazilian restaurant that offers a rich and diverse menu inspired by the flavors of Brazil. Known for its delicious feijoada, picanha, and caipirinhas, the restaurant provides an authentic taste of Brazilian cuisine in the heart of Manhattan. With a lively atmosphere and warm hospitality, Via Brasil delivers a memorable dining experience that captures the spirit of Brazil.

name: Cubby's
description: Looking for the perfect place to grab a delicious meal? Come on down to Cubby's today for an option that is great for the whole family! They are known for serving up some of the best burgers in town, as well as a tasty selection of ice cream and frozen yogurt. Stop by today for a guaranteed great time!

name: Press Box
description: The Press Box is Tampa's favorite place to watch the big game and party. They show all NFL games with five big screens and 23 screens total. If you want to see a sporting event taking place in North America (and some beyond), you can see it there.  Tampa's top sports personalities have been coming to The Press Box for years. When you stop by, you never know which of your favorite sports celebrities you may run into!  For example, every Tuesday there is a different member of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers making an appearance between 6-9 p.m.  Serving the area for over 20 years, The Press Box has added NFL Sunday Ticket, ESPN Game Plan (college football), NHL Center Ice, NBA League Pass, ESPN Full Court Press, MLS/ESPN Shootout, WNBA Season Pass and even WWE pay-per-views to the viewing repertoire.  Enjoy juicy wings, "burger mania," give-a-ways, prizes, drinks and beer specials.  If you have a big event, let them make it a home run with on- or off-premises catering!

name: VeganHood
description: Created by Lanise and Janine, VeganHood brings a familiar and relatable taste to their urban community. On a mission to bridge veganism and the hood, VeganHood offers soul food with a 100% plant-based spin. Stop in and taste tasty vegan comfort foods including wings, shrimp, mac and cheese, and much more.

name: South Fin Grill
description: Situated in Staten Island, NY, South Fin Grill is renowned for its stunning panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean. Alongside this picturesque backdrop, patrons can indulge in daily drink specials and enticing dinner deals, enhancing their dining experience with both culinary delights and scenic beauty.

name: TGI Fridays
description: End your busy week in a place where everyone says, "Thank Goodness It's Friday!" T.G.I. Fridays is an American restaurant that prides itself on fun and friendly service while offering a great menu, full bar and relaxed atmosphere. Enjoy fried mac and cheese, loaded potato skins, boneless buffalo wings & their famous Jack Daniels Grill items.

name: El Sushi Loco Sushi & Seafood
description: El Sushi Loco is a vibrant, eclectic restaurant that offers a blend of traditional Japanese sushi and Mexican-inspired fusion dishes. Its innovative menu and diverse flavors attract locals and visitors, making it a culinary paradise where traditional Japanese sushi meets bold Mexican cuisine.

name: Yasin's Homestyle Seafood - College Park
description: The best of homestyle seafood, chicken, and more is waiting for you at Yasin's Homestyle Seafood. Here you'll find jumbo shrimp and real fish fillets with no fillers and no additives. Yasin's cooks everything to order so it is fresh, hot, and delicious each and every time.

name: Brine
description: Brine is known for serving juicy and flavorful chicken dishes in a fast-casual setting. The menu features a variety of chicken-based meals, including their signature pulled chicken bowls and sandwiches, which are complemented by a selection of sides and sauces. With a focus on high-quality ingredients and bold flavors, Brine has become a popular spot for both locals and visitors looking for a satisfying and quick meal in the Chelsea neighborhood.

name: Baodega
description: Chef Kenny Yie was so inspired by his grandmother's recipes that he was moved to open Baodega, a charming cafe in the Flatiron District serving dim sum and other Shanghai-influenced dishes. Everything about Baodega is designed with a sense of community, from the long picnic tables to the abundance of shareable plates, so pull up a seat with some of your favorite people and don't be shy about ordering a lot of food. All of their menu options are made fresh in-house, and with so many choices, there's bound to be something to please everyone in your party. Their variety of soup dumplings are popular dim sum choices--such as crab roe, pork, chicken, and traditional Shanghai pan-fried--and their family-style entrees include dry pot chicken, sweet and sour ribs, braised pork, hot pot beef, and meatball stew. Lunch specials are available Monday-Friday, and the onsite Asian craft coffee bar has something that will perfectly complement any order. The dining space is homey and inviting with a modern cafe vibe that features exposed brick and wood paneled walls, unique lighting fixtures, minimal decor, and comfortable seating for groups small or large. Also available for takeout and delivery, Baodega puts a delicious contemporary spin on dim sum dining that you'll want to revisit again and again.

name: JC's Burger Bar - Coppell
description: Whenever you visit JC's Burger Bar (with a convenient party room for your next celebration), you're in for a treat. This spot puts a modern spin on the all-American classic with its fast-casual, counter-serve style. Tortilla chips with queso or guac, homemade chili, and piled-high plates of ultimate chicken nachos make for great starters. The main attractions are the burgers, of course, and JC's delivers with one-third pound, USDA Choice chuck patties on your choice of toasted white or wheat bun. Want to save the carbs? Go with Bemmie's Bunless Burger and its combination of green chiles, grilled onions, tomato, and Swiss and American cheese all served up on a bed of lettuce. The Nooner is another popular favorite; It's loaded with a fried egg, bacon, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and zesty cilantro aioli sauce. Chicken sandwiches, BLTs, veggie burgers, salads, or tacos (like the grilled fish) are available when you need more variety. Complete your meal with a flurry of sides and shakes -- or something from the full bar (there's even a TV so you can watch the game). When you're ready for a real challenge, ask about The Toddzilla!

name: Table 11
description: Looking for the perfect place to enjoy a delicious meal and immaculate atmosphere? Be sure to check out Table 11, a family-owned restaurant in beautiful downtown Concord. Their extensive menu features a variety of freshly grilled dishes that are cooked to perfection and made from the best quality ingredients. Table 11 only serves brunch on Saturdays.

name: Straw Hat Pizza
description: Straw Hat Pizza is a fan-favorite chain serving Californian pizza, stuffed sandwiches, and fresh salads made with locally grown ingredients. Whether you are looking for a tasty breakfast, a quick bite for lunch, or a place to enjoy dinner, they are a great place to satisfy your cravings, with delicious food and attentive service.

name: Hangry Joe's Hot Chicken- Herndon
description: Hangry Joe's Hot Chicken invites patrons with a lively atmosphere and a menu brimming with spicy delights. From the sizzling hot chicken dishes to the flavorful array of side dishes, the restaurant offers a tantalizing experience for those seeking a bold and fiery culinary adventure. With attentive service and a diverse selection of heat levels to cater to various palates, this eatery is a go-to destination for spice enthusiasts.

name: Evergreens
description: Evergreens in Hillsboro, OR, is a popular restaurant known for its fresh and vibrant salads, wraps, and bowls made with locally sourced ingredients. The eatery emphasizes healthy, customizable meals, catering to a variety of dietary preferences and needs. With its welcoming atmosphere and commitment to quality, Evergreens has become a favorite spot for both quick lunches and relaxed dinners in the community.

name: La Veranda Ristorante Italiano
description: La Veranda Ristorante Italiano brings a dash of Old World charm to the heart of Old Town Pittsburg. The family behind this restaurant is committed to preserving the tradition of fabulous food, drinks and service in this convenient location. Every meal begins with the very best quality ingredients. Stop by for lunch or dinner and try antipasti like the salmone affumicati (smoked salmon with goat cheese & capers), or the carpaccio Cipriani (with filet mignon). Their pizzas are a delightful alternative to heartier dishes, and with choices like the bel giardino (roasted veggies and pesto) and the salsiccia e funghi (Italian sausage and mushroom), there's something for everyone. But if you're craving pasta, they've got the dish for you! Gnocchi or ravioli di giorno, fettuccini Alfredo, and linguini alla vongole await your dining pleasure. Or, sup on house specialties which include the likes of umido di conigli (stewed rabbit) or piatto di mangiatore di carne (a grilled NY steak). This restaurant is also home to a splendid wine bar area -- with open seating and the full dinner menu available, this is a great alternative to the dining room if you forgot to make reservations. Speaking of wines, the carefully curated collection of wines includes those from both Italy and California, and with various price points, you can enjoy it by the glass or bottle. Check their Facebook page or call ahead and see when next they're offering live music, then head on over for an Italian dining experience that you won't soon forget.

name: Um.Ma.
description: Um.Ma. is your new go-to destination for mouthwatering Korean cuisine. Explore popular dishes like kimchi pancakes, bulgogi, Korean fried chicken, and tender pork belly. This welcoming eatery has an elevated atmosphere complete with authentic decor, beautiful greenery, and a private outdoor patio. Stop by Wednesday through Sunday for a wonderful time!

name: Atlanta Marriott Suites Midtown
description: Stop by for Grille 35 for tasty breakfast, lunch, or dinner fare. Conveniently located at the Marriott Suites Atlanta Midtown, this casual and modern eatery serves a variety of American dishes including burgers, chicken wings, and more. Hand-crafted cocktails are also available, making this a great spot no matter if you're a local or just visiting.

name: Charm Siam Restaurant
description: Charm Siam transports diners to the heart of Thailand with its authentic and aromatic dishes. Nestled in a cozy corner, its warm ambiance invites guests to savor the rich flavors of Thai cuisine. From fragrant green curry to spicy papaya salad, each dish is a culinary journey through the vibrant streets of Bangkok.

name: J D Tucker's Bar
description: J D Tucker's Bar is a locally owned and operated bar and restaurant that is known for providing a great, welcoming atmosphere for friends and family to enjoy and excellent customer service. This cozy and sleek spot is both casual and welcoming, with a full bar and an excellent menu of delicious options.

name: Angelina Bakery
description: Angelina Bakery is a charming and beloved establishment known for its exquisite pastries and delightful treats. Established with a passion for baking, this bakery offers a diverse menu that includes an array of freshly baked goods, from classic croissants and muffins to unique and creative pastries. Alongside its bakery offerings, Angelina Bakery also features a full dinner menu with savory options such as pasta, sandwiches, and pizza. Each item is crafted with the finest ingredients, ensuring a perfect blend of flavors and textures. The cozy and inviting atmosphere of Angelina Bakery provides a warm and welcoming environment for customers to enjoy their favorite baked delights or a satisfying meal. Whether stopping by for a morning coffee and pastry, indulging in a sweet treat in the afternoon, or enjoying a savory dinner, Angelina Bakery promises a delightful culinary experience that satisfies every palate. The friendly and attentive staff are dedicated to providing excellent service, making every visit to Angelina Bakery a memorable one.

name: Superfoods Cafe
description: Superfoods Cafe is an organic and gluten free cafe with a plethora of tasty vegan options including smoothies, bowls, wraps, sweets, coffee, tea, and more. Their market is filled with organic options that may be tough to find at the normal store. Whether buying for your own kitchen, on the go, or meeting with friends, you will be delighted.

name: Textile Taphaus
description: Textile TapHaus invites guests to experience a unique blend of craft beer, cocktails, mixed drinks, and culinary delights in its warm and inviting taproom. Textile TapHaus serves exclusive Textile Brewing Company (Dyersville, Iowa) brews, along with other primarily local craft beers. The food menu features delectable options such as the sizable Bavarian pretzel, pretzel bites, flatbreads available on regular or gluten-free cauliflower crust, beer cheese nachos, and other appetizers.

name: The Centro
description: The Centro restaurant in Cleveland, located in the Metropolitan at the 9 Hotel, steps from the arena, stadium, and theater district, is a stand-out destination for weekly brunch and daily breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Prepare for a culinary journey filled with tantalizing appetizers and mouthwatering main courses. From the rich flavors of Bone-In Filet Mignon, House-Made Lobster Raviolo, and delicate Chilean Sea Bass, these stand-out delicacy will ignite your taste buds. Pair your meal with a selection from Centro's extensive wine list, or sip on handcrafted cocktails.

name: Firehouse Subs - Harbison
description: People love a good meal, and at Firehouse Subs you can be sure that your meal will be terrific. Built on a legacy of fire and police service, this entrepreneurial eatery started small but has grown to more than 900 locations, all committed to serving the best quality meats, cheeses, and produce in hearty and delicious subs, sandwiches, and salads.

name: Chela's Tacos
description: In the mood for some delicious and authentic Mexican cuisine? Come check out Chela's Tacos for an option that you are sure to love. They care about quality, cooking with natural and healthy ingredients. They have menus for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with affordable combo plates, breakfast tacos, and a la carte!

name: Ageha
description: Ageha Japanese Fusion is a fabulous urban eatery, one where not only will diners find a décor that is comfortable, classy and very chic, but they'll find some of the freshest and most delicious Japanese food around. If you're hungry for sushi, pull up a chair at the fabulous sushi bar and watch in amazement as the talented sushi chefs roll, press and form delicious morsels using only the highest quality fish and seafood. If you're craving the comforting flavors of Japanese kitchen classics, then check out dishes like the Tempura Sampler, Kalbi, Negimaki and so much more. With friendly service, a full bar, a great Happy Hour and so much more, Ageha Japanese Fusion needs to become your first choice when it comes to Japanese cuisine - stop by today!

name: Pesto Italian Craft Kitchen Mission Valley
description: East Coast flavor mixes with West Coast vibes at Pesto Italian Craft Kitchen, a hearty, healthy new spin on traditional Italian fare. From crisp insalate and savory pizza and pasta to signature garlic knots, Pesto Craft Kitchen stirs your taste buds and feeds your soul.

name: Hungry Howie's #1849
description: At Hungry Howie's, they have combined the right ingredients and years of successful experience to create a superb restaurant environment. Their delicious, high-quality Flavored Crust (TM) pizzas, oven baked subs and salads are extremely popular and have become unique to the Hungry Howie's franchise.

name: Smokin' Joe
description: Looking for the perfect place to enjoy a delicious meal? Come on down to Smokin' Joe today for an option that is sure to hit the spot! Enjoy popular dishes like curry rice, chicken cutlets, Hainanaese grilled chicken, and braised cabbage, all packed with exciting flavor and made from the absolute best ingredients.

name: Vito's Restaurant
description: Vito's is an old-school Italian restaurant that has been a local favorite for over 40 years. A selection of appetizers, pasta, veal dishes, and seafood are served in their classic atmosphere. They offer one of the most impressive and expansive four-star wine lists in California along with experienced bartenders ready to craft any cocktail imaginable!

name: Pokeworks Webster
description: Pokeworks uses sustainable, seasonal ingredients to create colorful and healthy meals. A multi-step ordering process makes building your dish a blast. Begin by choosing from among the following options: bowl (kale noodle, sushi rice, organic brown rice, or quinoa), burrito (sushi rice and roasted seaweed wrap), kale noodles, or salad (fresh romaine and spring mix). Next up are the proteins (mix two or three if you can't choose just one): options like ahi tuna, organic tofu, spicy salmon, albacore tuna, chicken, shrimp, and scallops guarantee that you'll find a perfect combination. Finally, you get to jazz up your meal with mix-ins, toppings, flavors, and crunchy add-ons; you'll find everything from chopped shiso, fresh jalapeno, spicy ginger sauce, and wasabi aioli to lotus chips, macadamia nuts, and more. There's also a selection of signature bowls, like the popular spicy ahi, shiso salmon, or umami classic (ahi tuna, green and sweet onion, hijiki seaweed, cucumber, sesame seeds, and umami shoyu sauce). Pair your meal with a refreshing, infused iced tea or Hawaiian Sun tropical fruit drink.

name: Zane's Lebanese Grill
description: Zane's Lebanese Grill offers high quality, delicious meals. They are committed to food that always tastes great, specializing in Lebanese cuisine, refreshing salads, and delicious kebabs. They are a reliable spot for excellent service and also offer delivery. Stop by and try one of their platters or a build your own option!

name: Yamato Japanese Steakhouse and Sushi
description: Yamato Japanese Steakhouse is one of the area's most popular restaurants, for good reason. Not only will you find the finest hand-crafted sushi at this eatery, but you'll also discover an exceptional teppanyaki dining experience. This is a fun and interactive way to dine, where your personal chef will cook your meal before your very eyes! From spinning eggs and flaming onion volcanos to the chef's dazzling knife skills, you can't help but be impressed by their cooking savvy. At the end of the show, you're presented with a meal that was cooked to perfection. Order a feast of steak, chicken, shrimp, lobster, scallops and more, or mix and match by choosing one of their delicious combos. Each entrée is accompanied by soup, salad, vegetables, fried rice and noodles -- all for one affordable price! Yamato also features a state-of-the-art sushi bar, where the talented chefs create stunning morsels from the best the sea has to offer. There's plenty more to try at this restaurant, including kitchen entrées like: teriyaki, donburi, tempura, udon noodle dishes, and much more. With so much variety, make a plan to go again and again to sample it all. From special occasion dining and date-night to family dinners, co-worker lunches and more, there's no place quite like Yamato Japanese Steakhouse!

name: Denny's 7294
description: For over 65 years, Denny's has been satisfying customers with the most delicious diner food and welcoming atmosphere. They are committed to being a place where people can connect over great food. Whether you are in the mood for a sweet stack of pancakes, a savory handheld, or a customized omelette, Denny's has you covered with all the diner classics and more.

name: Kicker's
description: Kicker's is the top seafood restaurant in Morro Bay. Their menu features fresh and locally caught seafood from their raw oyster bar, hot and delicious homemade creations, and a broad spectrum of craft beers and cocktails that'll make your taste buds sing. This is the perfect spot to make memories, with an unbeatable view of the bay!

name: La Sandwicherie
description: La Sandwicherie in New York is a charming sandwich shop known for its fresh, high-quality ingredients and an extensive selection of gourmet sandwiches. This cozy eatery, with its friendly atmosphere and efficient service, has become a favorite among locals and visitors alike. Renowned for its unique combinations of flavors and freshly baked bread, La Sandwicherie stands out as a must-visit destination for sandwich enthusiasts in New York City.

name: Nakama Sushi Restaurant & Lounge
description: West Valley's newest hot spot, Nakama Sushi Restaurant & Lounge brings a hip, trendy atmosphere to the area.  Step inside and you will be greeted with a six-foot tall sake tower along with attractive red walls.  The bar area has a lounge theme with cube seating and throw pillows while a cool back-lit bar provides a variety of wines, martinis, mixed drinks, beers and premium sake.  Move on to the dining room, featuring an S-shaped sushi bar where you can taste the freshest sushi and sashimi from the experienced sushi chefs.  The full kitchen in the back provides an Asian fusion menu where you can choose an array of well-presented dishes from Asian-spiced rub ribeye to sake-marinated sea ball accompanied by signature wasabi mashed potatoes.  Nakama also has a huge patio for outdoor dining and private parties as well as flat screen televisions throughout the restaurant.  With a staff that strives to provide great service and awesome food, Nakama is sure that after just one visit you will become a part of its "circle of friends!" Happy Hour is from 3-6 p.m. daily.

name: El Pollo Inka Peru - Ozone Park
description: At El Pollo Inka, you'll find mouth-watering Peruvian cuisine, including their famous rotisserie chicken. Get it by the quarter, half or whole chicken along with tasty sides, or order the popular lomo saltado, saltado de mariscos, or arroz con frijoles! Pair your meal with their aji verde hot sauce to add some serious spice to your meal.

name: Mulligan's Grill
description: Mulligan's Grill proudly serves an authentic Outer Banks dining experience with the perfect setting for Southern Coastal Cuisine. With comfortable indoor and outdoor seating, they offer a family-friendly hangout spot with TVs so you can catch the big game. They offer the best burgers on the beach as well as a variety of fresh seafood.

name: Luna's Mexican Rotisserie
description: Luna's Mexican Rotisserie has been dishing up succulent and authentic Mexican eats since opening in 2002. Featuring their amazing rotisserie chicken, the secret recipe comes from the coast of Veracruz and with so much flavor, you'll be back for more. Homemade stews, tamales, and more are also on the menu, so go back often to try it all!

name: TGI Fridays
description: End your busy week in a place where everyone says, "Thank Goodness It's Friday!" T.G.I. Fridays is an American restaurant that prides itself on fun and friendly service while offering a great menu, full bar and relaxed atmosphere. Enjoy fried mac and cheese, loaded potato skins, boneless buffalo wings & their famous Jack Daniels Grill items.

name: Okawa Sushi & Ramen
description: Okawa Sushi & Ramen offers a delightful blend of traditional and contemporary Japanese cuisine, featuring an extensive menu of fresh sushi and flavorful ramen. The restaurant's cozy atmosphere and friendly service create an inviting dining experience for both casual meals and special occasions. Known for its high-quality ingredients and artistic presentation, Okawa Sushi & Ramen has become a favorite spot for sushi and ramen enthusiasts.

name: Menchie's - Westminster Promenade
description: What started as a simple frozen yogurt shop in a suburb of Los Angeles in 2007 has since grown into a sweets-lover's paradise as Menchie's now has locations all over the world. Every location still adheres to the core values of offering friendly service, providing a welcoming environment, and serving the highest quality product. At Menchie's you can truly have your frozen yogurt your way: grab a cup, fill it with your chosen flavor -- or mix it up with multiple flavors -- and sprinkle on as many toppings as you like. Price is determined by weight, and yogurt flavors come in nonfat, low fat, regular, low carb, no-sugar-added varieties, and fruity sorbets. Over 100 flavor options rotate regularly and vary by location, so at any time you'll find an assortment of traditional (vanilla snow, pure chocolate, strawberry burst) and unique (creamy peanut butter, dreamy dulce de leche, key lime pie) flavors that are sure to satisfy any sweet tooth. Topping choices include sauces and syrups, fresh fruit, nuts, granola, crumbled cookies, and candy pieces, so pile on as much or as little as you want for your completely customized yogurt experience. Also featuring a rewards program that will earn you dollars toward future purchases, Menchie's is the dessert stop that you just won't be able to resist.

name: UDON
description: Udon is a vibrant Japanese restaurant known for its delicious, hand-crafted noodles and flavorful broths. Located in Miami's trendy Wynwood district, it offers a modern yet cozy dining atmosphere perfect for enjoying a bowl of authentic udon. With a menu featuring fresh, high-quality ingredients and traditional Japanese flavors, Udon is a must-visit for noodle enthusiasts.

name: Salumeria Rosi
description: Always well-reviewed, Salumeria Rosi is bringing authenticity back to Italian cuisine. This is not an Italian-American eatery, instead, diners will discover a place that could have been plucked from the narrow streets of Italy. The cozy and intimate space is home to huge cuts of meat hanging behind the meat counter, a deli case filled to bursting with salami, other cured meats and cheeses, and a menu that has everyone from food critics to every-day diners raving. Porchetta, crostini, a salad of roasted cauliflower, hand-rolled gnocchi, their famous lasagna, the daily fish and the Tuscan spare ribs in a sauce so succulent, you'll be mopping the last traces of it from your plate. The real star of the show, however, is their salami. Each of the sampler plates feature eight salamis allowing diners to savor the nuances in flavor profiles. There are wines by the glass or bottle, so pick an interesting vintage and then nibble on some of the best genuine Italian fare the city has to offer.

name: Compadres Mexican Restaurant - Greenville
description: Compadres Mexican Grill & Bar boasts an authentic atmosphere infused with vibrant colors and traditional décor, immersing diners in the heart of Mexican culture. Their menu showcases a rich tapestry of flavors, from sizzling fajitas to zesty street tacos, meticulously crafted to tantalize taste buds and transport patrons to the streets of Mexico. With warm hospitality and an extensive selection of tequilas and margaritas, Compadres promises an unforgettable dining experience, where every visit feels like a fiesta among friends.

name: Snack Mania Hillside
description: Snack Mania Brazilian Delights offers an authentic taste of Brazilian cuisine with a variety of snacks and desserts. Known for its coxinhas, pão de queijo, and brigadeiros, the establishment provides a cozy atmosphere for enjoying traditional Brazilian flavors. It's a popular spot for both locals and visitors seeking a unique culinary experience.

name: Win Thai
description: In the mood for some delicious and authentic Thai cuisine? Come on down to Win Thai today for an option that is sure to leave you satisfied. They specialize in traditional Thai dishes that are made from the freshest and finest ingredients. Enjoy lunch specials from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. Tuesdays through Fridays!

name: A.O.C. East
description: A.O.C. East is a wine bar and bistro with a fabulous French spin. This rustic and urban-chic eatery has a great vibe that makes it perfect for foodies, drinks with friends, or date-night with someone special. This place does it all; start with a fabulous glass of wine. With a selection of vintages that are affordable, approachable and all-around terrific, you can share a bottle or order by the glass. Then, enjoy a delightful meal. Build your meal from the selection of petites plats and dine tapas style. Fresh crab croquettes, French fries maison with truffle oil, East Coast oysters, the trio of homemade sausage, and the foie gras are all wonderful. For a more traditional meal, select from entrees like the classic coq auf vin, Hudson Valley duck leg confit, or a bistro favorite: moules marinieres et frites. For late-night munching, check out the house made charcuterie or artisanal chees platter. After dinner, stick around for the live music. And, with two Happy Hours (4-7 p.m. and again from midnight until 1 or 2 a.m.), every time is a great time to visit A.O.C. East!

name: Tavern On The Point
description: Tavern On The Point serves an exciting chef-driven menu that elevates classic tavern fare to another level. They have an amazing atmosphere with great food, great drinks, and over 34 large screen HD TVs. Explore gourmet cooking and savory twists inspired from around the globe. Now serving brunch on Saturdays and Sundays!

name: House of Lasagna
description: Raved about by both food critics and tasty food lovers, House of Lasagna has is a small, neighborhood Italian restaurant perfect for low-key dining without all the hype. Complete with warm, friendly service and a great menu, this two level venue is perfect for family dinners, business lunches, date nights and everything in between. Open daily for lunch and dinner (dinner only on the weekends), there's always a variety of different lasagnas on the menu in addition to other dishes. Start what will surely be a memorable meal with an order of the bruschetta or the mozzarella Mediterranea, then dive into a layered delight like the classic lasagna Bolognese or crave-worthy chicken Parmigiana on a bed of spaghetti.  It doesn't really matter what you order, because it's all delicious!  What if you're not a fan of lasagna? Never fear, there's plenty more to be had including other pasta dishes and classics like the pollo alla Francese or the scaloppine of chicken alla Marsala. Add a great glass of wine to your meal and you'll be all set! For the best service, the tastiest food and an undeniably great all around dining experience, head to the House of Lasagna--check it out today!

name: Juicehead Smoothies & Coffee
description: Juicehead Smoothies & Coffee is a café, serving smoothies, raw juices, coffee, oatmeal, and bagels. Their smoothies are customizable with various superfood, protein, and other healthy ingredients. You can count on them for a delicious, no-nonsense treat made from all of the freshest stuff available.

name: Casa Patron
description: Casa Patron Mexican Restaurant is a vibrant dining establishment celebrated for its authentic Mexican cuisine. Known for its warm and inviting atmosphere, Casa Patron offers a diverse menu featuring traditional Mexican dishes made from fresh, high-quality ingredients. Guests can enjoy a variety of flavorful options, from savory tacos and enchiladas to hearty burritos and sizzling fajitas. The restaurant prides itself on its friendly service and a welcoming environment, making it a popular choice for both locals and visitors seeking a genuine taste of Mexico. With a focus on delivering a memorable dining experience, Casa Patron Mexican Restaurant is a go-to destination for anyone craving delicious Mexican fare.

name: Untamed Kitchen
description: Untamed Kitchen is a trendy eatery celebrated for its innovative plant-based dishes. With a focus on fresh, locally sourced ingredients, their menu features vibrant salads, nourishing bowls, and inventive vegan creations. From hearty grain bowls to colorful smoothie bowls, Untamed Kitchen offers a delicious and guilt-free dining experience for health-conscious foodies.

name: Queens Sports Lounge
description: Looking for the perfect, casual hangout spot? Come on down to Queens Sports Lounge for an option that is sure to give you a great time! They are a local favorite pub with amazing food and beer, as well as special events. You can count on them for a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and great service every single time.

name: Shawarma On The Run - Kenner
description: The talented chefs at Shawarma On The Run create mouthwatering Middle Eastern fast food favorites with high-quality ingredients and well-honed skills. Fast and fresh with a clean and contemporary dining room, this is the perfect spot for a quick midweek lunch or a big family feast. Check out appetizers like hummus, baba ganoush, and stuffed grape leaves. Popular entrees carved right from the spit include Philly shawarma sandwich, gyro, and chicken or beef shawarma wraps. Meals include a fountain drink, choice of fries or hummus, salad, pita bread, and traditional sauce. Be sure to save some room for a tempting dessert of baklava or cheesecake. The best of authentic shawarma is waiting for you at Shawarma On The Run.

name: Graze
description: A premier spot for creative casual cuisine, Graze offers an ever-changing variety of dishes to satisfy every palate. From seafood to vegetarian options and a full gluten-free menu, this electric eatery has you covered. Be sure to check out their impressive beer and wine lists and to stop by on Sundays for an unforgettable brunch.

name: Home BX Steakhouse
description: Home BX Steakhouse is definitely not your typical steakhouse! Stop by this exciting and inviting restaurant for a dining experience unlike any other. Their extensive menu includes a raw bar, filet mignon, salmon, grilled lamb chops, crabcakes, and much more, as well as a variety of craft cocktails and wine.

name: Smokey Bones
description: Celebrating authentic and savory barbecue offerings with a menu that features a tantalizing array of smoked meats, flavorful sauces, and hearty sides, Smokey Bones has established themselves as a go-to destination for their smoky goodness. Patrons can indulge in an array of barbecue classics in their laid-back atmosphere. Smokey Bones is a favorite among diners for their commitment to quality and passion for the art of barbecue.

name: Jack In The Box #1179
description: Just about everyone knows Jack from Jack in the Box with his telltale ping pong ball head, but what they might not know is just how good the food is at this favorite fast-food eatery. For more than 60 years, this all-American chain has been dishing up burgers, all-day breakfasts and a variety of Americanized snacks like eggrolls and tacos. This is not, however, your typical fast-food burger joint. With dishes only made once you place your order, the menu offers diners a variety of decidedly different dining options. From the Sourdough Jack (served on authentic sourdough bread) to the Bacon Ultimate Cheeseburger with two kinds of cheese, there are enough burger options to cure just about every craving. There's plenty more on the menu, including garden-fresh salads with grilled chicken, Chicken Pita sandwiches, grilled sandwiches, their famous Curly Fries, and much more. Jack in the Box is also known for their real ice cream milkshakes.  Regardless if you order one to go with your meal or to enjoy as a dessert, they really are delectable. Plus, with a rotating selection of seasonal and promotional dishes to try, you can make this your new favorite fast-food restaurant and never tire of the food! Get there today and dine-in or choose a location with a handy drive-thru, but make Jack in the Box your first choice when craving fabulous fast-and-delicious-food!

name: Nick's Pizzeria
description: Italian-owned and operated, Nick's Pizzeria brings hungry diners the best of Brooklyn with their delicious pies made with special family-recipe sauce and dough. Not in the mood for pizza? Check out salads, subs, wraps, baked pastas, and more.

name: Figaro Cafe
description: Figaro curates a Modern American menu blending flavors from diverse cuisines. Offering options from raw bar to salads, flatbreads, seafood, duck, and Pat LaFrieda steaks, Figaro aims to provide classic, delicious choices with a modern touch. Seasonal menus feature the freshest produce, sweetest fruits, and refreshing drinks from their innovative bar program that reinvents classic cocktails.

name: Stilin's Neighborhood Pub & Grill
description: Ales, stouts, lagers, pilsners, wheat, porters, IPAs...the list of tasty brews goes on and it's all at Stilin's Pub & Grill. It's all about beer and beef at this friendly spot that's decked out with plenty to eat, drink, see, and do. Hang out at the bar and knock back a few brews before turning to the menu and chowing down on house-made Reuben rolls, juicy wings, a hearty Italian beef sandwich, or a juicy burger or dog. The menu doesn't stop there--Southwestern cuisine fans love the tacos and burritos, the made-to-order pizzas are delish, and with wraps and salads, there's lighter fare, too. Thursdays are a popular day to dine at Stilin's, thanks to their Thursday comfort food specials, but any day is a great day. Go for lunch or make a night out of it with dinner and entertainment at this energized spot; live music, karaoke, and game show nights are all the rage. With the food, drinks, and fun times you're looking for, Stilin's Pub & Grill ticks all the boxes--check it out yourself today!

name: Empanadas Monumental
description: Every day at Empanadas Monumental starts with making fresh dough and fillings with quality ingredients. With over 20 tasty flavors including mixed seafood, pepperoni, and Philly cheese steak, you'll always find something to love at Empanadas Monumental.

name: Which Wich
description: A fresh and innovative concept featuring superior sandwiches, Which Wich has just one focus: serving you the best possible "wiches" in an edgy yet inviting environment.  No soups or salads here - just great wiches.  Which Wich is committed to creating the best wiches available anywhere.  Constantly pursuing and testing potential ingredients for its over 50 varieties of wiches, only the finest and freshest ingredients make the cut.  Great bread is a prerequisite for creating superior sandwiches, so Which Wich searched the country to feature the tastiest selections of white and wheat.  Even the extras are held to the same high scrutiny: the chips, hand-dipped shakes and just-out-of-the-oven cookies are unrivaled in the industry.  It comes as no surprise that they have become as popular and as addicting as the wiches themselves.  To ensure that each wich fits the customer's exact specifications, Which Wich created a revolutionary ordering system that simplifies the process.  At Which Wich, customers place their orders by using custom red Sharpies to mark up pre-printed menus on sandwich bags. The customer selects the variety of sandwich from 10 different categories, then checks the type of bread, chooses cheese and additional ingredients and finally marks off their desired spreads and sauces. This system guarantees that despite the endless options available, all wiches are customized to just the way you want them.  And all wiches are one low set price, too!

name: Brink Brewing Co.
description: Brink Brewing Co. is a must-visit brewery that is known for serving some of the absolute best beers in the United States. Their homebrew venture grew into an award-winning enterprise, even bringing home the prestigious Best of Show at the Hop Courage Great American Homebrew Contest in 2015.

name: The Back Room
description: The speakeasy tradition lives on at The Back Room. Known as one of only two speakeasies that operated during Prohibition that are still in existence today, this charming and secretive bar is a timeless example of the underbelly of New York's past. The original 1920s speakeasy known as The Back of Ratner's hosted many movie actors, gangsters and other both famous and infamous figures. Today, you can use the same hidden entrance that was used all those years ago to access this upscale, comfortable and inviting spot. Sip on a cocktail served in a teacup, the way they did in the 1920s. Enjoy the vintage decor, the secret room behind the book case, or just hang out and sample any of the hand-crafted cocktails. Featured in many productions including television shows, The Back Room's rich and authentic history sets it apart from other speakeasies, making this a must-visit when headed out for drinks.

name: Virraaj Fine Indian Restaurant
description: Virraaj Fine Indian Restaurant is a polished and upscale eatery where you'll find a delicious selection of hand-crafted fare. Using the best local produce to create amazing meals, enjoy your favorites among a setting that's decorated by murals and exotic art. There's a full bar here as well, so pair your meal with a cocktail or glass of wine.

name: Tangy Noodle
description: Tangy Noodle is a Chinese noodle restaurant that continues the Chef "Shorty" Tang's legacy through 3 generations since 1968 in the U.S. In addition to their noodles made in house, they also serve delicious and fresh dumplings, soups, and more! Stop by for a satisfying and fresh meal that is packed with authentic flavor.

name: KimThao's Bakery and Food To Go
description: KimThao's Bakery and Food To Go enchants locals and visitors alike with its irresistible aroma of freshly made delights and Vietnamese favorites. From banh mis and pho to fried tofu, each treat is crafted with precision and love, reflecting KimThao's dedication to quality and tradition. Step into this cozy haven and embark on a sensory journey that celebrates the culinary artistry of Vietnamese cuisine.

name: Eggcellence Cafe
description: Eggcellence Cafe invites you to start your day with an array of delectable breakfast options, from fluffy omelets to crispy waffles, all crafted with the freshest ingredients. Dive into a world of morning delights where every bite promises satisfaction and every visit feels like a warm, welcoming embrace.

name: Blaze Pizza  Frisco
description: Blaze Pizza is a fast-casual dining restaurant chain known for its custom-built pizzas, which are cooked in a high-temperature open-flame oven for a crisp crust in just 180 seconds. Founded in 2011, Blaze Pizza has gained popularity for its high-quality ingredients, diverse toppings, and speedy service. With a strong emphasis on customer experience, the chain allows diners to create their own pizzas or choose from a menu of chef-inspired options.

name: Rosalie
description: Rosalie is serving Italian soul food in its charming and inviting dining room. There's plenty on the menu to tempt you, including hand-crafted dishes like polpetta, pizzas, pastas, steaks, seafood, and more. Their family supper is a popular pick, and don't forget about dessert. A full bar, Happy Hour specials, and weekend brunch add to the appeal.

name: El Abuelo Restaurant
description: Searching for some of the best authentic Mexican cuisine in town? Come out to El Abuelo Restaurant where they are consistently turning out fresh homecooked meals packed with exciting flavor. You can count on them for a satisfying meal, efficient service, and a relaxing, family-friendly atmosphere great for any occasion.

name: Moustache Pitza
description: Moustache is serving up mouthwatering Middle Eastern cuisine guaranteed to delight your senses. The friendly restaurant invites you to relax and converse while enjoying delicious food in a warm and welcoming environment. The menu is filled with a variety of reasonably priced specialties like falafel, juicy kebabs, tasty pitza, and more.

name: Bagel Boss
description: With over 40 years of bagel making experience, Bagel Boss delivers fresh kosher bagels made by 5th and 6th generation bagel bakers. Every bagel here is water boiled, baked in a brick oven, and made with 100% love.

name: Sugar Hill Coffee
description: Sugar Hill Café is a specialty coffee shop open daily from morning until night! They serve the tastiest casual eats along with coffee from local sources which means that if you're in the mood for breakfast or a snack during the day, they've got what you need. Sandwiches, soups, pastries and more ensure plenty to nibble on at this cool spot!

name: Delicias Colombiana
description: Delicias Colombianas is the absolute perfect spot to explore Colombian culture with their authentic dining experience. They are a family-owned business that prides themselves on welcoming all who step in with open arms. Try some of their classics like their fried sweet plantains, carne asada and their Colombian platter.

name: Courtyard Restaurant & Pub
description: Owned and operated by former Boston Bruin Jay Miller, Courtyard Restaurant & Pub has been the area's go-to restaurant for food, drinks and entertainment. In a casual indoor and outdoor setting, guests can enjoy the year-round amenities of a full-service restaurant and bar. The menu features straight-from-the-docks seafood and classic New England fare, with ever-changing specials thrown in to keep things interesting. Fresh locally-sourced ingredients are used to create everything from hearty comfort foods to upscale steakhouse entrees.

name: Noodles & Company - Fashion Square
description: Gather around the table and around the bowls at Noodles and Company, where the dishes are always filled to the brim with internationally-inspired pasta creations. Since 1995, this casual and inventive eatery has been serving fresh food fast, and today, this fast-casual eatery is still in the lead when it comes to quick, healthy, and hand-crafted food. Everything on the menu is made in-house from real ingredients, so no matter if you're looking for a cozy spot to share a meal with friends or if it is family dinner night, you'll find something tempting on the menu. The Wisconsin mac & cheese is a favorite, the spicy chipotle adobo with braised pork in a smoky and spicy sauce is a great choice, and the pad Thai features all the flavors of this classic dish. There's plenty more on the menu, including Italian-inspired dishes, curries, Korean beef noodles, and traditional favorites like spaghetti & meatballs. There are meatless creations, gluten-free choices, low-calorie and low-sugar dishes, and those with lower sodium too, making Noodles & Company a great choice for everybody. With more and more locations every day, a delicious meal is just an order away at Noodles & Company! Please note: Noodles & Company also caters. From corporate events and lunches to private parties, the experienced team at Noodles & Company will make a meal your guests won't soon forget. Also be sure to check out Noodles & Company online!

name: Sushi Yami Japanese Restaurant
description: Sushi Yami Japanese Restaurant, a beloved culinary gem, beckons patrons into a world of exquisite Japanese flavors.
