Committed to sourcing fresh, premium ingredients, Sushi Yami ensures each dish is a harmonious blend of taste and artistry. The adept chefs showcase their skill in crafting visually stunning and delectable sushi creations., Sushi Yami Japanese Restaurant stands as a delightful haven for those seeking an authentic and satisfying Japanese dining experience.

name: Applebee's Grill + Bar
description: Applebee's Grill + Bar is a popular American casual dining restaurant chain known for its diverse menu and vibrant atmosphere. Offering a wide range of dishes, from signature burgers and appetizers to hearty steaks and salads, Applebee's caters to everyone's tastes. With a welcoming ambiance, friendly service, and locations across the United States, it has become a go-to destination for those seeking a relaxed dining experience with familiar favorites.

name: Pho Laveen
description: Nestled within the vibrant streets of Laveen, Pho Laveen emerges as a comforting sanctuary for enthusiasts of Vietnamese flavors. Its humble façade belies the treasure trove of culinary delights awaiting inside. Here, each dish is meticulously prepared, boasting a symphony of fresh ingredients that promise an unparalleled explosion of taste with every mouthful.

name: Greenwich Village Comedy Club
description: The Greenwich Village Comedy Club is owned by Al Martin, who has run comedy clubs in NYC for almost a quarter of a century. His other clubs, New York Comedy Club and Broadway Comedy Club, have featured a roster of stellar comics who have appeared on everything from MTV and Comedy Central, to the The Tonight Show and Letterman. You may even recognize some of the names that have performed at his venues: Chris Rock, Tracy Morgan, Brett Butler, Jim Gaffigan, David Spade, Rosie O'Donnell, and so many more. Al Martin now brings that experience to Greenwich Village Comedy Club, where you will see top headliners as well up-and-coming comics just before their big breaks. This is a chance to see the stars of tomorrow today. While you're spending those late evening hours soaking in some of the funniest people on the planet, checking out the open mic talent, or just enjoying a good laugh with friends, Greenwich Village Comedy Club features all the food and drinks you'll need to keep the party rolling. The kitchen cooks up a classic assortment of tavern-inspired fare, from the Macho Nachos Supreme and Hot Wings, to Sliders and a Double High Chocolate Cake for 2.  The bar stocks a variety of domestic and imported beers as well as Coastal Ridge Wines, premium cocktails, virgin drinks, and more. Keep an eye on the calendar for upcoming acts, although there's never really a bad night to stop by and check out the scene.

name: Vinny's Pizzarama 2
description: Whenever you decide it's time for someone else to take care of the cooking, then it's time to place an order at Vinny's Pizzarama 2. The ultimate casual neighborhood pizzeria, Vinny's has something to satisfy every dining need, from grabbing a quick slice of pizza on your lunch break to feeding the whole family dinner. Gourmet pizza options include eggplant parmigiana, taco, veggie or meat lovers, hot wings, sausage meatball, and baked ziti, or create your own with their selection of toppings. In addition to their classic New York-style pies, they also feature pan, Sicilian, and stuffed pizza, so whether thin or thick crust is your preference, Vinny's has you taken care of. Also on the menu are salads, calzones, Stromboli, hoagies, paninis, pasta dishes, burgers, beef or chicken cheese steaks, and classic Italian entrees like sausage and peppers, chicken or veal parmigiana or marsala, stuffed shells, and gnocchi. While primarily a take-out or delivery spot, there are a few tables and chairs in their casual dining area for enjoying a bite on the premises. Planning a meal doesn't have to be a chore when you let Vinny's Pizzarama 2 do all the work.

name: Banter Murray Hill
description: Banter is a cozy neighborhood gastropub celebrated for its inviting atmosphere and brunch with an Australian flare. From their colorful and healthy Banter Bowl to their decadent French toast, Banter satisfies both locals and visitors. With its friendly staff and relaxed ambiance, Banter is the perfect spot to unwind with friends over a drink and a delicious meal.

name: The Wharf - Garden Grove
description: The Wharf is a popular seafood restaurant located in the heart of Garden Grove's charming historic downtown Main Street, known for its fresh catches and coastal-inspired dishes. Just as the neighborhood offers an abundance of character, so do their unique offerings. The exploration of unconventional blends of spices, flavors, and textures will tantalize those adventurers who enjoy trying new things. Along with delicious cuisine, The Wharf features a lively atmosphere of pool tables, hosting leagues and tournaments for enthusiasts to enjoy. Karaoke available on Sunday-Tuesday.

name: Habanero's Metairie
description: Habaneros offers a vibrant culinary experience with its authentic Mexican cuisine, infused with bold flavors and fresh ingredients. This beloved eatery captivates diners with its cozy ambiance and attentive service, making it a favorite spot for locals and visitors alike to savor the heat of Habaneros' signature dishes. Whether you're craving traditional tacos bursting with spice or indulging in their famous habanero-infused specialties, a visit to Habaneros promises a memorable gastronomic adventure in the heart of Louisiana.

name: Brasil Paradise Grill
description: Experience the passion, flavors, and ingredients of hand-crafted Brazilian cuisine at Brasil Paradise Grill. This is a warm and inviting eatery, where white cloth-topped tables and friendly service make it a great choice for lunch or dinner. The whole family is welcome here, but it's also a popular choice among the working crowd looking for midday meals. There are two dining options at this popular eatery: choose your favorite dishes a la carte from the menu, or opt for the fully-loaded buffet. On the menu are tasty choices like shrimp in garlic sauce, grilled steaks, pork with mushrooms, and more. On the buffet, there's a fresh and fabulous selection of tempting meats, veggies, pastas, and more. Don't miss out on the feijoada which is served on the weekends, and take-out is always available. With fresh ingredients and terrific flavors, BYOB and head to Brasil Paradise Grill today!

name: Angelina Bakery
description: Angelina Bakery is a charming and beloved bakery known for its exquisite pastries and delightful treats. Established with a passion for baking, this bakery offers a diverse menu that includes an array of freshly baked goods, from classic croissants and muffins to unique and creative pastries. Each item is crafted with the finest ingredients, ensuring a perfect blend of flavors and textures. The cozy and inviting atmosphere of Angelina Bakery provides a warm and welcoming environment for customers to enjoy their favorite baked delights. Whether stopping by for a morning coffee and pastry or indulging in a sweet treat in the afternoon, Angelina Bakery promises a delightful culinary experience that satisfies every palate. The friendly and attentive staff are dedicated to providing excellent service, making every visit to Angelina Bakery a memorable one.

name: Ebby's Cafe
description: Savor a taste of New York on the Jersey Shore at Ebby's Ristorante & Lounge. This is a popular place for family dining thanks to the friendly service, a terrific menu of tantalizing dishes, and affordable prices. And, with a stunning selection of home-made Italian favorites to dine on, you can go again and again and try something new each time. Pull up a chair in the comfy dining room and feast on hand-crafted dishes like the pappardelle al fresca, rigatoni Bolognese and linguini with clam sauce. There's more to try, including their famous chicken Parmigiana and garlic pesto grilled shrimp. If you're not in the mood for a big meal, hang out at the bar and lounge. Quick bites and cold brews are waiting for you here, along with hand-crafted cocktails, making this a popular stop after a day at the beach.  And, if you need private party space, call the friendly staff at Ebby's and they can set you up in their private party room and can cater just about any occasion.

name: Los Arcos Restaurant Restaurante and Grill
description: Los Arcos Restaurant and Grill is a beloved dining destination known for its authentic Mexican cuisine and welcoming ambiance. They offer a menu featuring traditional dishes like tacos, enchiladas, and flavorful salsas, all made with fresh ingredients. With its friendly service and flavorful dishes, Los Arcos is a go-to spot for locals and visitors seeking an authentic taste of Mexico.

name: Pronto Cucina Italiana
description: Pronto Cucina Italiana is an Italian restaurant that prides itself on serving authentic Italian cuisine. With a warm and inviting atmosphere, Pronto Cucina Italiana offers a menu filled with traditional dishes made from fresh, high-quality ingredients. Guests can enjoy a variety of pasta, pizza, and classic Italian entrees, all prepared with a commitment to culinary excellence.

name: Main Squeeze Juice Co. Mont Belvieu
description: Main Squeeze Juice Co. Mont Belvieu is a health-focused smoothie and juice bar renowned for its 100% plant-powered menu. This venue specializes in crafting delicious and nutritious juices and smoothies, such as the "Classic," a blend of apple juice, banana, and strawberry. In addition to their variety of smoothies, Main Squeeze is also known for offering custom cold-pressed juice cleanses, providing a rejuvenating option for those looking to detoxify and refresh their bodies.

name: Tender Greens - El Segundo
description: Tender Greens is a chef-led kitchen serving seasonal and responsibly sourced food to improve the way people eat every day. All specials are guided by seasonal harvests, grown by local farmers, and inspired by unique flavors. Enjoy bowls, plates, salads, sandwiches and more at this fan-favorite trusted chain!

name: Up In Scoops
description: Get your groove on today at Up In Scoops! Open every day from 11:30 a.m. to 9:30 p.m., this retro dessert shop gives you a taste of 70s, 80s, and 90s flare. They are a hidden gem serving melt-in-your-mouth ice cream, gelato, shakes, floats, banana splits, and more. Stop by today for arcade games, exciting treats, and big smiles all around!

name: Mar Azul
description: Looking to try some of the best Mexican cuisine in town? Come check out Mar Azul for a guaranteed great time! They are known for their freshly made dishes including flavorful salsa and tortilla chips with every meal. No matter what you are in the mood for, they have you covered with a plethora of authentic and delicious options.

name: Ritz Diner
description: The Ritz Diner is not your typical all-American diner - at this 24 hour eatery, everything is just a wee bit ritzier! From the moment you step inside you'll notice that this restaurant has a distinct charm and personality which has made it a much-loved restaurant for everyone from celebrities to politicians and average, every day people. Despite being in the center of all the action in NYC, this diner has retained a small town ambiance, which means that you'll be welcomed with a friendly smile and served with pride. Head over at any time and choose from the diverse menu filled with tantalizing dishes. The food at this diner is so good, in fact, that the Ritz Diner was even featured for their healthy food in a segment on the popular TV show 20/20 with Barbara Walters. Standouts on the menu include: 3-egg combo omelettes, specialty salads, famous Ritz Wraps, burgers, Greek specials like the Chicken Souvlaki Sandwich and entrees that range from comfort food like Spaghetti and Meatballs to gourmet delights like the Grilled Tuna Steak. There's no doubt that the menu is filled with an abundance of scrumptious dishes, but be sure to save room for dessert because the Banana Royale and the Carrot Cake are divine. Sounding a bit rich for your diet? Never fear, this unique diner also features a variety of dishes that are waistline friendly. The next time you're craving a delicious meal and any old restaurant just won't do, check out the Ritz Diner!

name: Dimitri's Pizza
description: Are you in the mood for a little slice of Italy? Look no further than Dimitri's Pizza! This local hotspot is known to serve their community some of the best and freshest and most delicious dishes in their area. Made using only the freshest ingredients, you are guaranteed to get exactly what you want at this warm and welcoming restaurant.

name: Le Botaniste Bryant Park
description: Le Botaniste is a plant-based, organic restaurant offering a menu inspired by botanical and global cuisines, emphasizing sustainability and environmental consciousness. With its apothecary-themed decor and focus on fresh, nutrient-rich ingredients, Le Botaniste provides a unique dining experience that caters to both health-conscious and eco-friendly diners. In addition to the menu, they have seasonal specials always available.

name: Il Punto Ristorante
description: You may not be able to get away to Italy for a meal of authentic Italian cuisine, but at Il Punto Ristorante, you'll find genuine Italian fare right in the heart of Midtown. Conveniently located to area attractions and the Theater District, this upscale and welcoming eatery has been a favorite since opening in 2004. At this restaurant, every dish is made with care from the finest and freshest ingredients. Short-cuts are never taken, instead, meals are made the traditional way with time, patience and plenty of skill. Pastas are made fresh, breads are baked in-house, soups, salads and everything in between are all hand-made. Caprese salad with imported buffalo mozzarella, carpaccio di manzo, and calamari fritti are exceptional preludes to any meal. Primi like gnocchi al ragu di agnello and the risotto di mare showcases fresh seafood. Or, try the veal scaloppini, just-from-the-water pan-seared salmon, or a 30-day aged prime beef steak. There's more on the menu to try, so plan on going back again and again to sample it all. Reservations are recommended, but you can always hang out at the full-service bar with a cocktail until a table frees up. World class service accompanies every visit at Il Punto, and if you need private party space, this is a great place to host your meeting, celebration or event.

name: Marty's Place
description: Marty's Place will have you feeling right at home the moment you step through the door. With its vintage dining room, friendly staff, and well-crafted cuisine, this timeless supper club is a fitting choice for enjoying an unforgettable meal with friends, family, and colleagues. The menu is built upon the sort of everyday family cooking the owners grew up with, which is why you'll discover both savory steaks and fresh seafood, as well as the best prime rib in the valley. Marty's Place is flush with delicious menu offerings with something for everyone. So whether you're craving an Italian dinner like the chicken parmigiana, house specialties such as Marty's Haddock Oscar, inventive BBQ flavors, or wholly satisfying combinations of land and sea, you'll find it here. Lighter dishes take care of the young and "young at heart", while the seafood and steak selections provide a bountiful lineup that includes everything you'd want from a proper steakhouse -- from lobster tail to porterhouses. Add in nightly specials and a private party room that can seat up to 40 guests, and Marty's Place becomes THE place for occasions both big and small. Friendly atmosphere and attentive service also contribute to making this one of the most popular restaurants in town.

name: Taqueria Chapala #2
description: An unassuming neighborhood restaurant with big flavors, Taqueria Chapala #2 invites you to come enjoy great Mexican food including deluxe tacos, specialty plates, all-day breakfast, and more. Popular menu items include al pastor tacos, carne asada, and their Camelia fajita plate.

name: Raja Rani
description: Enjoy an unforgettable dining experience at Raja Rani. The elevated eatery's name translates to "king and queen" because its outstanding service and high-quality South Indian cuisine will make you feel like royalty. The menu is filled with a wide range of bold flavors and cooking styles from different Indian regions that are sure to delight your senses.

name: Rosa Mexicano
description: Rosa Mexicano is renowned for their vibrant and authentic Mexican cuisine, infusing traditional flavors with contemporary twists. Their lively atmosphere and colorful decor transport diners to the heart of Mexico. From freshly made guacamole to sizzling fajitas, Rosa Mexicano tantalizes taste buds with a celebration of bold spices and rich textures.

name: Ol' South Pancake House - Burleson
description: Founded in 1962, Ol' South Pancake House is the kind of restaurant where the entire family can enjoy Southern home-style cooking for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Their world famous German pancakes are a popular pick here, along with waffles, skillets, omelets, and so much more. There's plenty for the rest of the day too, at this local gem.

name: Flavors of India Port Charlotte
description: Famous for their scratch-made South Indian cuisine, Flavors of India is a charming and delicious place to dine. Stop by for their amazing lunch buffet, or enjoy all your favorites from the menu. There's plenty to tempt you like fresh-from-the-water seafood picks, tandoori-roasted dishes, and plenty of vegetarian dishes to delight you.

name: III Amici Ristorante
description: III Amici Ristorante isn't just another Italian restaurant. At Amici's, you'll find classic Italian cuisine prepared by an Italian chef who not only trained in Italy, but that has a legacy of working in some of the best restaurants in several different countries. The restaurant itself boasts a spacious dining room with a classic Italian decor. Comfortable seating, wonderful lighting, and elegantly set tables encourage lingering long over meals with a glass of wine in hand. There's also a Venetian-style lounge, which makes relaxing before or after dinner a pleasure. And, with a private banquet facility, your special events can be held in style. It is, however, the food that keeps people coming back for more. The made-to-order dishes include starters like bruschetta, clams casino, fried calamari, soups and crisp, green salads. The entrees are as diverse, ensuring plenty of variety for all. Dig in to hearty pasta creations like the tortellini Michelangelo (with prosciutto, chicken, and cheese) or the linguine alle vongole. Fresh fish and seafood, steaks, veal chops, vegetarian dishes and more round out the menu, and, everything, from the starter to your dessert, is made with the best quality and freshest ingredients. Add in a full bar, wonderful service, live music and a great vibe, and you won't need to eat anywhere other than III Amici when craving quality Italian fare!

name: Fozzie's Sandwich Emporium
description: Fozzie's Sandwich Emporium is a family owned gourmet sandwich shop that prides itself on using fresh ingredients. So fresh in fact, Fozzie's has its own outdoor garden with many fresh herbs and vegetables that make their way into the fine fare served up here. The menu offers a wide array of specialty sandwiches as well as classic staples, fresh seasonal salads, homemade spreads and don't forget the delicious desserts. Fozzie's can satisfy the carnivore or the vegetarian, and with offerings like the "Steak Thyme" (grilled steak, shaved parmesan, crispy chickpeas, and romaine with a lemon-thyme vinaigrette), "The Miss Piggy" (BBQ pulled pork and creamy slaw on a tasty bun), and classics like "The Ruben", there really is something here for everyone. Plus, there are burgers, gyros, dogs, and more to tantalize patrons' taste buds, and "Wee-Wiches" for the kids to enjoy. Fozzie's showcase seasonal fruits and veggies in their specials, prepares its food fresh each day without using unnecessary additives. This is "REAL food and it is REAL good!" Guests can take advantage of carryout and delivery, but there is seating for those that want to dine here including two great patio areas for outside dining at this Richmond Heights location.

name: Taqueria Tepito
description: Taqueria Tepito offers a vibrant culinary journey through Mexico with its authentic flavors and lively atmosphere. From sizzling street tacos to zesty salsa verde, it's a fiesta for the taste buds that transports diners to the bustling streets of Mexico City.

name: Old Mohawk
description: Meat Eaters. Vegetarians. Vegans. Beer Aficionados. Martini Drinkers. Classic Cocktailers. All of the aforementioned can find common ground at The Old Mohawk. This refuge has been a hub of Columbus day- and night-life since 1933. Wrote one regular customer, "Very impressive again! Every thing was top shelf as usual. This place is a 10 in my eyes. The only way you would not get what you want is because you didn't ask." Raved another frequent guest, "Great bar/restaurant: The food is great, good daily specials, and excellent beer selection. The Old Mohawk is right in the heart of German Village with plenty of history, from Al Capone running hooch through the basement to a brothel upstairs." So there you have it. This venue looks good, cooks good, and boasts a checkered past that adds to the cache. The restaurant is particularly well-known for its Turtle Soup, Bucyrus Bratwursts and legendary Mother Mohawk Sandwich (grilled roast beef and chicken salad, topped with Swiss and caraway horseradish sauce on fresh-baked rye). Soups, Salads, Seafood and Crustless Pizzas are also part of the lineup, as are Daily Dinner Specials served after 4 p.m. On Monday it's Pasta Night. Tuesdays feature Design Your Own Quesadillas. Wednesday is Lasagna Night. And the Thursday and Sunday all-day specials are Meatloaf and 8-oz. Sirloin respectively. You can't beat it, so join the crowd at Mohawk, 7 days a week.

name: Big Willie's
description: Big Willie's in Salt Lake City is a beloved establishment in the local community, renowned for its delectable comfort food offerings. With breakfast served every day from 10-2pm, Big Willie's has a diverse menu that caters to various cravings. Whether you're looking for a relaxed dine-in experience or a quick and satisfying meal to take on the go, Big Willie's is the go-to destination for indulging in delightful, nostalgia-evoking flavors that will keep you coming back time and again.

name: Fin & Feathers - Midtown
description: Looking for a high-end destination where you can enjoy some excellent food and beverages? Fin & Feathers is a 21+ location where professionals come to dine and socialize. They are a place to kick back and meet up with friends, with a menu that boasts Nu American Soul flair and inventive cocktails, served in a vibrant and sophisticated atmosphere.

name: The Casual Pint
description: The Casual Pint is Hoover's unofficial headquarters for anything craft beer! Equal parts market and bar, the pleasant atmosphere makes grabbing a pint or two with friends a blast. Sit at the bar or head for a table and order one of their many brews from the beer wall -- there's truly something for everyone. Or you can grab a bottle or can from the singles coolers and they'll "pint it up" while you watch the game and nosh on some mighty fine bites.  Whether it's pretzels and beer cheese, brewer's wings, artisan flatbreads, brats, salads, sliders, or wraps you're craving, the kitchen has you covered. Take the best of The Casual Pint home with you with mix-and-match six-packs or growlers filled fresh from the tap. It doesn't matter if you're a veteran of the craft beer scene or a novice looking for advice, The Casual Pint staff is always ready to help.

name: Ponderosa Steakhouse
description: Ponderosa Steakhouse is where you can find the spirit of the old west, and a place to call home. This local hotspot is known for serving up some great food at an affordable price, whether it's their great steaks, seafood and sides along with their "something for everyone" buffet. This place is perfect for bringing friends and family alike!

name: NoMoo New American Burgers
description: NoMoo New American Burgers is a vibrant, newly renovated and restored diner cooking up a 100% plant-based menu of handcrafted burgers, fries, salads, and house-made shakes. Come by and hang out in their colorful, welcoming atmosphere. There's no fuss when it comes to choosing what to eat here. Everything's a classic!

name: Smoothie King - Pawleys Island
description: Support a healthy lifestyle with delicious clean smoothies, supplements, and grab-and-go energy food from Smoothie King. Step up to the counter and let the knowledgeable staff help you pick the perfect smoothie for your nutritional needs and taste buds. Low calorie, high protein, vegan, and/or nutrient rich fare -- Smoothie King has it all!

name: Hye Life Cafe  Bar
description: Hye Life Cafe & Bar serves must-try Mediterranean BBQ and European appetizers, as well as inspired Armenian, Georgian, Ukrainian and Russian cuisine. This destination is complete with a full bar, delicious coffee, and decadent desserts, that work to make this an all-around great hangout spot for absolutely any occasion!

name: The Weird Sister
description: Step into The Weird Sister, where eccentricity meets elegance in an ambiance adorned with mystical decor and potions-inspired cocktails, inviting patrons to embark on a bewitching journey of taste and enchantment. Nestled in the heart of the city, this eclectic bar tantalizes the senses with its whimsical atmosphere and spellbinding concoctions, making every visit a magical experience to remember.

name: Rockin' Wok Thai Room at Rc's
description: Rockin' Wok Thai Room at RC's offers a tantalizing fusion of traditional Thai flavors with a modern twist, serving up bold and aromatic dishes that ignite the senses. This vibrant eatery invites diners to embark on a culinary adventure through Thailand's rich culinary heritage in a lively and welcoming atmosphere.

name: Sushi Sakura
description: Enjoy a traditional "kaiten" or conveyor belt sushi experience in a modern setting at Sushi Sakura. Family owned and operated, Sushi Sakura is dedicated to using the freshest ingredients to make delicious and affordable Japanese cuisine. Trendy and beautiful, this is the perfect locale for a celebration lunch with good friends or a fun and memorable romantic date. Moving sushi choices include Godzilla roll with spicy tuna, avocado, eel, and eel sauce; Mr Houston featuring kani, mango, avocado, lobster salad, and a crunch topping; and rocket rolls with spicy tuna, avocado, masago, scallion, and sweet chili sauce. For a more traditional dining service, start with appetizers like soft shell crab, poki tuna, or kani cucumber salad. Popular entrees include tasty Japanese-style fried rice, udon and ramen bowls, teriyaki dishes, and gorgeous house special sushi rolls. End your meal on a sweet note with delectable desserts like mochi ice cream, tempura ice cream, or cheese cake. An unforgettable dining experience awaits you at Sushi Sakura.

name: Wing It On!
description: The wing gods have proclaimed that Wing It On are the creators of the most irresistible chicken, being awarded America's "Best-Tasting Medium Traditional Buffalo Sauce" at the National Buffalo Wing Festival in Buffalo, New York. Wing It On remains committed to delivering unparalleled taste experiences, so indulge in their wings, and discover why settling for anything less than extraordinary is simply not an option.

name: Sunsets at Pismo
description: Enjoy a breath-taking view of the ocean while you savor some of the best food in Pismo Beach. Sunsets at Pismo offers a sumptuous elevation of comfort food, beautifully plated, with large portions and inspired ingredients. Come enjoy an excellent beverage along with panko macaroni balls, clam chowder, or award-winning Rib Line chili.

name: Marco's Pizza
description: When you're craving amazing pizza made from high quality ingredients then Marco's Pizza is the place for you. With multiple locations offering a mix of dine in, delivery, and takeout, you're all set to enjoy delicious, mouthwatering pizzas and other tasty fare -- from chicken wings to crisp salads to freshly baked subs, no matter where you are!

name: Table D'Hote
description: A warm and intimate French-American bistro, Table D'Hote maintains great food and a subtle ambiance making it the perfect place to enjoy a truly delicious meal with family, friends, and loved ones. With the help of the local green market, Table D'Hote impresses with a seasonal-inspired menu of creative dishes made with only the best ingredients around.

name: Mughlai Indian Cuisine
description: With two convenient locations to serve you, Mughlai Indian Cuisine offers some of the city's freshest, finest, and best-tasting Indian cuisine. The skilled chefs at this eatery are hand-crafting dishes from the best-quality ingredients, turning each dish into a mouth-watering taste sensation. Go for lunch or dinner and enjoy dishes like biryanis, chicken tikka, savory kebabs, chaats, curries, lamb and goat entrees, seafood, and tandoor-baked dishes. You can dine-in in the pleasant dining room or take something to-go from this local gem. Enjoy the tastes and flavors of India today at Mughlai Indian Cuisine! Please note: Online ordering is available.

name: Applebee's Grill + Bar
description: Applebee's Grill + Bar is a popular American casual dining restaurant chain known for its diverse menu and vibrant atmosphere. Offering a wide range of dishes, from signature burgers and appetizers to hearty steaks and salads, Applebee's caters to everyone's tastes. With a welcoming ambiance, friendly service, and locations across the United States, it has become a go-to destination for those seeking a relaxed dining experience with familiar favorites.

name: Memory Motel NYC
description: Get ready to spread your wings and shake your tail feather with great company at The Ugly Duckling! This bustling and modern spot is the perfect place to have a great time and enjoy some tasty American cuisine and a variety of beverages. They are also known for their excellent brunch and have plenty of TVs so you won't miss a game.

name: Local 42 Bar
description: Local 42 Bar offers a vibrant atmosphere perfect for both casual hangouts and lively nights out. The bar features a diverse selection of craft beers and inventive cocktails, appealing to a wide range of tastes. Live music and events are regular highlights, making it a popular spot for entertainment and socializing.

name: Russo's NY Pizzeria The Woodla
description: Since 1978, Russo's has been bringing the authentic tastes of Manhattan's Little Italy to the Lone Star State. From day one, the Russo Family has been inspired by the traditional Italian values of family, friends and, of course, food. All menu items - from the Coal-Fired Brick-Oven Pizzas and Calzones to the Appetizers, Salads, Soups and Pastas - are presented with a  passion for quality, freshness, and warm hospitality. It's a passion that continues to garner unqualified raves. EVERY DAY WITH RACHEL RAY named Russo's among the top contenders for "America's Best Slice." The HOUSTON CHRONICLE raved, "No matter how you slice it, Anthony Russo's pizza is tops." D MAGAZINE bestowed Russo's with top honors for "Best Calzone," while countless newspaper readers and AOL users have voted it "Best Pizza." But perhaps this ZAGAT reviewer put it best, writing, "I wanted to personally thank you for satisfying my cravings for a taste of home...I have lived in Houston for ten years and  tried every pizza place in this city. Your restaurant is the ONLY one that has hit the nail on the head! Your pizzas and calzones take me right back to Mulberry Street...I'm thrilled that you have moved into the neighborhood." You'll be thrilled with The Woodlands location, too. There's indoor and outdoor seating, free Wi-Fi and a buzzing beer-and-wine Happy Hour, plus plenty of flat screens for sports enthusiasts.

name: Dallas BBQ
description: Dallas BBQ is the New York's home for authentic and delicious Southern BBQ. With a legacy of successful restaurants, the family behind this iconic eatery is known for providing delicious food at an equally appealing price. Since the 1980s, diners have been coming to Dallas BBQ for their famous BBQ chicken and ribs. Served with your choice of sides, each hearty portion is finger-lickingly good. Baby back ribs are either BBQ basted or honey roasted, but they're always fall-off-the-bone tender. Or, try the BBQ beef ribs, Texas style, or the tender and juicy chicken. Burgers, steaks, seafood and combos are also on the menu, giving diners a variety of tasty options. Casual, inviting and always family-friendly, get your hands yummy 'que at Dallas BBQ! Please note: Dallas BBQ also offers a variety of catering packages, and their Texas-size frozen drinks are legendary!

name: Frankie's Pub & Grill
description: A popular hangout since open in 2007, Frankie's Pub & Grill is known for their amazing burgers that fans say are "as big as your head", a great selection of beer, terrific martinis, and more. This is a casual and friendly spot with room inside and out for you to have a good time. Relax and unwind and nosh on snacks like the wonton mozzarella sticks, beer battered wings, or the mini tacos. Check out the 17 draught beers that are hand-selected from the best breweries, or ask for a cocktail from the full-service bar. Then, feast on an oversize sandwich with tasty meats, veggies, cheeses, and more loaded onto huge Sheboygan Hardrolls which are made just for the spectacular sandwiches served here. The colossal BLT is loaded with a full pound of bacon, the steak sammich is a meaty pick, and the shrimp po'boy is inspired by the flavors of the South. There's more on the menu, like Frankie's famous Broasted chicken, seafood dinners, and more. It's all good at Frankie's, and with a casual laid-back vibe and friendly service, this local favorite is perfect for lunch, dinner, or late-night outings!

name: Turgeau's
description: Turgeau's is a southern & Mexican inspired café with allergen-friendly options, serving breakfast and lunch all day, every day of the week as well as catering and events services. They are a locally owned destination that is passionate about what they do, offering well thought-out creations to satisfy every customer.

name: Local Cantina - Brewery District
description: Local Cantina is a locally owned Mexican-inspired bar and restaurant. They pride themselves on their creative offerings, fresh drinks and fun environment. Let them host your next meal so that you can try any of their flavorful tacos, craft cocktails and delicious desserts. Stop by today for an unforgettable dining experience!

name: Junior's Restaurant and Bakery
description: The latest Junior's Restaurant and Bakery, situated in the heart of Manhattan and mere steps from Times Square, boasts moving lights and stainless steel that harken back to the original 1950s location. The full menu features their renowned dishes, from steakburgers and seafood combos to Romanian tenderloin, ensuring an unforgettable and enjoyable dining experience. Patrons can choose from take-out, counter seating, or the full-service bar. Be sure to indulge in their World's Most Fabulous Cheesecake for dessert!

name: Jamba Juice - Boca Raton (Yamato Road)
description: Check out Jamba Juice today for mood-boosting, taste bud-thrilling flavor experiences. Radical, freshly-blended whole fruit and vegetable smoothies, funky-fresh juices, tasty bowls, cold-pressed shots, and so much more are made fresh and fabulous at this convenient location. Premium ingredients and plenty of fun will keep you going back for more!

name: The Twisted Crab - Patrick Henry
description: Indulge in delicious Cajun-style seafood today at The Twisted Crab! At this friendly eatery, it's all about enjoying lobster, crab, mussels, and more, just how you like it. Pick your seasoning and add-ins, and their friendly crew will make it fresh just for you. There's more on the menu, so put your gloves on and get ready to feast on flavor!

name: A Brooklyn Pizzeria
description: In the mood for some fresh and delicious pizza? Come on down to A Brooklyn Pizzeria for an option that is sure to hit the spot. With two convenient locations, they are serving gourmet pizzas with the toppings of your choice, as well as stuffed calzones and rolls, oven-toasted sandwiches, pasta, dessert, and more!

name: Bonbon Cafe
description: Bonbon Café is the exciting and casual dining destination that you have been looking for! They are a Chinese kitchen that specializes in a variety of classic and eccentric dishes, all made fresh from excellent ingredients. Come try one of their tasty small plates or classic, hearty dishes along with a signature snow ice or other yummy dessert.

name: Karvouna Mezze
description: Step into a Greek oasis at Karvouna Mezze, a stunning restaurant with murals on the walls, clouds on the ceiling, and an upscale but still casual vibe. All this combines to create the perfect restaurant for your next Greek and Mediterranean cuisine feast. In Greece, even the simplest foods taste great, and they're recreating that in this fabulous restaurant. Imagine gyros cut juicy and fresh right from the spit, marinated and tender grilled meats, and plenty more. Begin your feast with a selection of dips that include tzatziki, hummus, and babaganoush. Then, try the moussaka, grilled souvlaki, or kebabs. There are sandwiches, too, and their mixed grill that's loaded with a delish selection of meats is always a popular pick. Finish every meal with something sweet--the house-made baklava is their specialty! You'll also find live music and DJ hosted events here; check online or call ahead for the schedule. For a taste of the Mediterranean in a stellar restaurant with a full bar, head to Karvouna Mezze! Please note: Catering services are also available. Call ahead for details.

name: Carreta's Grill - Elmwood
description: Serving the area for over 20 years, Carreta's Grill is committed to providing food lovers with authentic, quality, fresh Mexican cuisine at reasonable prices. Traditionally decorated with bold colors and beautiful paintings, this is the perfect place for a big family meal or a fun and memorable romantic date. Start with tasty appetizers like ceviche with your choice of saltines or tostadas, guacamole and chips, or mariachi fries topped with lettuce, Pico de Gallo, sour cream, and jalapenos. Popular entrees include tender carne asada, sizzling fajitas, and pollo loco (grilled chicken breast topped with spinach, asadero cheese, and onions). Fantastic enchiladas, tacos, and burritos make great picks as well. Pair your food with a refreshing frozen or on-the-rocks margarita or a crisp and cold beer. For fabulous food, drinks, and service, nothing beats Carreta's Grill.

name: Maria Mulata
description: Having been in operation for 12 years, María Mulata has been a longstanding presence in Manhattan, catering to its diverse community. It started as a humble concept but has since evolved into a compelling representation of Colombia's true essence and culture.

name: Burger Theory
description: Burger Theory is a popular restaurant and sports bar in the Holiday Inn in downtown Omaha. Featuring made-to-order burgers crafted with a special blend of chuck, brisket, and short rib, each burger is hearty and delicious. There's more on the menu if burgers aren't your thing, and, there are cold beers on tap and seating at the full-service bar.

name: Tap & Vine - Indian Trail - Sun Valley
description: Tap & Vine is a sophisticated yet welcoming wine bar with a diverse selection of wines from around the world and a menu of delectable small plates and charcuterie. It provides a chic and cozy atmosphere for wine aficionados and casual drinkers to unwind. With its elegant ambiance, knowledgeable staff, and carefully curated wine list, Tap & Vine offers a refined experience for those seeking the perfect blend of relaxation and indulgence.

name: El Pollo Loco - Peoria - Denver
description: El Pollo Loco is a restaurant chain known for its signature flame-grilled chicken marinated in a special blend of herbs, spices, and citrus juices. Founded in 1975 in Mexico, it has since expanded to numerous locations across the United States, offering a menu that includes burritos, tacos, and fresh salads. The restaurant is popular for its focus on fresh, healthy ingredients and its commitment to quality and flavor.

name: The Fox and Falcon - South Park
description: The Fox & Falcon by David Burke in Charlotte, NC offers a modern steakhouse menu featuring celebrity chef David Burke's classics like Clothesline Bacon, Lobster Dumplings, Popovers, and Cheesecake Pops. The menu is complemented by a thoughtfully curated wine list, craft cocktails, and beer selection, and the elegant yet whimsical decor is a must-see.

name: Afrikiko
description: Whether you're already a fan of African cuisine or are looking to try something new, you'll find plenty to tantalize your taste buds at Afrikiko Restaurant. Locally owned and operated, Afrikiko brings the authentic flavors and dishes of West Africa to Houston's southwest side of town. Everything on the menu is prepared fresh in-house using traditional recipes and seasonal ingredients, ensuring an amazing and flavorful feast no matter what you order. Soup is a staple of African cuisine, so there are plenty of choices here, including goat pepper soup, dry fish soup, egusi soup, vegetable soup, and peanut butter soup--all served with your choice of meat or fish. For a more complete meal, pair your soup with a dish like fufu (seasoned ground starch such as plantain, yam, or cassava), rice balls, fried fish, or jolof rice (jambalaya-style fried rice). A small selection of beer and soft drinks is available to pair with your order, and the laidback dining space is filled with checkered cloth-covered tables that invite you to hang out for a while to eat, drink, and socialize. A place truly unlike any other, Afrikiko Restaurant is also available for takeout and delivery, providing a taste of Africa anywhere you prefer to dine.

name: Cantiere Hambirreria
description: Cantiere Hambirreria offers a unique dining experience with a focus on gourmet hamburgers and craft beers with an Italian twist. Located in a stylish and modern setting, this eatery prides itself on using high-quality ingredients to create delicious, innovative dishes. Perfect for a casual meal or a night out, Cantiere Hambirreria combines great food, a welcoming atmosphere, and a wide selection of beverages.

name: Nonnas Pizza A Taste of Italy
description: Are you in the mood for a delicious and authentic Italian style dining experience? If so, then look no further than Nonna's Pizza A Taste of Italy! This standalone pizza shop is your favorite new spot to get all kinds of incredible pizzas, cheesesteaks, loaded nuggets and much, much more. Their service is outstanding as well.

name: High Grace NOLA
description: Love the dive bar vibes but want a fancy cocktail? Maybe a frozen adult beverage to cool down? A giant tower of beer so guests can over-serve themselves? Then head to High Grace. They're an upscale dive bar just steps off of Bourbon Street that is open 24/7 so patrons can take a break from the chaos but keep the party going.

name: Solly's Grille
description: Get your hands on one of the famous Butter Burgers from Solly's Grill, a local favorite that's been dishing up great eats since opening way back in 1936. Still family-owned and operated, this legendary eatery is the place to go for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. The award-winning burgers made here start with high-quality 100% sirloin beef with no fillers, and they're delivered fresh daily from a local butcher. Then, the magic happens. They're perfectly cooked, topped with fresh Wisconsin butter, and served a variety of ways. Be sure to specify "regular butter, easy, or no butter" to get it just how you want it.  Go back again and again to try all your favorites, or check out other popular eats like Solly's famous grilled cheese, tuna salad, a tenderloin sandwich, and more. There are breakfast eats, too, because Solly's opens early so that you can fill up on something tasty to get your day started, like their famous farm-style breakfast.  Don't forget about their home-made cherry pies, cherry shakes, and hand-crafted malts or ice cream shakes, served the old-fashioned way in a steel can. It's friendly, it's affordable, and it's always low-key at Solly's Grill, so when you're in the mood for something delicious, make this your first pick!

name: World of Beer- Grandscape
description: World of Beer is a vibrant and popular destination for beer lovers, offering an extensive and diverse selection from around the globe. They provide a lively atmosphere to enjoy a wide range of beer options from local brews to rare international finds as well as pub fare. With its friendly ambiance and an ever-changing lineup of brews on tap, World of Beer is the hot spot for all things beer.

name: La Diaspora
description: La Diaspora Bar & Restaurant is a vibrant and culturally rich establishment that offers a unique dining experience. Located in the heart of the city, it celebrates the diverse flavors of South American cuisine, bringing together a fusion of culinary traditions from around the world. With a welcoming ambiance and a menu curated with exquisite dishes, La Diaspora invites patrons to savor a global culinary journey in a lively and inclusive setting. Kitchen closes at 10 p.m. on weekdays, late night menu till 12 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.

name: Pa'ina
description: The Pa'Ina Lounge is chic, modern and very sleek - this newest Hawaiian and Asian inspired lounge is poised to become the new 'it' spot for those who are looking for a good time after dark. This amazing space has many unique features to its credit: a great menu of tasty food featuring Polynesian and Asian dishes, fabulous traditional as well as house specialty libations, two fully stocked bars, two private rooms and a fabulous stage on which to see and hear some of the best live entertainment around. With great lighting, plenty of plush seating and room for standing or mingling, this amazing venue truly does have it all. Be sure to check out their fantastic Happy Hour Tuesdays through Sundays for great food and drink specials, or check out their website to see the line-up of terrific events. Go for dinner and drinks or arrive late and stay even later; the choice is yours bet be sure to check out the Pa'Ina Lounge soon!

name: Tick Tock Diner NY
description: Tick Tock Diner is an iconic American diner that has completely mastered the art of casual dining. Served in a family-friendly atmosphere, the meals here are affordable and delicious! With plenty of made-to-order dishes on their extensive menu, you can enjoy breakfast, lunch, dinner, or late-night snacks at this popular eatery.

name: Yang Chow 2.0
description: Home of the world-famous Slippery Shrimp, Yang Chow 2.0 is a downtown LA staple that's dishing up fabulous fare here in Long Beach. This eatery is creating hand-crafted Mandarin and Szechuan cuisine and serving it in a casual and friendly eatery. Quick counter service means you can order and be on your way again in no time.

name: Bertucci's Brick Oven Pizza
description:
Have you been searching for a savory Italian meal in Timonium, MD? Visit Bertucci's to enjoy authentic dishes made fresh in our kitchen every day. Their house-made dough, tomatoes grown solely for our locations, and roasted, perfectly cooked vegetables are always ready and waiting for your order. Whether you decide on the brick oven pizza they are known for, a traditional pasta option, or a specially made dessert, there is always a dish that will complement your palate.

Bertucci's is open for lunch and dinner, offering an extensive menu for each. They are especially thrilled to be able to offer lunchtime deals that are perfect for both families and workers on their lunch breaks. Even if you only have an hour to dine, they'll make sure you have a delicious meal that will get you through the rest of the day! In the evening, Bertucci's is the ideal local spot for all sorts of occasions, from spontaneous family dinners to long-awaited date.

name: Applebee's Grill + Bar
description: Applebee's Grill + Bar is a popular American casual dining restaurant chain known for its diverse menu and vibrant atmosphere. Offering a wide range of dishes, from signature burgers and appetizers to hearty steaks and salads, Applebee's caters to everyone's tastes. With a welcoming ambiance, friendly service, and locations across the United States, it has become a go-to destination for those seeking a relaxed dining experience with familiar favorites.

name: La Fountain Mexican Restaurant
description: Since 2009, La Fountain Mexican Restaurant has been delighting diners with fresh, fabulous, and authentic Mexican cuisine. Still family-owned and operated, this trendy eatery features a big menu where every dish is packed with flavor. And, with several locations, there's bound to be a location near you where you can feast on flavor!

name: Chinese Taste
description: In the mood for some authentic and delicious Chinese food? Chinese Taste has your back! This causal eatery serves all of your favorite Chinese dishes, like kungpao beef, general Tao's chicken, orange chicken, LoMein, friend rice, and so much more. Enjoy well seasoned Chinese cuisine, available for dine-in and pick up, at Chinese Taste!

name: Beard Papa Sweets Cafe
description: Celebrating the sweet things in life since 1999, Beard Papa's Sweets Cafe is home to the world's best cream puffs. Beginning in Japan, Beard Papa's has expanded to over 400 stores in 15 countries while maintaining their commitment to tasty pastries.

name: Pho Van
description: Are you in the mood for an authentic Vietnamese dining experience? Come on down to Pho Van for some of the best Asian food you can find! They specialize in keeping their customers full while not breaking the bank. They have a variety of gluten-free and vegetarian and vegan options as well as specialty drinks and desserts!

name: Taco Bueno
description: Taco Bueno is a fan-favorite chain serving up delicious tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and more. With delicious meats and vegetarian meals, they have an option here for everyone. Enjoy freshly prepared, mouthwatering food handcrafted in their kitchens, made with real ingredients and customized to your liking.

name: Junior's Restaurant and Bakery
description: Junior's on Broadway is perfect for touring the city, catching a Broadway show, or just needing a great spot in New York. This restaurant offers summer patio dining, a full-service bar, and a beautiful dining room. The extensive menu features Brooklyn favorites and sophisticated salads and entrées, ideal for a night out. Situated near Broadway and 45th Street, Junior's also has a take-out entrance in Shubert Alley, connecting 44th and 45th Streets. The bakery serves a wide range of coffee drinks, cakes, and pastries.

name: IHOP
description: Since 1958, IHOP has been the place where families, friends, co-workers, and everyone in between meets for a delicious meal. Known for wholesome and delicious food at a fair price, there are IHOP restaurants all over the country. Smiles are a part of every meal at this casual, friendly and welcoming eatery that makes breakfast a time to be enjoyed.

name: La Familia Restaurant - Taunton
description: Discover fabulous hand-crafted Italian and Portuguese cuisine La Familia Restaurant. With several convenient locations, their family welcomes yours for lunch or dinner! Explore a diverse menu of fresh, chef-prepared fare including delectable home-made desserts, fresh-from-the-water seafood, plenty of tasty appetizers, and top-quality meats.

name: Apola Greek Grill
description: Apola Greek Grill is a beloved dining destination known for its authentic Greek flavors and vibrant atmosphere. From traditional souvlaki to flavorful gyro wraps and fresh salads, Apola Greek Grill offers a diverse menu that delights patrons with its Mediterranean cuisine. Apola makes for the best spot for diners to experience the rich flavors and warm hospitality of Greece.

name: Benito One
description: In a snug nook of the city, the Italian comfort food restaurant exuded a welcoming ambiance with its soft lighting and enticing scents wafting through the air. The menu, a tribute to Italian culinary traditions, featured a diverse selection of timeless dishes prepared with meticulous attention to detail. Patrons could delight in hearty pasta dishes adorned with luscious sauces or indulge in fragrant risottos bursting with flavor, each dish offering a comforting taste of home-cooked goodness.

name: Gyros Kebab Grill
description: Gyros Kebab Grill is a cozy Mediterranean eatery where the aroma of sizzling meats and spices fills the air, inviting guests to indulge in savory delights. From succulent gyro wraps to flavorful kebabs, each dish captures the essence of Mediterranean cuisine, promising a satisfying and memorable dining experience.

name: District 41 Sports Bar
description: District 41 Sports Bar has a variety of settings to accommodate whatever mood you're in. They have televisions propped up at various angles and a large selection of craft beers to enjoy while watching the game. Private dining and event spaces are also available.

name: The Sushi Bar
description: The Sushi Bar is one of the famous fine dining places in Edmond and Oklahoma City. They are a chic yet simple spot, serving sushi and other Japanese delicacies, along with a variety of Asian-inspired dishes, all made from the freshest ingredients. This relaxing destination also has a full bar with a selection of beers and spirits.

name: Mughlai Indian Cuisine
description: With two convenient locations to serve you, Mughlai Indian Cuisine offers some of the city's freshest, finest, and best-tasting Indian cuisine. The skilled chefs at this eatery are hand-crafting dishes from the best-quality ingredients, turning each dish into a mouth-watering taste sensation. Go for lunch or dinner and enjoy dishes like biryanis, chicken tikka, savory kebabs, chaats, curries, lamb and goat entrees, seafood, and tandoor-baked dishes. You can dine-in in the pleasant dining room or take something to-go from this local gem. Enjoy the tastes and flavors of India today at Mughlai Indian Cuisine! Please note: Online ordering is available.

name: Long Island Brothers Stone Oven Pizza
description: Looking for a place to enjoy some fresh and delicious pizza made in a real stone oven? Long Island Brothers Stone Oven Pizza is the destination you should try. All of their pies are made fresh every day, available both whole and by the slice. Come try a delicious pizza packed with the toppings of your choice.

name: Los Cabos The Pupusa House
description: Are you in the mood for a delicious and authentic Salvadoran Mexican fusion dining experience? If so, then look no further than Los Cabos! This local hotspot is known for their high-quality dishes and dedication to customer service. Make sure to try their delicious pupusas and take a look at their rebids menu as well!

name: LA CABANA RESTAURANT
description: La Cabaña Restaurant serves up an authentic taste of Mexico with a mouthwatering menu featuring traditional dishes bursting with flavor. Nestled in a cozy ambiance reminiscent of a rustic Mexican hacienda, diners can expect a culinary journey filled with bold spices and warm hospitality.

name: Noche Mexicana
description: Casual elegance, punchy flavors, and warm, attentive servers greet you at Noche Mexicana. Breakfast is served all day at this charming locale as well as lunch and dinner. Fill up on your choice of burritos, tostadas, tamales, tortas, hard- and soft-shell tacos, salads, nachos, fajitas, and much (much) more. This menu is chock-full of delicious dishes for you to enjoy. Try the bistec flautas, deep-fried corn tortillas plumped with meat, sour cream, and zesty Parmesan cheese and served with rice and black beans. Regulars love the spicy chicken nachos topped with melted Cotija and jack cheese, refried black beans, guacamole, pico de gallo, and pickled jalapeno for their exceptional flavor profile. If you're parched, a tart margarita might be just the perfect thing. Or maybe you'd like to sip on a Mexican soda or Jumex juice with your burrito. Either way, you'll receive authentic south-of-the-border fare at affordable prices. Order online for takeout or delivery.

name: Fish & Things Poke Bar
description: Fish & Things Poke Bar offers a vibrant array of fresh seafood and customizable poke bowls. Its commitment to sourcing sustainable ingredients ensures a guilt-free dining experience while supporting ethical practices in the seafood industry. With its inviting ambiance and dedication to quality, it has become a beloved destination for poke enthusiasts seeking a delightful culinary adventure.

name: Sweet Aloha Ice Cream
description: Sweet Aloha Ice Cream is a beloved ice cream shop located in Davie, Florida. This cozy little shop offers a variety of delicious and unique ice cream flavors that are sure to delight any sweet tooth. From classic favorites like chocolate and vanilla, to more exotic flavors like coconut, pineapple, and mango, Sweet Aloha Ice Cream has something for everyone. The shop also offers dairy-free and vegan options, making it a great choice for those with dietary restrictions. The decor is bright and cheerful, with a tropical theme that perfectly complements the delicious island-inspired flavors. Whether you're looking for a refreshing treat on a hot day, or just a sweet indulgence to satisfy your cravings, Sweet Aloha Ice Cream is worth a visit.

name: Pacos Tacos of Manhattan
description: Pacos Tacos is serving up authentic Mexican street tacos that are sure to excite your senses. The friendly taqueria features a variety of specialty tacos made fresh to order and crafted using high-quality meats like house-made chorizo and chargrilled skirt steak. Pair your meal with a refreshing margarita or cold beer and treat yourself today.

name: Paul's Unique Gourmet
description: Paul's Unique Gourmet is a family-owned restaurant and food truck chain. They serve Haitian and American-inspired dishes, homemade natural juices, and more. Their meats and seafood are marinated in a special, spicy Caribbean marinade, adding unique, bold flavor to every dish. They have something on their extensive menu for absolutely everyone!

name: Papa John's Pizza
description: Better ingredients really do make better pizzas, and at Papa John's, each hand-crafted and made-to-order pizza is fresh, hot, and delicious. You can build the pizza of your dreams with a large selection of sauces, cheeses, and toppings. Quality is at the core of everything they do, and from the pizza crust to the finishing toppings, it's all the best it can be.

name: Tacos El Rey Expresso
description: Tacos El Rey Espresso is a fusion haven where the aromatic allure of freshly brewed espresso meets the zest of authentic Mexican street tacos. Step into a cozy ambiance where the tantalizing aroma of coffee blends harmoniously with the sizzle of savory tacos, offering a delightful culinary experience that marries two beloved traditions.

name: Boca Grille and Raw Bar
description: Located at the H Smith Richardson Golf Course, Boca Grill and Raw Bar is a terrific spot to enjoy a delicious meal. Stunning views makes this a delightful getaway no matter if you've played golf or not. Stop by for fresh seafood, juicy steaks, hearty sandwiches, tasty pastas, and more. Check out the stellar wine selection, too.

name: Kelly's Sports Bar
description: Kelly's Sports Bar is a classic Irish pub in the heart of the East Village. It's the perfect spot to catch the big game and to cheer on your team. Or, stop by with friends to chill and relax over a great drink in a proper New York City bar. With a lively vibe and eclectic crowd, there's plenty to love about this gem of a sports bar--stop by today!

name: Jake's Wayback Burgers
description: Wayback Burgers started in 1991 in Newark, DE, and quickly became known as THE place to get an amazing burger. This simple and unassuming restaurant quickly became the best 'burger joint' around. Now, with more locations than ever before, you can still enjoy the same juicy, hand-made burgers and real milkshakes that made them famous all those years ago. The philosophy at this casual eatery also remains the same: to deliver the freshest, most delicious food with friendly service. Stop by any of their locations, including this convenient spot in Worcester, and feast on tasty eats like fresh-tossed salads, the fabulous double bacon with four slices of crispy bacon, fresh buttermilk chicken sandwiches, and plenty of delicious sides. There's plenty more on the menu to try, including their amazing Irish nachos, build your own hot dogs, hand-dipped milkshakes, and, more. The next time you're craving one of the best burgers around, check out Wayback Burgers, where friendly service and scrumptious food is only an order away! Please note: Wayback  Burgers also caters and can handle large orders. Just call ahead with at least 24-hours notice, and they'll work with you to make tasty food for your event. As a bonus, they'll even drop it off for you!

name: Firehouse Subs - Magnolia Plaza
description: People love a good meal, and at Firehouse Subs you can be sure that your meal will be terrific. Built on a legacy of fire and police service, this entrepreneurial eatery started small but has grown to more than 900 locations, all committed to serving the best quality meats, cheeses, and produce in hearty and delicious subs, sandwiches, and salads.

name: Primo Hoagies - Allentown
description: Embracing family traditions and recipes and the finest ingredients, PrimoHoagies is a cut above the rest when it comes to sandwiches and catering (ask about their amazing boxed lunches). It all starts with the bread which is baked every two hours and the locally-sourced veggies that are chopped every day, and each fresh-to-order specialty hoagie is made with Thumann's gourmet meats and cheeses. A fast-casual restaurant with that classic deli vibe, this is the perfect spot for a quick midweek lunch, a fun family outing, or whenever you need lunch for the office. The most popular subs here include the Philly cheesesteak, turkey diablo, and the Italian hoagie with prosciutto, Provolone cheese, hot capicola, and natural casing Genoa salami. Old fashioned meatball, chicken cutlet subs, and the corned beef Schwartzie with premium corned beef, Swiss cheese, cole slaw, and Russian dressing are also favorites. Watching carbs? Try a lettuce or low carb wrap. And vegetarians are not forgotten here either with four meat-free sandwiches including Nonna's Veggie with eggplant, sharp Provolone cheese, and broccoli rabe topped with roasted red peppers. Pair your food with a bag of chips and a fresh deli side like pasta salad, coleslaw, or potato salad. Catering options include hoagie trays, sampler platters, and box lunches -- all sure to be a hit. The friendly staff at PrimoHoagies are waiting to make you the perfect sub.

name: Patiala Indian Grill
description: Conveniently located near Penn Station, Patiala Indian Grill is a cozy spot offering authentic North and South Indian cuisine that is packed with bold and distinct flavors that will have you regularly coming back for more. Their curries are inspired by the curries that have become a dining staple in England, with choices that include chicken, lamb, shrimp, goat, and vegetable. For a small bite, there are appetizers and chaat (Indian street cart food) like samosas, pani puri, aloo tikki, and paneer pakora, or enjoy a full feast of clay oven, biryani rice, or pan-cooked entrees, with popular favorites including mutton murag (a rich soup with mutton attached to the bone), chicken tikka masala, lamb roganjosh, and shrimp vindaloo. There are plenty of both meat-based and vegetarian choices, so everyone can find something to enjoy here, and don't forget the freshly baked breads to scoop up every last bite of your order. Patiala's dining space is modern and relaxing, featuring exposed brick walls, unfussy decor, and a small collection of tables for eating on-site. Also available for takeout and delivery, Patiala Indian Grill invites you to stop by and take your taste buds on a culinary adventure.

name: Pei Wei Asian Kitchen
description: Pei Wei Asian Kitchen knows how to bring the flavor. They serve bold, craveable creations that are sure to impress the whole crew. Whenever you're in the mood for something sweet, spicy, or just plain good, you can count on them for wok'd to order dishes, like their bestselling Firecracker Chicken, created with quality ingredients. Order Now!

name: Margon
description: Margon Restaurant is one of the most popular Cuban restaurants at the heart of New York. Their food is bursting with authentic Cuban taste that you would love! Step into this approachable, counter-serve spot and enjoy delicious and authentic Cuban sandwiches, as well as American breakfasts, salads, and so much more.

name: Dervo's Deli and Grill
description: Dervo's Deli and Grill in Fresno is celebrated for its exceptional range of mouth-watering burgers, stacked deli sandwiches, and custom specials, making it a local favorite and known as Fresno's "best-kept secret". Located conveniently across from the Fresno State Save Mart Center, it offers a cozy atmosphere for enjoying a variety of dishes including fried chicken, salads, and more, with catering options available for any event​​.

name: Varners Restaurant And Tavern
description: Varner's Restaurant and Tavern offers a delectable fusion of hearty American fare and cozy tavern ambiance. Indulge in their flavorful dishes crafted with locally sourced ingredients, paired perfectly with a wide selection of craft beers and fine wines.

name: Bar Red
description: BaRed (Bar Red), located two blocks from the Colorado Convention Center and directly across Colfax Avenue from the Golden Triangle, is a wonderful place to stop by any time of day. BaRed offers flavorful breakfast with fresh espresso and delectable pastry served starting at 9 a.m. A quick and affordable sit-down lunch service begins at 11. After lunch the lights go down, the music comes up and BaRed transforms into a downtown Denver social destination. BaRed offers a robust Happy Hour menu from 4 to 7 p.m. with live music and deejays to make your experience pleasurable. Live entertainment is also a regular fixture on Friday and Saturday nights. BaRed features a unique Beats Boutique on Sunday evenings with downtempo hip-hop and jazz rhythms. The atmosphere provided by BaRed's elegant yet down-to-earth style, including tufted leather couches and exposed brick and stone, makes for an ideal dining experience with cocktails like no other. Make BaRed your destination. Please note: Parking is available behind the bar on 13th St between Glenarm and Tremont. There is also parking for $5 after 4 p.m. right behind the bar.

name: The Vega Lounge
description: The Vega Lounge is a chic and vibrant spot known for its stylish ambiance and expertly crafted cocktails. Located in a prime area of Pompano Beach, it offers a perfect setting for both relaxed gatherings and lively nights out. With a menu featuring innovative drinks, The Vega Lounge ensures a memorable experience for all its guests.

name: Firehouse Subs - Lexington
description: People love a good meal, and at Firehouse Subs you can be sure that your meal will be terrific. Built on a legacy of fire and police service, this entrepreneurial eatery started small but has grown to more than 900 locations, all committed to serving the best quality meats, cheeses, and produce in hearty and delicious subs, sandwiches, and salads.

name: Tropical Smoothie Cafe - Garden
description: Start your day off right with a refreshing and energizing smoothie from Tropical Smoothie Cafe. Choose from a variety of tasty options including the Kiwi Quencher, Avocolada, and Peanut Paradise and pair it with delectable food items like flatbreads, wraps, and even breakfast items. Stop by today or order online for a quick meal on the go!

name: Austin Kitchen
description: Austin's Kitchen is a cozy and inviting restaurant known for its delightful ambiance and delicious cuisine. This charming eatery offers a diverse menu that caters to a variety of tastes, often emphasizing fresh, locally-sourced ingredients. The interior of Austin's Kitchen is warmly decorated, creating a relaxing atmosphere that makes diners feel right at home. The restaurant is popular among locals and visitors alike for its friendly service and consistently good food.

name: El Sabor De Guerrero Takeout
description: Savor rich, authentic Mexican cuisine at El Sabor de Guerrero. The friendly restaurant invites you to sit back and relax as dedicated staff take care of all your dining needs. Choose from a variety of tasty dishes including chimichangas, quesadillas, chilaquiles, and more. Delivery and carryout are available so you can enjoy a great meal on the go!

name: Bankok Jazz
description: Bangkok Jazz is a family-run, casual, and inviting eatery offering up some of the tastiest and freshest Thai food around. This is a homey spot with a traditional Thai decor and a jazz-themed style. And, with lots on the menu, you'll be dazzled with tasty picks like pad Thai, curries, stir-fries, fresh seafood, lunch specials, and so much more.

name: Roma's Breakfast & Pizzeria
description: With their famous all-day breakfast eats and amazing pizzas, Roma's Pizzeria is the place to go for delish eats. In fact, this locally owned and operated spot has been serving the area since 1986. With legendary eats, you can feast on pizzas, pastas, salads, stromboli, panini, and of course, pancakes, French toast, and hearty breakfast sandwiches.

name: La Guapachosa Cuban Pizzeria
description: La Guapachosa Cuban Pizzeria is a vibrant culinary fusion hotspot where the flavors of Cuba meet the beloved Italian classic, pizza. Nestled in the heart of Miami's Little Havana, it's a haven for food enthusiasts seeking a unique dining experience. From the savory mojo-marinated meats to the crispy thin-crust pies, every bite is a tantalizing blend of cultures and tastes.

name: Bite
description: The first Bite location opened in 2002 with just a handful of sandwiches on the menu. Today, this multi-location culinary hot-spot has become known as the place to go when craving a hand-crafted globally inspired meal. The menu here is unique, and every dish is crafted from local and all natural ingredients. The bread is baked daily from a nearby bakery, the cheese is from a local dairy shop, the greens are organic, and the dressings, soups and more all made in-house fresh daily. Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner, there truly is something for everyone on the menu. Salads, soups, sandwiches, panini, snacks and desserts are all on the menu, offering variety enough for all. And, with a friendly, welcoming vibe and urban look, Bite can be your new go-to eatery for a delicious laid-back meal.

name: Santa Fe Mining Co
description: Open twenty-four-seven and inexpensively priced, Santa Fe Mining Co. is the place to go for delicious and fresh American fare. Serving all your favorite drinks, this restaurant and bar is great for a late night snack or as your final destination of the night. Welcoming families, servers and wait-staff prioritize quality and expedience. Known for their delicious sandwiches, Santa Fe Mining Co. offers numerous selections for all diets and palates. Whether stopping by for breakfast or craving an after-hours burger, all orders are sure to hit the spot!

name: Churrascaria Plataforma
description: Churrascaria Plataforma is a Brazilian steakhouse known for its authentic Rodízio-style dining, where guests enjoy an endless selection of expertly grilled meats carved tableside. The restaurant also features an extensive salad bar and a variety of traditional Brazilian sides, providing a comprehensive and flavorful dining experience.

name: Mr Waves Island Bar
description: Mr. Waves Island Bar offers a vibrant fusion of tropical flavors and laid-back ambiance, creating an oasis of island vibes in the heart of the city. With refreshing cocktails, fresh seafood, and a breezy atmosphere, it's the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in coastal delights. Don't forget to come experience their all-day breakfast and karaoke every night from 7p.m. to 11p.m.

name: Rosa Mexicano
description: Rosa Mexicano is renowned for their vibrant and authentic Mexican cuisine, infusing traditional flavors with contemporary twists. Their lively atmosphere and colorful decor transport diners to the heart of Mexico. From freshly made guacamole to sizzling fajitas, Rosa Mexicano tantalizes taste buds with a celebration of bold spices and rich textures.

name: Le George Mediterranean Bistro & Bar
description:
For reservations at Le George, please call the restaurant at 248-924-2016.

Upscale in both ambiance and cuisine, Le George is the inspiration of owner George Farah, a native of northern Lebanon. For his restaurant, he has chosen a chic, contemporary look defined by an open kitchen, dark woods, high-top tables, a cozy bar, and warm-weather outdoor seating. And, the entire look and feel of the place has been inspired by the Paris of the Middle East, Beirut. The colors, the forms, the melodies, the aromas and the flavors are all combined to celebrate tradition while stimulating the senses. Treat your palate to dishes like the braised lamb shank, shawarma rotisserie chicken, and just-from-the-water choices like the wild sockeye salmon. There's more to try, including Le George sampler plates that include a variety of different appetizers, entrees, desserts and a bottle of wine to share. There's a full-service bar here, and the wine list is affordable and approachable. Also be aware of dine-in specials like Wednesday's 1/2 off wine bottles that are under $50. Delicious, decadent and a treat for all the senses, Le George is a must-try.

name: La Madeleine French Country Cafe
description: La Madeleine invites guests to savor the essence of France with its charming ambiance and delectable cuisine. From cozy moments indoors to lively conversations on the patio, it's a delightful escape to French-inspired hospitality in the heart of your own neighborhood.

name: Village Bar & Grill
description: Located in the vibrant coastal city of Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, Village Bar & Grill stands as a culinary haven for locals and tourists alike. At the core of its charm lies the bustling bar, serving as a central hub for indulgent libations and convivial gatherings. The bartenders craft imaginative cocktails and pour an eclectic selection of beers and wines sourced from across the globe, fostering an atmosphere of camaraderie and celebration.

name: Grimaldi's Pizzeria - Watters Creek
description: Armed with over 100 years of pizza-making traditions and a coal-fired brick oven, the very first Grimaldi's Coal Brick-Oven Pizzeria started wowing diners back in 1990. Today, there are more locations across the country for you to enjoy an amazing meal. Each pizza starts with fresh, hand-tossed dough that's made in-house every day. Only the very best sauces, toppings, and hand-made mozzarella are used to top each quality pizza, which is then baked in an authentic coal-fired pizza oven to give it the very best flavor, a crisp crust, and perfectly cooked goodness. You can build a pizza just how you like it at Grimaldi's, or try one of their signature pizzas like The Don (sausage, meatballs, pepperoni), or the Brooklyn Bridge (oven-roasted red peppers, ricotta, Italian sausage). There's more goodness on the menu, like calzones, crisp and fresh salads, and don't forget about their house-made cheesecakes. With friendly service, a great vibe, and plenty of delicious eats, when you're craving a taste of New York City, check out Grimaldi's Coal Brick-Oven Pizzeria! Please note: Catering services are available. Call ahead to inquire.

name: Sol Mexican Cocina  Nyc 220 5Th
description: Sol Mexican Cocina is a vibrant and contemporary Mexican restaurant that brings the flavors of Baja California to its culinary creations. Known for its fresh and locally sourced ingredients, the restaurant offers a menu featuring a variety of tacos, ceviches, and innovative Mexican dishes. With a stylish and inviting atmosphere, Sol Mexican Cocina provides a delightful dining experience where guests can savor the bold and authentic tastes of Mexican cuisine.

name: Mosaic Cuisine
description: Mosaic Cuisine is a charming French-inspired breakfast spot known for its delightful array of pastries and freshly brewed coffee, offering a cozy ambiance perfect for starting the day. Nestled in the heart of the city, it entices patrons with its fusion of traditional French flavors and innovative breakfast creations.

name: Sergimmo Salumeria
description: Italy comes to Hells Kitchen in the form of the scrumptious, award-winning Sergimmo Salumeria...the most authentic Italian food store and restaurant you'll find this side of Sicily. Family run and operated for generations, and welcoming you with a new wine bar and delectable food concept, Sergimmo Salumeria is a spot that's close to major subway stops and tourist destinations. The story of the eatery is just as joyful as the food itself. In 1970, two brothers Giovanni and Fillippo Badalamenti, moved from Sicily to New York with nothing more than an elementary education and a hunger for opportunity. The brothers started their business in Astoria, Queens, which was the heart of Italian salumerias. With their driven personalities, ambition, work ethic, and family pride, their business prospered. Giovanni kept the tradition going after Fillippo's retirement in 1993, launching the current location in Whitestone, Queens. With such dedication and talent, it's little wonder the Salumeria became the source of all the finest Italian food and products in the area. Giovanni's sons, Sergio and Massimo, took over the family business after his retirement, becoming the second generation to continue the legacy. As children, Sergio and Massimo watched and worked closely with their father as he made traditional Italian specialties such as fresh mozzarella, ricotta, scamozza, and all sorts of Italian cured meats. The brothers honor those years by keeping the traditional specialties while also introducing more modern Italian culinary touches. Sergio and Massimo are constantly updating and perfecting their art in authentic yet modern Italian foods, which is why they travel yearly to Sicily seeking the very best cheeses, cured meats, spices, oils, bread, coffee, wine, and new techniques. By doing so the brothers ensure that you will experience and enjoy the finest Italian gourmet foods right here at Sergimmos, without ever having to travel outside of New York!

name: Onset Beach Patio & Grille
