description: Onset Beach Patio & Grille is a beachfront restaurant & deck showcasing a wide range of American staples, comfort food, mouthwatering burgers, specialty NY pizza & deli offerings. They also feature always fresh seafood rolls & platters, rotating beer and cider on tap, as well as wine & seltzers! On Monday to Thursday, they will also have Italian Restaurant Nights from 2pm till close where guests can order handmade authentic Italian cuisine. From choices like jumbo stuffed shells, chicken marsala, and nightly specials, customers can call ahead for reservations to experience new menu items from their Italian kitchen!

name: Caruso's Italian Kitchen
description: Caruso's Italian Kitchen is a casual and chill spot that's dishing up hand-crafted Italian fare. With a long and spacious bar plus plenty of tables, it's the perfect spot for lunch with co-workers, dinner with the family, or a night out with someone special. There's plenty on the menu, including pastas, pizzas, salads, and meaty picks.

name: Town Line Sports Grille
description: Town Line Sports Grille is the go-to destination for sports enthusiasts and food lovers alike. With multiple screens showcasing the latest games, guests can enjoy the action while savoring delicious pub fare and a wide selection of drinks. The vibrant atmosphere and friendly service make it the perfect spot for a fun night out with friends or family.

name: Haiku Tokyo
description: Haiku Tokyo is a trendy, fast-casual restaurant located in SanTan Village, Gilbert, Arizona. It specializes in Hawaiian poké bowls and Japanese Ramen, offering a range of flavors and nutritional choices. The menu includes traditional pan-fried Gyoza and island-inspired tuna Poke salad, among other dishes. Owned by an Asian Chef, Haiku Tokyo emphasizes authentic flavors with high-quality, freshly made ingredients, providing a unique and diverse dining experience.

name: The Islander Bar & Grille
description: From the comfortable bar seats to the pool tables to the flat screen TVs that dot the walls, Islander Bar and Grille seems to be a home away from home for suburban Clevelanders and travelers alike. Sure, you shoot the breeze, catch the latest game action, and grab an ice-cold beer here, but you can also surrender to that growing appetite that has you counting the minutes until lunch or dinnertime rolls around. You'll be glad you came too, because the kitchen here spends their time perfecting classics.

name: Melo Melo Coconut Dessert
description: Melo Melo Coconut Dessert started with a simple love for coconuts. They are committed to making and serving delicious, natural, and healthy desserts. They've always had high standards when it comes to choosing what they eat, and that carries over to what they serve. You get their very best in every bite!

name: Stacks - Campbell
description: Since 1997, Stacks has been serving the downtown Campbell area fresh and delicious breakfast and lunch in comfortable digs that keep guests regularly coming back for more. Everything on their menu is made to order with prime ingredients, and there are even full menus for kids and those following a gluten-free diet, making it easy for everyone to find something to enjoy. House specialties include huevos rancheros, old-fashioned biscuits and gravy, steak and eggs, ranchero breakfast burrito, veggie tacos, and chicken fried steak, and there are plenty of waffles, omelets, pancakes, skillets, burgers, sandwiches, salads, and more to choose among. Wake up with one of Stacks' espresso drinks or an organic tea, or sip on a fresh fruit juice or smoothie. Their dining space exudes a relaxed modern diner vibe, with table, booth, and counter seating, plus a pet-friendly outdoor patio. Also available for takeout and delivery, Stacks is sure to please your palate, satisfy your appetite, and have you planning a return visit in no time.

name: Gen X Tavern
description: Gen X Tavern is bringing back the coolest '80s and '90s food, drinks, and games to the heart of downtown Tampa. The trendy restaurant puts a contemporary twist on the "fads of yesteryear" and features a retro television wall where you can play classic video games, a collection of exciting arcade games like Pacman and pinball, and rows of lockers decked out with fun artwork that pays tribute to '80s and '90s pop culture. You're sure to feel nostalgic from the moment you walk through the door! The menu is filled with a wide selection of mouthwatering appetizers, entrees, and desserts including General Tso's fried or grilled cauliflower, quesadillas, Forrest's Shrimp Po Boys, Dunkaroos, and juicy burgers like the Macgyver Burger customized exactly to your liking with your choice of tasty toppings like cheese curds, arugula, and sriracha aioli. Happy hour is offered every day from 3-7 p.m. with incredible deals on select appetizers, signature cocktails, wine, and draft beer. Surprise your friends with a Top Gun Shot Flight or choose from a variety of other electrifying shots like Gusher and White Mystery Airhead. Open Tuesday through Sunday travel back in time and treat yourself to Gen X Tavern today.

name: Broadway Comedy Club
description: Already known as New York's biggest comedy club, Broadway Comedy Club now has a new addition to their already thriving business: a trendy American cafe located right next door. Frequenters of the Broadway Comedy Club are extremely pleased with the new bistro, which gives them the opportunity to enjoy a great meal after they enjoy classic performances from big-name comedians such as Conan O' Brien and Dave Attell! What's best about the cafe is that it gives you a chance to mingle with the comedians before and after the show. Ever dreamed of buying your favorite celebrity a drink? Well now you'll certainly have the chance at the Broadway Comedy Cafe. Enjoy one of their delicious wraps such as the Caesar Classic Caesar or the Grilled Chicken, both of which are served with potato chips. Although you may originally come to the Broadway Comedy Club for the show, you'll keep coming back for the delicious food, signature cocktails and fun ambiance created by mingling with the local talent and big-name stars of comedy.

name: Cosmos Bistro
description: Cosmos Bistro is a beloved culinary gem celebrated for its inventive French-inspired cuisine and inviting atmosphere. With a menu crafted from locally sourced ingredients, Cosmos Bistro offers a diverse selection of dishes that showcases creativity in their cuisine, making it the ideal destination for patrons seeking a unique dining experience in a warm and welcoming setting.

name: Jersey Mike's Subs Secaucus
description: Jersey Mike's Subs has become a fan-favorite chain for subs since their opening in 1956. They offer a sub above - one that's measured in more than inches or seconds 'til served. They carefully consider every aspect of what they do - every slice, every sandwich, every store - and provide customers with sustenance and substance too.

name: Pop's Bar & Grill
description: Looking for the perfect spot for a chill hangout? Be sure to check out Pop's Bar & Grill for a guaranteed great time! This casual sports-themed bar and grill features delicious and fresh American pub fare and a variety of exciting cocktails and beer. Come grab a table in their dining room or on the relaxing patio.

name: Pita House
description: Treat yourself to fresh and vibrant Middle Eastern fare with a trip to Pita House. The perfect stop after a day of shopping at Woodfield mall, this cozy restaurant offers great deals on superb food. Start with tasty appetizers like fresh-made hummus with pita bread, grape leaves stuffed with rice and vegetables, or warm lentil soup. Popular entrees include shish kabab made with tender beef, vegetarian falafel plate, and lamb kabab featuring grilled minced lamb seasoned to perfection. Beef or chicken shawarma wraps are also great choices. End on a sweet note with an order of delicious walnut baklava. For awesome, affordable, and authentic Middle Eastern cuisine, no one does it like Pita House. Planning an event? Pita House also offers catering.

name: Three Dollar Cafe
description: Three Dollar Café is a casual chain featuring a menu of burgers, pasta, and wings, as well as draft beers and sports on all their TVs. You can count on them for a chill environment and great food and drinks. Please join them for live music every Tuesday and Friday night! They also have team trivia every Wednesday, so check it out for a good time.

name: Che' OTR
description: Che' in Cincinnati OH beckons with its fusion of Latin American flavors and contemporary flair, creating a vibrant dining experience. This culinary gem offers a menu that dances with creativity, showcasing the chef's passion for bold and inventive dishes. From the stylish decor to the unforgettable tastes, Che' promises a dining journey that transcends the ordinary in Cincinnati.

name: Noodles and Things
description: Dishing up made-to-order noodle soups, Noodles and Things is sure to cure your craving for soul-satisfying eats. Influenced by the flavors of Hong Kong street food, they specialize in homemade soup creations made with broths that have simmered for more than 20 hours and are loaded with noodles. There's plenty to try at this fan-favorite spot!

name: Follia
description: Packed with all the charm of an Italian osteria, humming with the vivaciousness of an urban wine bar, and filled with the aromas from its wood-burning pizza oven, Follia is a beguiling eatery in a city filled with fascinating finds. Their bar is dispensing a roster of wines and other thirst-quenching relief throughout happy hour and dinner.

name: Pacos Mexican Cuisine
description: Bringing their hometown dishes to the area, you'll find fabulous and authentic Mexican eats at Pacos Mexican Cuisine. Featuring traditional dishes from Pachuca, Hidalgo Mexico, there's plenty on the menu to tempt you. Combine great food with stellar service and a great ambiance, and you'll see why this is a popular eatery all day long!

name: Firehouse Subs - Wards Corner
description: People love a good meal, and at Firehouse Subs you can be sure that your meal will be terrific. Built on a legacy of fire and police service, this entrepreneurial eatery started small but has grown to more than 900 locations, all committed to serving the best quality meats, cheeses, and produce in hearty and delicious subs, sandwiches, and salads.

name: Sushi Jo
description: Sushi Jo of Boynton Beach offers a wide variety of tasty and unique sushi dishes. Start your meal off with several of their mouth-watering appetizers, such as the Hamachi Tartar, Sashimi Appetizer, and Gyoza. Entrees range from traditional Japanese offerings to signature house specialties.  But rest assured, every  selection is handcrafted and made-to-order, using only the freshest ingredients, including locally-sourced seafood and produce whenever possible. Each chef is specially trained in preparing classic sushi and sashimi; however, all create their own personalized variations on a theme, based on their individaul preferences, training and experience. Planning an event?  Let the professionals at Sushi Jo handle the catering for a change of taste all your guests will appreciate. From salads to entrees, Sushi Jo will tailor a menu to meet your needs and fit your budget.

name: Dallas BBQ
description: With steerheads on the wall, Dallas BBQ offers very inexpensive, ribs, chicken, coleslaw, potatos, and plenty of all.  If you are the kind of person who is just looking for a casual, inexpensive place to chow down, look no more.  Large variety of barbecued chicken.

name: Ditto's Grill
description: For decades, Ditto's Grill has been an area hot-spot for tasty food, fun, frosty drinks and great times. Chef Dominic Serratore is the culinary genius in the kitchen, and he oversees Ditto's famous menu of global dishes. If it's got flavor, then it might be on the menu at this colorful eatery. From steaks to salads and American to Asian cuisine, there's plenty to try every time you go. Some of their more popular dishes include their famous Thai wings, the Kentucky pork burger, Asian lettuce wraps, and the stuffed Pacific bass. No matter if you're there for a feast with the family or something light, the menu is indeed diverse. Ditto's also offers a dinner-for-two menu, where diners can share an appetizer and dessert in addition to their own entrees. And, this is a spot-on place for brunch. Join them every Sunday from 9 a.m. until 2 p.m. for even more deliciousness. But wait, there's more! Happy Hour is Monday through Saturday from 1-6 p.m.,  but no matter when you go, you'll discover big flavors and pours and friendly service; it's all a part of the charm at Ditto's Grill!

name: The Patio Thai
description: When you're hungry for outstanding Thai cuisine, head to The Patio Thai Restaurant for an authentic and oh-so delicious meal. At this cozy and friendly spot, it's all about hand-crafting classic Thai fare. All your favorites are on the menu, including spring rolls, chicken satay, crispy duck with basil, curries with your choice of protein, pad Thai, and of course, pineapple rice. There are house specialties, too, and to go with your meal, there are exotic and fruity cocktails, lovely wines, and cold beers. This friendly spot is open daily for lunch and dinner, or make it your new go-to spot for drinks after work. With something made fresh and fabulous just for you, check out The Patio Thai Restaurant today!

name: Amazonica Buena Vista
description: Across Hispanic Cultures, there is always a place of social gathering where people flock to decompress, relax and have a good time. That is what the Amazonica Experience is about: a place of reunion and enjoyment where it's always fresh and sunny. Stop by today and enjoy tasty cholados, obleas, and baked goods!

name: Dosa South Indian Grill
description: Come explore the tastes of traditional North and South Indian cuisines at Dosa Grill. Offering a wide variety of dosa, vegetarian and meat appetizers, and mouthwatering entrees, Dosa Grill is a friendly, welcoming place to enjoy old favorites and new delights.

name: Sanders Ferry Pizza And Pub
description: Sanders Ferry Pizza and Pub is a cozy establishment nestled in the community, offering a delectable menu of pizzas, pub fare, and a variety of beverages. Known for its family-friendly environment, they are a favorite spot for locals and visitors alike. The pub's casual setting and outdoor seating make it ideal to enjoy delicious food, catch up with friends, and unwind with a selection of craft beers.

name: Bar Toto
description: Bar Toto is a local hangout that's dishing up tasty pizzas, pastas, plentiful entrees, and paninis, and pairing them with hand-crafted cocktails, luscious wines, and cold beers. There's room inside at the spacious bar, at cozy tables, or at a sidewalk table at this laid-back spot that also offers online ordering for delivery.

name: The Hitch Burger Grill - Upland
description: Enjoy a wonderfully fresh meal of burgers and fries with the family today at The Hitch Burger! They serve an impressive variety of entrees, including other sandwiches, barbecue ribs, and more. They even have a breakfast menu, and it's always cooked to perfection. Stop by this casual and welcoming location for a great dining experience!

name: Black Iron Burger
description: Wherever you join them in NYC, Black Iron Burger will always feel like home! They have been voted the Best Burger in NYC and are committed to staying true to that title. Stop by today for fine dining, chef-based burgers, craft beer, and cocktails! This is the perfect place for sports watching, private parties, or late night DJs.

name: Tocaya Modern Mexican - Downtown Los Angeles
description: Tocaya's Modern Mexican uses high-quality and sustainable ingredients to create delicious, chef-prepared tacos, burritos, bowls, and salads! A diverse menu of bold flavors is complemented by a curated beverage program that includes homemade aguas frescas and handcrafted margaritas. Stop by this sophisticated, fast-casual spot for a great meal!

name: Pocono Brewery of Whitehall
description: Pocono Brewery Company is your destination for in-house crafted beer and mouthwatering bites in an exciting atmosphere where friends and family can come together for an unforgettable dining experience. The welcoming brewery uses custom designed Italian brewing equipment to make one-of-a-kind brews on site like the pumpkin porter, vanilla chai brown ale, and the Apple-Achian cider guaranteed to tantalize your taste buds. Pocono Brewery Company is bringing its love for its home country to you in the form of traditional Italian-style pizza carefully crafted with fresh, quality ingredients and cooked in an authentic wood burning pizza oven. Choose from a variety of tasty pies like chicken bacon ranch and the Rustica featuring artichoke hearts, imported capers, and Kalamata olives. The menu also includes fresh cut pastas, loaded nachos, and tasty salads. Be sure to stop in Monday through Friday from 4-6 p.m. and Sundays from 6-8 p.m. for amazing happy hour deals on select drinks and food. Open seven days a week join in the fun at Pocono Brewery Company today and become a part of the family.

name: Pi-Local
description: Pi Local is a brick oven Neapolitan style pizza joint that offers some of the freshest and highest quality dishes around. They have everything from gourmet pies to paninis, salads, soup, wings, beer and wine. Come by today with friends or family alike for some of their classics like their Garden Fresh pie or their classic calzone.

name: Cloud Vietnamese
description: Cloud Vietnamese Restaurant proudly offers delicious and authentic Vietnamese food in New York City. Every single meal they make is unique and packed with flavor. The key to their success is simple: providing authentic Vietnamese food made from the freshest ingredients. You will fall in love with their dishes!

name: India At Times Square
description: Looking for the perfect place to savor delectable Indian cuisine? India at Times Square has got you covered! The casual restaurant has a sophisticated, yet warm ambiance complete with authentic decor and comfortable seating. High-quality service is of the utmost importance and friendly staff will ensure you're well taken care of throughout your meal.

name: Miranda Lambert's Casa Rosa
description: Casa Rosa brings the flavors of Texas to Nashville's Broadway with daily live music, vibrant nightlife, and premium VIP experiences. The Casa Rosa menu features chef-crafted Tex-Mex dishes made with fresh ingredients, including Miranda's favorites like margaritas and made-from-scratch daily salsas. Fans will be delighted by the extensive margarita and tequila menu, perfectly complementing the classic Tex-Mex offerings. The kitchen is open until midnight on Friday and Saturday.

name: Yamashiro
description: Yamashiro is a Cal-Asian sushi restaurant in Hollywood Hills, known for its timeless, sophisticated, and chic atmosphere. The restaurant features a pagoda-style dining room, shoji screen walls, and a Japanese-inspired garden courtyard with a koi pond. Chefs prepare delicious sushi and sashimi dishes, including starters like edamame, Brussels sprouts, and calamari. The restaurant can also host special events and offers stunning views for a memorable dining experience.

name: East Side Kosher Deli
description: No matter if you live down the street, are just visiting, or want something delicious shipped to you, everything at East Side Kosher Deli is terrific. This is a kosher deli, supermarket, and restaurant all rolled into one convenient, friendly, and quick location. Famous for their premium house-cured deli meats and 45-day dry-aged beef along with classics and globally-inspired fare, there's something delicious for everyone at this popular spot. Go early and start your day with an order of pancakes, blintzes, omelets, and more. For lunch and dinner, their crave-worthy deli sandwiches are loaded with meats like pastrami, smoked turkey, egg salad, house-cured corned beef, and tongue. And, there's a huge list of salads and other sides to go with your sammich. Also on the menu are entrees like grilled lamb chops, fish tacos, beer-braised ribs, and wild mushroom gnocchi. There's more to try, including vegetarian options, kid-friendly choices from the kids menu, and when you need catering, there's no place better or tastier. Call ahead and let them know what you need, and they'll take care of all the details. Get something to-go from the deli counter or enjoy a sit-down meal in the dining room--with all sorts of tempting house-made fare, East Side Kosher Deli can be your new one-stop destination for amazing food!

name: Amavi
description: Amavi is a sophisticated dining establishment known for its Mediterranean-inspired cuisine and elegant ambiance. The restaurant offers a menu that emphasizes fresh, seasonal ingredients, creating flavorful and artfully presented dishes. Amavi's stylish decor and attentive service make it an ideal spot for both intimate dinners and celebratory gatherings.

name: Biryani Kabab
description: Discover the delish halal Indian and Pakistani cuisine that's cooked hot and fresh at Biryani Kabab. This is a lively and friendly spot with room to dine-in, or you can take something fabulous to-go. With hand-crafted fare like pakoras, delish biryanis, chicken tikka masala, curries, and vegetarian picks, there's something here for everyone.

name: Beyond Juicery & Eatery - Troy
description: Beyond Juicery & Eatery offers a variety of made-to-order juices, smoothies, wraps, sorbet bowls and salads. Their commitment to fresh ingredients and excellent customer service is what sets them apart from other restaurants. This place is the perfect spot for anyone looking to turn their day around with a delicious and health-conscious dish.

name: Planet Smoothie
description: Planet Smoothie is dedicated to making great-tasting smoothies in a variety of options to meet any customer's taste and lifestyle demands. Select one of their favorite recipes, or customize your smoothie with any of their healthy add-ins! Want to skip the line? Order your smoothie online in advance.

name: Ming Palace
description: Cantonese, Mandarin, and Szechuan dishes are what you'll find at area favorite, Ming Palace. This is a casual and family-friendly restaurant with a diverse menu of hand-crafted dishes. Always made from the finest and freshest ingredients, you can count on a great meal no matter if you dine-in, or call ahead for take-out or delivery (some minimums apply). Check out their affordable and oh-so tasty lunch specials. Each comes with soup of the day, an egg roll, and your choice of side dish. Or, order a la cart from choices like kung pao beef, sweet & sour pork, pineapple chicken, curry shrimp and sizzling platters of BBQ pork. There's lots more on the menu, and if you need to feed the family, check out the meals for two or more diners. Great service, reasonable prices and fresh ingredients makes dining at Ming Palace a true pleasure!

name: Rosati's Pizza - Oswego
description: Rosati's is committed to providing customers with their signature Chicago pizzas, pastas, and sandwiches. They've been staying true to their roots since 1895 when Ferdinand Rosati, an Italian immigrant from Naples, Italy, opened a fine-dining restaurant on Coney Island. Less than 10 years later, Ferdinand moved to Chicago and started another Italian restaurant on Taylor Street which saw nearly overnight success. Back then, pizza was strictly Old World Italian fare, but little did Ferdinand know that diners would go crazy for this simple and humble dish when, in 1964, the first official Rosati's was opened. By 1978, a total of 10 Rosati family members owned carry-out pizzerias, firmly establishing the Rosati family name as a leader in the pizza restaurant business. Today, there are nearly 200 Rosati's restaurants across the country, and it has even been inducted into the Pizza Hall of Fame. And, with a legacy for amazing, fresh, and oh-so tasty food, every time you enjoy a pizza or a meal from Rosati's, you're tasting the tradition that made Rosati's a neighborhood tradition.

name: Sama
description: Sama, an Indian restaurant located in River Grove, IL, offers a delightful dining experience with its rich and diverse menu. Sama, known for its authentic Indian cuisine, serves a variety of traditional dishes that capture the essence of Indian flavors. The restaurant's inviting ambiance and exceptional service make it a popular choice among locals and visitors alike. Sama is dedicated to providing a memorable culinary journey through the tastes and aromas of India.

name: TGI Fridays
description: End your busy week in a place where everyone says, "Thank Goodness It's Friday!" T.G.I. Fridays is an American restaurant that prides itself on fun and friendly service while offering a great menu, full bar and relaxed atmosphere. Enjoy fried mac and cheese, loaded potato skins, boneless buffalo wings & their famous Jack Daniels Grill items.

name: Meson Sandwiches
description: Meson Sandwiches welcomes you with famous sandwiches, all-day breakfasts, and serious coffee. The story behind this Caribbean-inspired sandwich eatery began in 1972 in Puerto Rico, and now today there are more locations than ever before. You'll discover all-day breakfasts here, in addition to scrumptiously different sandwiches. Feast on favorites like the medianoche with seasoned pork, Virginia ham, pickles and more on freshly baked medianoche bread, or try the corned beef & Swiss cheese on their famous criollo bread. There are vegetarian options, salads, baked potatoes, specialty sandwiches, soups and a kids menu, making this the kind of place that's perfect for everyone in the family. Casual, welcoming and most importantly, delicious, Meson Sandwiches has arrived and it's here to stay!

name: Millennium
description: Millennium Restaurant has been a top pick for fresh, innovative, and delicious vegan cuisine since 1994. Offering globally-inspired plant-based fare in a fine dining setting, you can enjoy thoughtfully combined flavors in exciting dishes. The full bar features cocktails made with house-made infusions and fresh juices in addition to craft beers.

name: Mid City Garage
description: Once an auto repair shop, Mid City Garage now sports a whole new vibe, providing a hip and casual setting that creates the ultimate hang-out spot in Columbus. Their full-service bar has plenty of beer, wine, and cocktails to enjoy, and whiskey lovers will be especially delighted with the wide selection of bottles.

name: McALISTER'S DELI  Lubbock  Mil
description: McAlister's Deli is a popular American chain known for its extensive menu featuring sandwiches, salads, soups, and signature sweet tea. Founded in 1989 in Oxford, Mississippi, the deli has grown to over 450 locations across the United States. McAlister's is celebrated for its friendly service and comfortable, casual dining atmosphere.

name: ON + ON - Torrance
description: On + On Kitchen is a modern interpretation of convenient Asian food blending Korean cuisine with the bounty of California. They provide wholesome, seasonal food without compromising on the flavors you come to expect from your local Asian eatery. Stop by for a quick lunch or a healthy grab-and-go dinner for the family!

name: Jersey Mike's Subs-Reading
description: Jersey Mike's Subs has become a fan-favorite chain for subs since their opening in 1956. They offer a sub above - one that's measured in more than inches or seconds 'til served. They carefully consider every aspect of what they do - every slice, every sandwich, every store - and provide customers with sustenance and substance too.

name: Mestizo Restaurant
description: Mestizo Restaurant is locally owned and proud to serve Baton Rouge since 1999 as the premier Mexican restaurant, with both Mexican and Cajun-French influences. This inviting and popular spot is featuring modern & fresh cuisine in a festive atmosphere including Keto, vegetarian, and gluten-free menus.

name: Carolina Steel Sports Bar - Ballantyne
description: Carolina Steel Sports Bar is a vibrant hub for sports enthusiasts to cheer on their favorite teams with an extensive selection of drinks and hearty pub fare. With multiple screens broadcasting live games and events, the atmosphere is always electric and lively. Whether guests are die-hard fans or simply looking for a lively spot to unwind with friends, Carolina Steel Sports Bar offers the perfect blend of sports, camaraderie, and good times.

name: Sundaes
description: It's always time for ice cream at Sundaes! They offer frozen yogurt, soft-serve ice cream, gelato, Only 8 and vegan options as well. They have a vast and eclectic toppings bar that has over 50 different toppings. They also serve Acai bowls, pity bowls, milk shakes, smoothies, protein shakes and much more!

name: Tony's Di Napoli
description: Tony's Di Napoli, established in 1959, offers Southern Neapolitan cuisine in generous family-style platters serving 2-3 people. Located in Times Square at the Casablanca Hotel, it's a top spot for both locals and tourists. The extensive menu features dishes like Baked Ziti Bolognese, Lobster Oreganato, and Tony's Famous Twin 1lb. N.Y. Cut Sirloins. With private party space, catering services, and convenient parking options, Tony's is perfect for any dining occasion.

name: El Framboyan Cuban Cuisine
description: In the mood for something truly fresh and delicious? Come on down to El Framboyan Cuban Cuisine for an option that is sure to leave you satisfied. They are experts in authentic Cuban flavor and provide a welcoming atmosphere that is great for any occasion. Stop by today and enjoy Cuban sandwiches, yuca, and so much more!

name: Fresh & Savory Deli & Grill
description: Fresh & Savory Deli & Grill provides lunch and catering options including sandwiches, pasta, salads, desserts, and more. They are known for running great specials every day of the week, so be sure to check out daily specials on their website! They have been serving Texas fresh and tasty food since 1984.

name: Canton Michoacano
description: Canton Michoacano is a vibrant Mexican restaurant located in the heart of Kenosha. Renowned for its authentic Michoacán cuisine, the restaurant offers a wide array of traditional dishes that capture the rich flavors and culinary heritage of the region. Each meal is prepared using fresh, high-quality ingredients, ensuring an exceptional dining experience. The warm and inviting atmosphere of Canton Michoacano, combined with its friendly and attentive staff, makes it a popular destination for both locals and visitors. Whether enjoying a hearty plate of carnitas, a savory bowl of pozole, or a refreshing margarita, guests at Canton Michoacano are treated to a true taste of Michoacán's culinary excellence.

name: Yogli Mogli - Sandy Springs
description: Get creative and make something delicious today at Yogli Mogli, a frozen yogurt shop where unique flavors and toppings are totally mix-and-matchable. Here, you'll find quality froyo flavors that range from sweet to tart, and with gluten-free, dairy-free, and no-sugar added options, there's something for everyone. Get creative and swirl all your favorite yogurt flavor combinations, then top it with everything from fruits and nuts to candy bar pieces. There are nearly limitless combinations, and you are always in control! From snack-size to meal-size, you can get what you want when you want it at Yogli Mogli! Please note: Catering services are available. Call today for more information.

name: Krafted
description: Welcome to Krafted Burger Bar + Tap, where global inspiration meets the classic burger joint. From Chicago to Japan, and from San Francisco to Greece, Krafted's menu offers a culinary journey through carefully selected, fresh ingredients that capture the essence of each destination. They invite guests to unwind and savor the experience, enjoying a selection of 46 craft beers and cocktails while indulging in burgers, chicken thigh sandwiches, pizzas, and more in the company of friends.

name: Halftime Pub & Grill - Patty's Catering
description: Halftime Pub & Grill is a popular destination for those seeking a friendly, down-to-earth atmosphere combined with good food and entertainment. This establishment offers a variety of American-style food and drinks, including pizza, and is known for its lively environment and lunch specials. The pub features a full-menu restaurant, bar, and grill, catering to a wide range of tastes. Halftime Pub & Grill, have Smashburger, homemade chips, and southwest chicken rolls.

name: Side By Side Pizza
description: No matter if you're hungry for pizza by the slice or by the whole pizza, Side By Side Pizza in the Bronx has the pizzas you're craving. There's plenty on the  menu at this popular spot which also offers take-out and delivery. For lunch or dinner, you can nosh on hand-crafted specialty pizzas or build your own creation. The freshest toppings, the tastiest cheeses and sauces, and garden-fresh veggies top each pizza. There's more to try, like plentiful pastas (pasta with sausage, baked ziti or lasagna might tempt you), or check out grilled eats like juicy burgers. Hero sandwiches, flaky burek, salads, and more are all made fresh just for you. Craving casual eats? Check out the fabulous fare at Side By Side Pizza today!

name: The Old Warsaw
description: The Old Warsaw has been the Dallas area's ultimate dining experience since 1948.  Famous for the spectacular prime rib and savory rack of lamb as well as other exquisitely prepared dishes, The Old Warsaw has been a favorite of locals and out-of-town patrons for quite some time.  The elegant dining room beckons to those seeking a true premier dining experience to remember.  The long-established candlelit restaurant is known as one of the most romantic in Dallas and is widely recognized for its superior Continental preparations of meat, fish and seafood, as well as its extensive wine list, offering the finest of French and Californian wines.  The rich, Old World atmosphere has made it a favorite for holiday, anniversary or birthday celebrations as well as for business entertainment.  Nightly, musicians enhance the mood with a variety of musical selections and offer special musical celebrations for birthdays and anniversaries.  They have been rated in the first percentile in the country in exceptional cuisine, excellent service and in elegant dining atmosphere for 2007 while receiving the Four Diamond Award from AAA.  The Old Warsaw was also been named "One of America's Top Restaurants" by Zagat in 2006.

name: HENDRICKSON'S
description: Hendrickson's stands out as a quintessential American diner experience in the bustling cityscape. Nestled in a vibrant neighborhood, it captures the essence of classic diner culture with its retro ambiance and hearty comfort food offerings. From all-day breakfast favorites to mouthwatering burgers and milkshakes, Hendrickson's promises a taste of nostalgia and a welcoming atmosphere for locals and tourists alike.

name: Lares Restaurant
description: You are welcome at this family owned and operated restaurant that has been offering traditional Mexican cuisine as well as family recipes since 1968. Open daily, Lares Restaurant's interior décor consists of paintings done by local artists, including one of the owners. Serving breakfast, lunch and dinner, Lares Restaurant uses only the freshest ingredients possible. Voted as one of the 2004 Best 25 Restaurants on Los Angeles Magazine, Lares Restaurant is perfect for dine-in, take-out or catering. A full bar and live nightly entertainment is available. Stop by soon!

name: Pio Bagel
description: Check out bagels with a Latin twist at Pio Bagel. Founded in 2014 by the Espinoza family, Pio Bagel offers a wide variety of tasty bagels and breakfast and lunch favorites including homemade granola, muffins and pastries, omelets, salads, and homemade soups.

name: Le Botaniste UES
description: Le Botaniste is a plant-based, organic restaurant offering a menu inspired by botanical and global cuisines, emphasizing sustainability and environmental consciousness. With its apothecary-themed decor and focus on fresh, nutrient-rich ingredients, Le Botaniste provides a unique dining experience that caters to both health-conscious and eco-friendly diners. In addition to the menu, they have seasonal specials always available.

name: ADOBO MEXICAN GRILL
description: Adobo Mexican Grill in Brooklyn is celebrated for its authentic Mexican cuisine prepared with fresh, flavorful ingredients. From sizzling fajitas to hearty burritos and traditional tacos, Adobo offers a diverse menu that captures the essence of Mexican culinary traditions. With its vibrant atmosphere and friendly service, it's a go-to destination for Mexican food lovers.

name: The Great Greek Mediterranean
description: The Great Greek Mediterranean Grill is a restaurant that not only serves some of the best and most authentic Greek food across America, but also provides legendary service across the board. Some of their delicious creations include their Spanakopita, Athenian Burger and their famous Great Greek Rice Bowl.

name: IHOP
description: Go hungry and leave happy at IHOP! IHOP is an iconic American restaurant which is much loved for its fast-casual food that ticks all the boxes when it comes to favorites. From their always popular breakfasts to lunch and dinner menus, there are always plenty of options for hungry diners at this 24-hour eatery. Any time is a great time to go to this restaurant for a meal, but if you're there for breakfast you'll be wowed by the variety of tasty dishes including omelettes, crepes, waffles, pancakes, steak & eggs and so much more. This is also a fabulous place for lunch where you can be guaranteed a great meal served with a smile. Try a variety of salads, burgers, sandwiches and more for lunch, or save your appetite and swing by for a delicious dinner. The dinner menu is filled with great all-American classics like Country Fried Steak, Sirloin Tips, the Grilled Balsamic Glazed Chicken and much more. For a great meal at a great price, treat yourself to the legendary food and friendly service at this casual all-American IHOP today!

name: Kiitsu Washoku & Sushi
description: Staying true to their core ethos of authenticity, Kiitsu serves washoku, paying homage to traditional Japanese cuisine by using only the finest and freshest ingredients available. Their seafood is sustainably sourced from local producers, while their pickled items are made in-house in small batches. Stop by today for an unbeatable meal!

name: Edwards Steakhouse
description: Located in a renovated historic building that has been serving the Jersey City community since the Prohibition Era, Edward's Steakhouse offers the finest in New York-style steaks, chops, and seafood served in a comfortable upscale setting.

name: Tropical Smoothie Cafe  South
description: Tropical Smoothie Cafe's mission is to inspire a healthier lifestyle by serving amazing food and smoothies with a bit of tropical fun. For more than 20 years, this tasty spot has been a destination for flavor, a heritage they continue today. The menu boasts bold, flavorful smoothies, toasted wraps, sandwiches, flatbreads, and bowls. They cater too!

name: Samburna Indian Restaurant
description: Samburna Indian Restaurant is the product of a few like-minded food lovers who joined together to fulfill the lack of authentic Indian cuisine in the area. They believe in consistency and quality for better success. They always strive to serve better food with consistency and quality for all of their loving customers.

name: Farina Pasta and Noodle
description: Farina Pasta and Noodle brings a fresh concept to the pasta market. The fast-casual restaurant believes that handmade pasta shouldn't just be a fancy dinner option and invites you to try its Italian-style pasta and Asian-style noodles that are both delicious and affordable. Customize your own pasta dish or choose from a variety of signature selections.

name: Scardino's Italian Restaurant
description: In a recent review, The Torrance Daily Breeze wrote, "There are some wonderful small restaurants that dot the landscape of Italy. If you want to duplicate the experience of traveling to Europe without the expense, visit Scardino's Italian Restaurant in Torrance."  Scardino's is a family owned and operated ristorante, much like one would find in the neighborhoods of any southern Italian city. The authentic recipes originate from all southern provinces of the country.  The chefs carefully prepare the pasta, pizza and seafood each day with the highest quality ingredients available, most imported from Italy. Scardino's also has an excellent selection of moderately priced Italian wines and fantastically delicious homemade tiramisu. The Iorillo family - Phillip and Pauline along with daughters Tracy and Kristi - and their friendly, professional staff will pamper you with world-class service and Italian hospitality. Scardino's intimate, warm Italian atmosphere makes it the perfect choice for entertaining your family and friends. Scardino's, your favorite South bay restaurant, is now open for lunch and office catering.

name: EL PATIO DE FELA
description: El Patio de Fela offers an authentic taste of Afro-Caribbean cuisine, with vibrant flavors and dishes. The restaurant boasts a lively atmosphere, complete with colorful decor, transporting diners to a tropical oasis. From jerk chicken to plantain fritters, each dish at El Patio de Fela showcases the richness and diversity of Afro-Latin cuisine.

name: Cafe Hassla Bingsu And Waffle
description: In the mood for a special sweet treat? Cafe Hassla Bingsu and Waffle has exactly what you need to satisfy your cravings! Come and relaxing in their casual and inviting atmosphere while enjoying a menu of delicious bingsu, bubble tea, fruit tea, savory and cream waffles, Italian sodas, and so much more!

name: Bubbeleh Bagel
description: Bubbeleh Bagel in New York is well-regarded for its exceptional bagels, earning positive reviews for its quality and variety, including traditional, hand-rolled, and kettle-boiled bagels. With over 40 years of bagel-making experience, Bagel Boss has established itself as a destination for authentic New York bagels, made by 5th-6th generation bagel bakers​​. They offer a wide range of options, including vegan cream cheese and colorful rainbow bagels, catering to a diverse set of tastes and dietary preferences​.

name: Woody's Bar B Q
description: Woody's Bar B Q takes the art of BBQ quite seriously. That's why every day for nearly four decades, they've been slow-cooking BBQ for hours on end to deliver that signature fall-off-the-bone tenderness and melt-in-your-mouth smoky flavor to every patron every time. They invite you to service founded in Southern Hospitality and comfort food.

name: Poke Island
description: In the mood for a meal that is authentic and packed with exciting flavor? Poke Island is a modern, fast-food outlet providing create-your-own poke bowls made with a variety of fresh and delicious toppings and sauces. You can count on them for speedy service and a welcoming atmosphere that you are sure to enjoy.

name: Royal Kabob
description: Royal Kabob is a popular restaurant known for its authentic Middle Eastern cuisine, featuring a variety of flavorful kebabs, shawarmas, and traditional dishes. The establishment prides itself on using fresh, high-quality ingredients to create dishes that reflect the rich culinary heritage of the region. Customers frequently praise Royal Kabob for its friendly service and inviting atmosphere, making it a favorite dining spot for both locals and visitors.

name: Alachi Masala
description: Alachi Masala serves delicious and homemade southern Asian food. They have the best Indian cuisine in town, including all of the classic favorites, made with authenticity and flavor. Stop by today and grab a table in their dining room, or call in your order to take to-go!

name: Buenos Sabores
description: Buenos Sabores was founded with one passionate objective in mind-- give Austin residents the opportunity to experience authentic homemade Mexican food in a warm, friendly atmosphere. From chicken tinga tortas and succulent carnitas tacos to vegan quesadillas, the menu features a variety of traditional selections that are sure to excite your taste buds.

name: Raku It's Japanese
description: Raku It's Japanese is a stellar spot to cure your cravings for hand-crafted Japanese dishes. You'll find plenty on the menu to try, including plenty of picks from the sushi bar. Always made from the finest and freshest seafood, you can get your sushi, nigiri, and roll fix here. Tempura, ramen, teriyaki, and other hot dishes are also fabulous picks.

name: Sol De Jalisco
description: In the mood for some delicious and authentic Mexican cuisine? Come on down to Sol De Jalisco today for an option that is sure to leave you satisfied. They are known for their friendly atmosphere, attentive service, and sizzling hot meals that are packed with authentic flavor. Enjoy enchiladas, carne asada, and more!

name: Bird on the Run South Side
description: Famous for big and hearty chicken sandwiches and much more, Bird On The Run is a casual eatery where you can get what you want, how you want it. Their amazing sandwiches are available in various spice levels, and you can pair your pick with tasty sides and wash down your favorites with one of their terrific frozen cocktails.

name: Empanadas Monumental
description: Every day at Empanadas Monumental starts with making fresh dough and fillings with quality ingredients. With over 20 tasty flavors including mixed seafood, pepperoni, and Philly cheese steak, you'll always find something to love at Empanadas Monumental.

name: Navroz Mediterranean Grill
description: Searching for the perfect place to grab a delicious and refreshing meal? Come check out Navroz Mediterranean Grill, where they are serving authentic Mediterranean cuisine made from market fresh ingredients. Their menu includes fresh grilled kebobs, seafood, and vegetarian dishes made fresh to order.

name: Stanleys Cigar Lounge
description: Stanley's Cigar Lounge is a sophisticated spot for cigar aficionados to relax and enjoy a premium selection of cigars. The lounge features a cozy and upscale atmosphere, complete with comfortable seating and a well-stocked humidor. Known for its excellent service and knowledgeable staff, Stanley's provides a welcoming environment for both seasoned smokers and newcomers alike.

name: Savvy Sliders High St
description: Savvy Sliders takes the traditional slider and raises the bar. They've got everything from their classic Angus Beef Slider to the Famous Fried or Grilled Chicken Sliders, as well as their Ribeye Sliders with sliced steak grilled to perfection. They even have a vegetarian option with the falafel slider and an option to go bun-less!

name: Chill N Grill - Ashley Phosphate
description: Come enjoy American cuisine and good times at Chill N Grill, a family restaurant and lounge that specializes in burgers, wings, and loaded fries. Popular dishes include crab rice, chicken on the hill, Cajun stuffed burgers, chicken tacos, and loaded baked potatoes.

name: Taim Mediterranean Kitchen
description: Taim is a staple in the community, and their name literally means 'tasty'! They use the best ingredients, spices, and time-honored Mediterranean cooking techniques to create a one-of-a-kind experience. On Sundays, try their crave combo! For just $10, choose your favorite signature pitas served with fresh cut fries.

name: Rocco's Pizza
description: Rocco's Pizza brings authentic, handcrafted New York pizza and a traditional Italian espresso bar to the Chelsea neighborhood. This local pizza parlor serves classic New York-style pizza using only the freshest ingredients, as well as Grandma Pizza reminiscent of Italy, featuring San Marzano tomatoes and fresh basil. Their coffee is expertly brewed in true Italian fashion, and customers rave about the perfect balance of flavors in every cup.

name: Ho' Brah Tacos
description: Ho'Brah is a stylish, surf-themed restaurant and bar specializing in California-style tacos, burritos, Mexican small plates and cocktails. They are passionate about bright flavors and fresh ingredients, and their tacos are inspired by vacations around the world. Stop by today for a meal that is sure to blow you away!

name: Rodrigo's Mexican Grill
description: With the great taste of old and modern Mexico, enjoy Rodrigo's colorful and lively ambiance, along with delicious and fresh Mexican food at its best. Savor their award-winning, sizzling fajitas, seafood enchiladas, fish tacos, carne asada, chalupa salads and more. You will love their freshly made chips and salsa!

name: Poke House
description: At Poke House, they believe that you should feel great after eating great food. Their unique take on Hawaiian poke and their seasonally changing menu features dishes that are made in-house and prepared fresh every single day. Delicious, sustainable, and fresh, feast on something fabulous today at any convenient Poke House location!

name: Tin Shed Tavern & Pizza
description: Tin Shed Tavern & Pizzas has it all! Pizzas, burgers, mouthwatering appetizers, entrees, and more will fill you up. There are also private party rooms, happy hours specials, and plenty of TVs along with a full bar. Bring the family, meet some friends, or stop by after work and be sure to ask about the food and drink specials.

name: Brunch Snob
description: Brunch Snob is deserving of its name, serving the absolute best breakfasts in Phoenix. They serve comfort food with a special twist, combining flavors of the south with others from around the country. Stop by this welcoming, family-owned restaurant for any of your breakfast favorites, made with care and the freshest ingredients.

name: Firehouse Subs Palm Springs
description: Hot is the name of the game at Firehouse Subs, where they heat up taste buds like a four-alarm fire, serving sandwiches that are both delicious and filling. The theme of each location is one of service, honoring first responders and offering up quick, tasty meals. Order your hot/cold sub or salad today, and check out their catering options!

name: Chupacabra
description: Chupacabra Latin Kitchen & Taqueria, offers authentic Mexican food, including Birria, Al Pastor, and Baja Fish Tacos, and features a large outside patio that is partially enclosed and heated with TVs. This restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner every day and provides options for pick-up or delivery. With its unique name and varied menu, Chupacabra brings a lively and flavorful dining experience to the DC area, catering to a wide range of tastes and preferences​​.

name: Taqueria La Luz  Chattahoochee
description: Taqueria La Luz is the place to go for all your favorite Mexican eats! Located in the popular Chattahoochee Food Works, you'll find plenty to tempt you here. Quesadillas, steak tacos, crispy chips and creamy queso, and icy cold margaritas are all offered here. With street-style Mexican cuisine you'll be craving, go hungry and go often!

name: Graze Craze - Lakeland
description: Graze Craze offers an assortment of artfully curated charcuterie boards, perfect for any gathering or special occasion. Their selection includes a variety of gourmet cheeses, fresh fruits, artisanal meats, and delicious accompaniments. Known for both quality and creativity, Graze Craze provides a unique and tasty experience for food lovers.

name: Tri Dim Shanghai
description: Tri Dim Shanghai is an exceptional Chinese restaurant is a posh place that artfully combines the best of modern dining with an exotic Old World feel. Feast on dim sum like steamed Shanghai shumai, pan-seared dumplings, or the Peking crispy duck roll! Outstanding food, world-class service and a gorgeous restaurant make Tri Dim Shanghai a must-try.

name: Biscuits Cafe - Thunderbird
description: Open for breakfast, brunch, and lunch, Biscuits Cafe is a cozy and inviting eatery that's serving hand-crafted and oh-so delicious eats. Specializing in home-made biscuits and gravy, stuffed omelettes, and other tasty lunch picks, there's plenty on the menu here to love. Friendly service and reasonable prices add to the appeal at this busy eatery!

name: La Forketta
description: Looking for the perfect place to grab a delicious meal? Come on down to La Forketta for an exciting variety of traditional Italian eats made from the best quality ingredients. They provide an informal setting where you can bring the entire family to enjoy products imported from Italy and a great selection of wine.

name: Greek from Greece
description: Greek from Greece is one of the best cafes in town! They are a super diverse destination with a fast-paced environment and incredible food. They also are known for their top-notch coffee. Their exciting menu includes a variety of authentic recipes made from scratch using only the best quality ingredients.

name: Hoppy's Cantina
description: Hoppy's Cantina is a vibrant Mexican restaurant that tantalizes taste buds with its bold and flavorful dishes. Known for its lively atmosphere, extensive tequila selection, and delicious array of tacos and enchiladas, it's a go-to destination for those craving an authentic Mexican dining experience.

name: Banter
description: Banter is a sanctuary in which anyone can come and enjoy some great food, great coffee and some friendly Banter. This employee-owned enterprise serves a curate menu of excellent dishes for breakfast and lunch, as well as a selection of café and alcoholic beverages for you to enjoy. Stop by today for an unforgettable experience!

name: Kung Fu Tea Southlake
description: Quench your thirst with something fabulous today at Kung Fu Tea. You'll find some of the freshest drinks around at this popular spot with a huge menu. Sip on the original Kung Fu milk tea, try a slush blended with fresh fruit, or ask about the seasonal specials. Or, pick your own favorite and add their famous bubbles to every cup.

name: Woodcroft Steak House
description: A traditional steakhouse experience with a modern twist, Woodcroft Steakhouse & Seafood has all the sophistication of an established steakhouse, yet its rustic charm gives it a funky edge on the rest. They serve premium quality beef in a simple manner, allowing the true flavors to shine. Come enjoy an excellent meal at this inviting spot!

name: IHOP - Burlington
description: Making food that families love, IHOP is an iconic eatery known for amazing breakfast fare plus lunch and dinner eats. There's plenty on the menu here, including their signature pancakes. Also watch for seasonal specials and their popular family feasts that are available to-go. With something for everyone, you can count on IHOP for a great meal!

name: Oahu Hawaiian BBQ
description: Oahu Hawaiian BBQ is a restaurant in Virginia Beach that offers a taste of Hawaii's aloha spirit and diverse flavors. Founded by passionate Hawaiians, it aims to create a sanctuary for loved ones to indulge in the essence of paradise. The menu features Hawaiian grill and BBQ specialties, and the ambiance is inviting, inviting guests to embark on a culinary voyage.

name: Round Table Pizza
description: Round Table Pizza has a storied history, with decades of memories made within their walls. Their new restaurant design acknowledges all that came before, while boldly stepping into the present - providing a contemporary dining experience for friends and family to enjoy today and tomorrow. Come on by today!

name: Lunar
description: Lunar boasts an elegant ambiance adorned with traditional Chinese décor, offering a serene escape for diners. With an extensive menu featuring authentic dishes from various regions of China, Lunar tantalizes taste buds with its flavorful culinary creations. Renowned for its impeccable service and commitment to quality, Lunar provides a delightful dining experience that keeps patrons coming back for more.

name: Ax-Caliber Axe Venue & Coffee House
description: Serving breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night eats in addition to offering axe throwing Lakeland-style, Ax-Caliber Venue and Coffee House is a popular place to eat, drink, and have a good time. Stop by this casual and fun spot (walk-ins welcome) and throw some axes, sip on a cold beer, and nibble on something terrific at this all-in-one spot.

name: Mexology
description: Mexology, is a contemporary restaurant with its innovative approach to Mexican cuisine. This stylish eatery combines traditional Mexican flavors with modern culinary techniques, creating a menu that is both familiar and exciting. The atmosphere at Mexology is chic and vibrant, with an interior that balances rustic charm with urban sophistication, making it a popular destination for both casual diners and food enthusiasts. A highlight is their selection of handcrafted cocktails, which perfectly complement the spicy and rich flavors of the food. Mexology is not just about dining; it's an experience that brings together the best of Mexican culinary traditions and contemporary gastronomy, set in a lively and welcoming environment in the heart of Elizabeth.

name: Pit Za Pizza
description: When you're craving tasty and affordable eats, head to Pit Za Pizza. This is a family owned and operated spot, so they know how to treat customers right! Head over for fresh and delicious eats like their famous pizzas. Pepperoni rolls, subs, wraps, pastas, and garden-fresh salads are also on the menu at this popular and busy eatery.

name: Marco's Pizza - Scottdale - N Decatur Rd
description: Marco's Pizza has been making pizzas the Italian way for years, and with convenient locations all around the city, you can get your hands on a delicious and authentic pizza any day of the week from Marco's. Here, they take pride in the details, which means that the dough is made from premium flour and the water-to-air temperature ratio is controlled to create the best tasting crust, the sauce is still made from the founder's original Italian recipe, and pizzas are topped with a wholesome and tasty combination of three cheeses. Get a pizza just how you want it or try a specialty pie like the fully-loaded deluxe. Pizzas are the star of the show at Marco's, but there are other delicious eats to try like hearty subs, garden-fresh salads, and their tasty cheezybread that goes well with everything on the menu. Art meets science at Marco's Pizza--a place where the pizzas are pretty nearly perfect! Please note: Marco's also caters; call ahead for details.

name: Noodle Box Kitchen
description: Noodle Box Kitchen is a culinary haven where the artistry of noodles takes center stage. From wok-tossed delights to slurp-worthy soups, their menu is a symphony of flavors inspired by Asian cuisine. The vibrant ambiance and skilled noodle artisans make it a go-to spot for those craving a bowlful of deliciousness.

name: Rosati's Pizza
description: Since the first restaurant opened in 1895, Rosati's has been committed to serving signature Chicago pizzas, pastas, and sandwiches. Today, there are 200 Rosati's restaurants, and they are a Pizza Hall of Fame inductee. Every time you enjoy a pizza or a meal from Rosati's, you're tasting the dedication that made Rosati's a neighborhood tradition.

name: Hot Pot  Korean BBQ Fort Myers
description: A fun and exciting dining experience awaits you at Hot Pot Korean BBQ. Step up to the buffet to grab your raw ingredients to take back to your table where you'll find individual hot pots plus a shared barbecue grill. You'll find the veggies running throughout the dining room on a magnetic conveyor belt.

name: Northern Lites
description: Searching for the perfect place to spend your evening? Come on down to Northern Lites for a guaranteed great time! Since opening in 2022, Northern Lites has been one of Slidell's leading restaurants, applauded for both its gracious service and casual take on fine dining and sweet spirits. They serve brunch, burgers, hookah, and more!

name: John Holly's Asian Bistro - Downing St
description: Let John Holly's Asian Bistro take your taste buds on an exotic journey with delectable Chinese and Thai cuisine. The casual restaurant combines comfort with elegance to create a cozy dining environment filled with friendly, attentive staff. The creative menu features a variety of delicious options including bamboo steamed dishes, basil seafood, crispy honey chicken, and flavorful fried rice and noodles. A full sushi bar is available and features both classic and specialty rolls like the mouthwatering Grand Canyon roll filled with salmon, jalapenos, and cilantro and topped with spicy tuna. John Holly's Asian Bistro will cater to your specific needs and can modify any dish exactly to your liking. Choose from a wide selection of wines from all over the world to elevate your dining experience. Relax with a glass of Pinot Grigio from Italy, or sip on Sauvignon blanc from the shores of New Zealand. Stop in and savor innovative meals today!

name: FLOR DE MAYO
description: As one of the few remaining Chino-Latino restaurants in NYC, Flor de Mayo provides selections crafted by their chef's skillful touch, seasoned with unique herbs and spices from both cultures. Accompany flavorful dishes with fascinating signature cocktails from their fully stocked bar and enjoy sophisticated service and a cozy atmosphere!

name: Melbourne Seafood Station
description: Get a taste of just-from-the-water fish and seafood at Melbourne Seafood Station, a local favorite with several convenient, casual, and friendly locations. Famous for their signature Low Country boils, you can get the seafood of your choice customized just how you like it. Pick from lobster, snow crab, shrimp, crawfish, and more, then pick from mild or spicy heat, and be sure to add their amazing garlic sauce. The kitchen crew cooks it up fresh and hot, and it comes with corn, potatoes, sausage, and garlic toast. What a feast! But there's more on the menu at this low-key high-flavor seafood outpost, like their tasty build-a-bowl option. Pick a base of garlic rice, noodles, grits or broccoli, then have fun layering in your favorite fresh catch and flavorings. There are family feasts to ask about if you're with the kids, and you can dine-in or take something delicious to-go. Craving seafood that's fresh, flavorful, and fabulous? Head to Melbourne Seafood Station today!

name: Red Crab Juicy Seafood
description: Red Crab Juicy Seafood in Joliet offers an enticing dining experience with its flavorful seafood dishes served in a vibrant atmosphere. Known for their signature Cajun-style boils, patrons can enjoy a variety of crab, shrimp, and lobster cooked to perfection with a choice of delicious sauces. The restaurant's lively ambiance and generous portions make it a popular spot for seafood enthusiasts.

name: Nicholas Anthony's Family Kitchen
description: Looking to discover your new favorite spot for the whole family? Nicholas Anthony's Family Kitchen is a family-owned BYOB establishment that offers lunch & dinner with great food & a wonderful ambiance! They are sharing a long-time tradition of sharing meals together, as a family. Sit down, relax, and enjoy a great dining experience!

name: Barbonzai Lebanese Eatery
description: Barbonzai Lebanese Eatery is a family-owned business which was created to deliver fresh and fantastic food with a friendly face. Whether someone is dining at a Michelin star restaurant or just grabbing some solo lunch during a work break, everyone deserves a special dining experience. What are you waiting for? Come down today!

name: Capitaine Bar & Grill
description: Capitaine Bar & Grill offers patrons a culinary voyage where vibrant flavors harmonize with genuine hospitality. The menu reflects a testament to culinary ingenuity, presenting a fusion of coastal-inspired cuisine infused with contemporary flair.

name: La Madeleine French Country Cafe
description: La Madeleine invites guests to savor the essence of France with its charming ambiance and delectable cuisine. From cozy moments indoors to lively conversations on the patio, it's a delightful escape to French-inspired hospitality in the heart of your own neighborhood.

name: Patio Tapas and Beer
description: Patio Tapas & Beer channels Old World elegance and combines it with an exceptional menu of tapas, wines, beers and more. Chef-owned and operated, this family run restaurant and bar features the best of Spanish influenced tapas. Designed to be eaten alongside good conversation and wine, each small plate is meticulously crafted from the finest and freshest ingredients. Order several plates to make a customized meal, or just select one or two as a light snack with your wine. Piquillo relleno, patatas bravas, pulpo salad, and pork belly montadito are just a few of the outstanding choices. Also on the menu is a charcuterie platter that is loaded with imported meats, cheeses, olives and more. Dine inside in the charming dining room, or step out to the expansive patio which offers diners a la carte dining in a garden-like setting. Keep up with all the action by following Patio Tapas & Beer on Instagram or stop by today!

name: Montegrillo Pizza & Restaurant
description: Montegrillo Pizza & Restaurant offers a cozy and inviting atmosphere where guests can enjoy delicious, authentic pizza and a variety of classic Italian dishes. Known for its exceptional quality and friendly service, it's the perfect spot for a delightful dining experience.

name: Trattoria Bianca
description: Trattoria Bianca is a casual and informal eatery dishing up hand-crafted and affordable Italian favorites. There's plenty on the menu to tempt you here, including their made-from-scratch pizzas that are topped just how you like them. Explore a selection of fresh seafood creations, pastas, chicken Parmigiana, and so much more at this popular spot!

name: Ohayo Sushi - Lewisville
description: Ohayo Sushi offers a delightful dining experience with a menu featuring fresh, high-quality sushi and a variety of traditional Japanese dishes. Known for its inviting atmosphere and excellent service, it?s a popular spot for both sushi enthusiasts and those new to Japanese cuisine. With a commitment to using the freshest ingredients, Ohayo Sushi ensures a memorable meal for every guest.

name: Bite
description: The healthiest and heartiest meal in town is waiting just for you at Bite! For a very affordable cost, you can indulge in everything from bagels, soups, salads and hummus to cold sandwiches, hot paninis, gourmet coffees and more. Bite hand-picks only the freshest and finest ingredients from New York City to ensure the utmost flavor in each meal. Many on the greens are organic and the meats are always top quality. Perfect for a quick bite on the run or any other dining occasion imaginable, Bite is simply too good to pass up. Stop by today with friends and family and have a "bite" for yourself!

name: Tely's Chinese Restaurant
description: At Tely's Chinese Restaurant, everything is freshly-prepared when you order, which guarantees that you'll want to visit cozy spot again...and again! The menu features plenty of popular Chinese dishes, like salt and pepper pork, beef with broccoli, mandarin chicken, and quite a few varieties of lo mein and fried rice. You'll also find some unique entrees like fried pumpkin slices, chicken casserole, curried tofu, mango shrimp, and nested seafood (lobster, scallops, shrimp, squid, mussels, veggies). Pair your entree of choice with a glass of wine or a bottle of beer from the bar, and stop by on weekday afternoons to enjoy smaller-portioned lunch specials. A simple and modern dining room provides the ideal setting for enjoying a relaxing meal with friends or family, or you can place an order online for take-out or delivery to dine at home. Fresh and flavorful, just one meal at Tely's Chinese Restaurant will turn you into a regular customer for life.

name: Kikoo Sushi
description: With exceptional Japanese cuisine, Kikoo Sushi is more than just another Asian restaurant. This is a contemporary spot with a mission to bring the best quality sushi to the masses, and with a vibrant and upscale but still casual decor, you can stop by any afternoon or evening for a sumptuous feast. Known for outstanding sushi, each hand-crafted morsel is made with the very best quality just-from-the-water fish and seafood. Sea urchin, snapper, tamago, and scallops are just a few of the proteins used in each piece of sushi, sashimi, and roll. Pick and choose from the selection, or try one of the combination meals and enjoy the chef's pick. Sushi is the main feature here, but there's more on the menu. Salads, appetizers, and even poke bowls are made fresh and to-order, each and every time. The service is also on point, and with a full bar, you can sip on sake, a beer, or a glass of wine with your meal. Exceptional from start to finish, Kikoo has the sushi you're craving!

name: The Time Brewpub
description: Looking for the perfect place to kickback and enjoy some drinks? Come check out The Time Brewpub for that perfect hangout spot. They are a brewpub with on-site brewing along with all the spirits and wines you could dream of. They also offer plenty of TVs to watch the sports games you've been meaning to catch.

name: Max Gill And Grill
description: Max Gill & Grill is Washington Park's authentic "surf and turf" eatery. It's a neighborhood bar and grill with an upscale ambiance. Whether sitting in the inviting brick front room enjoying the flames from the fireplace or retiring to the tropically-styled open-air patio, guests can liven their palates with a full slate of seafood dishes, a fresh raw bar menu, and a selection of grilled and barbecued rotisserie entrees. From a Fat Max Burger or a half-dozen Dressed Oysters, to the Slow Smoked Rib Platter or Live Maine Lobster, the offerings cater to almost every appetite and any craving. Max Gill & Grill serves both lunch and dinner, along with a Saturday and Sunday brunch. It also features a lively bar scene with happy hours and DJs, which compliment the extensive drink list populated by wines, martinis, draft beers, bottled imports, and other specialty drinks.

name: Casa Los Abuelos
description: Casa Los Abuelos has been dishing up hand-crafted and oh-so good Mexican fare for more than 17 years. This popular eatery has plenty on the menu, including hearty burritos, pollo en mole, carne asada, fresh seafood dishes, tacos, and so much more. Always made from the finest ingredients, pair your meal with a fruity margarita or cold beer.

name: Socarrat Nolita
description:
The tantalizing aroma of saffron-infused rice and savory seafood wafts from the open kitchen, where skilled chefs expertly craft traditional paellas in wide, shallow pans known as "socarrats." Each dish is a masterpiece of flavor, featuring perfectly cooked rice with a delightful caramelized crust, complemented by an array of fresh ingredients sourced locally and from Spain.

As diners savor their meals, they are enveloped in the lively buzz of conversation and the clinking of glasses, creating an atmosphere that is both convivial and intimate. Whether gathering with friends for a casual evening or celebrating a special occasion, Socarrat Paella Bar offers an unforgettable culinary experience that transports guests to the vibrant streets of Spain with every delicious bite.

name: Hardee's - Lake Alfred
description: Hungry and craving a tasty, breakfast or burger place near you? From fluffy Made From Scratch Biscuits to crispy bacon on their classic breakfast platter, to charbroiled burgers like the Third Pound Original Angus Burger that you can't get anywhere else...Hardee's serves food just the way you like it.

name: Jack Diamond's
description: Jack Diamond's is a quaint and cozy bar located on 27th between 3rd and Lexington in Manhattan. This 'Kips Bay' neighborhood spot features a comprehensive selection of quality craft beers, elegant cocktails, and elevated fare. Enjoyed as a date spot, happy hour location, weekend hang out, or brunch spot, they offer a welcoming, first-class experience.

name: Mama Russo's Pizzeria
description: There's room for you and the whole family at Mama Russo's Pizzeria. This is a casual and inviting spot where you'll feel right at home. Check out the menu which is loaded with tasty pizzas, garden-fresh salads, saucy wings, hot and hearty sandwiches, and so much more. The prices are right, too, at this laid-back and popular eatery.

name: Lizzy's Soul Food
description: Lizzy's Soul Food welcomes you to have a soulful experience. Their restaurant was founded upon the love of a son for his mother, with core values of family and community. They pour their hearts and souls into every dish, using only the freshest ingredients to construct their dishes made from family recipes.

name: Magazine Pizza
description: Established in 2011 and located across from the World War II History Museum, Magazine Pizza offers amazing salads, wraps, sandwiches, calzones, desserts, and, of course, pizza! Enjoy great food made fresh whether you're dining in, taking out, or having it delivered right to your door.

name: El Tanque Trattoria
description: El Tanque Trattoria is a vibrant and newly established pizzeria restaurant located in the lively neighborhood of Inwood, New York City. In addition to their famous pizzas, their curated menu offers antipasti as well as cocktails and an impressive wine list. Stop by today for an all-around wonderful meal!

name: Taim Mediterranean Kitchen
description: Enjoy free parking when you visit Taim! The parking garage (directly across from the restaurant on the corner of Knox & Yale) has free parking for the first hour. They have curbside pickup available on our app. Just pull right up Knox Road in front of Taim. Give them a call so they know you're there and they'll bring your order right to your car!

name: Butter Dose
description: Butter Dose is a dream for anyone with a sweet tooth. It has been said that you can smell their delicious pastries from down the block. They serve all kinds of goodies such as their bite-sized cream puffs, classic chocolate chip cookies and exotic Peach Oolong tea. This is simply a classic New York bakery with a lot of personality.

name: Campione's Taste Of Chicago
description: Campione's Taste of Chicago takes pride in making their own sauce from the family recipe, rolling their own meatballs by hand, and making their soups, chili, chicken salad and more in the restaurant daily. Guests can find the owners, their parents, children and grandchildren serving up those aromatic, tasty Chicago Italian Beef sammiches and 5th generation pasta recipes. They use only the good stuff for an authentic Chicago taste to make sure guests feel like they're part of the family.

name: Bahn Appetit
description: Looking for a place to enjoy some delicious and satisfying Vietnamese cuisine? Bahn Appetit is an unassuming eatery fixing up classic Vietnamese sandwiches, finger foods, and make-your-own rice bowls. Everything they serve is fresh and homemade, and you will surely enjoy their flavorful meals and top-notch service.

name: Moe's Southwest Grill
description: Moe's Southwest Grill offers a variety of Tex-Mex dishes including burritos, quesadillas, tacos, and nachos, all made with over 20 fresh ingredients. Known for its welcoming atmosphere, Moe's provides free chips and salsa with every meal and caters to various dietary preferences including vegetarian options. The restaurant features convenient services like takeout, delivery, and catering.

name: Bibi's Haitian Cuisine
description: Bibi's Hattian Cuisine invites diners on a culinary journey through the vibrant flavors of Hattian culture, offering an array of traditional dishes crafted with authentic recipes and fresh, locally sourced ingredients. From savory stews to aromatic spices, each bite at Bibi's encapsulates the rich heritage and warmth of Hattian hospitality.

name: Tuscany Italian Restaurant II
description: Tuscany Italian Restaurant stands as a charming dining destination that transports its guests to the heart of Italy through its authentic cuisine. Renowned for its traditional Italian dishes, the restaurant prides itself on using time-honored recipes and the freshest local ingredients to craft its beloved menu.

name: Afro Deli & Grill
description: Afro Deli & Grill offers fast and friendly service and affordable eats. With everything from hot coffees and teas to tasty picks for lunch, dinner, and dessert, everything is made fresh from the finest halal ingredients. It's also a great spot for a break in a busy day, so meet some friends here today!

name: Yama Ramen and Sushi
description: Yama Ramen is serving up fresh, delectable sushi and authentic Japanese cuisine that's sure to satisfy your cravings. The modern restaurant is committed to using selective, high-quality ingredients and is focused on bringing you a unique experience, whether you're stopping in on your lunch break or enjoying a celebratory dinner with friends.

name: Swagat
description: An authentic Indian restaurant conveniently located in Manhattan, Swagat offers a wide selection of fabulous Indian fare from across all regions. Begin your meal with amazing appetizers like dal (lentil) soup, crispy vegetable pakora, or tasty samosas. Popular entrees include chicken tikka, lamb vindaloo, and chicken biryani. Vegetarians will love South Indian dishes like palak paneer (spinach and paneer cheese), aloo gobhi (potatoes and cauliflower with spices), and tandoori paneer. Pair your food with delicious tandoori breads like nan, paratha, and roti, and a glass of masala tea or mango lassi. Be sure to save room for tempting desserts like traditional kheer (rice pudding) and gulab jamun. For classic Indian fare made with expert skill and fine ingredients, look no further than Swagat.

name: Tikka Bowls And Tacos Southside
description: Tikka Bowls and Tacos provides a special blend of two mouthwatering culinary worlds. This fusion restaurant provides an experience unlike any other, with recipes inspired by the authentic flavors of both Indian and Mexican cuisine. Whether you are in the mood for a tasty taco or tikki masala, they've got you covered!

name: Country House - Golden Gate
description: Country House is a charming eatery known for its hearty, homestyle cooking and welcoming atmosphere. The menu features classic American comfort food, including breakfast favorites, savory burgers, and delicious homemade pies. With its cozy setting and friendly service, Country House has become a beloved spot for locals and visitors looking for a comforting meal.

name: Tequilas Time Restaurant
description: In Tequila's Time Restaurant, the menu celebrates traditional Mexican flavors, highlighting fresh, locally sourced ingredients. From sizzling fajitas to flavorful tacos and hearty enchiladas, each dish is meticulously prepared by the skilled kitchen team. Dominating the dining area is a well-stocked bar

name: Jersey Mike's Subs
description: Jersey Mike's Subs has become a fan-favorite chain for subs since their opening in 1956. They offer a sub above - one that's measured in more than inches or seconds 'til served. They carefully consider every aspect of what they do - every slice, every sandwich, every store - and provide customers with sustenance and substance too.
