name: Cheese & Bread
description: Cheese & Bread is a charming Georgian bakery celebrated for its authentic and flavorful baked goods. Specializing in traditional Georgian pastries and breads, the bakery offers a delightful array of treats that highlight the rich culinary heritage of Georgia. Each item at Cheese & Bread is crafted using time-honored recipes and the finest ingredients, ensuring an authentic taste experience.

name: Chateau de Chantilly Cafe
description: Chateau de Chantilly Cafe is a polished and welcoming place to enjoy refreshing beverages, delicious meals, and snacks. Open from morning until night, this is the perfect place to meet friends, share time with someone special, or get a bit of work done while sipping and nibbling on delicious fare. Dine-in or take something to-go today!

name: Cayo Esquivel
description: Located in the restaurant district, Cayo Esquivel is nothing short of a great place for family, friends, and co-workers to enjoy a wonderful meal. The atmosphere is very casual with large fish and sea-life painted across the walls of the restaurant, as well as a TV playing your favorite sporting events. Their menu is primarily seafood, with a Latin background providing the seasoning for each delicious dish. They have great seafood sandwiches as well as a portion of the menu where you can combine any of their fillets with your choice of sauce. Cayo Esquivel also has many delicious dessert options for those who still have room left.  Carryout and delivery are both an option for those looking to enjoy their great food in the comfort of their own home.  Next time you're looking for great seafood at an affordable price as well as a unique experience, try Cayo Esquivel and you will not be disappointed.

name: LE BURGER
description: An intimate jewel nestled in a warm, brick & wood laden space in the East Village, Le Burger is an ode to the rich, decadent flavors of France in burger form. Their artisanal, ingredient-forward menu reps burgers full of luxe accoutrements, not to mention refreshing sips to make your feat that much more magnifique.

name: Caprese
description: If you are looking for some of the tastiest New York style pizzas and pastas, head to Caprese. They've been making pizzas and other casual Italian eats for more than 40 years, and every dish and every pizza is hand-crafted from the best ingredients. With a focus on customer service, go for the lunch buffet weekdays, or go anytime for a delish meal.

name: Kokee Tea - Ellicott City
description: Kokee Tea serves flavorful and delicious teas made from all-natural cane sugar and other fresh ingredients. They offer an impressive selection of exciting flavors and are committed to serving you the best products possible. Stop by this cheerful joint for a delicious and healthy treat that will leave you feeling great.

name: Sushi X
description: Sushi X is a unique take on a sushi restaurant in downtown Chicago. Offering a full menu of traditional, vegetable, neo, mega and inside out rolls, Sushi X also has hot dishes of chicken, shrimp and tuna, cold entrees like oyster shooters and creamy ginger salads and a rare mochi ice cream available for dessert. All rolls are made to order, so the chef can accommodate almost any diner's needs. Most exceptional about Sushi X is their delivery service, which patrons rave about. Sushi X provides plenty of attention to detail from the packaging of the food to the specially designed carry out plastic bag, box stickers, chopsticks, menu and business card. Each roll is carefully tucked-in to its delivery box, ensuring they arrive in the same condition they are prepared. Inside, the dimly lit space resembles a nightclub, with candlelit tables and a black ceiling. Even the music tends to recall the trendy club scene, although Sushi X retains a cozy ambiance all times of the day. Sushi X is also unique in that there is not a sushi bar and everything is made in the kitchen. For a distinctive sushi experience at a great locale, Sushi X is a must-visit. And, you can keep up with all the tastiest news by following Sushi X on Instagram.

name: Miraj Healthy Grill
description: Miraj Healthy Grill Restaurant offers a burgundy-tablecloth, fine-dining experience serviced by a knowledgeable, expert and friendly staff eager to escort you through Persian customs. The environment mixes traditions of a distant land (traditional music) with flavors of basmati rice, tomatoes, and grilled kebobs, making it a modern art!

name: Bar Verde
description: Bar Verde is a small, cozy bar located in the heart of the city. It has a friendly and welcoming atmosphere, and the staff are always happy to help you find the perfect drink. The bar offers a wide selection of cocktails, beers, and wines, as well as a variety of snacks and appetizers.

name: Boca Oyster Bar
description: Located at Steelpointe Harbor, Boca Oyster Bar offers amazing views, hand-crafted drinks, and stunning New England fare. With gorgeous ocean ambiance from the patio to the bar, this is an excellent spot for any occasion that calls for upscale dining. Enjoy raw bar items like littleneck clams on the half-shell with cocktail sauce, Atlantic and Pacific oysters, and chilled Maine lobster tails. Popular appetizers include: sauteed mussels with leeks, plum tomatoes, brandy cream sauce, and toast points; the Boca Tartare with diced avocado, sushi-grade ahi tuna, cucumber, tomatoes, soy ginger sauce, and wonton chip; and panko-encrusted lobster mac and cheese lollipops. For entrees try the tender filet mignon, half roasted organic chicken with garlic whipped potatoes and Brussels sprouts, or French-cut Berkshire pork chop with caramelized onions, Calabrian chilies, fried potatoes, and garlic white wine sauce. Complement your meal with a glass of wine or a refreshing cocktail like the strawberry jalapeno margarita. Come experience prime waterfront dining at Boca Oyster Bar.

name: BUCHANAN DELI
description: Buchanan Deli offers a delightful fusion of culinary traditions, where bold flavors meet comforting classics. From gourmet sandwiches to artisanal salads, each dish is crafted with locally-sourced ingredients, inviting guests to savor a taste of creativity in every bite.

name: Russo's New York Pizzeria- Meyerland
description: New York Pizzeria is a casual dining spot that offers Italian fare -- appetizers, pasta, meat dishes, salads, desserts and breads -- as well as authentic New York City pizza. Chef and owner Anthony Russo grew up in the kitchen of his family's New York restaurant and says he's giving the same attention to his pizzas now as his family did -- with dough made from scratch and sauce that comes from an age-old family recipe.  The restaurant, open for 30 years, is inspired by the traditional Italian values of family, friends and, of course, food.  Their menu delivers delicious Italian meals prepared with their passion for food, fresh ingredients and the goal of providing their guests with a distinctive dining experience.  Both in décor and taste, New York Pizzeria blends the simplicity of a pizzeria with the freshness of a fine Italian restaurant.  Today there are over 20 New York Pizzeria locations including the newest in Meyerland.  They have been named the "2007 City's Best Pizzeria" by AOL CityGuide and also received the "Best Pizza" award in 2004 and 2006 from the same group.  Zagat says New York Pizzeria is "outstanding" and Margaret Biggs of Houston Press called it "a slice of heaven...bak(ing) up a pie that's the stuff of dreams."

name: Lalibela Restaurant
description: Lalibela Restaurant is a small, humble Ethiopian eatery whipping up stews served on injera, along with an exciting variety of other traditional dishes. This lovable spot is known for their delicious and authentic dishes that are packed with excellent flavor, served in a casual, cheerful, and family-friendly environment.

name: Hwy 55 Burgers,Shakes & Fries
description: For a fresh, all-American dining experience, choose Hwy 55. From never frozen burgers to delicious sandwiches and salads, the casual joint offers a variety of classic menu items cooked in an open kitchen so you can watch as your mouthwatering meal is being prepared. Be sure to save room for dessert and indulge in tasty milkshakes and frozen custards.

name: Denny's 8788
description: As a name synonymous with family dining since 1953, you can rely on Denny's to deliver good food, and plenty of it, at prices that spell "value" with a capital V. But if you haven't visited Denny's lately, you may not be aware of all the new things being cooked up to stay in step with America's changing tastes. For example, one of the restaurant's biggest draws has always been its around-the-clock breakfasts. Well now, in addition to the platters of pancakes, waffles, eggs, omelettes and meats, diners have heart-healthy options made with egg whites and chicken sausage patties. In fact, Denny's has a whole roster of Fit-Fare™ selections for health-conscious patrons, and each item is yummier than the next. There's a specially-priced menu for the 55-and-older crowd too, in addition to Denny's money-saving kids menu. Happily, however, Denny's remains committed to satisfying hearty appetites with great-tasting sandwiches, salads, entrees and desserts that fit the bill, and do it with change to spare.

name: Borough
description: Since opening on January 2nd, 2013, Borough has been become a staple in the North Loop neighborhood. In September of 2019, Borough underwent a seven-day transformation of both the space and menu. In any business, it's important to stay ahead of the curve and constantly reinvent yourself. Things are always changing, and we realize the importance of being adaptable,? says Brent Frederick, owner of Jester Concepts. ?We sat an opportunity to delight guests and make a few updates we've had on our Wishlist. We've listened to our guest over the year and can't wait to share these updates with them. Executive chef, Mike DeCamp along with the chef de cuisine have developed a fresh take on the menu. Still showcasing the best of Minnesota's seasons with familiar and classic flavors, the menu will now include smaller plates designed to encourage guests to experience more of the menu.

name: The Spot Jamaican Restaurant
description: A Caribbean lounge and event space, The Spot Jamaican Restaurant offers incredible food and fun nightlife. Come enjoy their popular and vibrant Jamaican cuisine like curry chicken, jerk pork, and fried rice with tasty sides including fried plantains, corn bread, rice and peas, and mac and cheese.

name: BRIO Italian Grille - Waterside
description: Brio Italian Grille is a Tuscan-inspired restaurant destination serving authentic, northern Italian cuisine and luxury wines and cocktails. With delicious specialties including premium steaks, seafoods, and wood-fired flatbreads, this upscale eatery brings the pleasures of small town Tuscany to your neighborhood. Enjoy a dining experience like no other at Brio!

name: Burrito District
description: Burrito District is a fast casual Cali-Mex and drive-thru restaurant. They are happy to bring the ultimate SoCal experience with their best-selling carne asada burritos, carne asada fries, and Baja fish tacos, just to name a few. Their exciting flavors, speedy service, and welcoming environment set them apart in so many great ways.

name: Tropical Smoothie Cafe
description: Tropical Smoothie Cafe's mission is to inspire a healthier lifestyle by serving amazing food and smoothies with a bit of tropical fun. For more than 20 years, this tasty spot started as a destination for flavor and they are  proud of that heritage which they continue today. Tropical Smoothie Cafe revolutionized the concept of healthy fast food. The menu boasts bold, flavorful smoothies with a healthy appeal, and all made-to-order from the freshest ingredients, because superior, simple ingredients including real fruits and veggies just taste better. Toasted wraps, sandwiches, flatbreads, and bowls are all made fresh with quality meats and cheeses, fresh produce, and flavorful sauces. There are also plenty of vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options available. Stop by and grab one of the power-packed smoothies like detox island or green or chia blueberry max, and relax while you refresh. Combine that with a fun, relaxing atmosphere--and unparalleled hospitality--and you can see why people return again and again. They cater, too. So, if your office just needs a little pick me up or afternoon boost, just call ahead and they'll show up with delicious eats. Good, healthy food makes the whole office feel sunny! Tropical Smoothie Cafe: Eat Better. Feel Better.

name: Global Quesadilla Company
description: In the mood for some convenient and delicious Mexican cuisine? Come on down to Global Quesadilla Company for an option that is sure to hit the spot! Here you can enjoy a stacked, juicy quesadilla stuffed with the fillings of your choice. They also offer salads, nachos, and other sides as well as a kids menu!

name: Frank's Trattoria
description: Enjoy the finest in casual Italian cuisine at Frank's Trattoria. This family friendly and cozy NYC hot-spot has what many claim to be the best pizza in the city! A large boast, but it only takes one bite of their freshly prepared pizza loaded with a variety of the freshest and highest quality ingredients to discover for yourself how special it is. It's so special, in fact, that seeing massive pizza orders leaving the restaurant for delivery to schools, offices and special events is nothing new! Try a specialty pie or top it your way, or, if you're not in the mood for pizza, then you're in luck because there's a great menu at this eatery which is just filled with a variety of tantalizing dishes. From the Clams Casino appetizer to hearty meals like chicken Scarpariello, Mussels Marinara, Cannelloni Florentine, the broiled Veal Chop and more, there's always something delicious to try. As if that's not enough, there are also daily specials that are too good to pass up. Whether it's the Veal Osso Bucco with Gnocchi or the Swordfish Almandino, the home-cooked meals at this restaurant are too good to pass up. Open daily for lunch and dinner, the next time you're craving fresh and scrumptious Italian dishes, head to Frank's Trattoria!

name: CP's Pub South
description: Looking for the perfect place to spend your evening? Come check out CP's Pub South for an option that you are going to love. This classic pub has a welcoming and inviting atmosphere, known for their friendly staff and chill ambiance. You can count on them for a guaranteed great experience every single time.

name: Smoothie King
description: Smoothie King is a health focused smoothie and beverage shop. This tasty spot?s mission is to inspire their customers to live a healthy lifestyle, and provide delicious smoothies to help them do just that. They are committed to using clean and fresh ingredients in each of their smoothie blends, creating delicious and nutritious products for every customer. Be healthy and happy, at Smoothie King!

name: Anyway's Pub - Bloomingdale
description: Anyway's Pub was opened in 1995 as a remake of the authentic Chicago-style establishments frequented by the owner when he traveled throughout the north side neighborhoods of the city as a youngster. Recently remodeled to include a beautiful stone fireplace, hardwood floors, comfortable seating and strategically placed high definition televisions, Anyway's is the perfect setting in which to enjoy a fantastic meal and some refreshing drinks. The extensive menu features authentic Chicago eats as well as plenty of bar fare that all Americans will find enjoyable. From homemade potato chips, wings and nachos to south-of-the-border entrees, burgers, sandwiches and salads, everything is absolutely delicious. The Chicago-style pies, Italian pasta dishes and specialty sandwiches (meatloaf sandwich, flat iron steak sandwich, BBQ pork sandwich) lend touches of flair to the menu. Don't forget to check out the draft and bottled beer selection; customers can also order from the full bar or pick a choice from the selective wine list. No matter when you visit or who you stop by with, Anyway's Pub will send you and yours home with a full stomach and a smile on your faces.

name: Denny's
description: As a name synonymous with family dining, you can rely on Denny's to deliver good food, and plenty of it, at prices that spell "value" with a capital V. But if you haven't visited Denny's lately, you may not be aware of all the new things being cooked up to stay in step with America's changing tastes. For example, one of the restaurant's biggest draws has always been its around-the-clock breakfasts. Well now, in addition to the platters of pancakes, waffles, eggs, omelettes and meats, diners have heart-healthy options made with Egg Beaters®. In fact, Denny's has a whole roster of Fit-Fare™ selections for health-conscious patrons, and each item is yummier than the next. There's a specially-priced menu for the 55-and-older crowd too, in addition to Denny's money-saving kids menu. Happily, however, Denny's remains committed to satisfying hearty appetites with great-tasting sandwiches, salads, entrees and desserts that fit the bill, and do it with change to spare.

name: Border Brewing Company
description: An original Kansas City brewery and taproom established in 2015, Border Brewing Company is known for their wide variety of beer styles with approachable but complex flavors perfect for amateurs and aficionados alike. Stop in on Sunday afternoons for free live music from local and touring artists.

name: Bearded Monkey Sports Bar & Grill - Rockwall
description: Offering great food, great service, great drinks, and plenty of TVs, Bearded Monkey Sports Bar and Grill is a top spot to watch the game and have a bite to eat. Burgers, wings, tacos, appetizers, sandwiches, and pizza are all on the menu, as well as brunch selections such as the hangover burger and breakfast tacos.

name: Biryani and Bakers
description: Biryani and Bakers is an Indian restaurant renowned for its aromatic biryanis and delightful baked goods. The menu features a variety of traditional biryani recipes, made with fragrant spices and high-quality ingredients, alongside an array of freshly baked pastries and breads. With its cozy atmosphere and commitment to authenticity, Biryani and Bakers offers a unique and satisfying culinary experience.

name: Kahwa Coffee Roasting
description: Since they first started roasting coffee back in 2005 in sunny St. Petersburg, Kahwa has combined passion and expertise to provide discerning establishments all over Florida first-rate coffee products. But, there's no better way to enjoy these delicious brews than at the source, and that's why a visit to Kahwa's own cafe can provide a perfect way to kick off your morning at a local coffee chain that roasts its own coffee. Here, you'll find plenty of great coffees and high-quality coffee drinks whether you're heading over in the morning hours, need a pick-me-up to get through the rest of the afternoon, or heading back home after a full day's labor. While you sip on a latte, tea, fresh juice, or one of the other masterfully created drinks, grab something to eat from a lineup that includes fresh baked pastries, muffins, sweet treats and more. You can also get coffee by the pound to take home and enjoy. Casual, fast, and full of flavor, Kahwa continues its mission to bring Florida locals and travelers the finest coffee around. It all adds up to make Kahwa Coffee Roasting a great destination, and it is why it is continually winning awards year after year!

name: Bubbakoo's Burritos
description: Relax after a long day and savor a fun and fresh meal at Bubbakoo's Burritos. The quick-service eatery has a unique skater-surf atmosphere and welcomes all to enjoy its tasty bites. Each dish is made to order using high-quality ingredients and customized exactly to your liking with delicious proteins like Buffalo crispy chicken and sweet chili shrimp.

name: Keel & Curley Winery
description: Nestled in Plant City, Florida, Keel Farms is home to Keel & Curley Winery and Keel Farms Agrarian Ales and Cider. They offer unforgettable experiences with tours, tastings, dining, and fun events. Visitors can explore the vineyards, enjoy a wine tasting session, and savor farm-fresh dining at the on-site restaurant. Guests can also join in for live music, seasonal festivals, and more.

name: The Mirage Restaurant  Cafe
description: With delicious Mediterranean-inspired fare for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, you can stop by any time for a great meal at The Mirage Restaurant & Cafe. This popular foodie-worthy spot is a spacious market and bakery that's staffed with people who are passionate about great food. There's something for everyone at this food lover's paradise, including a gourmet-style convenience market, a high-quality bakery, gourmet coffee station, juice bar, and a grab-n-go section with chef-prepared food. Your sweet tooth will love the selection of just-baked goodies, including both sweet and savory delights. Or, sit in the bright and cheery contemporary dining room to feast on hand-crafted fare like huevos rancheros or a smoked salmon eggs Benedict, crispy calamari, signature salads, burgers and sandwiches, pastas, and more. There's plenty of variety, and it's all made fresh and hot and always to-order. Steaks, chicken, seafood, and ribs are also on the menu, offering plenty of variety for every appetite. Open daily and staying open until late, there are tasty things happening at The Mirage--check it out yourself today! Please note: Catering services are available. Call ahead for details or fill out their online form for more information.

name: Burgundy Square Cafe
description: Burgundy Square Café in Venice, FL, is a beloved destination for its simple yet abundantly served food, offering a relaxed atmosphere with an all-American menu of comfort foods. Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, the café is known for its delicious lobster roll, which has been recognized as one of the best in the country. Additionally, the menu features a range of other items, including various types of omelettes, French toast, wraps, quiche, and a selection of seafood dishes like whole-belly Maine clams and fish and chips.

name: My Tequila House
description: When you have a need that can only be satisfied by the delicious flavors of authentic Mexican cuisine, you'll want to head straight to My Tequila House, a greatly praised and perennial award-winning restaurant. My Tequila House, with its fresh, lively, and colorful decor, always feels like a party, whether you're with family, friends, or coworkers.

name: Mario's Restaurant
description: The Migliucci family has been preparing fine Italian cuisine on Arthur Avenue since 1919! Joe Migliucci and his family invite yours to enjoy their menu, which is prepared with passion and care. With the perfect location on Arthur Avenue, the Little Italy of the Bronx, they serve up traditional dishes like lasagna, chicken milanese or the delicious clams oregenata. The fresh sauces, hot fresh breads, octopus salad, spiedini with anchovy sauce and other authentic recipes are among the dishes that have made customers return time and time again Craving pizza? Mario's can help there too! Some would say you'll enjoy the best pizza in the Bronx at Mario's! No wonder they won the James Beard Award in 2000. The Migliucci family and the staff - with over 90 years of experience - will serve you in a manner that best fits the occasion. Every customer is treated like a relative whether you have an intimate affair of two, 20 or 200! Parking is available via valet or the lot.

name: Nanno's Bakery and Ice Cream P
description: Nanno's Bakery and Ice Cream Place is a delightful culinary destination, adored for its homemade treats and welcoming ambiance. From freshly baked pastries and cakes to creamy scoops of ice cream, Nanno's offers a tempting array of sweets to satisfy any craving. West Long Branch is grateful to be home to this perfect spot to indulge in a sweet treat and enjoy a relaxing moment with loved ones.

name: Milan's Wood Fired Pizza
description: In the mood for a convenient and delicious meal? Come on down to Milan's Wood Fired Pizza today for an option that is sure to leave you satisfied! They are dedicated to providing the highest quality food and service to every single guest. They even offer a menu for the dogs, as well as coffee, beer, and wine for you to enjoy with your meal!

name: Hardee's - Plant City
description: Hungry and craving a tasty, breakfast or burger place near you? From fluffy Made From Scratch Biscuits to crispy bacon on their classic breakfast platter, to charbroiled burgers like the Third Pound Original Angus Burger that you can't get anywhere else...Hardee's serves food just the way you like it.

name: Chick-N-Smash
description: Chick N Smash offers a modern twist on classic fried chicken, delivering bold flavors and crispy perfection in every bite. With a menu featuring signature chicken sandwiches, burgers, and sides, it's a go-to spot for comfort food enthusiasts. Whether dining in, taking out, or grabbing a late night meal, Chick N Smash promises a delicious and satisfying experience.

name: Carmen's Cafe Nicole
description: Relax and enjoy stunning ocean views and waterfront dining at Carmen's Cafe Nicole. This sweet little gem by the water is open for breakfast and lunch services. Nosh on a decadent lobster roll while you sip on a bacon-jalapeno bloody Mary and watch the world go by. Kick-start your day by ordering a healthy breakfast like The Ivy, created with avocados, salsa, eggs, black beans, and a side of fresh fruit. The menu features American-style breakfast food like French toast, pancakes, and waffles while leaving room for yummy sandwiches, soups, salads, and burgers. Mexican-style entrees like rice bowls, burritos, and tostadas fill out this enticing lunch menu. A refreshing cranberry-walnut salad features mesclun greens, toasted walnuts, dried cranberries, mandarin oranges, feta cheese, and a tangy Zinfandel vinaigrette. If you're craving Thanksgiving dinner, order the cleverly named Pilgrim wrap -- it enfolds roasted turkey, stuffing, mayo, and a refreshing cranberry sauce in a yummy wrapper. And the hungriest customers dine on the Fisherman's Platter meal featuring fresh haddock, whole belly clams, shrimp, and scallops. Whatever you choose will not disappoint, so come stop by Carmen's Cafe Nicole, the cafe on the bay!

name: Applebee's Grill + Bar
description: Applebee's Grill + Bar is a popular American casual dining restaurant chain known for its diverse menu and vibrant atmosphere. Offering a wide range of dishes, from signature burgers and appetizers to hearty steaks and salads, Applebee's caters to everyone's tastes. With a welcoming ambiance, friendly service, and locations across the United States, it has become a go-to destination for those seeking a relaxed dining experience with familiar favorites.

name: Cape Cod Candy Company
description: Love sweets? Check out the dazzling selection of confections today at Cape Cod Candy Company. This much-loved spot features more than 2500 different kinds of candies, nuts, and more. Made in-house, made locally, or sourced from all over the world, you'll find childhood favorites here plus new and exciting treats and flavors to try.

name: Bite
description: The healthiest and heartiest meal in town is waiting just for you at Bite! For a very affordable cost, you can indulge in everything from bagels, soups, salads and hummus to cold sandwiches, hot paninis, gourmet coffees and more. Bite hand-picks only the freshest and finest ingredients from New York City to ensure the utmost flavor in each meal. Many on the greens are organic and the meats are always top quality. Perfect for a quick bite on the run or any other dining occasion imaginable, Bite is simply too good to pass up. Stop by today with friends and family and have a "bite" for yourself!

name: Life's Good Bar & Grill
description: Life's Good Bar & Grill in Dallas, TX, is a welcoming spot in the Lower Greenville area, known for its friendly vibe and a wide array of pub fare and craft beers. The bar features two patios, live music, and various games like pool and giant Jenga, making it a lively destination for both locals and visitors. It's also pet-friendly, so patrons can enjoy a meal or a drink in the company of their furry friends​.

name: Cafe Ole in the Valley
description: Cafe Ole in the Valley is a charming café known for its warm, inviting atmosphere and delightful culinary offerings. Nestled in the heart of the valley, this café has become a beloved spot for both locals and visitors seeking a cozy place to enjoy a meal or a cup of coffee. Cafe Ole prides itself on using fresh, high-quality ingredients to create a menu that features a variety of delectable dishes, ranging from hearty breakfasts to savory lunches and indulgent desserts. The café's friendly staff and comfortable setting make it an ideal destination for a relaxing dining experience, whether you're catching up with friends or enjoying a quiet moment to yourself.

name: Harlemite
description: Harlemite specializes in unique, homemade Peruvian cuisine! Chef Gabriel has created an exciting menu of Peruvian dishes including incredible seafood options. Their extensive menu has a great selection that will have you coming back to try more! Stop by today and taste their fried fish, shrimp mofongo, or BBQ chicken lollipops.

name: Kismat Indian Restaurant
description: Since 1984, Kismat Indian Restaurant has been known for outstanding dining. Fresh, exotic and aromatic dishes representing the best of India and Bangladesh are cooked from the highest quality ingredient while adhering to traditional cooking practices. The result? Meals that are memorable as well as delicious. This NYC standard offers diners a spacious dining room that is warm, homey and comfortable, service that is top-notch, and a diverse menu which makes exploring each dish fun. Standouts include the lamb rogan josh, saag matar paeer, and any of the tandoori specialties. Plus, with vegan and gluten-free choices, this place is ideal for just about everyone. There's plenty more on the menu to discover, making this a bona fide Hudson Heights favorite which is still family owned and operated. A great décor, full-service bar, and food too good to pass up -- the next time you're in the mood for Indian cuisine, make Kismat your first choice! (Also be sure to visit their sister restaurant Clove Indian Restaurant at 140th and Amsterdam.)

name: Casa Grande
description: Check out the authentic and hand-crafted Mexican eats at the family owned and operated Casa Grande restaurant. This is a terrific spot to enjoy reasonably priced meals that are packed with flavor. Lunch specials, vegetarian picks, combos, Chef's specialties, and a kids menu ensure plenty of variety for everyone at this popular eatery.

name: Philly Jay's Steaks
description: Philly Jay's Steaks is a family-owned and operated food truck in Alhambra, CA, specializing in serving up hearty meals for people throughout the community. They serve authentic Philly cheesesteaks with a gourmet twist. For an authentic taste, they use Amoroso rolls and a special butcher blend of rib eye and sirloin from Philadelphia!

name: Birmingham Pub
description: Birmingham Pub brings a sophisticated twist to the classic gastropub experience. Their inviting ambiance is casual, yet sexy and quite comfortable with an eclectic mix of luxe touches and urban chic details. They are passionate about life's simple pleasures - an after-work cocktail, a perfectly grilled New York strip, and fine wine.

name: Jimmy John's
description: Jimmy John's is a popular American sandwich chain known for its fresh, high-quality ingredients and speedy delivery service. The menu features a variety of sandwiches made with freshly baked bread, hand-sliced meats, and crisp vegetables, providing a quick and satisfying meal option.

name: Gulliver's
description: For more than 45 years, Gulliver's has been famous for tender, juicy and perfectly cooked prime rib of beef. This unique eatery is designed to evoke the vibe of 18th century England, and with a warm and inviting interior, friendly service and delicious food, it is a perfect choice for everything from family dining to celebrating life's special moments. Known for large portions and reasonable prices, you can escape to Gulliver's for a dining experience to remember. Crispy pork belly, ahi tuna tartare, daily soups, just-from-the-water seafood, and of course, the pride of the house, prime rib of beef, is on the menu. Available in a several different cuts, each is served with Yorkshire pudding and other sides. There's more on the menu, including steaks, rack of lamb, baby back ribs and Gulliver's roasted chicken. After dinner, retire to Gulliver's Pub for a drink. Elbow-up to the solid oak copper-top bar for an ale on tap, or sit out on the patio and sip on your favorite drink. Happy Hour is from 4-7 p.m. weekdays at the bar only, and there's a separate menu of bar bites (weekdays from 3-5 p.m.) in case you want to make a night of hanging out at this convivial pub. Legendary food, fabulous service and an iconic decor makes Gulliver's a one-of-a-kind dining destination. Please note: The Travelers Room is available for any special occasion. From business lunches and rehearsal dinners to just getting together with some friends, the unique 18th century setting creates a magical dining experience like no other. The Travelers Room can accommodate small or large parties up to 90 guests. Gulliver's also offers a smaller private room that can accommodate up to 40 guests. So, whether it's a birthday party, business meeting, corporate or private event, or a holiday party, Gulliver's is the perfect place for your event.

name: Lombardi's
description: Lombardi's Bar & Restaurant has been dishing up tasty eats, pouring cold drinks, and treating guests to great entertainment since opening in 2002. This is a lively and casual neighborhood spot. Famous for their thin-crust pizzas and other Italian dishes, Happy Hour is also a great time to visit. The full bar is fully loaded--check it out today!

name: Persis Biryani Indian Grill
description: Come savor the flavors of authentic Indian cooking at Persis Biryani Indian Grill. Begin with delicious appetizers like onion pakoda, shrimp fry, and crispy Persis Wings. Popular entrees include chicken tikka grilled in a tandoor clay oven, vindaloo, and creamy butter chicken. Vibrant, rich, and complex Indian cuisine and professional service are waiting for you at Persis Biryani Indian Grill.

name: Jersey Mike's Subs
description: Jersey Mike's offers a savory experience with its signature subs, freshly sliced meats, cheeses, and toppings piled high on freshly baked bread. Renowned for its commitment to quality ingredients and customizable sandwiches, it's a go-to destination for satisfying cravings with a delicious touch of East Coast flavor.

name: Sorellina
description: For a relaxed, yet sophisticated, Italian dining experience, look no further than Sorellina. Meaning "little sister" in Italian, Sorellina is the second restaurant opened by HM Management, and it continues their tradition of offering approachable fine dining. The restaurant features soft color tones, multi-hued wooden floor and accents, tufted leather booths and banquette seating, elegant lighting fixtures, and multiple seating areas, including a lofted second floor and a lounge where happy hour is offered daily. Sorellina's menu has both classic and contemporary Italian fare, such as antipasti, salads, thin crust pizza, pasta dishes, and entrees like Scottish salmon, fine cuts of steak, filet and mushroom risotto, and grilled chicken with spinach and artichoke cream. The full-service bar has beer, cocktails, and an impressive selection of Italian wines that bring Tuscany to Traverse City. Chic enough for a special occasion, yet casual enough for any meal, Sorellina is available for dine-in and takeout, allowing you to enjoy the flavors of Italy no matter where you prefer to dine.

name: The Dinner Detective
description: The Dinner Detective Murder Mystery Show offers an immersive theatrical experience where guests become part of the mystery-solving process. As they enjoy a delicious meal, attendees interact with professional actors who seamlessly integrate clues and red herrings into the storyline. With its unique blend of suspense, humor, and audience engagement, The Dinner Detective Murder Mystery Show promises an unforgettable evening of entertainment.

name: Station One Smokehouse
description: Station One Smokehouse offers a savory journey through the heart of Southern barbecue, boasting a menu brimming with slow-smoked meats and signature sauces. Nestled in the heart of town, it's a haven for BBQ enthusiasts seeking authentic flavors and a cozy, welcoming atmosphere.

name: Cafe Bionda
description: Ciao and welcome to Cafe Bionda, where they serve 'la dolce vita' on a plate, right here in the heart of Chicago. Their doors are open to those seeking an unforgettable culinary journey steeped in authentic Italian charm. Experience the rich, tantalizing flavors of our signature appetizers, mouthwatering entrees, and irresistible desserts.

name: Mountain Lakes Bagels & Deli
description:
At Mountain Lakes Bagels & Deli, you'll discover an enticing selection of dishes tailored to meet every taste bud's desire. Indulge in classic New York-style bagels, lavishly adorned with cream cheese or lox, or opt for hearty deli sandwiches overflowing with top-tier meats and cheeses. If you prefer lighter options, they also offer crisp salads and invigorating smoothies.

Whether you're grabbing a quick breakfast on the fly or enjoying a leisurely lunch with friends, you can count on Mountain Lakes Bagels & Deli to provide swift and amiable service.

name: Bjork Cafe  Bistro
description: In the mood for a splendid dining experience? Stop by Bjork Café & Bistro for an option that you are going to love. They are a Nordic café and bistro, presenting both new and traditional Nordic fusion in a comfortable and upscale setting. Come try their excellent fish & shellfish soup, sparkling Nordic mimosas, and wonderful desserts today.

name: Bar Nine
description: A unique Manhattan party spot, Bar Nine is famous for being one of the city's original dueling piano bars. Every night is completely unique because the audience picks the tunes, and you can dance the night away in this lively club. Between songs, munch on some tasty bar favorites like West Side wings or boneless bites, crispy fried Buffalo-drizzled cauliflower, or bacon-wrapped chicken skewers. For a bigger bite try the classic chicken sandwich or the Bar Nine Burger made thick and juicy and served on a potato bun with lettuce, tomato, and white onion. Pair your eats with one of 20 draft beers, a glass of wine, or a cool cocktail like The Baby Grand infused with fresh fruit, Don Julio tequila, Grand Marnier, and an electric blue finish. Also be sure to ask about the daily specials, and if make this your new go-to for Sunday football specials that include ticket, food, drink, merchandise, gift card, and game ticket giveaways. World class entertainment and fabulous fare awaits you at Bar Nine. Please note: Bar Nine is also a fabulous place for your next bachelor or bachelorette party -- call ahead for details!

name: Dallas BBQ
description: With steer heads on the wall and other assorted mementos of their culinary heritage, Dallas BBQ offers an inexpensive but authentic rendition of classic down-home barbeque, dishes like ribs, rotisserie chicken, Angus beef and deep-fried seafood. Like any good joint, Dallas BBQ features a tasty array of sides like coleslaw, potatoes, and plenty of others. In addition to the heartier fare, the menu also provides soups and salads. For lunch, dinner or larger catered gatherings, Dallas BBQ is the place for some great cooking, friendly service and fantastic prices. Diners can get the flavorful tastes of the South right in the heart of New York.

name: The Salad House of Morristown
description: Salad House is a popular restaurant chain known for its focus on fresh and customizable salads. With a diverse menu featuring a wide range of fresh greens, vegetables, proteins, and dressings, Salad House offers customers the opportunity to create their own nutritious and flavorful salads. The chain emphasizes a healthy and balanced approach to dining, making it a go-to choice for individuals seeking a refreshing and customizable meal option.

name: Marco's Pizza
description: When you're craving amazing pizza made from high quality ingredients then Marco's Pizza is the place for you. With multiple locations offering a mix of dine in, delivery, and takeout, you're all set to enjoy delicious, mouthwatering pizzas and other tasty fare -- from chicken wings to crisp salads to freshly baked subs, no matter where you are!

name: El Corral
description: A true slice of Tucson history, the building El Corral resides in was originally built in the 1920s and was one of the first restaurants in the area. After many decades and a few name changes, the El Corral that exists today is a Tucson institution, famous for its steakhouse fare and the best prime rib in Arizona. Their prime rib is slow-roasted and served with au jus and uncut horseradish, and their famous homemade tamale pie is the ideal side dish. Other menu options include baby back ribs, mesquite-grilled steaks, chicken stuffed with green chilies and cheese, and salmon fillet, along with sides and appetizers that make any order a full meal. The full-service bar offers beer, wine, sangria, and craft cocktails, as well as bar food specials that will satiate a smaller appetite. The restaurant space retains a lot of its original rugged, Old West feel, with dark wooden beamed ceilings, stone floors, exposed brick, and various cowboy memorabilia scattered throughout that offers a historical glimpse into the local area. When you've got a cowboy-sized hunger, head to El Corral for a hearty feast you won't soon forget.

name: Salata South Arlington
description: Salata is your kitchen away from home! With over 50 fresh toppings and a dozen signature dressings, you can customize a salad or wrap just how you like it. Mix and match with all your favorites at this casual eatery, and pair your pick with a flaky croissant and cookie. Eat better, fresher, and tastier today at this popular eatery!

name: Sophra Grill
description: Serving modern interpretations of some of the most loved Turkish and Mediterranean dishes, Sophra Turkish Restaurant has the flavors and dishes you're craving. This is an inviting spot with a big menu loaded with tasty picks like red lentil soup, plenty of kebabs, fresh seafood, and hearty gyros. Or, try something from the signature brick oven.

name: Pizza Ranch-West Point
description: Pizza Ranch is a popular American restaurant chain known for its unique combination of pizza and a family-friendly buffet experience. With over 200 locations across the Midwest, Pizza Ranch offers a diverse menu featuring a variety of pizzas, crispy chicken, salads, and desserts. The restaurant is celebrated for its welcoming atmosphere, where guests can enjoy a casual dining experience and savor a range of flavorful dishes in an all-you-can-eat setting.

name: Jack in the Box
description: Just about everyone knows Jack from Jack in the Box with his telltale ping pong ball head, but what they might not know is just how good the food is at this favorite fast-food eatery. For more than 60 years, this all-American chain has been dishing up burgers, all-day breakfasts and a variety of Americanized snacks like eggrolls and tacos. This is not, however, your typical fast-food burger joint. With dishes only made once you place your order, the menu offers diners a variety of decidedly different dining options. From the Sourdough Jack (served on authentic sourdough bread) to the Bacon Ultimate Cheeseburger with two kinds of cheese, there are enough burger options to cure just about every craving. There's plenty more on the menu, including garden-fresh salads with grilled chicken, Chicken Pita sandwiches, grilled sandwiches, their famous Curly Fries, and much more. Jack in the Box is also known for their real ice cream milkshakes.  Regardless if you order one to go with your meal or to enjoy as a dessert, they really are delectable. Plus, with a rotating selection of seasonal and promotional dishes to try, you can make this your new favorite fast-food restaurant and never tire of the food! Get there today and dine-in or choose a location with a handy drive-thru, but make Jack in the Box your first choice when craving fabulous fast-and-delicious-food!

name: 54th Street Restaurant & Drafthouse - The Rim
description: Check out 54th Street Restaurant & Drafthouse, a polished casual dining and bar experience featuring "Made from Scratch Food," 'hand crafted cocktails', and 54 Draft beers at 29 degrees! You'll enjoy the eclectic decor with a great vibe and friendly service. Stop by for a meal with friends or family, enjoy full sized appetizers & drink specials during Happy Hour, watch your favorite sports team on one of their large format TV's or sit and relax on the patio featuring group friendly fire-pit tables.

name: TGI Fridays
description: End your busy week in a place where everyone says, "Thank Goodness It's Friday!" T.G.I. Fridays is an American restaurant that prides itself on fun and friendly service while offering a great menu, full bar and relaxed atmosphere. Enjoy fried mac and cheese, loaded potato skins, boneless buffalo wings & their famous Jack Daniels Grill items.

name: Los Chilangos Downtown Redmond
description: Taqueria Los Chilangos & Catering is renowned for its authentic Mexican cuisine, offering a menu that features traditional tacos, burritos, and other flavorful dishes. They provide catering services for various events, bringing their delicious street food experience to a wider audience. Known for their fresh ingredients and vibrant flavors, Taqueria Los Chilangos has become a beloved spot for Mexican food enthusiasts.

name: Flames Indian Aroma
description: Family-owned and operated, Flames Indian Aroma offers tasty Indian favorites made with fresh ingredients and vibrant spices. Stop by and enjoy charcoal tandoori-grilled specialties, spicy curries, and bright and flavorful vegetarian dishes. Don't forget to pair your entrees with some fresh tandoor-fried naan and a tangy mango lassi.

name: Baby Brasa
description: A lively spot modeled after the traditional pollerias that are a hallmark of Peruvian street cuisine, Baby Brasa offers organic Peruvian fare including many vegan and vegetarian options. A gorgeous restaurant with lush greenery throughout, Baby Brasa is an ideal locale for a romantic date. Start with some shareable tapas like crispy chicken empanadas served with huancaina sauce, patatas bravas, and lettuce wraps filled with pulled rotisserie chicken, mango bites, crunchy noodles, cilantro, and ginger miso. Ceviche bar items include classic ceviche, power mixto, and seared tuna avocado on a spicy leche de tigre. For your main, check out the grass fed N.Y. churrasco steak, organic rotisserie chicken, and ossobuco with braised veal shank in Peruvian spices served over mashed potatoes. Pair your main with sides like fried sweet plantains, yucca fries, and roasted Brussels sprouts, and quench your thirst with an expert-mixed cocktail like the Baby Brasa Martini. Tempting desserts include tres leches, Baby's Lava Cookie served with ice cream, and vegan choco cake. Come take a journey through the flavors of Peru at Baby Brasa.

name: Earl Of Sandwich
description: The extensive menu at Earl of Sandwich pays tribute to the royal art of sandwich-making with freshly baked, artisan bread and the finest ingredients for its hot sandwiches. Enjoy creative sandwiches from The Original 1762 (roast beef, cheddar, and horseradish) to the Holiday Turkey and the Hawaiian BBQ! They also serve salads, wraps, and more.

name: Nancy Whiskey Pub
description: Nancy Whiskey Pub has been your neighborhood pub since 1967.  A saloon away from home, Nancy was in town before it was called "Tribeca."  Serving burgers, sandwiches, baskets, heroes, sides and fresh baked pizzas, Nancy also has a full bar including varieties of your favorite liquors and beers both on tap and in bottles.  Happy hour is offered from 4-7 p.m. Monday-Thursday with $2.50 Bud and Bud Light bottles and pints, and Nancy always offers $8 pitchers of Bud and Bud Light Monday-Thursday until closing.  Looking for entertainment? Nancy has you covered.  Six televisions show games from NFL Sunday Ticket and ESPN College Game Plan while a bank shuffleboard table stands as the only of its kind in Manhattan.  Informal play goes on all week with tournament play most Saturday and Sunday nights.

name: El Centro
description: You can taste the freshness in every bite at El Centro Classic Mexican Food and Drink. From the amazing homemade salsa to mouthwatering carnitas, there's plenty on the menu to tempt you. Stop by for a feast, a light snack, or just a break in a busy day. Plus, with a great selection of ice cold beers and fruity margaritas, it's all delish!

name: The Codfather, Proper Fish and Chips
description: The Codfather, Proper Fish and Chips is a charming seaside eatery that brings the authentic flavors of traditional British fish and chips to its patrons. The restaurant boasts a welcoming atmosphere reminiscent of a classic fisherman's haunt. With a commitment to quality ingredients and expertly fried fish, The Codfather offers a delightful culinary experience that transports diners to the heart of England's coastal culinary traditions.

name: 122 Elm St Tavern
description: 122 Elm Street Tavern is a cozy neighborhood spot known for its welcoming atmosphere and delicious comfort food. Located in a charming Cheshire, the tavern offers a diverse menu with hearty dishes, craft beers, and signature cocktails. It's an ideal place for locals and visitors alike to relax, enjoy good food, and connect with friends.

name: Cat Sports Pub
description: Located in NYC's Financial District, Cat Sports Pub is a combination club, lounge, and sports bar, guaranteeing that anyone can find what they're looking for here. The space is relaxing and approachable, featuring ornate chandeliers and faux windows on the ceiling, a large central bar, and multiple TVs for keeping up on all the sports action. The full-service bar has all the beer, wine, and cocktails you could want, with happy hour specials available daily. Live DJs on the weekend keep the energy pumping well into the night and the space can be reserved for private events. A hip spot where everyone is welcome, Cat Sports Pub invites you to drop in an relax for a while.

name: Thai Villa Cuisine
description: At Thai Villa Cuisine, Chef Suzy and her culinary team offer the most delicious and authentic Thai food. This inviting and impressive spot is perfect for any family night out, your next special event, or even a romantic evening. Come experience this beautiful setting and authentic, flavorful cuisine today at Thai Villa.

name: Diho Siam - Mission Viejo
description: Promising the freshest ingredients, finest quality foods, and friendliest service around has helped Diho Siam establish itself throughout Orange County. With four locations serving the area, including this wonderful Lake Forest spot, Diho Siam features a menu brimming with mouthwatering appetizers, refreshing soups, and scrumptious entrees that give a good overview of the delightful foods of Thailand. Whether you've had this food 100 times before or are tasting it for the very first time, the staff at Diho Siam can help guild you to new favorites or old standbys. With the likes of Green Jungle Curry, Satay of Beef, Pad Se-Lew, Thai Fried Rice, and others tempting your taste buds, there's always something zesty ready to tackle your hunger. In addition to Diho Siam's popular Thai menu, the kitchen also offers a complete Chinese lineup with everything from Lo Mein and Almond Chicken to Mongolian Beef and Shrimp with Lobster Sauce to help ensure there is something delicious for everyone in your family or group of friends and colleagues to enjoy. If you are getting away from the office for a bit or heading home for the day and find yourself short on time, head online to order your favorite Diho Siam dishes and have them ready to go by the time you get to the restaurant.

name: Mario's Oakland Saloon
description: Mario's Oakland Saloon is a unique blend of neighborhood, college and sports bar all rolled into one. With a warm and relaxing ambiance and great vibe, you can go for a meal and drinks at this local hot-spot. Serving pizzas, wings, and other pub fare, check out the roomy patio, cheer on your team on the TVs, or go for the entertainment.

name: Astro Restaurant
description: Astro Restaurant is a local beloved restaurant that serves authentic Greek and classic American comfort food. This all-day diner has been around for decades and is known for their delicious variety of meals, a warm and cozy environment, and attentive service.

name: Smokin Thighs
description: All things chicken...all things delicious! It's the Smokin Thighs way. Of course, they do it with their own verve, using applewood smoking and perfect grilling techniques to create some of the finest chicken in Nashville. There's no frying here, instead they focus on using their tried-and-true methods to turn out mouthwatering eats like the smoked chicken chili, loaded chicken nachos, and the overflowing "Dump Truck O' Wings" that can feed four to six of you. Craving a tasty burger? The chicken burgers are leaner than beef and provide the kind of gourmet burger experience you're not likely to forget. The build your own chicken selection lets you pick it, flavor it, and top it. Whether it's chicken in a pile, wings on the bone, thighs on Texas toast, or legs on the bone, this chicken is first-rate. Smokin Thighs has a great drink menu to help you wash it all down with, and that includes an extensive moonshine selection (the largest in the city), providing dozens of flavored and classic versions of this fabled distilled spirit. From its outdoor patio and multitude of TVs to watch the game to the terrific happy hour specials, Smokin Thighs is always cooking up a good time.

name: The Château Anna Maria
description: The Château is an award-winning restaurant that has been featured on the Food Network! They serve seafood, organic meats, lamb, and more. Their food is French inspired and served with Italian portions, so you can be sure you won't go hungry. They are proud to provide delicious food and a great dining experience!

name: Osteria Cotta
description: Osteria Cotta is an Upper West Side restaurant and wine bar that has a distinct Italian flair. The main level bar offers a lively scene where patrons can enjoy artisanal cocktails, selections from an extensive wine list, and craft beers. The upstairs dining room is a candlelight getaway, where a meal of perfectly-prepared Italian standards makes any occasion feel truly unique. Cotta's menu features a myriad of familiar Italian staples, including antipasti, salumi, cheeses, market sides, and small plates you can mix and match for the perfect meal. Signature dishes like the wood-fired, free-range chicken and house made pappardelle with braised pork ragu barely scratch the surface of the menu's fantastic offerings. The chef's artisanal pizzas are not to be missed. Each one is made in the imported wood-burning oven, which gives popular selections such as the Tartufo Pie (speck, truffle cream, button mushrooms, fresh mozzarella, and truffle oil) its unique flavor. The Saturday and Sunday brunch options let you enjoy Osteria Cotta's distinctive dining on weekend afternoons with a well-curated collection of specialties.

name: Tropical Smoothie Cafe  Avon
description: Start your day off right with a refreshing and energizing smoothie from Tropical Smoothie Cafe. Choose from a variety of tasty options including the Kiwi Quencher, Avocolada, and Peanut Paradise and pair it with delectable food items like flatbreads, wraps, and even breakfast items. Stop by today or order online for a quick meal on the go!

name: Noodles & Company - Turkey Creek
description: Gather around the table and around the bowls at Noodles and Company, where the dishes are always filled to the brim with internationally-inspired pasta creations. Since 1995, this casual and inventive eatery has been serving fresh food fast, and today, this fast-casual eatery is still in the lead when it comes to quick, healthy, and hand-crafted food. Everything on the menu is made in-house from real ingredients, so no matter if you're looking for a cozy spot to share a meal with friends or if it is family dinner night, you'll find something tempting on the menu. The Wisconsin mac & cheese is a favorite, the spicy chipotle adobo with braised pork in a smoky and spicy sauce is a great choice, and the pad Thai features all the flavors of this classic dish. There's plenty more on the menu, including Italian-inspired dishes, curries, Korean beef noodles, and traditional favorites like spaghetti & meatballs. There are meatless creations, gluten-free choices, low-calorie and low-sugar dishes, and those with lower sodium too, making Noodles & Company a great choice for everybody. With more and more locations every day, a delicious meal is just an order away at Noodles & Company! Please note: Noodles & Company also caters. From corporate events and lunches to private parties, the experienced team at Noodles & Company will make a meal your guests won't soon forget. Also be sure to follow Noodles & Company online!

name: Mino Brasserie
description: Mino Brasserie brings you the generous culture of the South of France and a cozy and festive environment with diffused lights and candles. Their open kitchen concept is located in the heart of the restaurant and creates a welcoming atmosphere. They serve impeccable French cuisine with a variety of fine meals and perfectly cooked meats.

name: Curry Up Now
description: Curry Up Now is on a mission to serve Indian flavors and ingredients in a friendly and recognizable way. Their signature dishes include fan-favorite tikka masala burritos, bowls, tacos, Deconstructed Samosas, Naughty Naan, and more, as well as a variety of traditional and Indian street food like Thali Platters, Kathi Rolls, and Bhel Puri. Don't miss some of the best cocktails in the Grandscape area, Mortar & Pestle. A full bar and tap beers! Come on in!

name: Palmer's Chicken, Catfish and Shrimp
description: Palmer's Hot Chicken is a tantalizing culinary haven where crispy, succulent chicken takes center stage, delivering an unforgettable dining experience. Renowned for its expertly spiced and perfectly fried poultry, Palmer's invites guests to savor the bold flavors and southern charm that define its signature hot chicken offerings.

name: Dressler's Restaurant
description: With a cozy vibe that's somewhere between casual and upscale, friendly service, and a terrific menu, Dressler's Restaurant continues to amaze and delight diners. Called an upscale and contemporary steakhouse, this popular local eatery has two convenient locations to better serve you. Stop by for lunch or dinner and enjoy hand-crafted fare that ranges from steakhouse classics like French onion soup and lump crab cakes to heartier fare like rack of lamb, the fresh catch of the day, and of course, succulent steaks. Hand-cut ribeyes, a colossal porterhouse, and filet mignon are among the beefy options, and each is perfectly seasoned and cooked just the way  you like it. Finish your meal with creme brulee or an apple crisp, and be sure to check out the amazing wine list to sip on something special with  your meal. Dressler's is perfect for lunch or dinner, but they also cater. No matter the occasion or size of event, their on- and off-site catering team is outstanding. For exceptional dining no matter the occasion, check out Dressler's!

name: The Classic
description: The Classic is a culinary haven where tradition meets innovation, offering a nostalgic dining experience with a modern twist. This restaurant exudes timeless charm and elegance, attracting locals and tourists alike. With its impeccable service, diverse menu featuring classic dishes reinvented with contemporary flair, and cozy ambiance, The Classic promises an unforgettable dining affair.

name: Domino's Pizza
description: From humble beginnings as a single pizza restaurant in 1960, Domino's has become today's recognized world leader in pizza delivery. They are fully committed to making and delivering delicious food made from high-quality ingredients. In addition to their classic pies, they serve a variety of wings, sandwiches, pastas, breads, salads, and more!

name: Firehouse Subs - Mira Mesa
description: People love a good meal, and at Firehouse Subs you can be sure that your meal will be terrific. Built on a legacy of fire and police service, this entrepreneurial eatery started small but has grown to more than 900 locations, all committed to serving the best quality meats, cheeses, and produce in hearty and delicious subs, sandwiches, and salads.

name: The Cottage
description: The Cottage Restaurant is a locally-owned and operated trendy eatery right on Main Street, and with friendly service, a great menu, and plenty to love, it's no wonder that this downtown Ayer eatery is as popular as it is. Relax in the comfortable dining area, grab a meal to-go, and they'll even deliver all so that you can enjoy something tasty today. Open for lunch and dinner, the menu features hot sammiches (try the saucy Italian meatball or the tasty chicken salad sandwich), enjoy a juicy burger, check out the garden-fresh salads, or dig in to an order of wings or their amazing pizzas. There's quite a lineup of specialty pizzas, but you can also build your own masterpiece. Finish your feast with a scoop or two of ice cream, or try the powdered sugar dusted fried dough. It's all terrific, and with reasonable prices, you can take the whole family, meet co-workers for lunch, or make this your new favorite for date-night. The Cottage Restaurant also caters, so the next time you need to feed the office or need food for a crowd, call ahead and they'll take care of all the details! Delicious from start to finish, check out this local favorite today!

name: El Mezcal Grill  Connersville
description: El Mezcal Grill provides a vibrant dining experience, featuring classic dishes like fajitas, enchiladas, and tacos. Patrons can savor the flavors of Mexico while enjoying a variety of margaritas, tequilas, and beers in a festive atmosphere. With colorful décor and a welcoming environment, this is the local's favorite when they're craving the taste of Mexico's culinary culture.

name: Sexy Pizza-Park Hill
description: Sexy Pizza is known for its creative and delicious pizza options, offering a variety of unique toppings and combinations. The pizzeria emphasizes a commitment to quality ingredients, with a menu that caters to diverse tastes, including vegan and gluten-free options. Its casual and inviting atmosphere makes it a popular spot for both quick bites and leisurely meals with friends and family.

name: Jack in the Box
description: Just about everyone knows Jack from Jack in the Box with his telltale ping pong ball head, but what they might not know is just how good the food is at this favorite fast-food eatery. For more than 60 years, this all-American chain has been dishing up burgers, all-day breakfasts and a variety of Americanized snacks like eggrolls and tacos. This is not, however, your typical fast-food burger joint. With dishes only made once you place your order, the menu offers diners a variety of decidedly different dining options. From the Sourdough Jack (served on authentic sourdough bread) to the Bacon Ultimate Cheeseburger with two kinds of cheese, there are enough burger options to cure just about every craving. There's plenty more on the menu, including garden-fresh salads with grilled chicken, Chicken Pita sandwiches, grilled sandwiches, their famous Curly Fries, and much more. Jack in the Box is also known for their real ice cream milkshakes.  Regardless if you order one to go with your meal or to enjoy as a dessert, they really are delectable. Plus, with a rotating selection of seasonal and promotional dishes to try, you can make this your new favorite fast-food restaurant and never tire of the food! Get there today and dine-in or choose a location with a handy drive-thru, but make Jack in the Box your first choice when craving fabulous fast-and-delicious-food!

name: Taste
description: Incorporating the best parts of wine bars, tapas restaurants, lounges, and nightclubs, TASTE offers a unique dining and drinking experience that will have you eager to plan a return visit. Reserved for those 19 and over, this spot is designed to be a sophisticated haven for those with refined tastes to enjoy stimulating conversation while they drink and dine. Their extensive wine selection is sure to have something that will please your palate, and all of their bottles are available for retail purchase. Wine and craft beer flights allow you to sample a variety of options before making a decision, or opt for one of their hand-crafted cocktails prepared with seasonal ingredients. TASTE's food menu features charcuteries, flatbreads, and small plates like grilled lamb chops, short rib pasta alfredo, pan seared scallops, and Parmesan-crusted pork medallions that are ideal for sharing. Brunch is served on Sundays, and be sure to follow them on social media to learn about special events like live music, wine tastings, and holiday celebrations. Happy hour is offered every day, so stop by TASTE to see what you've been missing.

name: Rebel Restaurant and Bar
description: Rebel Restaurant and Bar is serving up mouthwatering Creole and Caribbean cuisine. Enjoy authentic dishes made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients and recipes passed down through generations. The welcoming ambiance and outstanding staff make this lively joint the perfect place for enjoying a drink and sharing some good times with friends.

name: Rosie's Sidekick Sandwich Shop
description: Rosie's Sidekick Sandwich Shop is a family-owned and operated local sandwich shop in Logan Square. Their bread is homemade with no GMOs, and they have homemade eggplant parm, homemade meatballs, homemade Italian roast beef! Even the cannoli are homemade, so stop by for something truly delicious.

name: Pando 39
description: A contemporary New York City bar, restaurant, and social lounge, Pando 39 is a place where sophisticated blends with casual, corporate blends with leisure, and simple blends with complex. Leave your stress at the door and enjoy elevated plates, exquisitely handcrafted cocktails, and an impressive selection of locally sourced craft brews.

name: Alma Bistro Cocina Latina
description: For mouthwatering meals with a modern Latin twist, choose Alma Bistro, Cocina Latina. Founded out of a deep love for fresh, healthy, and authentic food, the bright, lively restaurant uses only the finest ingredients to craft amazing food and custom cocktails that are sure to delight your taste buds. Stop by today!

name: Giordano's Restaurant & Pizza
description: Giordano's is pretty much famous for their stuffed pizza - what started out as a culinary phenomenon in Chicago in the mid 1970s has now become the epitome of pizza among those who crave only the freshest, tastiest and best pizzas. Nothing, many claim, comes close to the pizzas and other dishes made up fresh to order at Giordano's.

name: Tacos Trompo
description: Are you in the mood for a classic Mexican style dining experience? If so, then come on down to Tacos Trompo! This local hotspot is serving up tacos al pastor, enchilada plates, chips and queso and the most delectable chilaquiles. Made with only the freshest ingredients, their dishes are made to perfection!

name: CasAmigos Bar & Lounge
description: CasAmigos Bar & Lounge is a vibrant restaurant that masterfully combines the flavors of Peruvian and Mexican cuisines. Known for its delicious fusion dishes, such as ceviche, tacos, and lomo saltado, the restaurant offers a diverse and exciting menu. With a lively atmosphere and expertly crafted cocktails, CasAmigos Bar & Lounge provides a perfect setting for enjoying a unique and flavorful dining experience.

name: L'Adresse
description: L'Adresse Nomad is a cool and comfortable eatery where all-day dining is always terrific. There's a well-rounded menu here with something for everyone. From burgers to elegant seafood dishes, dishes are inspired by European culinary traditions and modern American techniques. Fusing flavors and ingredients, every meal here is terrific! Also visit their Nomad Location www.ladressenyc.com

name: Hen House
description: Hen House in New York City is an acclaimed eatery known for its inventive and sophisticated take on classic poultry dishes. Nestled in the bustling heart of the city, this restaurant has gained popularity for its unique menu that features a range of creatively prepared chicken dishes, from gourmet fried chicken to exotic, globally-inspired flavors. The ambiance of Hen House combines modern chic with a cozy, welcoming vibe, making it a popular destination for both casual diners and food connoisseurs.

name: Lala Pocha
description: Lala Pocha delights with its innovative blend of Korean and Texan flavors, creating a unique culinary experience. With a cozy ambiance and friendly service, it's the perfect spot for adventurous foodies seeking new taste sensations. From a wide array of hotpot options to spicy Korean fried chicken, each dish is a fusion masterpiece.

name: Imli
description: Enjoy contemporary Indian cuisine and beverages at Imli, conveniently located on New York City's Upper East Side. Their carefully crafted menu features both traditional and modern favorites with a few surprises for added dimension and bold flavor. The tranquil interior, highlighted by a brick wall, soothing lights, a partially open kitchen, a beautiful bar, and a lively patio, all make Imli the perfect choice for your next meal.

name: See Fah Thai Cuisine
description: See Fah Thai Cuisine serves delicious and authentic Thai cuisine cooked by a Thai chef who is proud to bring you old world recipes. They are the experts of these incredible dishes, and they are eager to share a flavorful, traditional meal with you amongst family and friends in a welcoming and relaxing environment.

name: Firehouse Subs - Greenville
description: Hot is the name of the game at Firehouse Subs, where they'll heat up your taste buds like a four-alarm fire with sandwiches that are guaranteed to be both delicious and filling. As the name implies, the theme is one of service, honoring first responders and offering up food for the discerning masses. Hot specialty subs like the Hook and Ladder are hard acts to follow, especially when loaded up with smoked turkey breast, Virginia honey ham, and melted Monterey Jack cheese. It's served in Firehouse's trademark "Fully Involved" style, which layers on mayo, deli mustard, lettuce, tomato, onion, and add a kosher dill pickle on the side. Whether it's the Club on a Sub or the Smoked Beef and Cheddar Brisket, Firehouse is more than ready to tackle your appetite. Sample the New York Steamer, a corned beef brisket, pastrami, and melted provolone sub finished off with deli mustard, mayo, and Italian dressing. They've also got all the cold subs you can handle, plus a number of under-500 calorie options and salads to fit any craving. Firehouse Subs is community driven and continually gives back in support of first responders. They also cater, with sub platters capable of feeding any crowd.

name: Bar Ten
description: Bar Ten is a vibrant hotspot known for its eclectic ambiance and top-notch cocktails. It offers a unique blend of craft cocktails and live entertainment, making it a favorite among locals and visitors alike. With its chic decor and friendly staff, Bar Ten provides the perfect setting for a night out on the town.

name: Lime Light Grill & Bar
description: Continental cuisine in a casual atmosphere, the Limelight Grill provides great American cuisine at great prices. The menu offers an array of flavors, featuring appetizers and a simple selection of entrees, all prepared in a masterful way. From the full bar, diners can enjoy a selection of cocktails and other assorted drinks while enjoying a sporting event or joining in on the karaoke festivities that take place every Wednesday, Thursday and Friday nights. Their happy hour lasts from 10am to 7pm and they even offer a DJ on Saturday nights to go with their many sports specials. Skillfully prepared food, good service and a relaxing ambiance are at the heart of the Limelight Grill, and will make it a repeat stop on your dining list. Free WiFi is available for your enjoyment.

name: Chakra
description: Chakra  invites diners on a flavorful journey through Thailand's culinary landscape, where vibrant spices and traditional recipes blend harmoniously. Indulge in authentic Thai delicacies crafted with fresh ingredients, served amidst a warm and inviting ambiance that transports guests to the bustling streets of Bangkok.

name: Pei Wei Asian Kitchen
description: Pei Wei Asian Kitchen knows how to bring the flavor. They serve bold, craveable creations that are sure to impress the whole crew. Whenever you're in the mood for something sweet, spicy, or just plain good, you can count on them for wok'd to order dishes, like their bestselling Firecracker Chicken, created with quality ingredients. Order Now!

name: Toscana Italian Kitchen
description: Italian dining is all about fresh flavors and a familial atmosphere, so it's only fitting that Toscana Italian Kitchen is a family-owned-and-operated restaurant where they prepare all of their dishes fresh daily. An elegant space featuring white tablecloths and an open kitchen, Toscana Italian Kitchen is open exclusively for dinner service, making it the ideal setting for a special night out. Start your meal off with some antipasti like bruschetta, fried calamari, or mozzarella caprese before moving on to a full entree (all of which are served with soup or salad). Dishes featuring their homemade pasta include cheese or lobster ravioli, eggplant rollatini, penne vodka, and spaghetti with your choice of meatball, Italian sausage, or Bolognese. Meat and seafood-based options consist of parmigiana, picatta, Sorrento, linguine clams, shrimp scampi, and red snapper Mediterranean. The bar offers a wide assortment of beer and wine to complete your meal, and be sure to ask your server about the daily special. A warm and inviting space with both indoor and outdoor seating, Toscana Italian Kitchen invites you to reserve a table the next time you'd like dinner to be someone else's responsibility.

name: Genghis Grill
description: Genghis Grill offers a lively and engaging Mongolian Stir Fry dining experience. Guests have the opportunity to unleash their creativity by crafting their own customized bowl at the Mongolian grill. With an extensive selection of over 80 fresh vegetables, meats, spices, and sauces available at the Fresh Market Bar Buffet, diners can tailor their meal to their exact preferences before Grill Masters expertly cook their creations to perfection.

name: TGI Fridays
description: End your busy week in a place where everyone says, "Thank Goodness It's Friday!" T.G.I. Fridays is an American restaurant that prides itself on fun and friendly service while offering a great menu, full bar and relaxed atmosphere. Enjoy fried mac and cheese, loaded potato skins, boneless buffalo wings & their famous Jack Daniels Grill items.

name: Cantinho Do Brazil
description: For delicious Brazilian treats, choose Cantinho Do Brazil. The family-owned restaurant is excited to serve you a wide variety of delectable dishes including acai bowls, sweet and savory crepes, smoothies and shakes, and even snacks to go! Be sure to try the coxinha-- the staple Brazilian pastry that is sure to make your mouth water.

name: SWEET CHICK
description: Sweet Chick is a popular restaurant chain known for its innovative take on classic Southern comfort food, particularly its signature dish of chicken and waffles. With a hip and contemporary vibe, Sweet Chick combines a nostalgic ambiance with a modern twist, offering a diverse menu that caters to both comfort food enthusiasts and those seeking a unique dining experience. Founded by restaurateur John Seymour and hip-hop artist Nas, Sweet Chick has gained acclaim for its flavorful dishes and stylish atmosphere.

name: Mr Biggs Bar & Grill
description: Mr. Biggs Bar & Grill is a dynamic culinary hotspot, offering a fusion of flavors that tantalize the taste buds, alongside a vibrant ambiance perfect for socializing with friends. From signature cocktails to savory grilled delights, it's the ultimate destination for memorable dining experiences and good times.

name: Mayuri Indian Grill
description: Mayuri Indian Grill is committed to serving the best authentic Indian cuisine around and an atmosphere to match. Their recipes are authentic and time-tested, made from high quality  ingredients that are always fresh. Stop by and allow them to treat you to a dining experience that is absolutely unparalleled.

name: Island Fin Poke
description: Welcome to Island Fin Poke where fresh, original poke bowls are presented in unique Hawaiian style. From farm-to-fork, only the freshest fish, produce, and ingredients are used to hand-craft each amazing meal. Seasonal flavors and options are also available, so you've always got plenty to tempt you. Check out the fresh flavors made here today!

name: Chuponcito
description: Located in Aliso Viejo, CA, Chuponcito treats its patrons to a delightful array of Mexican classics. The menu features a tempting variety of options, ranging from delectable tacos and indulgent cheesy enchiladas to invigorating ceviche and velvety flan for dessert. Each dish is skillfully paired with salsas of varying heat levels, ensuring a flavorful experience. To quench their thirst, guests can choose from an extensive beverage selection, including refreshing horchata and classic margaritas, further enhancing their dining journey.

name: The Fremont Bar & Grill
description: A classic neighborhood sports bar and grill, the Fremont Bar & Grill has all the ingredients necessary for a great time! Open for lunch and dinner, this spot offers a menu chock-full of American comfort foods freshly prepared with locally-sourced ingredients. Wraps, sandwiches, a build-your-own burger option, salads, bar snacks and appetizers, and more are up for grabs. They're famous for their chicken melt and wings -- the wings are made to order and come with one of a dozen different sauces! The full-service bar is stocked with beer, wine, and liquor, and each day brings new food, drink, and/or lunchtime meal specials. Multiple HDTVs regularly play the latest games -- with emphasis on the Blackhawks -- and be sure to check out their events calendar to see when special events like trivia night are happening.
