Open until at least 1:00 a.m. daily and accepting online orders for pick-up, the Fremont Bar & Grill has you covered for lunch, dinner, late-night reveling, dining at home, and everything in between.

name: LTD Pizza & Bar
description: LTD Pizza & Bar is a New York-style pizzeria and slice shop serving gourmet pizza, add-ons, small plates and entrees - all made in their 900-degree oven. They also offer craft beers and a sommelier's selection of wine in a unique space to be utilized for intimate nights out, private events or small gatherings.

name: Primo Hoagies  Trexlertown
description: Embracing family traditions and recipes and the finest ingredients, PrimoHoagies is a cut above the rest when it comes to sandwiches and catering (ask about their amazing boxed lunches). It all starts with the bread which is baked every two hours and the locally-sourced veggies that are chopped every day, and each fresh-to-order specialty hoagie is made with Thumann's gourmet meats and cheeses. A fast-casual restaurant with that classic deli vibe, this is the perfect spot for a quick midweek lunch, a fun family outing, or whenever you need lunch for the office.

name: Tivoli Pizza and Trattoria
description: A taste of Italy is just a fork's length away at Tivoli Pizza & Trattoria. Located in the Berkshire Shopping Center, this eatery features an appetizing array of unique specialty dishes and fresh-out-of-the-oven gourmet pizzas. Open for lunch and dinner, they offer fast delivery, convenient take out, and are available for catering. Diners are treated like family here, and each meal begins with a basket of bread sticks and appetizers like Buffalo wings as the kitchen staff busily prepare heaping helpings of cheese ravioli in pink sauce, linguine Alfredo, penne pomodoro, chicken piccata, and eggplant parmigiana. There's a dish here for every appetite, and the selection of fresh salads, paninis, wraps, or baked lasagna is truly impressive. You can even create your own pasta dish or pizzas with your choice of nearly two-dozen different toppings. Other menu standouts include the gourmet pizzas -- the Hawaiian, Buffalo chicken, and clams casino to name a few. Tivoli also has a bit of a Brazilian streak, featuring pizza like the Calabresa (sauce, mozzarella, Brazilian sausage, onions) and Mineria (mozzarella, sauce, steak, green olives, and Brazilian Catupiry cheese).

name: Qdoba Mexican Eats
description: As the menu at Qdoba Mexican Grill reads, their food is "made fast, made fresh, made right in front of you!" The delightful Qdoba features authentically prepared Mexican specialties, using the finest ingredients and traditional preparation methods of old world Mexico! The menu features all your favorites, from zesty nachos, savory tortilla soups, traditional tortilla chips and hearty dips to signature made-to-order burritos that you truly won't find anywhere else. Qdoba also serves amazing taco salads in a crispy flour tortilla bowl bursting with fresh, flavorful ingredients. If you enjoy burritos but prefer forks to fingers, ask for the house specialty "naked burrito;" it includes all the robust burrito ingredients served in a bowl! Take out and catering services are also available. Co-workers, friends and family alike will be happy to be your guest at Qdoba Mexican Grill where good food starts with good ingredients, and you'll savor a genuinely memorable dining experience!

name: Indian Summer
description: Savor traditional Indian cuisine at Indian Summer. This cozy Harlem spot has a warm and welcoming atmosphere with friendly, attentive waiters at your service. The menu is full of delicious, fresh options including spicy duck vindaloo, flavorful chicken tikka masala, mango lamb, and delectable chicken curry. The biryani dishes are also a favorite among customers. Prepared to order with your choice of tender chicken, lamb, fresh shrimp, or vegetable biryani, you're sure to be satisfied with this authentic dish. Stop in for lunch and choose from the extensive options available at the lunch buffet or take your meal to go with a lamb, chicken, or vegetable take-out box. Online ordering is available for carry out or delivery so you can enjoy Indian Summer at work or in the comfort of your own home.

name: Cuzin's Pizza
description: With delicious pizzas and so much more, Cuzins Pizza is a casual spot to fill up on fresh food at reasonable prices. This is a friendly spot, so go hungry and feast on specialty pizzas, grinders, burgers, big and plump wings, and more. There are some Greek classics, too, plus seafood and pastas. With something for everyone, stop by today!

name: The Laurels
description: The Laurels is a cozy and romantic craft cocktail bar located in the heart of New York City, featuring a creative selection of contemporary American inspired cocktails and an array of seasonal food fare. Some of their memorable dishes are their steak frites, short-rib poutine and seared ahi tuna steak.

name: Pantano's Gourmet
description: Searching for that all-day breakfast you have been craving? Come check out Pantano's Gourmet for an option that is sure to put a smile on your face! They have it all from classic breakfast to acai bowls, delicious pasta, hearty sandwiches, and more! Everything they serve is made from the best quality ingredients around.

name: Colombini Bistro
description: Colombini Bistro is a cozy Italian restaurant at Nob Hill Hotel offering lunch and dinner in a casual, Tuscan-like setting. Inspired by the rich landscapes of Tuscany, their intimate fine-dining experience is itself a destination. Immerse yourself in Italy at this wonderful spot and enjoy an unforgettable meal.

name: La Poblanita Mexican Cuisine
description: Experience the authentic flavors of Mexico at La Poblanita Mexican Cuisine, where traditional recipes and fresh ingredients come together to create mouthwatering dishes. From savory tacos to flavorful enchiladas, every bite will transport you to the heart of Mexico.

name: Main Squeeze Juice Webster
description: Main Squeeze Juice Co. is a haven for those seeking vibrant and nourishing beverages made from the freshest ingredients. From cold-pressed juices to invigorating smoothie bowls, they are dedicated to promoting wellness through delicious concoctions. With a commitment to sustainability and health, Main Squeeze provides a refreshing escape for those looking to rejuvenate mind and body.

name: Awesum DimSum Times Square
description: Awesum DimSum Times Square is a traditional Cantonese restaurant that specializes in a quintessential Cantonese dish: Dim Sum. Dim Sum is commonly translated to "touch the heart" and that is exactly what this cultural hot spot does. Their ambience is very welcoming and makes you want to stay well past closing.

name: Farmer Boys - Irvine 1099
description: Farmer Boys is a popular fast food chain known for its farm-fresh ingredients and hearty portions, offering a diverse menu of burgers, sandwiches, salads, and breakfast items. With a commitment to quality and taste, they deliver a delicious dining experience rooted in the essence of American farm-to-table cuisine.

name: Luchadores NYC
description: Come see the fight of the century as tacos battle burritos for the championship at Luchadores NYC. A fun and colorful restaurant with seating indoors and out, Luchadores is a great place for families looking for a memorable bite. Popular items include the pollo asado burrito with tender chicken, cilantro-lime rice, pinto beans, Monterrey cheese, pico, and crema; carne asada tacos with juicy steak, sauteed onions, cojita cheese, Lucha Salsa, cilantro, and lime; and the veggie quesadillas stuffed with portobello, Monterrey cheese, and sauteed onions. Quench your thirst with a cold Jarritos or Mexican Coke. Step into the ring today and experience friendly service and unbeatable eats at Luchardores NYC -- sparkly mask and cape optional.

name: Guantanamera
description: Guantanamera is a friendly, fun, vibrant restaurant featuring traditional Cuban fare, magnificent mojitos, complimentary hand-rolled cigars on Friday and Saturday nights, and live Cuban music. Guantanamera captures the essence of Old Havana with exotic décor, candle-lit tables, rattan-covered ceiling fans, and hand-painted folkloric murals.

name: Tami's Dugout
description: Tami's Dugout is a locally owned, vibrant destination for enjoying quality food, specialty beverages, and excellent service. This lively bar and restaurant frequently hosts entertainment including live music. Come check it out for a night of great talent along with delicious food and beverages amongst great people!

name: Chelino's
description: Marcelino "Chelino" Garcia arrived in Oklahoma City directly from Aquas Calientes, Mexico, in 1979, and hasn't looked back. Today, with a restaurant empire that encompasses a bakery, tortilla factory and more, you can count on getting authentic, delicious and superior Mexican cuisine at any Chelino's Mexican Restaurant. It's always a fiesta at Chelinos, where bright, cheery interiors and friendly service makes this lunch and dinner hot-spot a delicious choice. Stop by for lunch and enjoy a quick meal, or go with friends, family or someone special for dinner. There's plenty on the menu, including house specialties like camaron al mojo de ajo, ranchero steak, and of course, Chelino's famous fajitas. There's plenty more on the affordable menu, and if you're having trouble deciding, there are plenty of combination plates. Friendly, and oh-so tasty, add some flavor to your day and dine at Chelino's!

name: Mimo
description: Mimo offers a delightful culinary experience blending traditional Italian flavors with modern twists. Its cozy ambiance and attentive service create the perfect setting for a memorable dining experience. From classic pasta dishes to decadent desserts, Mimo delights patrons with its authentic Italian cuisine crafted with fresh, locally-sourced ingredients.

name: TGI Fridays
description: End your busy week in a place where everyone says, "Thank Goodness It's Friday!" T.G.I. Fridays is an American restaurant that prides itself on fun and friendly service while offering a great menu, full bar and relaxed atmosphere. Enjoy fried mac and cheese, loaded potato skins, boneless buffalo wings & their famous Jack Daniels Grill items.

name: Michele's
description: Michele's in DC is a sophisticated dining establishment situated in the heart of Washington, D.C. The restaurant boasts a diverse menu that showcases contemporary American and French cuisine, meticulously crafted with the finest ingredients and innovative culinary techniques.

name: The Pint Room
description: The Pint Room is passionate about bringing people together and believes that every good beer deserves a good meal. They partner with local breweries to rotate in the latest offerings and create custom beer and food menu pairings. Their menu is handcrafted by local, in-house chefs and features signature foods with bold flavors!

name: Mrs. Fish
description: Nestled in the heart of New York's Chinatown, Sichuan Hot Pot Cuisine makes the ordering process as easy as pointing your finger -- all the house specials are posted with photos. The specials include poached meat and seafood dishes, as well as their namesake hot pots, where you cook your protein in simmering broths right at the table. Hot pot proteins include everything from traditional chicken or lamb to the more exotic crocodile or frog legs. Rounding out their extensive menu are plenty of classic, westernized Chinese dishes, such as kung pao or sesame chicken, spicy fatty beef, fried rice, dumplings in hot oil, Szechuan double cooked pork, and eggplant in garlic sauce. Sichuan Hot Pot Cuisine's simple dining room is the perfect place for small or large groups to gather for a meal, or they offer take-out and delivery if you prefer to dine at home. Never dull and always delicious, Sichuan Hot Pot Cuisine has a little bit of everything that's sure to please most everyone.

name: Curry Up Now
description: Curry Up Now serves innovative and unexpected Indian fare that's a little naughty too! Since day one, this local hotspot has been on a mission to serve Indian flavors and ingredients in a friendly and recognizable way. Their signature dishes include tikka masala burritos, bowls, tacos and much, much more! Come down today!

name: Copal Mexican Cuisine
description: Copal Mexican Cuisine is here to give Lincoln a true taste of Mexico. They are proud to serve up family recipes that have been passed down for generations, showcasing a wide variety of traditional Mexican cuisine. Enjoy their classic dishes and be prepared to indulge in their fresh seafood items.

name: Frank & Helen's Pizzeria
description: Open since 1956, Frank & Helen's is a local institution, serving some of the most delicious pizzas and broasted chicken you'll find anywhere in town! Generations of local diners have grown up on enjoying this spot's mix of charming, family-friendly service and timeless comfort foods. With lunch and dinner service Tuesday through Friday (dinner only on Saturdays and Sundays), you can dive headfirst into appetizers like seasoned wings, golden-brown mozzarella sticks, and toasted ravioli -- a St. Louis original. Salads and soups are perfect sides for entree options that include homemade lasagna, grilled grouper, country-fried steak, cannelloni, and a meatball sub. You'll definitely want to try the broasted chicken, a house specialty that never disappoints. it's perfectly seared with a crispy-battered skin outside and moist, tender meat inside. The pizzas are just as delectable and available in gourmet pairings with crust choices that include thin, thick crusts, and gluten-free -- shrimp pesto, veggie lovers, and BBQ chicken are just a few of the their mouthwatering options. Frank & Helen's catering is an affordable and accommodating choice for all of your public and private events, with custom menus available to suit your needs.

name: Tres Machos Cantina & Cocina
description: Tres Machos Cantina & Cocina in Glen Allen, VA, is a vibrant and welcoming restaurant celebrated for its authentic Mexican cuisine and lively atmosphere. Nestled in the heart of Glen Allen, this eatery has become a local favorite, known for its extensive menu that offers a wide range of traditional Mexican dishes. The chefs at Tres Machos pride themselves on using fresh, high-quality ingredients to create flavorful dishes such as tacos, enchiladas, fajitas, and burritos. Each dish is prepared with a focus on authenticity and a flair for bold flavors.

name: Joey B's at Brickstone
description: Paying homage to great American restaurants, Joey B's at Brickstone is a sophisticated, elegant and delicious place to dine. Chef Brophy has spent years perfecting the art of fine cuisine, and with a dedication to only using the finest and freshest ingredients, you can count on an exceptional meal here. Go for lunch, brunch on Sunday, or dinner any day but Monday, and feast on continental favorites like escargot, pate au poivre, duck breast a la orange, sea scallops au gratin, grilled filet of beef, and more. Outstanding service accompanies every meal here, and with a full-service bar, you can sip on a glass of wine or a cocktail with your meal. Joey's is also idea for private parties, special events, and even corporate meetings. Please note: Reservations for dining at Joey B's are recommended.

name: Acenar
description: Located on San Antonio's Famous Riverwalk, this Modern Design Restaurant is a must Visit for Downtown San Antonio.  For south-of-the-border favorites, Acenar promises regional Mexican fare with a Texas flair. Casual and relaxed, Acenar offers a spacious patio for outdoor dining or a private balcony. Ideal for dates, you'll enjoy reasonable prices and innovative house specials like their Baby Goat dish, Grilled Snapper, or Mini Veal Shank. Pair a specialty cocktail with your meal from Acenar's extensive selection. On Fridays and Saturdays, the bar is open until 2am with DJs providing music.   Acenar offers reservations on opentable.com or direct

name: Casa Tuya
description: Casa Tuya is a crossover Latin American restaurant in Manhattan's Inwood neighborhood, with a focus on creating a relaxed and inviting ambience where you can enjoy culturally diverse Latin food from their award winning chef, craft cocktails, and your favorite music. They are perfect for a tranquil lunch space or an upscale dinner.

name: Taim Mediterranean Kitchen
description: Taim is a staple in the community, and their name literally means 'tasty'! They use the best ingredients, spices, and time-honored Mediterranean cooking techniques to create a one-of-a-kind experience. On Sundays, try their crave combo! For just $10, choose your favorite signature pitas served with fresh cut fries.

name: Pei Wei Asian Kitchen
description: Pei Wei Asian Kitchen knows how to bring the flavor. They serve bold, craveable creations that are sure to impress the whole crew. Whenever you're in the mood for something sweet, spicy, or just plain good, you can count on them for wok'd to order dishes, like their bestselling Firecracker Chicken, created with quality ingredients. Order Now!

name: Tropical Caribbean Authentic Latin Cuisine
description: In the mood for something fresh and delicious? Come check out Tropical Caribbean Authentic Latin Cuisine today! They offer a variety of authentic Latin cuisine that is made fresh and packed with flavor! Come try their churrasco, creamy cajun shrimp over linguine, chalets fritas, shrimp mofongo, and picador Dominican.

name: STAT Pizza
description: At STAT Pizza, the focus revolves around flavor. Established in 2020, STAT Pizza stands as a family-owned fast-casual take-out restaurant renowned for its delectable made-to-order pizzas and wings. Each pizza is meticulously crafted from scratch, featuring freshly prepared dough, a tantalizingly rich marinara sauce infused with a closely guarded secret recipe, and an ample serving of 100% real, freshly grated mozzarella cheese. These elements combine seamlessly with premium quality toppings, ensuring a savory culinary experience with every bite.

name: Cobra
description: Located in the Brewery District of Columbus, Ohio, Cobra stands as a neighborhood bar with an Asian-American flair. It offers a laid-back and vibrant atmosphere, where late-night patrons can indulge in a variety of Asian-American inspired food and drinks.

name: Pitaziki Mediterranean Grill
description: Pitaziki Mediterranean Grill in New Haven is a popular dining spot renowned for its fresh, flavorful, and authentic Mediterranean cuisine. The restaurant offers a variety of dishes, including savory pitas, fresh salads, and delicious grilled meats, all prepared with high-quality ingredients. With its casual and friendly atmosphere, Pitaziki provides a welcoming environment for both quick bites and relaxed meals, embodying the vibrant culinary culture of the Mediterranean.

name: Tacologist: Tacos Tequila Margaritas
description: Locally owned and operated, Tacologist offers a mix of traditional and modern Mexican dishes in a casually sophisticated space suited for any type of gathering. Featuring high ceilings, contemporary decor and lighting fixtures, a unique bar area with a colorful tile backsplash, and an outdoor patio for sunny days, this inviting restaurant will put you in a relaxed state of mind as soon as you walk in the door. It's no surprise that tacos are the house specialty, and options include both classic and especial choices, such as carnitas, BBQ pork, avocado, carne asada, chicken teriyaki, fish, and el pastor. Rounding out the menu are other Mexican favorites like burritos, enchiladas, quesadillas, fajitas, and shareable appetizers like fresh guacamole, flaming queso dip, and elote. The bar has more than 100 different types of tequila and their collection of margaritas are prepared to order with freshly squeezed fruit juices. There's also imported and domestic beers, wine, and house-made sangria, and happy hour has deals on select drinks and small bites. Tacologist uses only the highest quality ingredients in their dishes and makes everything in-house, so you can rest assured that no matter what you order, it will be amazing and leave you eager to plan a return visit.

name: Captain's BBQ
description: Located in Palm Coast, FL, Captain's BBQ greeted patrons with the tantalizing aroma of smoky meats and savory sauces wafting through the air as they approached. Inside the bustling kitchen, skilled chefs tended to racks of ribs sizzling on the grill and trays of succulent pulled pork, creating a hive of activity and culinary expertise.

name: The Halal Guys - Ashburn
description: The Halal Guys have been dishing up tasty and authentic American halal dishes since 1990. There's lots to love here, including chicken platters or sandwiches, meaty gyros, falafel platters, and plenty of delish sides. All crafted from the very best ingredients, every visit is a flavorful one! Also call to inquire about catering options.

name: Hondos
description: As one of Richmond's premier chophouse, HONDOS is the ultimate destination for a great steak. Serving a variety of steak cuts like the cowboy cut ribeye, New York strip, filet mignon and porterhouse, you're sure to find something to fit your palate. Rounding out the menu is their succulent seafood choices like twin South African lobster tails, rockfish with jumbo lump crabmeat, and jumbo Chesapeake lump crab cakes. Whether you're having a romantic evening for two or a business dinner, HONDOS is sure to surpass your highest expectations.

name: Kung Fu Tea
description: Fresh. Innovative. Fearless. At Kung Fu Tea, every beverage is made-to-order with real Kung Fu. Quench your thirst with something fabulous today at Kung Fu Tea. You'll find some of the freshest drinks around at this popular spot with a huge menu. Sip on the original Kung Fu milk tea, try a slush blended with fresh fruit, or ask about the seasonal specials. Or, pick your own favorite and add their famous bubbles to every cup.

name: Michaleno's Pizzeria
description: Family-owned and operated by two generations, Michaleno's Pizzeria offers Italian favorites made with fresh ingredients, time-honored recipes, and lots of love. Perfect for families, Michaleno's Pizza has a classic casual Italian atmosphere. Begin with tasty appetizers like fried breaded ravioli, loaded jumbo tater tots, and jalapeno poppers. For the main event, check out specialty pizzas like meat lovers, bacon cheeseburger, or the deluxe with cheese, sausage, pepperoni, mushrooms, black olives, onion, and green pepper -- or build your own perfect Italian-style thin crust or blanket (double crust stuffed) pizza with your picks of over 20 delicious toppings. If you're not in the mood for pizza, try the seafood dinners, specialty sandwiches, or baked pastas like the gourmet ravioli with roasted mushrooms. Be sure to save room for delectable desserts like cannoli, raspberry cheesecake chimis, and cake bites. Stop by Michaleno's Pizzeria today for friendly service and outstanding Italian cuisine.

name: Joyners Bar
description: Joyner's Bar is the definition of classic and deals only in high-quality drinks and good times. They don an ambience that is reminiscent of a study, with their many leatherbound books and fancy seating for friends and co-workers alike. This place is like no other, with a friendly and attentive staff that is sure to make your day!

name: Alpaca Peruvian Charcoal Chicken
description: Alpaca Chicken is a tasty spot to get a quick and casual meal, and with their famous Peruvian rotisserie charcoal chicken on the menu, you're in for a real treat! This is a fast-casual dining concept where all-natural chicken is marinated and slowly cooked over charcoal for the very best flavor. Pair your picks with hand-crafted sides at this gem.

name: Taco Bueno
description: Taco Bueno is a fan-favorite chain serving up delicious tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and more. With delicious meats and vegetarian meals, they have an option here for everyone. Enjoy freshly prepared, mouthwatering food handcrafted in their kitchens, made with real ingredients and customized to your liking.

name: Chicago's Pizza On Tap
description: Chicago's Pizza On Tap is proud to introduce a new take on the Chicago's Pizza concept. They offer delicious food and familiar favorites that you will love, along with tasty new offerings served in a sporty environment. They even have an impressive selection of wine and beer that will perfectly compliment your specialty pizza, fried ravioli, and pepperoni sticks!

name: Orient Express
description: A swanky cocktail bar and cafe, Orient Express will impress you at every turn. The curved ceilings and charming decor create the atmosphere of an old and distinguished dining car, a lovely locale for a memorable date. Start with a mixed appetizer plate featuring dolma, hummus, lebni, lentil balls, and smoked eggplant. For the main event, check out delicious entrees like Turkish kofte (char-grilled ground lamb and beef patties served with pickles and arugula), ratatouille (traditional French Provencal vegetable dish), and chicken panini pressed with coriander and fresh mozzarella. Complement your meal with a glass of wine, imported beer, or a fine craft cocktail. In the day time, stop in and enjoy breakfast and an expert-made espresso. Come embark on a journey and see why Orient Express is such a beloved neighborhood gem.

name: Caffe De La Venezia
description: Caffe de la Venezia is a cozy and casual spot to enjoy hand-crafted Italian fare. With cheery service and a diverse menu, there's something here for everyone. For pizza fans, order your favorite pie topped with the very best ingredients. Or, dig in to hearty pastas, chicken and veal dishes, seafood, and more. Don't forget about dessert at this gem.

name: Blue Maiz Restaurant
description: Dishing up authentic Mexican food in the heart of Midtown, Blue Maiz is a colorful and casual eatery. Order all your favorites at the counter. With tasty picks like burritos, tacos, quesadillas, and more, you can customize your dish just how you like it. Or, check out the sizzling fajitas or crispy flautas; there's plenty to love here!

name: Smoothie King
description: Support a healthy lifestyle with delicious clean smoothies, supplements, and grab-and-go energy food from Smoothie King. Step up to the counter and let the knowledgeable staff help you pick the perfect smoothie for your nutritional needs and taste buds. Low calorie, high protein, vegan, and/or nutrient rich fare -- Smoothie King has it all!

name: Smokey D'Z BBQ & Catering
description: Home of the backyard BBQ, Smokey D'Z BBQ & Catering is the perfect place to enjoy all your favorite cooked low-and-slow flavors. Famous for their Cake Daddy Cake Bowls and specializing in tender, juicy, hickory-wood smoked barbecue, there's plenty here to tempt you. Pulled pork, brisket, ribs, chicken, and links--they do it all at this eatery!

name: La Bamba Tacos & Beer
description: In the mood for some delicious Mexican cuisine? La Bamba Tacos & Beer works as a family and a team to better serve your needs and provide quality Mexican food and service that they are proud of. Some of their most popular menu items include carne asada street tacos, super fries, al pastor street tacos, and much more!

name: The Edge
description: The Edge is a trendy Hamilton Heights eatery where delicious food and a casual vibe intermingle to create a dining and drinking experience you aren't soon to forget. Housed on a gorgeous tree-lined street, this eatery is just a quick trip from downtown Harlem, making it a great choice for breakfast, lunch or exploring the brand new full dinner menu with specials which change daily. Or, feel free to stop in for coffee and a pastry, or a seasonal cocktail with Happy Hour specials daily from 11 a.m. until 5 p.m. Family owned and operated, no detail is overlooked. From the creation of each hand-crafted meal to the presentation and drinks, the flavors of Jamaica and England are infused with a touch of New York attitude. Head over any day for breakfast or lunch (brunch) and feast on the likes of the coconut fish & chips, the jerk chicken & waffles, or the shrimp & Parmesan grits. For a special treat, drop by for a leisurely weekend brunch and enjoy traditional fare like ackee & saltfish & festival, the jerk Caesar salad, their famous smoked salmon platter, the popular salmon burger, or a classic like the bagel and smoked salmon. For dinner, small plates are where it's at, and with choices like spicy shrimp & mango salsa, codfish fritters, and the savory pie of the day, there's something for everyone. After dark, the ambiance turns lively as people sip on quality wines and frosty brews, and listen to live entertainment (check out their Facebook page for a list of upcoming performances or call ahead). Located close to the A, B, C, D, and 1 subway lines, The Edge is what drinking and dining in Harlem is all about! -- Please check out burger night Mondays and live music Wednesdays!

name: Royal Pizza of Norwood
description: Royal Pizza of Norwood has all the flavors you're craving! With a big selection of casual and tasty eats, you can get your hands on pizzas topped just the way you like them, hot and cold subs, specialty wraps, pastas, burgers, hearty dinners, and more. Made fresh from the best quality ingredients, there's plenty here to tempt everyone!

name: Pickles Deli
description: Pickles Deli is dedicated to handcrafting classic sandwiches with the best available meats, ingredients, and breads in town. Their locally owned and operated deli is passionate about the community and continues to give back to local groups in the St. Louis area. They were voted St. Louis' #1 Delicatessen 8 years in a row!

name: Andersons Eatery and Distillery
description: Anderson Distillery and Grill serves up a unique blend of craft eats and micro-distilled spirits in an industrial bar atmosphere unlike any other Roanoke restaurant. They pride themselves on combining carefully-sourced ingredients with scratch-cooking to serve up gourmet sliders, fresh salads, loaded fries, and more.

name: 5th & Mad
description:
5th & MAD, located in Midtown Manhattan is a Irish influenced bar and restaurant with a bi-level space that lends itself perfectly to hosting events for groups of up to 300. INSIDER at 5th & MAD is the restaurant taking center stage on the main floor. Head Chef Carlos Cruz and his team have put together a menu that is versatile for any occasion. Whether you're grabbing a quick bite at lunch, dining with friends or looking for a late night snack. The 40-foot full-service bar stocks everything from beer, wine and spirits to cleverly crafted cocktails, which blend the casual bar vibe that runs throughout with a casual dining experience. The Lobby Bar on the mezzanine level is the perfect intimate gathering place for an after work catch-up, pre-show cocktails, or a secret rendezvous or  late-night party. The Lobby Bar is a time-warp to the golden age of speakeasies, and the 1920s-style clandestine bar serves an extensive menu of spirits and specially crafted cocktails  specializing in gin.

 Whatever the occasion , casual dinner, catch a game, after work happy hour, birthday, cocktails with friends  the 5th & MAD team will make your night one to remember.

name: Paradise Island
description: Paradise Island Restaurant in Staten Island is a culinary destination that offers a diverse menu featuring a mix of Caribbean and American cuisine, known for its flavorful dishes and vibrant atmosphere. The restaurant's decor is themed to give diners a tropical island experience, complete with colorful accents and a relaxed setting. It's a popular spot for both locals and visitors looking to enjoy delicious food in a unique and inviting environment, where the warmth of the staff complements the overall dining experience.

name: DD Mau Vietnamese Eatery
description: DD Mau Vietnamese Eatery is a fast-casual restaurant that's dishing up authentic flavors and traditional dishes. Serving quality ingredients in every dish, everything here is hand-crafted and oh-so delish. Check out popular picks like customizable bowls, sliders, and rolls, or feast on a fully loaded banh mi sandwich. There's pho, too!

name: Ned Kelly's Irish Pub
description: Ned Kelly's Irish Pub offers a welcoming and authentic Irish pub experience in the heart of downtown. With its cozy atmosphere, back patio, and Irish charm, patrons can enjoy a flair of Ireland right in their neighborhood. Whether guests are looking for a pint of Guinness or a refreshing cocktail, Ned Kelly's is the perfect spot to unwind and enjoy good company.

name: Yara
description: For delicious and healthy Lebanese cuisine, choose Yara. The warm restaurant has a chic, yet welcoming environment perfect for enjoying authentic dishes and craft cocktails with friends and family. The menu focuses on clean, fresh ingredients that highlight a healthy Mediterranean lifestyle and even features a variety of vegan dishes. Stop by today!

name: Kolaches And Coffee
description: Kolaches and Coffee, a coffee shop in Overland Park, Kansas, is known for its signature products, including soft, fluffy kolaches made with organic jam and sweet fruit and cheese. The company's commitment to quality and authenticity has earned it a reputation for premium coffee experiences. The shop has expanded to cater to locals' needs and become a go-to destination for those seeking genuine flavors and a warm atmosphere. Kolaches and Coffee has firmly secured its place in the hearts and taste buds of Overland Park residents.

name: Pakos Fresh Mex
description: In the mood for some of the most delicious Tex Mex around? Come check out Pakos Fresh Mex for an option that is sure to leave you satisfied. They are a small, family-owned Mexican food truck that travels all around the DMV! You can count on them for a delicious and fresh meal made form the absolute best quality ingredients.

name: Los Toltecos
description: With legendary margaritas, sizzling fajitas and other south-of-the-border fare, and stellar service, Los Toltecos is a fabulous place to go when craving big and bold flavors. Here, they're making home-style Mexican fare from the finest and freshest ingredients. You'll find a variety of popular dishes on the menu, plus regional specialties to tempt you. Go hungry for lunch or dinner and feast on cool and creamy guacamole, tender carne asada, arroz con pollo, stuffed burritos, or saucy enchiladas. There's plenty more on the menu to try, including vegetarian picks. Kids get their own special menu here, so bring them along! From the bar, check out their famous margaritas or sip on an ice-cold cerveza. It's all terrific, and with a great vibe, this can be your new go-to when you're in the mood for Mexican cuisine! Please note: Los Toltecos also caters. Call ahead for details.

name: The Barnyard Crafthouse & Eatery
description: The Barnyard Crafthouse & Eatery is a low-key destination complete with a patio, serving burgers, salads, and sandwiches, along with shared plates and desserts. They redesigned an elegant barn to provide a quality dining environment and event space with great indoor and outdoor ambiance. Stop by for a great dining experience.

name: Willie Jewell's Old School Bar-B-Que
description: Willie Jewell's Old School Bar-B-Que is a popular restaurant chain known for its dedication to traditional Southern-style barbecue. The eatery prides itself on its slow-smoked meats, cooked over low heat for up to 12 hours to achieve deep, rich flavors and tender textures. The menu features a variety of barbecue favorites, including brisket, ribs, pulled pork, and chicken, all served with a selection of homemade sides like macaroni and cheese, collard greens, and baked beans. Willie Jewell's also offers a range of sauces to complement the smoky meats.

name: Marty's
description: Marty's is serving up American classics that are sure to make your mouth water. The laid-back joint offers all your favorite comfort food including tasty sandwiches, hot dogs, hand-cut fries, and awfully delicious, never frozen burgers guaranteed to satisfy all your cravings. Stop by today or order online for takeout for an amazing meal on the go.

name: Wing It On!-Waterbury
description: Wing It On! is a popular spot known for its crispy, flavorful wings that come in a variety of unique and classic sauces. Customers rave about the generous portion sizes and the high-quality ingredients used in their dishes. In addition to wings, the menu features a range of tasty options including sandwiches, wraps, and sides, all crafted to satisfy diverse palates.

name: Rockwells American Restaurants
description: Rockwells American Restaurants offers a classic American dining experience with a menu featuring a variety of comfort foods, including burgers, steaks, and seafood. The restaurant is known for its welcoming atmosphere, making it a popular spot for both casual meals and special occasions. Additionally, Rockwells hosts events providing entertainment that complements its hearty dishes and friendly service.

name: Carl's Jr
description: In the mood for a convenient and satisfying meal? Come check out Carl's Jr for an option that hits every single time. This classic American favorite is known for their delicious angus burgers stacked with bacon and onion. They also serve breakfast! Come try their Monster Biscuit or the Breakfast Burger to start your day off with a bang.

name: Blu
description: Blu is a quaint lakeside restaurant offering a charming blend of gourmet cuisine and scenic views. Nestled along the shores of Lake Michigan, Blu provides guests with a memorable dining experience, combining fresh, locally-sourced ingredients with innovative culinary techniques. Whether indulging in their signature seafood dishes or savoring a glass of wine on the outdoor patio, Blu promises a delightful taste of Northern Michigan's culinary treasures.

name: Jack in the Box
description: Just about everyone knows Jack from Jack in the Box with his telltale ping pong ball head, but what they might not know is just how good the food is at this favorite fast-food eatery. For more than 60 years, this all-American chain has been dishing up burgers, all-day breakfasts and a variety of Americanized snacks like eggrolls and tacos. This is not, however, your typical fast-food burger joint. With dishes only made once you place your order, the menu offers diners a variety of decidedly different dining options. From the Sourdough Jack (served on authentic sourdough bread) to the Bacon Ultimate Cheeseburger with two kinds of cheese, there are enough burger options to cure just about every craving. There's plenty more on the menu, including garden-fresh salads with grilled chicken, Chicken Pita sandwiches, grilled sandwiches, their famous Curly Fries, and much more. Jack in the Box is also known for their real ice cream milkshakes.  Regardless if you order one to go with your meal or to enjoy as a dessert, they really are delectable. Plus, with a rotating selection of seasonal and promotional dishes to try, you can make this your new favorite fast-food restaurant and never tire of the food! Get there today and dine-in or choose a location with a handy drive-thru, but make Jack in the Box your first choice when craving fabulous fast-and-delicious-food!

name: Cluckers Charcoal Chicken
description: Well into its third decade, Clucker's Charcoal Chicken remains the Windy City's favorite poultry-centric destination. Patrons come from miles around to get their hands on Clucker's amazingly delicious rotisserie chicken and other accompanying goodies. Each chicken is all natural and hormone free, so they cook up plump, juicy, and delicious each and every time. "From the coop and straight to your plate," these are the best quality birds around. Each delicious bird is marinated in a vibrant blend of natural fruit juices and zesty herbs. Then they're slow cooked to absolute golden-brown perfection over a live charcoal fire. By the time Clucker's adds on the slaw, tortillas, sauce (BBQ, pesto, or salsa), and sides, you'll have the meal you deserve. They've got quarter Cluckers, half Cluckers, brick chicken, and more. There's something for every appetite, including feasts fit for the entire team, family, or group. Clucker's sports some fantastic starters too, including the eatery's famous chili and wings as hot or mild as you can stand them. Throw salads, burgers, brisket platters, and other mouthwatering specialties into the mix, and Clucker's becomes your go-to stop for just about any occasion: dine-in, carry-out, delivery, or catering.

name: Turks & Frogs
description: Turks and Frogs is a sophisticated wine bar exemplifying all the intimacy and novelty of the West Village neighborhood. The wine list is unbeatable and features a wide variety of selections from all over the world. The menu is filled with delicious Mediterranean tapas like smoked eggplant, poached beef dumplings tossed in a light garlic yogurt sauce, and savory chicken skewers served with rice and arugula salad. Cheese plates are also available. Pair your Pinot noir with a creamy and nutty Gruyere plate or enjoy a Bucheron plate with your glass of Sauvignon blanc. The beautiful restaurant has a romantic ambiance making it the perfect spot to bring that special someone. Turks and Frogs welcomes private parties. Whether you're hosting an intimate gathering with friends, or an event with coworkers, your guests are sure to have a relaxed and memorable evening. Open seven days a week from 4 p.m.-2 a.m., enjoy great wine and food all night long.

name: Lexington Pizza Parlour
description: Lexington Pizza Parlour is an upscale 20-seat restaurant serving authentic brick-oven pizza and refined Italian cuisine. The cozy outside patio seating lets you enjoy your meal while people-watching in one of the most vibrant and diverse metropolises in the world, New York City. Find delicious panini, New York style pizza, and cheesy calzones on their lunch menu, along with fabulous salads. At sundown, the pizza parlour converts and the daily specials become the evening stars. Rigatoni Bolognese and a classic chicken Parmigiana grace the menu along with other delectable dishes like handmade ravioli and homemade gnocchi drizzled in a sage-infused brown butter. Signature dishes include the daily selection of whole fish oven-roasted to perfection in their large pizza ovens and succulent Roman artichokes. Homemade desserts include tempting selections like their authentic tiramisu and chocolate hazelnut pizza with fresh raspberry sauce. Lexington Pizza Parlour is open for lunch and dinner and can host your next small party or event --they also have an extensive catering menu available. Dine-in or order online for expeditious delivery or carryout.

name: Ashley's Restaurant  Bar
description: With a modern vibe, terrific service, and chef-crafted eats, Ashley's Restaurant & Bar is a terrific pick when you're headed out. Family-owned and operated, this is a comfortable and welcoming space for families, friends, date-night outings, or for cheering on your team on game day. You can't beat the lineup of tasty eats and cold drinks here.

name: Vega Caffe Mexican Deli - Downtown
description: Vega Caffe Mexican Deli serves up a tantalizing fusion of Mexican flavors with the cozy ambiance of a deli. From hearty breakfast burritos to savory tacos and homemade salsas, every dish at Vega Caffe is crafted with authentic ingredients and love. With friendly service and a menu that caters to both traditional and adventurous palates, it's a go-to spot for those craving a taste of Mexico in their neighborhood.

name: Little Mike's
description: Famous for their NYC style pizzas, pastas, and more, Little Mike's is a tasty and convenient place to get a great meal at a great price. There's plenty on the menu at this friendly spot, including paninis, garden-fresh salads, wings and garlic knots, and so much more. Catering services are also available for events of all kinds.

name: Rise and Shine a Steak & Egg Place
description: Rise and Shine a Steak & Egg Place has proudly been serving delicious food to the local community since 2010! They are a family-owned and operated business that has been whipping up amazing breakfast and lunch favorites for two generations. Stop by to explore their exciting menu of classic American dishes, juices, smoothies, and more!

name: Marco's Pizza - Jefferson
description: Craving amazing pizza made from high-quality ingredients? Then Marco's Pizza is the place for you. Whether you want a little taste of Italy delivered to your table or right to your doorstep, there's nothing better than a slice of Marco's. The specialty pizzas are a big draw, so load up on temptations like the White Cheesy, which features an award-winning combination of four types of cheese (including feta), plus bacon, onions, sliced tomatoes, and a garlic butter sauce. The New Yorker provides mega slices with big tastes, while the Deluxe Uno is one of Marco's most popular combinations, pairing up pepperoni, sausage, mushrooms, green peppers, onions, and extra cheese. It's fun creating your own pizzas too, so pile on your favorite ingredients to create delicious fusions. Each pizza is made with fresh dough that's prepared in store each and every day, then topped with Marco's signature sauce. Even the cheese is fresh...it's never frozen! Plus, with free crust toppers like butter garlic or Roma seasoning, your pizza is guaranteed to provide a flavor-packed punch. It's not all pizzas at Marco's, as the kitchen turns out an excellent collection of specialties -- from chicken wings to the signature salads to freshly-baked subs -- made to order just for you.

name: Blue Agave Street Tacos and Margaritas
description: Blue Agave Street Tacos and Margaritas is a sleek and exciting destination that provides high-end Mexican cuisine. Try their fresh handmade margaritas, fan-favorite tacos, or another authentic dish packed with flavor. This destination is great for a night on the town amongst great company and impressive service.

name: Colonia BBQ
description: Colonia BBQ was started by entrepreneur and food enthusiast Sofia Texeira, who prides herself in providing authentic Portuguese cuisine. Although they are famous for their delicious and fresh BBQ meats, they also serve a variety of seafood, sandwiches, desserts, coffee, tea, and much more for you to enjoy.

name: Thai House
description: Thai House is a family owned and operated eatery that's dedicated to serving you the very best Thai food. Welcoming and friendly, this is the perfect spot to explore the food of Thailand. From street food classics to traditional dishes, there's plenty on the menu to tempt you. And with reasonable prices, it's a great pick any day of the week.

name: Sabor-s-peru
description: Sabor-S-Peru is a distinguished Peruvian restaurant that brings the rich and diverse flavors of Peru to its patrons. The restaurant prides itself on using fresh, authentic ingredients to create traditional Peruvian dishes that are both vibrant and flavorful. From ceviche to lomo saltado, each dish is meticulously prepared to showcase the unique culinary heritage of Peru.

name: Taim Mediterranean Kitchen
description: Taim is a staple in the community, and their name literally means 'tasty'! They use the best ingredients, spices, and time-honored Mediterranean cooking techniques to create a one-of-a-kind experience. On Sundays, try their crave combo! For just $10, choose your favorite signature pitas served with fresh cut fries.

name: Leeside Pub
description: Leeside Pub is a part of the Quahog Republic family, a carefully curated collection of four bars and restaurants that stand out, each for their own reasons. Located in the beautiful peninsula of Cape Cod, this local hotspot offers some of the most incredible seafood dishes, such as their lobster grilled cheese and their famous chowder.

name: Vito's Pizza & Italian Ristorante
description: For over two decades, Vito's Pizza Place & Ristorante has been the place to go for Italian dining in Mesa. In the years since it opened, little has changed except that more recognition and accolades continue pour in from all over, marking Vito's a must-see destination. Of course, the food is the true test, and it's drawn from family recipes that create a menu of delectable authentic Italian dishes.  Here, Northern and Southern Italian styles of cooking blend with freshest ingredients to offer diners everything from thin-crust pizzas and shrimp cocktail, to salmon piccata, lobster ravioli and pesto gnocchi. Whether you're having lunch or dinner, finish it off with homemade tiramisu or homemade cannoli. The wine list is excellent, and the décor a stylishly casual take on Old World themes that pays colorful homage to Vito's Italian heritage. The entire menu is available for take-out or delivery, and Vito's can host larger events on- or off-site.

name: Local Cantina - Grandview
description: Local Cantina is a locally owned Mexican-inspired bar and restaurant. They pride themselves on their creative offerings, fresh drinks and fun environment. Let them host your next meal so that you can try any of their flavorful tacos, craft cocktails and delicious desserts. Stop by today for an unforgettable dining experience!

name: The Skinny Pancake - Albany
description: The Skinny Pancake is a tasty spot offering up breakfast, lunch, and dinner fare. On a mission to change the world by offering delicious food in a placed that's fun and affordable, there's plenty to love about this local favorite. Showcasing sweet and savory crepes, there are also burgers, sandwiches and salads plus cocktails and beers here.

name: Stack'd Burger Bar
description: Beloved by foodies, Stack'd Burger Bar offers tasty burgers made with premium local ingredients. Effortlessly cool and comfortable with high ceilings and exposed brick walls, this is an excellent space to meet up with friends for a cold one or enjoy a family feast. Build your own burger with protein choices like 100% grass-fed beef, natural free-range chicken, bison, house-made black bean veggie burger, and the Impossible Burger. Stack that burger with your choices from a staggering array of cheeses, toppings, and sauces. Bun options include classic, soft pretzel, naked on a bed of greens, and Rich's Gluten-Free Roll. Can't decide? Try a specialty burger like the hangover stack with grass-fed beef smothered with fried onions, bacon, Wisconsin cheddar, lettuce, tomato, and a fried egg. Pair your perfect burger with delicious sides like hand-cut fries, creamy coleslaw, fried pickles, and twisted mac and cheese. With over 100 bottle and tap selections and one of the best craft cocktail programs around, you're sure to find the perfect drink complement to your meal. Stop by weekdays from 2-6 p.m. for Happy Hour specials on drinks. A locally-owned spot centering great eats, great drinks, and community spirit, Stack'd Burger Bar is a gem.

name: Trattoria Dell'Arte
description: Trattoria Dell'Arte is a vibrant Italian restaurant renowned for its art-themed decor and extensive menu of classic Italian dishes. Located near Carnegie Hall, it offers a lively atmosphere perfect for both casual dining and special occasions. The restaurant is particularly famous for its antipasti bar, featuring a wide variety of fresh, seasonal ingredients.

name: Double Zero
description: At Double Zero, they offer a fresh take on the world's favorite food. Their menu showcases pizzas crafted in a custom wood-burning oven, small plates with distinctive tree-nut cheeses, plant-based desserts, and a selection of organic and sustainable European wines. Nestled in East Village, their flagship location provides a warm, casual environment to enjoy delightful culinary offerings.

name: Stick To My Pot Potsticker
description: Stick To My Pot Potstickers is a casual and cozy eatery in Midtown West that offers fun to eat and oh-so delicious potstickers, umami-rich braised pork baos, a variety of dumplings, crispy spring rolls, and more. Every dish is hand-crafted in-house daily from the finest ingredients. This means that each potsticker, each dumpling, and each and every dish on the menu is hand-rolled, hand-pinched, and hand-crafted to be delicious. Stop by any time for lunch, dinner or a snack and feast on your choice of pan-fried or steamed potstickers or dumplings filled with turkey, the classic which is a blend of shrimp and pork, the vegan filling, or mix and match all your favorites. Pair your picks with pickled Napa cabbage, scallion pancakes, or any of the other tasty dishes. Eating here is also affordable so pop by Stick To My Pot Potstickers today for something fabulous! Please note: Take-out, delivery, and catering options are also available.

name: Cka Ka Qellue
description: With a unique homey vibe, dining at Cka Ka Qellue is always an experience. Serving hand-crafted Albanian cuisine, you'll feel like you're dining in a friend's rustic home at this popular spot. Try the popular clay dishes, grilled fare, stuffed dumplings, and more. Always crafted from the finest ingredients, the stellar service is an added bonus.

name: Outback Steakhouse #535
description: Australia and barbecues go hand-in-hand, and while a trip down under might be out of the question, there's sure to be an Outback Steakhouse near you. Famous for a warm environment, generous portions, and juicy meats for an incredible price, they are a fan-favorite, Australian-inspired steakhouse complete with a full bar!

name: Nadeau's Subs Salads Wraps - Exeter
description: Get your fill of premium quality subs, salads, and wraps at Nadeau's Subs, a popular fast-casual eatery with a long history. The first location opened way back in 1969 with a commitment to superior service, a family-friendly atmosphere, and to providing great food. Those same guiding principles are in effect today, and they're just as important now as they were then. The flagship location has the distinction of being the longest continually operating sub shop in the city, and over the decades, more locations have opened. Still family-owned and operated, a tasty meal is just an order away, and only the best ingredients are used to hand-craft each taste sensation. Freshly-baked rolls, USDA choice sirloin is used in their famous steak subs, all-natural chicken breast, meats sliced daily in-house, and garden-fresh produce are used to make Philly steak subs, stone-fired flatbread pizzas, hot subs and sandwiches, cold subs, wraps, and more. You can choose from any of  their signature creations and customize it with veggies, condiments, sauces, and even change up the bread. Drop by and fill up on something amazing today, and if you need catering, Nadeau's is the place to call!

name: El Pollo Loco - Telegraph - Washington
description: El Pollo Loco is a restaurant chain known for its signature flame-grilled chicken marinated in a special blend of herbs, spices, and citrus juices. Founded in 1975 in Mexico, it has since expanded to numerous locations across the United States, offering a menu that includes burritos, tacos, and fresh salads. The restaurant is popular for its focus on fresh, healthy ingredients and its commitment to quality and flavor.

name: DimSum Garden
description: Dimsum Garden offers a delectable array of traditional dim sum dishes served in a bustling, authentic atmosphere. Renowned for its extensive menu featuring steamed dumplings, buns, and savory small plates, Dimsum Garden provides a genuine taste of Chinese culinary tradition. It's a favorite spot among locals and visitors alike seeking an immersive dim sum experience.

name: Junior's Cheesecake Mail Order
description: Since the 1950s, Junior's has been renowned for its excellent food, fun atmosphere, outstanding service, and famously delicious cheesecake. With a diverse menu featuring everything from steaks and seafood to sandwiches and salads, Junior's promises a fantastic mail order experience as well to one's home or office when ordered online. And, of course, don't forget to order dessert!

name: Shango's Urban Taqueria
description: Shango's Urban Taqueria is a vibrant destination where taco aficionados embark on a flavor-filled journey through the diverse and mouthwatering world of Mexican street food. With a menu that showcases inventive taco combinations, Shango's tantalizes taste buds with its fusion of traditional ingredients and contemporary twists, creating a lively dining experience that captures the essence of urban taquerias.

name: Stephanie's Crepes
description: Steps from Miracle Mile, Stephanie's Crepes offers a globally inspired menu where each portable crepe is made with the highest quality ingredients and offered in sweet and savory options with a strong focus on gluten-free offerings. The quintessential crepe experience awaits you at the warm and inviting Stephanie's Crepes.

name: Miss Saigon
description: Miss Saigon Vietnamese Grill & Noodles is a modern and hospitable eatery that's dishing up authentic Vietnamese food. Midday diners love the lunch specials, or stop by for a decadent dinner. There are picks like basil chicken, lemongrass beef, and Saigon spicy shrimp to try. And, every dish is hand-crafted from the very best ingredients.

name: My Thai & Vegan - Frisco
description: My Thai & Vegan offers an exceptional opportunity for you to enjoy traditional authentic Thai taste and flavor (sweet, sour, spicy, and savory) plus many flavorful vegan dishes that will help you stay full and healthy. Every dish is freshly prepared to order right on the premises.

name: Jocy's Restaurant
description: Jocy's Restaurant specializes in breakfast and lunch favorites, all made from scratch! Their philosophy is simple: fresh ingredients make fresh food. Take a well-deserved break from working around the house and let them do the cooking. They now offer easy-to-use online ordering! From breakfast to burgers and tacos, they have it all.

name: Italian Village Trattoria
description: Italian Village Trattoria is a cozy restaurant offering authentic Italian cuisine crafted with passion and tradition. With its warm ambiance and attentive service, diners are transported to the rustic charm of an Italian countryside trattoria, where every dish tells a story of culinary excellence and heritage. From classic pasta dishes to mouthwatering pizzas, Italian Village Trattoria invites guests to savor the essence of Italy in every bite.

name: Neat Bar Food & Lounge
description: Neat Bar & Grill is a locally owned restaurant with a family-friendly atmosphere! Their dog-friendly patio is a great place to relax and enjoy a Guinness or local brew along with quick and tasty meals. Their menu includes specialties like fish & chips, amazing chicken wings, meatloaf sandwiches, and the best burgers in town.

name: IHOP - Peppers Ferry
description: Making food that families love, IHOP is an iconic eatery known for amazing breakfast fare plus lunch and dinner eats. There's plenty on the menu here, including their signature pancakes. Also watch for seasonal specials and their popular family feasts that are available to-go. With something for everyone, you can count on IHOP for a great meal!

name: McALISTER'S DELI  Beaumont
description: McAlister's Deli is a popular American chain known for its extensive menu featuring sandwiches, salads, soups, and signature sweet tea. Founded in 1989 in Oxford, Mississippi, the deli has grown to over 450 locations across the United States. McAlister's is celebrated for its friendly service and comfortable, casual dining atmosphere.

name: Bek's Nizza Pizza  Lamar
description: Bek's Nizza Pizza is a New York style pizzeria. Famous for their authentic pizzas, home-made pastas, subs, salads, and more, there's plenty on the menu at this local favorite. It's a family owned and operated spot, so when you're hungry for flavor at a reasonable price, dine-in, call for pickup, or order online for delivery!

name: Pop's Bagels - Brentwood
description: Pop's Bagels serves gluten free bagels that marry an incredibly light and fluffy interior with their signature crispy exterior. This must-try bagel spot started as a passion project from founder Zach Liporace, who has been perfecting his bagel and cream cheese recipes for years. Stop by today for an incredible selection of wonderful bagels!

name: Highness Cuisine
description: Highness Cuisine is where passion for unparalleled culinary artistry comes to life in the heart of Atlanta. Experience luxurious dining at this upscale Atlanta establishment, featuring a full bar, hookah, and a sophisticated cigar lounge. Every ingredient is a testament to their dedication to quality, and every moment spent is steeped in luxury.

name: Pichurros Mexican Grill Cypres
description: Pichurro's Mexican Grill serves up vibrant and authentic Mexican cuisine in a welcoming atmosphere. Their menu boasts a variety of flavorful dishes, from sizzling fajitas to mouthwatering tacos, made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. With friendly service and a cozy setting, Pichurro's Mexican Grill offers a delightful dining experience for all.

name: Mithaas
description: Indian cuisine is synonymous with street food, offering a culinary journey through diverse flavors. Mithaas, a pioneering restaurant in New Jersey and New York, elevates traditional Indian fast food into a modern dining experience. It offers an expansive menu of authentic street food, chaat, North and South Indian delicacies, Indo-Chinese dishes, and traditional mithai, providing a comfortable and homely ambiance for business meetings or lively evenings.

name: Cafe Suliman
description: Café Suliman draws inspiration from the casual cafés and eateries of the Levant, Egypt, North Africa, and the Arabian Gulf. They offer simple, comforting home-cooked food that celebrates the richness of the Arabian pantry in a cozy cafe setting. Partnering with Marc Papineau of Cantina Sauvage, Café Suliman provides expertly curated glass pours and retail bottles, making it ideal for casual lunches, coffee breaks, drinks, or leisurely dinners.

name: El Pollo Supremo
description: Dishing up amazing eats that are always hand-crafted, El Pollo Supremo is the place to go for unique and delicious dishes. Chicken is the star of the show at this casual eatery, and you'll find it prepared a variety of ways. With Latin American, Mexican, and Cuban dishes on the menu, there's always something new to try at this popular spot!

name: Firehouse Subs
description: People love a good meal, and at Firehouse Subs you can be sure that your meal will be terrific. Built on a legacy of fire and police service, this entrepreneurial eatery started small but has grown to more than 900 locations, all committed to serving the best quality meats, cheeses, and produce in hearty and delicious subs, sandwiches, and salads.

name: Rusty Anchor
description: Located right on the water and with a spectacular outdoor patio, waterfront dining has never been better or tastier than it is at The Rusty Anchor. This is a locally owned and casual spot. Perfect for lazy lunches or dinners after a day out on the water, every dish is hand-crafted from the finest and tastiest ingredients. Get your hands on a delicious burger or the blackened ahi tuna sandwich that's always made to-order. If you're looking for a heartier meal, check out seafood favorites like the fried catfish, blackened shrimp Alfredo, or the grilled grouper. Craving a steak? They've got those too, and they're always perfectly prepared. Just be sure to save room for their famous brownie sundae! There's also a full-service bar here, so order your favorite cocktail then kick-back and enjoy the views. Stick around after your meal for some good times at Catfish Johnny's where live entertainment and outdoor dining and drinking is always fabulous! Great food, drinks and fun times are waiting for you at The Rusty Anchor -- set sail today for this great restaurant and bar!

name: Los Abuelos Mexican Grill-Newnan
description: Searching for a casual and exciting spot where you can enjoy some delicious and authentic Mexican cuisine? Come check out Los Abuelos Mexican Grill in Newnan to experience the legendary taste of Mexico, amongst the art and culture of Mexico. Their dishes are made from the heart and crafted with pride from grandmother's recipes. Don't forget to check out their newest location in Johns Creek!

name: Chi Restaurant & Bar
description: Chi Restaurant & Bar offers a vibrant fusion of Asian cuisine in a stylish and contemporary setting. With a diverse menu featuring traditional dishes alongside innovative creations, Chi caters to a wide range of tastes and preferences. Whether you're craving sushi, dim sum, or signature cocktails, Chi promises an unforgettable dining experience infused with culinary excellence.

name: Fratellos Hot Dogs
description: Allow Fratello's Hot Dogs to reintroduce you to the Chicago classics like delicious Vienna Red Hots and mouthwatering milkshakes. They have been serving terrific eats since 1975, with a menu of Italian beef & sausage, the savory chicken pesto panini, and charbroiled burgers. Stop in for a nostalgic atmosphere and unforgettable food!

name: Beef Shack
description: They're making it fast and making it good at Beef Shack. Home of the famous Cheezy Beef, this eatery is piling on the beefy goodness. Surrounded by classic rock music and a cozy vibe, every Shack is a different experience with a different look. One thing never changes: the food. Always fresh and insanely good, dining here is always a tasty choice.

name: May Kaidee
description: May Kaidee is a plant-based Thai restaurant in lower Manhattan. Featuring hand-crafted and authentic dishes, you'll find all the fabulous flavors of Thai food made vegan. From green papaya salad and tom ka soup to heartier picks like curries, pad Thai, and stir-fries, you can add plant-based proteins to most meals. Fresh and tasty, it's all great!

name: SENYAI Thai Street Food & Noodle Bar
description: Senyai Thai Noodle Bar offers a vibrant and authentic Thai dining experience. Senyai Thai Noodle Bar features a menu brimming with traditional Thai dishes such as Massaman Curry, Pad Thai, and various noodle soups, all prepared with fresh ingredients and bursting with genuine flavors​​. The cozy and inviting atmosphere, adorned with Thai-style décor, makes Senyai a favorite spot for locals and visitors alike, offering a true taste of Thailand right in Jacksonville​.

name: Veritas Whiskey & Wine
description: Our American fusion menus, developed by chef and owner Rolfe Loomis, bring you the best from an American wood-fired grill featuring locally sourced foods while incorporating flavors from around the world. We offer a variety of charcuterie, small plates, burgers, salads, paella, seafood and great steaks. Our dishes are made fresh to order using farm fresh ingredients. We locally source our produce and meats from the Midwest. Seafood is procured from trusted sources and flown in weekly. Experience a unique brunch featuring a breakfast small plates menu and extensive brunch cocktail options.

name: Route 66 Bar & Grill
description: Route 66 Cafe is serving up contemporary American comfort food in a fun, casual environment. The nostalgic decor and rustic atmosphere will make you feel like you're dining right along this historic highway. The menu has been carefully crafted with an emphasis on fresh, quality ingredients. Stop in for breakfast and savor delectable dishes like eggs and omelets, golden buttermilk pancakes, and spicy huevos rancheros. The lunch/dinner menu is equally as delicious featuring mouthwatering burgers, tasty wraps and sandwiches, and pastas. Specials are available daily so you can satisfy all your cravings without breaking the bank. Open 7 a.m.-12:30 a.m. seven days a week, grab your friends and family and cozy up with great food at Route 66 Cafe.

name: Durbins
description: Durbins restaurant blends their passion for crafting delicious food with their extensive knowledge of their cuisine to create authentic and classic dishes for the enjoyment of their customers. They are committed to using the freshest, locally-sourced ingredients and ensuring an exciting experience for their patrons' taste buds.

name: Tasty Crab
description: Tasty Crab tantalizes taste buds with its signature Cajun-inspired flavors centered around fresh and flavorful crab, shrimp, and other seafood delights. They invite patrons to roll up their sleeves and dive into a hands-on dining adventure and communal experience. Whether guests prefer their seafood spicy or not, Tasty Crab's menu and space have it all for a delightful fusion of Southern hospitality and mouthwatering seafood.

name: Hail Mary Pizza
description: It's not just a pizza restaurant, but pizza and bread are the cornerstones of the menu at Hail Mary Pizza. Using ethically and locally-sourced ingredients like organic wheat and grains and wild yeasts, their dough is made fresh daily and long, cold fermented. Come check out tasty pizza, salads, bites, natural wine, and beer. Keep an eye on their rotating menu as it is seasonal and subject to change.

name: Taim Mediterranean Kitchen
description: Taim is a staple in the community, and their name literally means 'tasty'! They use the best ingredients, spices, and time-honored Mediterranean cooking techniques to create a one-of-a-kind experience. On Sundays, try their crave combo! For just $10, choose your favorite signature pitas served with fresh cut fries.

name: Gamarjoba
description: Discover amazing and authentic Eastern European cuisine at Gamarjoba, formerly known as New Georgian House. This is a polished eatery with a large, heated patio. Go for lunch or dinner and feast on hand-crafted specialties like kebabs, lamb shanks, and the house specialty, smoked hocks. There's much more to try at this popular spot!

name: Mya's Bar & Kitchen
description: In the mood for something fresh and exciting? Mya's Bar & Kitchen serves the best Jamaican Cuisine in the Bronx. With a Southern infusion, you will find no Caribbean taste that competes with their unique flavors! All of their items are cooked fresh with love, cooked to order with a keen attention to quality.

name: Umi Japanese
description: Umi Japanese offers a unique twist to the Japanese cuisine found here in Central Florida. Their chefs prepare each menu item utilizing meticulous methods starting from the preparation all the way down to the execution. Presented to you are bold dishes that express refinement and art and are made from the freshest ingredients.

name: Kaze Sushi And Hibachi Restaurant
description: At Kaze Sushi And Hibachi Restaurant, the menu is a symphony of flavors, showcasing a diverse selection of sushi rolls, sashimi, and hibachi specialties crafted from the finest ingredients. Whether diners are craving classic favorites like California rolls or daring to explore more adventurous creations, there is something to tantalize every palate.

name: Villa Formia
description: Villa Formia is a charming Italian restaurant offering authentic, homemade dishes inspired by traditional recipes. From freshly made pasta to wood-fired pizzas, every dish is crafted with the finest ingredients and a passion for Italian cuisine. The warm, inviting atmosphere makes it the perfect spot for a cozy meal with family or friends.

name: Papa Johns 2395
description: Better ingredients really do make better pizzas, and at Papa John's, each hand-crafted and made-to-order pizza is fresh, hot, and delicious. They don't need gimmicks at this coast-to-coast pizza chain, because it's always just that good. Quality is at the core of everything they do, and from the pizza crust to the finishing toppings, it's all the best it can be. Curbside and contactless pickup available.

name: Patron
description: Patron Mexican Grill is open daily for lunch Wednesday through Sunday and dinner seven days a week so that when your taste buds crave spice they can be assuaged at this fantastic restaurant. This eatery specializes in flavor which can be found in their Tex-Mex favorites, authentic Mexican dishes, ceviche and more. If you're looking for an genuine Mexican dish try the Yucatan Style Cochinita Pibil. A combination of marinated pork is slowly roasted until it is fall apart tender, then wrapped in a banana leaf and topped with habanero red pickled onions. Less adventurous diners can still feast on fajitas, enchiladas and a variety of fabulous tacos. The guacamole at this restaurant is truly spectacular: fresh avocados are mixed with jicama, cucumber, pineapple, pomegranates, Serrano chilies and more to give it a spicy tropical taste. It is always fresh and made only when you order it. Sink a freshly made corn tortilla chip into it and scoop up some truly outstanding guac. To really be authentic, start your meal off with a shot of any of their varieties of tequila, or order a house-made margarita. Sundays, Mondays and Tuesdays feature all-day happy hour with happy hour drink specials, and Wednesdays and Thursdays between 12:00 p.m. and 7:00 p.m are also happy hour times. The next time you want a taste of Mexico without leaving the city, stop by the Patron Mexican Grill and let your taste buds go on a culinary journey to flavor-ville.

name: The Helm Provisions & Coastal Fare
description: The Helm Provisions & Coastal Fare is a collaborative raw bar and market experience that toasts the sea's harvests, changing tides, and everyday revelry. They serve sustainably sourced, always fresh seafood caught by local fishermen and cooked to perfection. Stop by this inviting spot for a great dining experience and excellent food.

name: Dallas BBQ
description: When you're in the Bronx and you find yourself craving the delicious and authentic taste of barbeque from the Lonestar State, there's only one option - head on over to Dallas BBQ and get ready for some of the yummiest, most tender and smoky barbeque that you can imagine. For more than 15 years New Yorkers have known that this is the place to go for the city's best - and now with more locations than ever before, getting your hands on their finger lickingly scrumptious barbeque is easier than ever. Roll your sleeves up and dig in to heaping portions of tasty starters, salads, sandwiches, specialties, burgers, entrées and more. Be sure to try the Famous Texas Crispy Wings or their Colossal Onion Loaf (best in the city), then feast on rotisseried chicken, their famous baby back ribs, BBQ Brisket, Carolina Pulled Pork, steak, fish fry meals like the Crispy Cod Filet Platter and much more. Or, save yourself the stress of a decision and opt instead for their Wild West Combos like the House Special with sirloin steak, ribs, crispy shrimp and sides. It doesn't matter what you order because everything is lip smackingly fabulous! The next time you're craving the most delicious barbeque in the city, head on over to Dallas BBQ and get ready to feast!

name: Mexico City Restaurant
description: A third generation, family-owned restaurant famous for their fried tacos, Mexico City Restaurant also has a wide variety of Mexican dishes made from the freshest ingredients. Menudo, green chili, chile rellenos, burritos, and elotes are all excellent choices here.

name: Komoon Thai Sushi Ceviche
description: Reading the menu at Komoon Thai Sushi & Ceviche is like catching part of the opening ceremony of the Olympics. Dishes bearing the flags of Thailand, Japan and Peru proudly enter your view, carrying the varied flavors (if not the athletic hopes) of their respective cultures but all gathered harmoniously in one place. With an exceptional team of sushi, Thai and Peruvian chefs, Komoon Thai Sushi & Ceviche is the only place in the region where you can enjoy delicious cuisines from all of these countries. Owners Saifon Sombun and Paul Adrianzen make it their business not just to offer great tasting food, but also to make sure that you have a memorable dining experience. Upon entering the restaurant, you will be met with warm, contemporary colors, relaxing music and beautiful photos decorating the walls. The friendly, attentive staff will tend to your needs and ensure that you experience the magic. The menu is neatly divided into the various cuisines, including a sizable list of sushi and sashimi dishes. Feel free to mix and match items from any and all parts of the menu. No matter how you choose, you'll dine like a champion.

name: Maracuya by Llama Restaurant
description: Maracuya by Llama Restaurant is a culinary gem where Peruvian flavors and creativity intertwine to offer a unique dining experience. With a menu inspired by the diverse and rich culinary heritage of Peru, Maracuya invites guests to savor the vibrant tastes of Latin America in a stylish and inviting atmosphere curated by the renowned Llama Restaurant.

name: OLIN BAR & KITCHEN
description: Olin Bar & Kitchen is a contemporary dining spot known for its innovative cuisine and sophisticated ambiance. Located in a vibrant neighborhood, it offers a diverse menu blending modern techniques with traditional flavors. The chic decor and welcoming atmosphere make it ideal for any occasion, while the attentive staff ensures an exceptional dining experience with high-quality, fresh ingredients.

name: Ron's Hamburgers & Chili
description: Ron's Hamburger & Chili made its mark all the way back in 1975 when the doors opened to their first eatery. Ron's is a casual, family-friendly burger spot that is perfect for lunch or dinner. With a wide range of burgers available, along with Ron's famous chili, sandwiches, and real draft root beer, there's no chance you're walking out of here hungry. Classic burgers abound in all sorts of combinations, while the favorites lineup kicks things up to a whole new level with the likes of the "Who's Your Daddy?". This massive beast packs two whole pounds of beef, a quarter-pound of cheese, fries and raw onions, mustard, pickles, lettuce, and tomatoes into one daunting, but irresistible package. There are patty melts, country fried steaks, and even a low carb platter that feature a jumbo cheeseburger with bacon pieces, lettuce, and tomato. The toughest part of coming to Ron's is deciding just what you're ordering, because there are still the likes of hamburger steaks, sandwiches and salads, boneless chicken, loads of sides, and of course, that homemade chili to enjoy. Ron's Hamburgers & Chili has received plenty of acclaim over the years for their work, including a four-star award by the International Chili Society and being voted "Best Hamburger and Chili" by the Urban Tulsa Weekly.

name: Melville Tavern
description: From wood-fired pizzas to pastas and saucy wings, there's plenty to tempt you at Melville Tavern. This is a friendly and casual spot complete with great service. There's a spacious bar, plenty of tables, and enough TVs so that you never miss a second of the action. Cold beers and a selection of wines are also available for your sipping pleasure.

name: A La Turka
description: A La Turka has been delighting diners since 1995. This Midtown eatery is a popular spot known for kebabs, seafood, and so much more. With a great view, plenty of indoor and outdoor dining, and terrific service, this Mediterranean eatery is the only one you need when craving something delicious! Catering services are also available.

name: Ferrara Foods and Confections
