description: Since 1982, the Ferrara family has been delighting Little Italy's residents and visitors with its outstanding Italian and French desserts. From cannoli and sfogliatella to gelati and fine cookies, these sweet treats became so popular that Ferrara now ships them nationwide. Come in and enjoy some great baked goods with a coffee, latte or espresso!

name: Spicy Moon
description: Spicy Moon is a culinary gem nestled in the heart of the Bowery neighborhood. The restaurant is known for its bold and fiery flavors. At Spicy Moon, you can expect an extensive menu filled with authentic dishes that will tantalize your taste buds. From mouth-numbing Mapo Tofu to savory noodles, their offerings are a flavorful journey through the rich culinary traditions.

name: Taco Bueno
description: Taco Bueno is a fan-favorite chain serving up delicious tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and more. With delicious meats and vegetarian meals, they have an option here for everyone. Enjoy freshly prepared, mouthwatering food handcrafted in their kitchens, made with real ingredients and customized to your liking.

name: Frankies Gastro
description: Frankie's Gastro is a vibrant gastropub located in the heart of Cliffside Park, NJ. This popular establishment is renowned for its unique blend of traditional and contemporary cuisine, with each dish crafted from locally sourced ingredients and infused with innovative twists. The pub boasts an impressive array of craft beers and signature cocktails, attracting a mix of casual diners and those in search of a sophisticated gastronomic adventure. With its dynamic menu and welcoming atmosphere, Frankie's Gastro has become a beloved spot for both locals and visitors alike.

name: Bangkok Thyme
description: Dishing up traditional and authentic Thai food and sushi in a cozy and inviting dining room, Bangkok Thyme is always a tasty spot to enjoy a great meal out. Perfect for family dinners, date nights, lunch with the office, and more, you can count on tasty meals at this popular eatery. Craving sushi? It's always hand-crafted for the very best flavor.

name: Gloria's Restaurant
description: Gloria's Restaurant is a homegrown family-owned eatery that's been dishing up scratch made goodness in Bowling Green since 2006. Still a popular eatery, you'll find plenty at this breakfast and lunch restaurant. From the daily lunch specials to morning classics and homemade soups, there's always something new to try at this friendly spot.

name: Crab Shell
description: The Crab Shell is one of Stamford's favorite waterside restaurants and bars where great food, cocktails and live entertainment make this the place to see and be seen. With views that can't be beat and both indoor and outdoor dining, you can head over anytime you're in the mood for delicious just-from-the-water seafood. Clams, oysters, shrimp, mussels, lobster, crab and more are turned into mouthwatering dishes that will surely please. Try the grilled Cajun swordfish wrap, lobster pot pie, Maryland crab cakes, or the shrimp, chicken & sausage Creole. Sure, this casual and energized place is seafood centric, but there's plenty for landlubbers, too. Filet mignon, chicken Francaise and BBQ baby back ribs are just a few of the choices for those not interested in fish or shellfish. And, if you're looking for a fun night out, there's no place better than this! With a dockside bar, late-night hours and an unparalleled lineup of live entertainment, you can rock the dock until the wee  hours. (The Crab Shell is open year round, but they are closed Sundays November through February.)

name: Playa Bowls - West Caldwell
description: Playa Bowls is excited to serve you a slice of summer, anytime. Using the freshest and highest quality ingredients, they offer healthy and delicious acai, pitaya, coconut bowls, juices, and smoothies, always keeping sustainability and the community in mind. Customize the bowl or smoothie of your choice and feel satisfied and rejuvenated.

name: Oishi Sushi Restaurant
description: Feast on all your favorite sushi at Oishi Sushi Restaurant. This is a casual and friendly spot with a diverse menu filled with rolls, hand rolls, specialty rolls, sashimi, nigiri, and more. Plus, there's an all-you-can-eat option for a great price. A tasty selection of soups, salads, and sides are available from the kitchen at this trendy eatery.

name: Kabobistan
description: Kabobistan is a quick and casual eatery where you can feast on tasty Mediterranean cuisine. From succulent kabobs to other grilled dishes and plenty of vegetarian picks, there's plenty here to tempt you. Ask about the lunch specials or check out the salads, too. Order online or stop by ad fill up on something delicious today at this popular spot.

name: Taco Bueno
description: Taco Bueno is a fan-favorite chain serving up delicious tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and more. With delicious meats and vegetarian meals, they have an option here for everyone. Enjoy freshly prepared, mouthwatering food handcrafted in their kitchens, made with real ingredients and customized to your liking.

name: Round Table Pizza
description: Round Table Pizza has a storied history, with decades of memories made within their walls. Their new restaurant design acknowledges all that came before, while boldly stepping into the present - providing a contemporary dining experience for friends and family to enjoy today and tomorrow. Come on by today!

name: Hart House - Hollywood
description: Hart House was founded by actor Kevin Hart. It specializes in plant-based cuisine, offering a wide range of healthy and delicious alternatives to traditional fast food. The restaurant is committed to sustainability and wellness, aiming to provide an eco-friendly dining experience. With its casual and welcoming atmosphere, Hart House appeals to both vegans and non-vegans, making it a favorite spot for health-conscious diners.

name: Haven Rooftop
description: Located on top of the Sanctuary Hotel, Haven Rooftop offers guests a chance to indulge in Manhattan's Midtown views while enjoying modern American cuisine, craft cocktails, and cool music. It's the perfect spot to celebrate life in New York City. Get ready to fall in love with Haven Rooftop this season. Business casual attire only please.

name: Fresco Mexican Grill  Salsa Ba
description: Owned and operated by a father and son team, Fresco Mexican Grill & Salsa Bar redefines the concept of fast casual dining. Appropriately named for the Spanish word for "fresh," Fresco Mexican Grill uses only fresh ingredients and all their dishes are prepared to order. Want to make a taco vegetarian or get some extra beans in your burrito? Just ask, and their helpful staff will make it happen. Menu options include tacos, burritos (as a wrap or in a bowl), quesadillas, garden-fresh salads, and their popular homemade guacamole or queso dip starters. An extensive salsa and hot sauce bar allows you to put the finishing touches on your order, and there is domestic and imported beer, Mexican sodas, and frozen margarita, sangria, or sangarita to make your order a full meal. Fresco Mexican's dining space is modern and laidback with counter service, plenty of tables and high-tops, lots of natural light, and brightly colored walls that lighten your mood as soon as you walk in the door. If you're looking to feed a crowd or have a special event coming up, they are available for traditional catering or you can have their food truck come to the venue. Ideal for a quick bite, a leisurely sit-down with friends or family, or grabbing some food to go, Fresco Mexican Grill & Salsa Bar invites you to experience some of the best Mexican fare this side of Texas.

name: Pacos Mexican Cuisine 2
description: Paco's Mexican Cuisine 2 is a family establishment that brings their hometown feel to Fort Worth. They serve traditional dishes from Pachuca, Hidalga Mexico. Their mission is to serve and connect their community from their love of authentic Mexican cuisine. They provide a fun-filled atmosphere that?s perfect for bringing friends and family.

name: Rams House
description: Rams House is a VCU-focused bar and kitchen serving craft beers (36 taps), pizzas, wings, sliders, and cocktails in a spacious bar setting! Whether you're gearing up for the big game, catching up with friends over drinks, or simply soaking in the sports-centric atmosphere, Rams House promises an unforgettable experience.

name: McDonald's - N Tustin St
description: Since 1955, McDonald's has been serving some of the world's favorite food. The golden arches beckon you to a place where you know the food is going to be fast and delicious. McDonald's may be the most iconic fast food restaurant in the world, but it is also the place where you'll find tasty and affordable meals for breakfast, lunch and dinner. From steaming cups of premium blend McCafe coffees to classic Egg McMuffins and fruit & maple oatmeal, mornings have never been tastier. For lunch, dinner and late-night snacks, wrap your hands around hearty and oh-so-satisfying Big Macs, Premium Grilled Chicken Club sandwiches, or the classic Cheeseburger. With sandwiches to make the meal, world famous fries and crisp, garden-fresh salads, you can have a meal that is perfect from the first bite to the last. Kids also love McDonald's -- with their famous Happy Meals, each box is full of child-friendly goodness. The Dollar Menu is also a great choice when needing a snack on the go, or something extra with your meal. No matter when you go, McDonald's will always be there for you with hot, fresh and delish food! Please note: Gift card purchases do not qualify for Rewards points.

name: The Sushi Bar
description: The Sushi Bar is one of the famous fine dining places in Edmond and Oklahoma City. They are a chic yet simple spot, serving sushi and other Japanese delicacies, along with a variety of Asian-inspired dishes, all made from the freshest ingredients. This relaxing destination also has a full bar with a selection of beers and spirits.

name: Carbone's Pizzeria
description: Carbone's Pizzeria is known as the place to go for quality family dining, and amazing award-winning pizzas. Since 1954, diners have been loving the delicious eats at this restaurant that was started by an Italian family who came to America in 1917. Today, with more locations than ever before, a tasty meal is never far. The pizzas are outstanding. Try a specialty "za" like the Taco with all the flavors of the Southwest, or feast on their legendary Super Pie. Topped with all sorts of meats and veggies and their delicious thick crust, this pizza tops them all! There's more on the menu at Carbone's, including hoagies, cheese steak sammies, pastas, burgers and more. And, to wash it all down, ask about the selection of beers and wines. Called one of the best pizza places around, Carbone's is welcoming, family friendly and always a great choice when craving casual and oh-so-delicious pizzas and more!

name: Empire Wingz
description: Empire Wingz proudly serves delicious food to the greater Baton Rouge community. They were voted best wings in Baton Rouge and creators of the BBQ Ranch Fries. You must stop in to try their excellent variety of delicious food and experience the friendly and welcoming environment they have to provide.

name: L&L Pizza & Pasta
description: Check out the authentic Italian cuisine and New York style pizzas served at L&L Pizza & Pasta. This local gem is a friendly spot, and with a delicious selection of tempting and affordable eats, it can be your go-to when dining out. From amazing pizzas to soups, salads, and sandwiches to pastas like baked ziti, there's plenty to try here!

name: Smokey Bones
description: Celebrating authentic and savory barbecue offerings with a menu that features a tantalizing array of smoked meats, flavorful sauces, and hearty sides, Smokey Bones has established themselves as a go-to destination for their smoky goodness. Patrons can indulge in an array of barbecue classics in their laid-back atmosphere. Smokey Bones is a favorite among diners for their commitment to quality and passion for the art of barbecue.

name: Sushiro
description: Welcome to Sushiro, where handcrafted sushi meets culinary artistry! Nestled in the heart of New York City, Sushiro is a haven for sushi enthusiasts seeking an authentic and innovative dining experience.

name: Smokey Bones
description: Celebrating authentic and savory barbecue offerings with a menu that features a tantalizing array of smoked meats, flavorful sauces, and hearty sides, Smokey Bones has established themselves as a go-to destination for their smoky goodness. Patrons can indulge in an array of barbecue classics in their laid-back atmosphere. Smokey Bones is a favorite among diners for their commitment to quality and passion for the art of barbecue.

name: Clean Juice - Roseville
description: Clean Juice brings easily accessible and delicious nutrition in a fun and laidback atmosphere. Each location features friendly counter service -- perfect for grabbing a drink or bite while on the go, pulling up a chair inside, or enjoying out in the sunshine. Clean Juice is known for its USDA-certified, organic cold-pressed juices and smoothies.

name: Taim Mediterranean Kitchen
description: Taim is a staple in the community, and their name literally means 'tasty'! They use the best ingredients, spices, and time-honored Mediterranean cooking techniques to create a one-of-a-kind experience. On Sundays, try their crave combo! For just $10, choose your favorite signature pitas served with fresh cut fries.

name: Radio Bar
description: With its Asian-inspired decor and 18-foot tall ceilings, Radio Bar feels like a cross between a 1940s opium den and a contemporary warehouse loft with a mezzanine level lounge - "the cage" - in between, overlooking the action on the main floor below.  The cocktail menu is extensive and exotic and includes house specialties like key lime pie.  DJs spin nightly from 10 p.m. to 2 a.m. with the music running the gamut from hip hop to reggae to 80s hair metal to power pop.   Located in the heart of downtown Oakland, half a block from the 12th Street BART station, it is open from 4 p.m. to 2 a.m. daily.

name: Dimo's Apizza
description: Offering colossal New Haven-style pizzas and salads, grinders, and even seasonal veggies, Chef Dough Miriello is in the kitchen making sure every bite of everything you order is fabulous! With the signature chewy and char-bottomed crust on the pizzas, you can get your hands on a specialty pizza or customize one--just save room for dessert!

name: Fulton Market Kitchen
description: Fulton Market Kitchen is a New American restaurant that blends culinary innovation with an artistic atmosphere, offering a unique dining experience. The menu features creative dishes made from locally sourced ingredients, set within a space adorned with contemporary art and vibrant decor.

name: Bravo Pizza
description: Bravo Pizza is a welcoming and family-friendly pizzeria known for its delicious and handcrafted pizzas. The menu features an array of options, from classic Margherita and Pepperoni to innovative gourmet creations, ensuring there's something to satisfy every palate. With its warm ambiance, attentive service, and mouthwatering dishes, Bravo Pizza is a favorite destination for both locals and visitors seeking a delightful dining experience.

name: Sarabeth's
description: Sarabeth's is a convenient and fabulous restaurant that is famous for their brunch, as well as a variety of delicious lunch, dinner, and cocktail options. The menu of classic American dishes is hand-crafted from fresh and locally sourced ingredients, and every meal is complemented by an extensive selection of beers, wines, and creative cocktails.

name: Sei Less
description: With an elegant and inviting ambiance, Sei Less provides the perfect setting for a romantic dinner, a celebratory gathering, or a casual outing with friends. Their extensive Asian fusion menu has options that everybody will love, including a full selection of cocktails, wine, and beer. Stop by today for an unforgettable dining experience!

name: Nicco's Pizzaria
description: In the mood for some delicious and authentic Italian cuisine? Nicco's Pizzaria is an easygoing pizzeria with a typical menu featuring specialty pies, hearty hoagies, and classic salads. You can count on them for a delicious meal packed with the real flavor of Italy, served in a casual and cozy environment.

name: Hacienda El Sombrero
description: Fresh, fast and affordable Mexican cuisine has never been tastier than it is at Hacienda El Sombrero Restaurant. This is a family friendly spot where you can sit back in comfort and enjoy the diverse menu filled with hand-crafted and tantalizing dishes. Start your south-of-the-border feast with botanas like the freshly prepared guacamole, a bowl of menudo (weekends only), or the fun to eat queso fundido. Then, get your fork ready for all your favorites. Enchiladas, fajitas, carne asada, burritos, chimichangas, tacos and Tampico-style tilapia are just a few of the stand-out choices. There's plenty more on the menu here, and there's also a full-service bar, so order your favorite cerveza or margarita and turn your meal into a fiesta! Ask about the Jose Cuervo frozen margarita flavor of the month, or order a pitcher for the table. And, with late-night hours on Fridays and Saturdays, karaoke on Thursdays from 8-10 p.m., live music on Fridays and Latino karaoke and dancing on Saturday nights, there's plenty of fun to be had, too. With great food, friendly service and a fun ambiance, you can skip the airfare and head instead to El Sombrero the next time you're in the mood for Mexican cuisine!

name: The Westy Bar & Grill
description: Treat yourself and head for Hamburg's premier place for great food, drinks, and entertainment . . . The Westy Bar & Grill! This locally owned and operated spot offers a killer menu loaded with tons of great choices. Start out with some of the best wings you'll find in Berks County, then move on and really give your night out a lift with the kitchen's incredible ribeye steak. Of course, there are plenty of burgers, wraps, pizzas, calzones, clubs, seafood, and meats like Grilled Ham Steaks and Veal Cutlet to make sure your hunger is easily taken care of. The drinks are a big part of Westy's success too, with the likes of Coors Light, Miller Lite, Yuengling Lager, Blue Moon, Labatt, and Guinness on draft. There's also a large selection of bottled beer that is constantly changing to keep your thirst quenched. It's a complete bar, so if you can think up a drink, chances are they can make it. The friendly staff, great atmosphere, and entertainment options make The West Bar & Grill a must for any night out. NOTEWORTHY: Smoking is permitted on the outside patio, while the interior rocks with karaoke on Thursday nights 10pm-1am, and live bands on most Saturdays. Happy Hour is Tuesday-Friday 4-6pm, then 1-3 pm on Saturdays and Sundays.

name: Truago
description: The perfect spot for delicious, home-cooked meals, Truago is an absolute must-try. Locally owned and operated, their impressive menu features both comfort food classics and creative eats. Fresh seafood, succulent steaks, pastas, burgers, sandwiches, and more are all served at this polished eatery, complete with a full bar!

name: Bob & Edith's Diner
description: Celebrating over 50 years in business, Bob & Edith's Diner is a three generation family-owned and operated restaurant where diners are treated like family. With their extensive menu of tasty breakfast, lunch, and dinner favorites and 'round-the-clock hours, Bob's & Edith's has something for everyone all the time.

name: Bent River Brewing Company
description: Bent River Brewing Company prides itself on brewing the best hand-crafted ales and lagers in the Quad Cities. They offer a great variety of unique beers and are famous for their house-smoked meats, beverages, and lovely outdoor patio. Stop by today to relax and enjoy an absolutely unforgettable night!

name: Tin Can Cafe
description: Start your day on a high note at Tin Can Cafe. The quaint eatery has a warm, friendly atmosphere and offers delicious breakfast and lunch selections that are sure to make your mornings brighter. Choose from a variety of classic dishes like farm fresh eggs, waffles and crepes, sandwiches and Philly cheesesteak, and so much more!

name: 4Thirteen Sports Lounge
description: 4Thirteen Sports Lounge has a mission to deliver an innovative way to dine and entertain. Serving beyond the idea of "bar food," their in-house branded kitchen blends traditional American fare with a soul food twist that will not disappoint! 4Thirteen is the ideal place to come together with friends and family, offering a variety of amusements, including karaoke, bingo, and live music nights. For the most updated information on happy hour and events, visit 4ThirteenDallas.com.

name: Appas Pizza
description: Appas Pizza is a beloved Korean pizza parlor known for its fusion handcrafted pizzas made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The warm and friendly atmosphere makes it a popular spot for families and friends to gather and enjoy a delicious meal. In addition to their signature pizzas, Appas Pizza offers Korean inspired main dishes like buldak pasta and kimchi bacon risotto for those looking for a fun, innovative experience.

name: Los Cantaritos
description: The talented chefs at Los Cantaritos know great tasting Mexican food starts with fresh ingredients and time-honored recipes. Vibrant and festive, this is an excellent choice for any casual occasion. Get going with tasty appetizers like guacamole fresco made right at your table, chicken wings tossed in your choice of sauce, and nachos Texanos with grilled steak, chicken, and shrimp. Popular entrees include spicy pollo chipotle, tender rib-eye steak a la Mexicana, and grilled seafood especial featuring grilled shrimp, scallops, and tilapia topped with a chipotle cheese sauce. The sizzling fajitas, burritos, enchiladas, and tortas here are also top-notch. Quench your thirst with a cold beer, glass of wine, or tangy-sweet margarita. A kids menu is available for the small fries, and diners of every age will love delectable desserts like creamy flan, churros, and fried ice cream. Stop by Los Cantaritos today and enjoy friendly service and unbeatable eats.

name: Sal's Pizza Sussex
description: Sal's Pizza in Sussex is renowned for its authentic New York-style pizza, made with fresh ingredients and a perfect crust. The cozy atmosphere and friendly staff make it a favorite spot for locals and visitors alike. Beyond pizza, Sal's offers a variety of Italian dishes, ensuring a delightful dining experience for all.

name: Nu Crepes
description: Nu Crepes is a family owned and operated destination serving up American inspired crepes in a fast-casual atmosphere, including both indoor and outdoor dining. Stop by and try one of their delicious creations, savory or sweet! They also offer pre-ordered crepe trays that are perfect for a convenient meal at home and easily cooked in your own oven.

name: Bambu Tacoma
description: In the mood for a special sweet treat or the perfect tea to start your day? Bambu Tacoma is a cafe chain serving coffee drinks, milk tea, and Asian desserts, including Vietnamese che. You can count on them for delicious and high quality products along with a pleasant atmosphere and excellent service.

name: Sol Mexican Cocina  Playa Vista
description: Sol Mexican Cocina is a vibrant and contemporary Mexican restaurant that brings the flavors of Baja California to its culinary creations. Known for its fresh and locally sourced ingredients, the restaurant offers a menu featuring a variety of tacos, ceviches, and innovative Mexican dishes. With a stylish and inviting atmosphere, Sol Mexican Cocina provides a delightful dining experience where guests can savor the bold and authentic tastes of Mexican cuisine.

name: L'adresse Nomad
description: L'Adresse Nomad is a cool and comfortable eatery where all-day dining is always terrific. There's a well-rounded menu here, from burgers to elegant seafood dishes. Their dishes are inspired by European culinary traditions and modern American techniques. Fusing exciting flavors and ingredients, every meal here is terrific!

name: RANCHO TEQUILERIA
description: Rancho Tequileria, with locations in New York's Upper West Side and Hell's Kitchen, offers an authentic Mexican culinary experience. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of margaritas, tequilas, and mezcals alongside dishes featuring homemade mole sauce. Committed to using fresh ingredients and traditional preparation methods, Rancho Tequileria celebrates Mexico's rich gastronomy, inviting diners to savor the authentic flavors of various regions.

name: Social Pie
description: Social Pie is a casual counter-service restaurant offering artisan pizza, craft beer and wine in a laid-back setting. Their casual atmosphere is complete with an expansive outdoor patio and plenty of TVs! Enjoy a selection of tasty appetizers, as well as handcrafted pizzas topped with the absolute best quality ingredients.

name: Baires Grill - Sunny Isles
description: Recognized world-wide for their famous barbecue and legendary meat cuts, Baires Grill offers authentic Argentine cuisine in charming surroundings. The atmosphere here is lively and casually elegant making this a popular choice for romantic dates. Begin with delicious appetizers like beef carpaccio, jumbo lump crab cake with spicy aioli, and Tablita Baires featuring crispy sweetbreads, sausage, blood sausage, and your choice of empanada. Popular entrees include the center-cut filet mignon, char-grilled salmon, and the parrillada for two with skirt steak, flap meat, short ribs, chicken, sausage, and more. The pasta dishes and Milanesas are also fantastic here. Complement your meal with a draft beer or a glass of wine from their extensive list of reds and whites from Argentina and around the world. A kids menu is available for the small ones in your group and diners of any age will appreciate ending on a sweet note with a tasty scoop of ice cream. Come savor something extraordinary today at Baires Grill.

name: Jinya Ramen Bar - Topanga Westfield
description: Jinya Ramen Bar is a popular spot known for its rich and flavorful ramen dishes, crafted with a perfect balance of broth, noodles, and toppings. The restaurant offers a modern and inviting atmosphere, making it a great place for both casual dining and special occasions. Guests can also enjoy a variety of appetizers, rice bowls, and Japanese-inspired cocktails, ensuring a well-rounded dining experience.

name: Mabu Kitchen
description: A rustic and cozy French-inspired Southern BYOB bistro serving an elevated comfort brunch and dinner menu, Mabu Kitchen is a popular spot for great eats. Favorites include the fried chicken and waffle Benedict, bay scallops gratin, and their smash double cheeseburger served with hand-cut fries.

name: Pokeworks  Southlake
description: Pokeworks uses sustainable, seasonal ingredients to create colorful and healthy meals. A multi-step ordering process makes building your dish a blast. Jazz up your order with mix-ins, toppings, flavors, and crunchy add-ons. There's also a selection of signature bowls, and don't forget to pair your meal with a refreshing, infused iced tea.

name: Pizza J
description: A colorful pizza joint and bar, Pizza J offers top-notch eats and an entertaining atmosphere. Get going with apps and small plates like white bean hummus served with house flat bread, roasted Brussels sprouts with apple cider glaze, and the O.G. featuring crispy fried local calamari with pickled chilies, red sauce, and lemon. For the main event, order up a big and bold pizza like the beautiful yeti with smoked pork, whiskey-cola BBQ sauce, shaved red onion, mozzarella, and scallion; alphabet street with pepperoni, applewood-smoked bacon, Italian sausage, red sauce, mozzarella, and fresh herbs; and king tidal wave featuring smokey tasso ham, roasted pineapple, scallions, mozzarella, and red sauce. If you're not in the mood for pizza, check out "sandos" like the chicken Parm sando, cauliflower po'boy, and meatball sub. Pizza J also offers plenty of vegetarian and vegan options. Pair your eats with something from their extensive list of bottled and on-tap craft beers, and be sure to end on a sweet note with homemade ice cream. Stop by Pizza J today for cold drinks, great food, and fun that never stops.

name: Sombrero Tacoria
description: From humble beginnings as a food truck, now you can feast on the amazing flavors and dishes at Sombrero Tacoria. Family owned and operated and sharing with you their family recipes, each hand-crafted dish served here is terrific. A variety of tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and bowls are offered here along with equally delish sides.

name: MK Bistro
description: Welcome to MK Bistro - formerly known as- Ol' Vine - where every bite tells a story of American culinary heritage. Experience a menu teeming with lively flavors influenced by the diverse tapestry of American cuisine. From sizzling steaks to comforting Tomato Basil Bisque, each dish embodies a fusion of robust seasonings and locally-sourced ingredients, promising a flavorful journey with every visit.

name: Adoro Lei
description: Adoro Lei is an exciting Italian restaurant and lounge that fashions an upscale dining experience to create the most vibrant and delicious pizza party you can imagine. Here, it's all about chef-crafted cuisine (Executive Chef Mario Gentile, who studied under Michelin Star chefs, is at the helm), and with artisanal mixologist crafted cocktails, this is truly the best pizza party in the city. Everything, from the art on the walls to the videos and every dish on the menu, has been carefully selected to create a dining experience unlike any other. A custom-built wood-burning oven is at the heart of the kitchen, and the culinary crew is busy hand-crafting authentic Neapolitan pizzas. Each 12-inch pie is topped with the finest and freshest ingredients, and there are both creative selections and more traditional pizzas from which to choose. But there's more on the menu, like toasty panini sandwiches, grilled steaks, and succulent pastas in both individual and sharing-size portions. Also ask about the just-from-the-water picks from the raw bar, or just go for snacks and cocktails. Adoro Lei is as much about the music and entertainment as it is about the food or drinks, and with a stellar lineup of DJ hosted parties, live music, and more, there's often something fun going on. Craving a deliciously different pizza and cocktail experience? Check out Adoro Lei today!

name: Jack in the Box
description: Just about everyone knows Jack from Jack in the Box with his telltale ping pong ball head, but what they might not know is just how good the food is at this favorite fast-food eatery. For more than 60 years, this all-American chain has been dishing up burgers, all-day breakfasts and a variety of Americanized snacks like eggrolls and tacos. This is not, however, your typical fast-food burger joint. With dishes only made once you place your order, the menu offers diners a variety of decidedly different dining options. From the Sourdough Jack (served on authentic sourdough bread) to the Bacon Ultimate Cheeseburger with two kinds of cheese, there are enough burger options to cure just about every craving. There's plenty more on the menu, including garden-fresh salads with grilled chicken, Chicken Pita sandwiches, grilled sandwiches, their famous Curly Fries, and much more. Jack in the Box is also known for their real ice cream milkshakes.  Regardless if you order one to go with your meal or to enjoy as a dessert, they really are delectable. Plus, with a rotating selection of seasonal and promotional dishes to try, you can make this your new favorite fast-food restaurant and never tire of the food! Get there today and dine-in or choose a location with a handy drive-thru, but make Jack in the Box your first choice when craving fabulous fast-and-delicious-food!

name: Granny's Soulfood
description: Granny's Soulfood, A lively southern-style restaurant, Granny's Soul Food exudes an atmosphere of warmth and vibrancy. Known for its delectable cuisine and welcoming ambiance, the restaurant brings a Southern flavor to every dish.

name: Spirit WATER Brewery Distillery
description: Spirit WATER is a micro-brewery, micro-distillery, and taproom. Customers are welcome to bring their own food or have it delivered from neighboring eateries. During the summer, they also host a variety of food trucks on-site! This venue is a great hangout spot and also perfect for hosting private events of all kinds. Check out their website to make reservations for your next Spirit WATER Brewery tour!

name: Egg House Cafe
description: The Egg House Cafe is your new favorite go-to spot for breakfast and lunch! Their large portions and affordable prices, as well as their high-quality dishes, make for a combination that's unparalleled. Some of their delicious creations include their steak omelet, eggs benedict and Philly cheese patty melt.

name: Butcher and Banker Steakhouse
description: New York's "most unique steakhouse," Butcher & Banker is housed in a restored bank vault that was built in the 1930s. This hidden dining destination offers the finest steaks, bespoke cocktails, and fabulous service. Conveniently located, you can enjoy an exceptional meal and world class drinks at this lively and sought-after restaurant.

name: Moe's Southwest Grill
description: Welcome to southwestern food with a twist! Moe's Southwest Grill isn't a place you go to eat traditional Mexican or Tex Mex food, nor is it just a burrito joint. With a variety of fresh and flavorful ingredients, Moe's brings unique and new flavors to the table. Enjoy nachos, salsas, and good times made in-house every day at Moe's!

name: Dallas BBQ
description: Dallas BBQ features Angus beef and rotisserie chicken, Texas style. Rib and rib combos are featured on the menu and grilled to perfection. Soups, sides, and salads grace the menu and are a great side or first course of the meal.  Deep fried seafood dishes are on the menu for patrons who want a lighter fare for lunch or dinner. Dallas BBQ has a catering menu for a party or gathering.

name: Twin Birch Restaurant
description: Twin Birch Restaurant takes pride in serving handcrafted food and offering a great sports-viewing experience with big screen TVs. Check out their selection of 12 taps and a variety of awesome drinks. Enjoy an incredible meal after taking part in some golfing, biking, or winter activities at this popular spot!

name: Cafe J
description: The fine dining jewel in Lubbock's collection of restaurants, Cafe J is the ultimate destination restaurant. Café J has long maintained a singular place in West Texas cuisine and the arts. Blending modern techniques with worldwide influences, an extensive wine selection, and original paintings, inspired cuisine meets impeccable service.

name: Moe's Southwest Grill
description: Moe's Southwest Grill offers a variety of Tex-Mex dishes including burritos, quesadillas, tacos, and nachos, all made with over 20 fresh ingredients. Known for its welcoming atmosphere, Moe's provides free chips and salsa with every meal and caters to various dietary preferences including vegetarian options. The restaurant features convenient services like takeout, delivery, and catering.

name: Shamrock's Alehouse
description: Shamrock's Ale House is a family-owned and operated restaurant based on the traditional Irish Pub feeling. They offer a variety of food, a family-friendly environment and sports galore with 15 high-def, big screen televisions and a total sports package. Stop by today and discover the perfect hangout spot with family and friends!

name: The Doctor's Office
description: The Doctor's Office, is an intimate bar known for its global spirits tasting room, classic cocktails, and a strong emphasis on personalized service. It offers a unique experience that feels like having a fresh cocktail poured by a hospitable friend in their own home. This cozy venue, with its small, dark room complete with a marble bar and a sofa, is a must-visit for those looking to enjoy a sophisticated drinking experience, and it's advisable to make a reservation due to its exclusive atmosphere​​​​.

name: Freda's Caribbean & Soul Cuisine
description: Locally-owned and operated, Freda's Caribbean & Soul Cuisine is a friendly, welcoming, and tasty place to enjoy lunch or dinner. Here, it's all about fresh ingredients and crafting scrumptious fare. There's flavor in every hand-crafted dish on the menu, and no matter if you're there for something light or a hearty feast, you'll have no trouble finding something delicious to try. Sit in the comfortable dining room or take your meal to-go, and enjoy dishes like brown stew chicken, curried goat, jerk chicken, oxtails, and jerk shrimp. There's more to try, including tasty lunch specials that come with your choice of side. It's all made fresh here from the finest ingredients, so whenever you're craving something fabulous, check out Freda's Caribbean & Soul Cuisine! Please note: Catering services are also available. Please call ahead for details.

name: Brooklyn Diner
description: Brooklyn Diner is a cherished dining establishment celebrated for its authentic New York-style diner experience. Located in the heart of the city, the diner offers a nostalgic atmosphere reminiscent of classic American diners, complete with retro decor and a warm, inviting ambiance. Guests can enjoy a diverse menu featuring hearty breakfast options, delicious burgers, sandwiches, and a variety of comfort food dishes made with high-quality ingredients. Known for its friendly service and generous portions, Brooklyn Diner has become a favorite spot for both locals and visitors seeking a taste of traditional American diner fare.

name: Le Botaniste 43rd & 3rd
description: Le Botaniste is a plant-based, organic restaurant offering a menu inspired by botanical and global cuisines, emphasizing sustainability and environmental consciousness. With its apothecary-themed decor and focus on fresh, nutrient-rich ingredients, Le Botaniste provides a unique dining experience that caters to both health-conscious and eco-friendly diners. In addition to the menu, they have seasonal specials always available.

name: Zac's Hamburgers - Folsom
description: Make your stomach happy at Zac's Hamburgers. Since it first opened in Crum Lynne in 1984, Zac's has expanded to offer great classic burgers and food at five locations in Pennsylvania.  The extensive menu includes burgers, hot dogs, chicken sandwiches, seafood sandwiches and plenty of different side orders of fries from regular to spicy to waffle supreme with chili and cheese.  Hand-dipped milkshakes, weekend burger specials and burgers of the month add to the options.  Salads are available at the Media and Folsom locations only.  With five great Delaware County locations to serve you, come in and experience for yourself how Zac's exceeds all the others with a great selection of food and a casual atmosphere for the entire family.  Come see for yourself why Zac's is known for serving up the "best burger in Delaware County!"

name: Lei'd Hawiian Poke
description: Lei'd Hawaiian Poke is committed to making sure that every guest has a memorable dining experience with a happy ending. The casual restaurant specializes in poke -- a Hawaiian dish that consists of raw fish marinated in various combinations of Asian sauces and seasoning. You have the power to customize every poke-bowl you order! Start off by selecting your base. You have your choice of a salad mix, white or brown sushi rice, or even poke nachos. Next, choose your protein and sauce. Prepared fresh daily, a wide variety of delectable options are featured like salmon with a spicy honey miso sauce or tuna with a tasty sea-salt Limu sauce. Top your bowl with fun, delicious ingredients like sweet eel sauce, mango, pickled ginger, or a hot Cheeto crunch. Can't decide what to order? You can ask for a free sample of any base, protein, sauce, or topping. In a rush? Order online and take your poke-bowl on the go. Catering is available and is sure to make your event unforgettable.

name: Szechuan Gourmet
description: When you're in the mood for authentic Szechuan cuisine that's always hand-crafted from the freshest ingredients, head to Szechuan Gourmet. This is charming and casual eatery where you'll find a diverse menu loaded with tempting picks. From fresh fish and seafood picks to vegetarian dishes and meaty delights, there's plenty to try.

name: Sweet Chick
description: Sweet Chick is a popular restaurant chain known for its innovative take on classic Southern comfort food, particularly its signature dish of chicken and waffles. With a hip and contemporary vibe, Sweet Chick combines a nostalgic ambiance with a modern twist, offering a diverse menu that caters to both comfort food enthusiasts and those seeking a unique dining experience. Founded by restaurateur John Seymour and hip-hop artist Nas, Sweet Chick has gained acclaim for its flavorful dishes and stylish atmosphere.

name: The Dirty Buffalo - Little Creek
description: The Dirty Buffalo is a popular restaurant known for its delicious and extensive menu of buffalo-style cuisine. Located in various cities, it offers a casual and vibrant atmosphere where patrons can enjoy a variety of buffalo wings, sandwiches, and comfort food. With a focus on flavorful dishes and a sports-friendly environment, The Dirty Buffalo is a go-to spot for those seeking a laid-back dining experience with a spicy twist.

name: The Wild Goose
description: Looking for the perfect hangout spot to cheer on your favorite sports teams and enjoy a cold beer with friends? The Wild Goose has got you covered! Locally owned and operated, the laid-back sports bar is known for its delicious stone oven pizzas, excellent craft beer, and friendly service that will make you feel like a part of the family.

name: Sri Thai Kitchen & Sushi - Atl Station
description: Sri Thai Kitchen & Sushi's creative wooden structure gets your attention from the street, and their imaginative dishes get your attention in the restaurant. The owner loves traveling back to Thailand, and his goal is to bring that to Atlanta with fresh dishes from scratch, mouthwatering sauces, and dishes that are salty, sour, sweet and spicy!

name: Dumpling House
description: Dumpling House, is renowned for its authentic Chinese cuisine, specializing in a variety of handmade dumplings. The restaurant offers a cozy and welcoming atmosphere, making it a favorite dining spot among locals and visitors alike. Known for its fresh ingredients and traditional flavors, Dumpling House has established itself as a must-visit destination for those seeking a genuine taste of Chinese culinary delights.

name: Jack In The Box #1538
description: Just about everyone knows Jack from Jack in the Box with his telltale ping pong ball head, but what they might not know is just how good the food is at this favorite fast-food eatery. For more than 60 years, this all-American chain has been dishing up burgers, all-day breakfasts and a variety of Americanized snacks like eggrolls and tacos. This is not, however, your typical fast-food burger joint. With dishes only made once you place your order, the menu offers diners a variety of decidedly different dining options. From the Sourdough Jack (served on authentic sourdough bread) to the Bacon Ultimate Cheeseburger with two kinds of cheese, there are enough burger options to cure just about every craving. There's plenty more on the menu, including garden-fresh salads with grilled chicken, Chicken Pita sandwiches, grilled sandwiches, their famous Curly Fries, and much more. Jack in the Box is also known for their real ice cream milkshakes.  Regardless if you order one to go with your meal or to enjoy as a dessert, they really are delectable. Plus, with a rotating selection of seasonal and promotional dishes to try, you can make this your new favorite fast-food restaurant and never tire of the food! Get there today and dine-in or choose a location with a handy drive-thru, but make Jack in the Box your first choice when craving fabulous fast-and-delicious-food!

name: Fonda Chelsea
description: Fonda Comida Mexicana is a refreshingly different kind of Mexican restaurant. The contemporary decor is chic and urban, and with chef and owner Roberto Santibanez behind this restaurant, every meal here will be a delight. Born in Mexico City and graduated with honors from Paris' prestigious Le Cordon Bleu, Chef Santibanez has a variety of awards to back his international career as chef, culinary consultant, author, and teacher. He founded three highly acclaimed restaurants in Mexico City and worked as executive chef  before heading up his own New York City restaurants. At Fonda, you'll find exciting and affordable cuisine which showcases the chef's love of his native dishes. Here, food is prepared with passion; tortillas are always hand-pressed, guacamole is made to order, and margaritas are thoughtfully crafted. Chef Santibanez's version of enchiladas in black mole would impress any Mexican cuisine traditionalist's palates. Open daily for dinner and on the weekends for brunch, this is a delightful dining spot that has won over jaded New York diners, and is sure to please you as well.

name: Cafe Paradiso
description: Cafe Paradiso offers a cozy and inviting atmosphere perfect for enjoying a relaxed meal. Specializing in Italian cuisine, the cafe serves a delightful array of pasta, pastries, and aromatic coffees made from the finest ingredients. Whether you're stopping by for a quick espresso or a leisurely dinner, Cafe Paradiso provides a warm and memorable dining experience.

name: HASHTAG INDIA
description: Guests are invited to immerse themselves in the rich flavors and aromatic spices that define the heart and soul of their diverse nation at Hashtag India. From mouthwatering chaats to delectable tandoori delights, the menu offers a delightful tapestry of authentic Indian gastronomy. Patrons are welcomed on a flavorful journey through the bustling streets of India, where every bite tells a story and every dish ignites taste buds.

name: IHOP
description: Making food that families love, IHOP is an iconic eatery known for amazing breakfast fare plus lunch and dinner eats. There's plenty on the menu here, including their signature pancakes. Also watch for seasonal specials and their popular family feasts that are available to-go. With something for everyone, you can count on IHOP for a great meal!

name: The Truck Bar Higganum
description: Leave the same old destinations behind and shift gears to the newest roadside attraction, The Truck Bar Higganum! This exciting destination is the perfect place to crack open a cold one, play games, and have the ultimate hang. They are excited to provide you with a great time and family-friendly fun for any occasion.

name: Souvlaki Fast
description: Traditional Greek flavors meet the grill at Souvlaki Fast, an eatery started by two friends who also happen to be natives of Greece. With a love of grilling, you can try family recipes made from the freshest and finest ingredients. Just-from-the-water seafood, top cuts of beef, chicken and pork, and garden-fresh veggies go into the preparation of each meal. As an added bonus, each meal is healthy and delicious! Served up quick and to-order, try a gyro pita or shrimp souvlaki platter, and for the hungriest, try other Greek favorites like moussaka. The Greek burger and Philly steak are also delish options, and be sure to ask about specials like Saturday's kids eat free offer (some exclusions apply). And, if you need catering, the friendly people here will make a meal your guests won't soon forget. Dine-in, call for take-out or ask about delivery, but when you're craving the bright, bold and sunny flavors of Greece and what many claim is the best darn souvlaki around, head to Souvlaki Fast!

name: Munchiez 805
description: Munchiez 805 is a locally owned restaurant with great food and good vibes! They have a diverse menu to accommodate everyone. They are a fast casual restaurant who caters to customers who are looking for good food that is relatively quick yet healthy, and they offer a great beer selection and TVs to watch all of your sports game!

name: 16 Handles
description: They're flaunting flavor over at 16 Handles, a NYC original fro-yo eatery that's taken the city by storm. Here, they celebrate individuality. That's why there are endless combinations of frozen yogurts and toppings, all so you can create exactly what you're looking for. Unleash your inner fro-yo chef and pick your favorite chef-inspired flavors and top it with candies, nuts, fruits, cookies, candy bars, sauces, and so much more. The selection of frozen yogurts is always rotating to keep things fresh and exciting, but you can look for flavors like American apple pie, blackberry addiction, cappuccino, cake cake cake batter, fudge brownie, and so many more. There are sorbets, too, and all are labeled to show if they're gluten-free, fat-free, low-fat, contains nuts, and other dietary features. There's more to love here, including fabulous frozen cakes and creamy smoothies. Always high-quality and always delicious, get the party started today at 16 Handles! Please note: Catering options are available; call ahead for details.

name: Bon Chon
description: True to its original Korean roots, Bonchon is a family-friendly restaurant offering an affordable, casual dining experience in a lively atmosphere. Its chicken is cooked-to-order and made fresh with high-quality ingredients and spicy flavors that will make your mouth water. You'll fall in love with its crispy, double-fried wings after just one bite!

name: Main Squeeze Juice Lakeview
description: Main Squeeze Juice Co. is a vibrant juice and smoothie bar offering a variety of organic cold-pressed juices, smoothies, and plant-based snacks designed to nourish and energize. Emphasizing health and sustainability, the restaurant sources high-quality ingredients to create delicious, nutrient-dense options for a balanced lifestyle.

name: Thai Singha House
description: No matter where you are, BYOB and head to the Thai Singha House for a meal of tasty Thai favorites. Conveniently located in University City, this area favorite has been winning over diners since opening their doors in 1990. The beautifully appointed space sets the stage for Thai cuisine presented with fine-dining panache. Featured house specialties include shrimp pad Thai, duck curry, rack of lamb with red coconut curry sauce, stir fried cashew chicken & shrimp, and the piece de resistance -- fire game Cornish hen and spicy shellfish. Plus, with monthly dinner specials, lunch and early bird specials, and Sunday brunch, every time is a great time to visit.

name: Burning Rice-Addison
description: Burning Rice serves food that is fresh, healthy, and bold! They offer traditional Korean BBQ Bibimbop served in a regular or Hot Stone Bowl. Customize it your way with your choice of rice, protein, toppings, and an egg! That humble, hearty staple meal of Korea is what they do best. Stop by for a refreshing and flavorful meal made just for you.

name: Pei Wei Asian Kitchen
description: Pei Wei Asian Kitchen knows how to bring the flavor. They serve bold, craveable creations that are sure to impress the whole crew. Whenever you're in the mood for something sweet, spicy, or just plain good, you can count on them for wok'd to order dishes, like their bestselling Firecracker Chicken, created with quality ingredients. Order Now!

name: Beer For The Meeples
description: Beer For The Meeples was founded in 2022 with the purpose of creating a fun, welcoming environment! They serve a nice selection of excellent craft beers, with an option on the menu for people of all preferences. They have a great variety of board games as well for you to enjoy amongst great company.

name: IHOP
description: Making food that families love, IHOP is an iconic eatery known for amazing breakfast fare plus lunch and dinner eats. There's plenty on the menu here, including their signature pancakes. Also watch for seasonal specials and their popular family feasts that are available to-go. With something for everyone, you can count on IHOP for a great meal!

name: El Jefe Luchador
description: Check out the hardcore Mexican street food made fresh and fabulous at El Jefe Luchador. This is a casual and upbeat spot where big, bold flavors are what you can expect. Check out the specialty tacos. Go traditional with the ancho-smoked crispy pork belly or the Angus ribeye with roasted corn-jalapeno salsa fresca, or go with a fusion favorite like the Korean fried chicken. The tacos are available a la carte, and when paired with tasty sides like Mexican rice, sweet plantains or roasted corn, they're a hearty meal. Also check out the plated options. The phatty burrito is stuffed with your choice of protein, the smokin' bowl is brimming with tasty ingredients, and the nachos and quesadillas are fun to eat. Dine-in or take something to go, but climb into the ring at El Jefe today and you'll fall in love with the food!

name: Blind Rabbit Kitchen
description: The Blind Rabbit Kitchen is a distinguished seafood and steakhouse restaurant renowned for its premium cuts of meat and fresh, succulent seafood. The restaurant offers a sophisticated and cozy atmosphere, perfect for intimate dinners or special occasions. With a focus on culinary excellence and exceptional service, Blind Rabbit provides a dining experience that is both luxurious and memorable.

name: Show Me Pizza
description: Show Me Pizza isn't just a terrific eatery with delicious pizzas, but you can actually watch it being made via livestream! Here, every pizza is started when you place an order. Hand-tossed, topped with the best quality ingredients, and baked fresh in minutes, you'll wonder why it took you so long to find this popular eatery!

name: Le Botaniste UWS
description: Le Botaniste is a plant-based, organic restaurant offering a menu inspired by botanical and global cuisines, emphasizing sustainability and environmental consciousness. With its apothecary-themed decor and focus on fresh, nutrient-rich ingredients, Le Botaniste provides a unique dining experience that caters to both health-conscious and eco-friendly diners. In addition to the menu, they have seasonal specials always available.

name: Morning Star Cafe
description: Morning Star Cafe is where delicious food, friendly service, and a warm welcome are always on the menu. These hallmarks of this classic American diner make it a Turtle Bay favorite for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, all served up in a family-friendly environment. Whether you start your day with a cup of coffee and a muffin, or pick on of the multitude of omelets, Morning Star Cafe is the place to be. The breakfast menu alone features dozens of delicious dishes, including some specialty options like the lox Benedict, eggs Florentine, and huevos rancheros. There are healthy options, all sorts of pancakes, waffles, and more to try as well. The lunch and dinner menus are no less tempting, featuring a lineup of sandwiches -- from the Philly cheese steak and open-face slice fresh turkey to the BLT wrap and fried fish filet on a bun -- that can take on any competitor. A little Mediterranean flavor waits in the Greek corner, where you can choose dishes like the spinach pie, moussaka, and gyro souvlaki platter. There's so much more too, such as numerous sides, cold salad platters, diet delights, eight-ounce burgers, seafood, pastas, and various entrees that include shrimp scampi, chicken marsala, chopped sirloin steak, loin pork chop, and others. They have great desserts and a wide-ranging drink program here as well, which is why Morning Star Cafe is always a terrific choice anytime of the day.

name: Loko Fried Fish
description: Loko Fried Fish is a popular seafood restaurant located in Orlando, FL, renowned for its delectable selection of dishes. The menu features a variety of expertly prepared seafood, with standout items including the Grilled Tilapia Fillet, which is seasoned to perfection and cooked to a tender finish, and the Fried Tilapia Fillet, known for its crispy, golden exterior. Another favorite is the Fried Red Snapper, a dish that showcases the fresh flavors of the fish complemented by a light, crunchy coating. Additionally, the restaurant offers succulent Fried Shrimps, which are a hit among patrons for their juicy texture and flavorful breading. Loko Fried Fish is a go-to destination for seafood lovers in Orlando, offering a casual yet inviting atmosphere perfect for enjoying a hearty seafood meal.

name: La Preferida Mexican Restaurant
description: Check out the authentic and oh-so delicious south-of-the-border fare at La Preferida Mexican Restaurant. This family-friendly spot has a big menu that's loaded with all your favorite picks. Ask about the daily specials, or dig into saucy enchiladas, sizzling fajitas, quesadillas, and more. Always scratch-made, it's all terrific at this gem.

name: Noodles & Company - University Place
description: Gather around the table and around the bowls at Noodles and Company, where the dishes are always filled to the brim with internationally-inspired pasta creations. Since 1995, this casual and inventive eatery has been serving fresh food fast, and today, this fast-casual eatery is still in the lead when it comes to quick, healthy, and hand-crafted food. Everything on the menu is made in-house from real ingredients, so no matter if you're looking for a cozy spot to share a meal with friends or if it is family dinner night, you'll find something tempting on the menu. The Wisconsin mac & cheese is a favorite, the spicy chipotle adobo with braised pork in a smoky and spicy sauce is a great choice, and the pad Thai features all the flavors of this classic dish. There's plenty more on the menu, including Italian-inspired dishes, curries, Korean beef noodles, and traditional favorites like spaghetti & meatballs. There are meatless creations, gluten-free choices, low-calorie and low-sugar dishes, and those with lower sodium too, making Noodles & Company a great choice for everybody. With more and more locations every day, a delicious meal is just an order away at Noodles & Company! Please note: Noodles & Company also caters. From corporate events and lunches to private parties, the experienced team at Noodles & Company will make a meal your guests won't soon forget. Also be sure to check out Noodles & Company online!

name: RAKKAN Ramen- Folsom
description: The restaurant known as RAKKAN Ramen has garnered a reputation for its delectable and authentic ramen offerings. Within its menu, a diverse array of ramen choices can be found, ranging from the traditional Tonkotsu. The chef leading the kitchen at RAKKAN Ramen is characterized by their commitment to utilizing top-tier ingredients and their meticulous approach to meticulously fashioning each bowl of ramen with precision and care.

name: Gyroville-Kendall
description: Offering the fresh and fabulous flavors of the Mediterranean in casual, inviting, and low-key locations, it's all about deliciousness at Gyroville. Here, you're the master of your meal--build your own pitas, wraps, salads, and more at this popular spot where quality is key. Once you've decided between a bowl, pita or salad, fill it with their fabulous gyro meat, chicken or falafel. Then add in fresh veggies and top it with your favorite sauce. That's it! There's more on the menu to try like a traditional gyro, a pita melt with plenty of melted cheese, quick bites like puta and hummus, and sweet, flaky baklava for dessert. They also offer dinner family packs, so you can take something fabulous home to share. Gyroville is also a great pick when you need catering--their trays, lunch boxes and platters will be the talk of the office, party, or event! It's all fabulous at Gyroville, where quality eats are always affordably priced!

name: El Pollo Real
description: In the mood for some fresh and delicious chicken? Come check out El Pollo Real for an option that is sure to leave you satisfied! Some of their most popular dishes include rotisserie chicken, chicken soup seafood, and flan! Stop by today for excellent service and to have all of your cravings satisfied.

name: Grotta Azzurra
description: Grotta Azzurra is back, transformed! Nolita and Little Italy's famous Grotta Azzurra Inn, whose namesake is the "Blue Grotta" in the isle of Capri, was first founded by the Davino family and attracted eminent celebrities like Frank Sinatra, Jackie Kennedy, James Darren, and Danny and Marlo Thomas. The new-fangled Grotta Azzurra, with indoor and outdoor seating for almost 150, is sure to draw a similarly illustrious crowd. Grotta's head chef, Chris Pfeifer, plans to incorporate some of Grotta's classics, like lobster fra diavolo and steak pizzaiola into a new, seasonal Italian market.

name: Oliver's Bar & Grill
description: Located inside Quality Inn & Suites nestled in the heart of the Kankakee River Valley, Oliver's Bar & Grill is a full-service restaurant showing all of your favorite sports on their multiple flat screen televisions.  Dine or grab some drinks in the bar area with high-top tables and bar seating, in the dining room or in the lounge with comfortable seating and sporting artifacts on the walls.  There is even a video game room perfect for kids and adults.  More upscale than most sports bars, the menu here ranges from traditional bar fare to fine dining entrees.  Whatever your taste buds or stomach desires, you can find it here at Oliver's Bar & Grill.

name: Prime Catch
description: Centrally located in the Theatre District of Times Square, Prime Catch is an attractive steakhouse and seafood restaurant with an eye on quality and comfort. Offering on-site dry-aged beef, fresh seafood including raw bar favorites, and Italian entrees, the food and service here are sure to impress.

name: Blind Pig Tavern - Westside
description: Since 1998, the Blind Pig Tavern has been known as the area's best place to go when looking for fun, relaxation and a delicious meal. Head over today and catch the big game on any of their TVs, or just unwind over a great meal and drinks. Perfect for lunch, dinner, late-night eats and drinks anytime, this outstanding neighborhood bar and grill really does have it all. Go hungry and feast on any of their specialty burgers, or build your own creation. Or, try any of their subs, wraps, dogs, sandwiches, and entrées like the BBQ Plate with finger lickingly delish smoked pulled pork. Another great option is to make a feast out of eminently munchable favorites like their plump and juicy Wings, Fried Dill Pickles or the Gravy Cheese Fries. Combine all this and more with friendly service and a comfortable and casual ambiance, and you've got the Blind Pig Tavern!

name: BB's Burgers
description: BB's Pub and Grill is a lively establishment offering a welcoming atmosphere and a menu filled with classic pub favorites. Known for its hearty burgers, flavorful wings, and extensive beer selection, it's a favorite spot for both locals and visitors. With regular live music and events, BB's Pub and Grill provides a vibrant setting for dining and entertainment.

name: Yalla Middle Eastern Cuisine
description: Yalla Middle Eastern Cuisine offers delicious food that is minimally processed, made from fresh, local ingredients! Their dishes come together with an exotic mix of spices and herbs to satiate hunger and leave your taste buds with a burst of flavor. They offer various healthy dishes that are loaded with meats and vegetables.

name: Levity Brewing Company - Altoona
description: Levity Brewing Company is known for its innovative craft beers and welcoming atmosphere. Founded in 2016, this brewery offers a diverse selection of brews, from classic IPAs to unique seasonal creations. The brewery also hosts various community events and provides a cozy space for locals and visitors to enjoy fresh, locally made beer.

name: Cafe Dazzling
description: In the mood for a hot, fresh meal? Stop by Cafe Dazzling today for a meal that will put a smile on your face! They are the local go-to spot for authentic ramen that is absolutely packed with flavor and made from the best quality ingredients available. They offer a comfortable dining room, friendly atmosphere, and great service.

name: Choong Man Chicken- Glenview
description: Famous for their fried chicken, the eats at Choongman Chicken are so good, people can't stop talking about it. Imagine perfectly seasoned chicken that's battered and fresh-fried until golden brown. Now, smother that chicken in homemade, Asian-inspired sauces. No matter if you're a wing, tender, or whole chicken fan, you'll be raving about the eats!

name: Taquearte California
description: Taquearte California is a vibrant and contemporary Mexican restaurant located in the heart of California. The restaurant boasts a diverse menu featuring traditional Mexican dishes crafted with a modern twist, using fresh, locally-sourced ingredients whenever possible.

name: Pokeworks Houston Heights
description: Pokeworks uses sustainable, seasonal ingredients to create colorful and healthy meals. A multi-step ordering process makes building your dish a blast. Begin by choosing from among the following options: bowl (kale noodle, sushi rice, organic brown rice, or quinoa), burrito (sushi rice and roasted seaweed wrap), kale noodles, or salad (fresh romaine and spring mix). Next up are the proteins (mix two or three if you can't choose just one): options like ahi tuna, organic tofu, spicy salmon, albacore tuna, chicken, shrimp, and scallops guarantee that you'll find a perfect combination. Finally, you get to jazz up your meal with mix-ins, toppings, flavors, and crunchy add-ons; you'll find everything from chopped shiso, fresh jalapeno, spicy ginger sauce, and wasabi aioli to lotus chips, macadamia nuts, and more. There's also a selection of signature bowls, like the popular spicy ahi, shiso salmon, or umami classic (ahi tuna, green and sweet onion, hijiki seaweed, cucumber, sesame seeds, and umami shoyu sauce). Pair your meal with a refreshing, infused iced tea or Hawaiian Sun tropical fruit drink.

name: Sammy's Cafe - Rialto
description: For an all-American dining experience, choose Sammy's Cafe. The small family restaurant with a big heart will make every customer feel right at home and features a variety of delicious, homemade breakfast, lunch, and dinner selections that are sure to satisfy your cravings. Stop by today for great service, fresh food, and a fun, family environment.

name: Thai World Gourmet Restaurant
description: Searching for the best Thai cuisine in Pembroke Pines? Come give Thai World Gourmet Restaurant a try for an option that you are going to love. They serve traditional Thai cuisine including lunch specials, offered in a convenient strip-mall setting. Their menu includes som tum, lab gai, moo yang, fried rice, gai satay, and more!

name: Capriotti's Sandwich Shop - North Wales
description: Part of the Kitchen United MIX line-up of great takeout restaurants, Capriotti's Sandwich Shop offers premium sandwiches including signature subs, cheese steaks, and vegetarian options plus vibrant salads all made with fresh, high quality ingredients.

name: Nantucket Shrimp Shack
description: At Nantucket Shrimp Shack, they know all about seafood. Here, they're hand-crafting all your favorite shrimp and seafood dishes, making them from the freshest and finest the sea has to offer. From jumbo fried shrimp and shrimp po'boys to fish and chips and their famous jumbo sampler with a variety of all their most popular dishes, there's plenty to love on the menu at this popular eatery.  Plus, kids get their own special menu here, and if you're out with the family, ask about their popular family meal. And, with a few locations to better serve you, there's no place better to relax and unwind after a day in the sun or in the office. It's a fast-casual dining experience with food that's so good, you'll be back for more! A family-friendly ambiance and convenient location makes this a top pick for dinner any day of the week. When you're craving just-from-the-water seafood, head to Nantucket Shrimp Shack!

name: Brooklyn Diner
description: Brooklyn Diner is a cherished dining establishment celebrated for its authentic New York-style diner experience. Located in the heart of the city, the diner offers a nostalgic atmosphere reminiscent of classic American diners, complete with retro decor and a warm, inviting ambiance. Guests can enjoy a diverse menu featuring hearty breakfast options, delicious burgers, sandwiches, and a variety of comfort food dishes made with high-quality ingredients. Known for its friendly service and generous portions, Brooklyn Diner has become a favorite spot for both locals and visitors seeking a taste of traditional American diner fare.

name: Domino's Pizza - Princeton Junction
description: From humble beginnings as a single pizza restaurant in 1960, Domino's has become today's recognized world leader in pizza delivery. They are fully committed to making and delivering delicious food made from high-quality ingredients. In addition to their classic pies, they serve a variety of wings, sandwiches, pastas, breads, salads, and more!

name: Piccolo
description: Piccolo is a multiple award-winning Italian restaurant that's known for dishing up delicious new spins on traditional fare. Serving scrumptious food in a contemporary atmosphere, they're famous for their family recipe for marinara, a full bar with refreshing cocktails, covered seating, and hand-cut steaks topped with garlic butter.

name: Jalisco's Restaurant & Bar - Buda
description: Based on the popularity of Jalisco's original location in Austin, Jalisco's Restaurant & Bar has brought their famous flavors and Mexican cuisine to hungry diners in Buda. This is a family-friendly spot where every day is a fiesta, and there's a great menu of hand-crafted tasty eats. It's open daily for lunch and dinner, and guests are loving the rustic decor, great service, and fresh flavors. House specialties at this eatery include traditional Mexican favorites like chicken mole, chipotle steak, and carne asada. Tex-Mex seekers can fill up on stuffed tacos, flautas, and chicken chimichangas. There are also lunch specials to try, and no matter when you go, a citrusy margarita or frosty cerveza are great additions to your meal. With the Mexican cuisine you're craving, head to Jalisco's today!

name: La Corneta Taqueria
description: La Corneta Taqueria offers a wide variety of fresh and delicious Mexican food for almost any occasion or taste. They provide a clean and pleasant atmosphere; rich colors and hand painted murals adorn their walls to surround you while you enjoy and savor your meal. They also offer delivery and catering for parties and events.

name: Provenza Restaurant - Event Center
description: Provenza Restaurant is a vibrant Latin eatery known for its authentic cuisine and lively atmosphere. Nestled in a bustling neighborhood, it offers a diverse menu featuring traditional dishes from various Latin American countries, crafted with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The restaurant's warm, colorful decor and friendly staff create a welcoming environment perfect for both casual dining and special occasions.

name: Jack In The Box #1140
description: Just about everyone knows Jack from Jack in the Box with his telltale ping pong ball head, but what they might not know is just how good the food is at this favorite fast-food eatery. For more than 60 years, this all-American chain has been dishing up burgers, all-day breakfasts and a variety of Americanized snacks like eggrolls and tacos. This is not, however, your typical fast-food burger joint. With dishes only made once you place your order, the menu offers diners a variety of decidedly different dining options. From the Sourdough Jack (served on authentic sourdough bread) to the Bacon Ultimate Cheeseburger with two kinds of cheese, there are enough burger options to cure just about every craving. There's plenty more on the menu, including garden-fresh salads with grilled chicken, Chicken Pita sandwiches, grilled sandwiches, their famous Curly Fries, and much more. Jack in the Box is also known for their real ice cream milkshakes.  Regardless if you order one to go with your meal or to enjoy as a dessert, they really are delectable. Plus, with a rotating selection of seasonal and promotional dishes to try, you can make this your new favorite fast-food restaurant and never tire of the food! Get there today and dine-in or choose a location with a handy drive-thru, but make Jack in the Box your first choice when craving fabulous fast-and-delicious-food!

name: Koki Creative Puerto Rican Kitchen
description: Kokí offers an extended fare of Puerto Rican cuisine including rice bowls, mofongo, empanadas, sandwiches & more. Its informal & fast-casual setting makes it perfect for your everyday joint. With a menu packed full of keto-friendly, vegan, vegetarian options, and Gluten Free  - for breakfast, lunch and dinner - they have something to appeal to everyone!

name: Carlo's Cucina Italiana
description: Carlo's Cucina Italiana features authentic Italian cuisine in addition to daily specials. Dishing up some of the city's best tasting fare, you can feast on all your favorites here. In addition to a great menu, the bar is stocked with cold beers and Italian wines. Dine-in in the family-friendly restaurant or take something amazing to-go.

name: Mamajuana Cafe
description: Upscale Dominican dishes made with the freshest ingredients and presented with magazine-worthy flare are what you'll find every time you visit Mamajuana Cafe. A rustic and beautiful restaurant, Mamajuana is perfect for romantic dates and family feasts alike. Get started with tasty appetizers like MamaChimis with Dominican-style ground beef, empanada trio, or crispy calamari with garlic aioli. For the main event, try popular entrees such as tender churrasco steak with chimichurri sauce, Mediterranean sea bass with fresh herbs, or Mamajuana Paella with hot lobster, shrimp, calamari, clams, mussels, chorizo saffron rice, roasted pepper, and sweet peas. A kids menu is available for the small fries in your group, and diners of all ages will love the delectable desserts here. Pair your food with a hand-crafted cocktail or cold beer. Stop by Sundays for an all-you-can-eat brunch buffet with bottomless mimosas. Make a reservation for your next great dining experience at Mamajuana Cafe.

name: Galleria Ristorante
description: Galleria Ristorante opened in 1981 and has been dedicated to providing the finest Italian dining experience ever since. They prepare their dishes with the greatest care, the freshest ingredients, and a know-how for Italian cuisine that spans decades. Their menu reflects classic Italian favorites as well as signature dishes with a special twist.

name: Inland Pacific Kitchen
description: Inland Pacific Kitchen specializes in seasonal menus featuring fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Chefs draw inspiration from the Pacific Northwest's forests and waters, creating culinary masterpieces that reflect the region's finest offerings. The menu includes seafood, vegetables, and meats from local ranches. In addition to the cuisine, guests can enjoy craft cocktails, enhancing their dining experience. Inland Pacific Kitchen invites guests to experience the flavors of the Pacific Northwest in every unforgettable moment.

name: Amish Heritage Country Market
description: Come and enjoy fresh baked goods, a full-service deli, boxed lunches, gift baskets, candy, health foods, and more at Amish Heritage Country Market. A quaint and charming shop, the moment you reach the parking lot you'll feel transported to another time where life and food are simple and wholesome. Here you'll find country-raised eggs, fresh meats and cheeses, seasonal produce, and artisanal honey to make your meals at home sing with flavor. If you're hungry now, grab an amazing deli sandwich and bag of chips. Be sure to purchase some homemade soaps and other great gifts on your way out. A conveniently located little slice of Amish County, Amish Heritage Country Market is a gem.

name: Omelet Bar
description: At Omelet Bar, breakfast, munch, and brunch are not only meals, but a state of mind that they like to call a morning meal journey. At this casual and inviting eatery, your breakfast experience includes delicious food, unmatched service, and reasonable prices. In fact, Omelet Bar has set out to transform the most important meal of the day, turning it into the most delicious meal of the day. Not only will you find a selection of perfectly prepared classic dishes on the menu, but you'll also discover seasonal and global favorites throughout the year. Feast on the chicken & waffle flight, frittatas, a decadent lobster Benedict, banana pecan crunch pancakes, caramel apple waffles, and so much more. If you're there to munch, the delightful time between breakfast and lunch, or are there for a proper lunch, there's more to try. A chipotle burger will wake up your taste buds, the house BLT is loaded with crisp bacon, the soups are savory and delicious, and the sandwiches and wraps are creative. There are some morning favorites on the lunch menu, too, so that you don't have to miss your favorite morning dishes. Satisfying die-hard breakfast, munch, and lunch fans one meal at a time, Omelet Bar has something for just about everyone!

name: Sangria y Cerveza - Tapas Lounge
description: Sangria y Cerveza - Tacos & Tapas Lounge offers a full kitchen and full bar specialist in Latin-style drinks and dining. Let's call it Mexiterranean... Mexico meets the Mediterranean in an eclectic lounge setting in the heart of West Plano. Stop by today for an exciting meal that is absolutely packed with flavor!

name: Temptation's Bite The Bread Shop
description: Welcome to Temptation's Bite, a space devoted to the art of bread-making. At Temptation's Bite, they share a passion for dough, traveling the world through the diverse breads we create and taste together. They offer tips, recipes, stories, and happy moments, aiming to elevate bread's importance at the table to that of the main dish.

name: Smokey Bones
description: Celebrating authentic and savory barbecue offerings with a menu that features a tantalizing array of smoked meats, flavorful sauces, and hearty sides, Smokey Bones has established themselves as a go-to destination for their smoky goodness. Patrons can indulge in an array of barbecue classics in their laid-back atmosphere. Smokey Bones is a favorite among diners for their commitment to quality and passion for the art of barbecue.

name: Previti Pasta  Pizza
description: Are you in the mood for an authentic and delicious Italian style dining experience? If so, then look no further than Previti Pizza! This local hotspot is known for their signature slices, such as their eggplant and ricotta slice, artichoke and spinach, and their signature focaccia slices that are absolutely to die for!

name: Grimaldi's Pizzeria - Scottsdale Quarter
