description: Armed with over 100 years of pizza-making traditions and a coal-fired brick oven, the very first Grimaldi's Coal Brick-Oven Pizzeria started wowing diners back in 1990. Today, there are more locations across the country for you to enjoy an amazing meal. Each pizza starts with fresh, hand-tossed dough that's made in-house every day. Only the very best sauces, toppings, and hand-made mozzarella are used to top each quality pizza, which is then baked in an authentic coal-fired pizza oven to give it the very best flavor, a crisp crust, and perfectly cooked goodness. You can build a pizza just how you like it at Grimaldi's, or try one of their signature pizzas like The Don (sausage, meatballs, pepperoni), or the Brooklyn Bridge (oven-roasted red peppers, ricotta, Italian sausage). There's more goodness on the menu, like calzones, crisp and fresh salads, and don't forget about their house-made cheesecakes. With friendly service, a great vibe, and plenty of delicious eats, when you're craving a taste of New York City, check out Grimaldi's Coal Brick-Oven Pizzeria! Please note: Catering services are available. Call ahead to inquire.

name: The Halal Guys  Manassas
description: The Halal Guys have been dishing up tasty and authentic American halal dishes since 1990. There's lots to love here, including chicken platters or sandwiches, meaty gyros, falafel platters, and plenty of delish sides. All crafted from the very best ingredients, every visit is a flavorful one! Also call to inquire about catering options.

name: Grimaldi's Pizzeria - West Village
description: Armed with over 100 years of pizza-making traditions and a coal-fired brick oven, the very first Grimaldi's Coal Brick-Oven Pizzeria started wowing diners back in 1990. Today, there are more locations across the country for you to enjoy an amazing meal. Each pizza starts with fresh, hand-tossed dough that's made in-house every day. Only the very best sauces, toppings, and hand-made mozzarella are used to top each quality pizza, which is then baked in an authentic coal-fired pizza oven to give it the very best flavor, a crisp crust, and perfectly cooked goodness. You can build a pizza just how you like it at Grimaldi's, or try one of their signature pizzas like The Don (sausage, meatballs, pepperoni), or the Brooklyn Bridge (oven-roasted red peppers, ricotta, Italian sausage). There's more goodness on the menu, like calzones, crisp and fresh salads, and don't forget about their house-made cheesecakes. With friendly service, a great vibe, and plenty of delicious eats, when you're craving a taste of New York City, check out Grimaldi's Coal Brick-Oven Pizzeria! Please note: Catering services are available. Call ahead to inquire.

name: Big Mama's & Papa's Pizzeria
description: Big Mama's and Papa's Pizzeria serves up freshly prepared homemade Italian favorites using the highest quality ingredients and real California cheese. The menu has something for everyone. It offers a large selection of salads, sandwiches, pastas and desserts. If pizza and calzones are what you are after, Big Mama's & Papa's has just about any topping you can think of -- from Canadian bacon to mandarin oranges. The sauces are made fresh each day, just like Mama always has. Whatever you do, be sure to save room for dessert -- the delectable cakes truly give you something to look forward to.  Big Mama's & Papa's is the home of the world's largest pizza, the Big Papa's 36" pizza. This masterpiece is cut into 60 slices. It's the perfect choice for parties, get-togethers, large families and hungry appetites. Kids love it and adults can't get enough. Don't worry, if you wish for a smaller pie, Big Mama's and Papa's also offers mini 10", medium 13", large 16", x-large 18", jumbo 24" and Big Mama's 28" pies.  The catering menu also offers larger portions, delicious options and great pricing on crowd-pleasing appetizers, salads, pastas, sandwiches and desserts.

name: Black Crescent
description: Sea-to-table has never been fresher or better than at the Black Crescent, an oyster and cocktail bar which never fails to impress. As Mike Herman of the New York Food Journal put it, "Black Crescent takes the term "Oyster Bar" to another level." Indeed it does, wooing diners and drinkers with its sophisticated feel, dim lighting, big band music playing in the background, and communal tables. It is, however, the impeccable seafood that keeps people coming back for more. Offering a variety of just-from-the-water oysters, house specialties like the pastrami smoked-salmon and seafood small plates, the prices are affordable and the eats are sublime. With an attention to detail that is usually reserved for high-end dining, the delicious dishes are complemented by the cocktails which are expertly prepared, creative and refreshing. For the best of both worlds, stop by for Happy Hour daily from 6-8 p.m. and again from 12-1 a.m. for $1 oysters and great drink specials. With food worthy of the best fine dining establishments and perfectly poured cocktails, check out the new Lower East Side favorite: Black Crescent!

name: Andros Diner
description: Open 24/7, Andros Diner is a family-friendly pick that everyone loves and talks about. This is the perfect spot to enjoy all your breakfast, lunch, and dinner favorites. From pancakes to salads, sandwiches, and chops, there's something here for everyone. Casual and convenient, check it out today!

name: Burger Joint at Moynihan Food Hall
description: Burger Joint at Moynihan Food Hall is a quick and casual counter service destination where you can grab an excellent meal for a great price. They are known for their signature burgers always made with high quality ingredients, and they pair excellently with their variety of delicious sides, beverages, and milkshakes.

name: Jakarta Munch
description: Jakarta Munch takes patrons on an exquisite journey through the diverse flavors of Indonesia. The restaurant, nestled in the heart of the city, boasts a menu that showcases authentic Indonesian dishes, meticulously prepared to capture the essence of this vibrant cuisine.

name: Sobol Bed Stuy
description: In the mood for something truly refreshing and delicious? Come check out Sobol Bed Stuy for a high-quality meal made from the best and freshest ingredients around. This casual and cozy café specializes in an exciting variety of smoothies and acai bowls, and they have a full juice bar for you to enjoy.

name: Dunn Brothers Coffee
description: Since 1987, Dunn Bros. has been brewing and pouring amazing coffees and more. Open all-day, you can stop by early and get your caffeine fix with drinks made with freshly roasted beans. Or, drop by any time and get a bit of work done while you sip on a refreshing drink and nibble on something tasty. Always friendly, stop by today!

name: Daddy O
description: Daddy O is a unique addition to the Jersey Shore. The vintage and retro seashore exterior is combined with a contemporary interior decor, reflecting the hotel's elegant simplicity and warm hospitality.  Located on premises is Daddy O's restaurant -- serving delicious contemporary American cuisine -- a stylish respite from a mundane dining scene.

name: Falora
description: Falora is your new favorite spot for all things wood-fired Napoli pizza! This place is known for being a cornerstone in their community, providing a great space for gatherings of friends and family alike. Some of their signature dishes include their Margherita pizza, Manhattanara, San Gennaro and their delicious vegan Hazelnut Gnocchi.

name: Orange Blossom
description: Located steps from Collins Park and across the street from the Setai Hotel, Orange Blossom is right in the heart of the new Miami Beach. The eatery pays homage to the thriving, vibrant cultural destination that Miami is, offering an eclectic menu flush with locally-sourced ingredients and an equally tempting craft cocktail program. Mornings don't get any better than being surrounded by elegant, but comfortable decor and noshing on breakfast favorites like huevos rancheros and Belgian waffles. Surf and turf plates make for excellent afternoon dining options along with grilled romaine salads, Black Angus burgers, and pastas like the fettuccine Alfredo or lobster ravioli. And dinner? You'll be hard-pressed to choose between entrees choices that include center-cut prime sirloin, seafood risotto, and grilled lamb chop. There's also a weekend brunch -- a must-try Orange Blossom specialty, much like the daily happy hour.

name: Dairon's Cuban Pizzeria
description: The talented staff at Dairon's Cuban Pizzeria know that great pizza starts with the freshest ingredients. Come enjoy handmade Cuban pizzas, soups, pastas, and tasty milkshakes and other ice cream treats in this cozy family-owned restaurant.

name: Jack Patrick's Bar & Grill
description: Jack Patrick's Bar and Grill is a cozy neighborhood spot known for its relaxed atmosphere and delicious comfort food. With friendly staff and a welcoming ambiance, it's the perfect place to unwind after a long day or gather with friends for a casual meal. From juicy burgers to flavorful craft beers, Jack Patrick's offers something for everyone to enjoy.

name: Dunn Brothers - Hutchinson
description: Dunn Brothers Coffee is a cozy haven for coffee aficionados, serving up meticulously crafted brews roasted in-house to perfection. With a warm ambiance and a commitment to quality, it's the ideal spot to savor rich, aromatic blends while unwinding or catching up with friends.

name: Piehole Wood Fired Pizza
description: At Piehole Wood Fired Pizza, we elevate the art of pizza-making with our signature wood-fired oven, imparting a unique smoky flavor to every slice. Discover a fusion of tradition and innovation, where each pie is a culinary masterpiece waiting to be savored

name: Maison Harlem
description: Step inside Maison Harlem and enter a gourmet dining oasis that will transport you to France without ever leaving the city. This amazing eatery is a culinary destination in West Harlem, and it delivers a charming and rustic interior that perfectly complements French bistro-style cuisine, trendy outdoor seating, a superb wine list and service that is professional and friendly. Owned and operated by French New Yorkers, this eatery strives to deliver authenticity in everything from the French window-walls to the food which is crafted with care, precision, and only the very best ingredients. The space itself is bright and airy, and the exposed brick walls help create an ambiance which is very urban, comfortable, and casual. But just take a look at the menu: from breakfast to lunch and dinner, you'll find plenty of delicious dishes that focus on flavor and not pretentiousness. Dine on scrumptious breakfast dishes like the feuille de brique (ham and cheese in phyllo pastry) or the always delicious house-made granola. Lunch is always a special event at this eatery, and it's ideal for power lunches, romantic interludes, lunch with the ladies, and everything in between. The dinner menu really showcases the culinary talent of this mighty eatery--from the always popular French onion soup to decadent starters like the fois gras, there  is something for everyone on the approachable menu. Entrees include dishes like the duck leg confit, a classic coq au vin, truffle mac and cheese, the seafood croustillant (seafood medley in a pastry shell) and so much more. Be sure to also visit during the daily Happy Hour, and stick around for the live music. With world-class service and food that is divinely scrumptious, there's every reason to check out Maison Harlem--stop by today! Please note: Present your receipt of a previous visit from AOC West Village, AOC East or BTL Harlem and receive a 10% discount.

name: Classic Arepas
description: Conveniently located around the corner from Washington Square Park, Classic Arepas brings the best Venezuelan flavors to New York City. With family recipes for their traditional arepas, delicious empanadas, and so many more dishes to try, Classic Arepas is the place to be.

name: Smokey Bones
description: Celebrating authentic and savory barbecue offerings with a menu that features a tantalizing array of smoked meats, flavorful sauces, and hearty sides, Smokey Bones has established themselves as a go-to destination for their smoky goodness. Patrons can indulge in an array of barbecue classics in their laid-back atmosphere. Smokey Bones is a favorite among diners for their commitment to quality and passion for the art of barbecue.

name: My Sweet Art
description: Located in the Pine Island Shopping Center, My Sweet Art is a French restaurant offering homemade pastries, beef Bourguignon, croque monsieur, salads, tartines, quiches, French onion soup, and so much more. In addition to their amazing savory entrees, you can enjoy a variety of pastries hand-crafted by Chef Yveline who obtained her professional pastry degree at Lenotre in Paris. Want to learn from the pros? Cooking classes are held here on Wednesday and Friday evenings.

name: Jane Doe Bar & Restaurant
description: Nestled inside the iconic Mansfield Hotel, Jane Doe Bar and Restaurant is on its way to becoming a Midtown mainstay. Diners enjoy handcrafted, upscale cocktails and gourmet entrees daily from 11am-4am. With a plethora of beer, wine, and cocktail options on tap, this opulent establishment provides glamorous beverage choices sure to satisfy.

name: Chihuahua Mexican Restaurant
description: Chihuahua Mexican Restaurant welcomes patrons with vibrant décor reminiscent of the lively streets of Mexico. It offers an authentic culinary journey through traditional Mexican flavors, from sizzling fajitas to zesty enchiladas. With its warm ambiance and mouthwatering dishes, Chihuahua invites guests to savor every bite while immersing themselves in the rich tapestry of Mexican cuisine.

name: Firehouse Subs Washington, PA
description: Firehouse Subs, a renowned chain, is a sandwich lover's paradise where flavorful creations are crafted with passion and precision. With a commitment to hearty portions and premium ingredients, this restaurant invites diners to savor a diverse menu of subs and sandwiches that are not only satisfying but also contribute to a mission of supporting local first responders.

name: Route 66 Motorhead Bar  Grill
description: Route 66 Motorhead Bar and Grill, Museum and Entertainment Complex is the coolest place to bring your family and friends for great food and unique atmosphere! Every aspect of their bar, restaurant, and museum was designed with car and racing enthusiasts in mind. Stop by for a delicious meal, a cold drink, and a rush of nostalgia!

name: Brooklyn City Pizzeria & Market
description: Searching for the best takeout pizza option in town? Be sure to try out Brooklyn City Pizzeria & Market to meet all of your Italian cuisine needs. They serve pizza every single day until they run out of dough. You can count on them for something truly fresh and delicious made from the best quality ingredients.

name: Fuji Sushi Bar & Grill - Upper King
description: From signature sushi rolls made with the freshest fish to scrumptious, irresistible hibachi dinners, Fuji has been hand-crafting some of the tastiest Japanese food in Charleston since 2009. This downtown location along Upper King offers the familiar fan favorites that have given the brand its great reputation throughout the region. There's a cool, approachable vibe at Fuji's, where the popular and vibrant bar is as inviting as the sushi counter, and the rooftop dining is the piece de resistance for any lunch or dinner visit. No matter where you choose to dine, you'll find the yellowtail, escolar, sea urchin, eel, and scallops are not just fresh off the boat, but hand-crafted into mouthwatering morsels of nigiri, sashimi, and rolls that are absolutely delicious. In the mood for something truly unique? Ask about the chef's special rolls. Each is expertly crafted, artfully presented, and unforgettable. Hibachi entrees are served with your choice of chicken, lobster, and steak; each meal is served with rice, veggies, and your choice of soup or salad. Drop by for Happy Hour daily from 4-7 p.m. for weekly specials, bento-box lunch specials during the week, and set your alarm for the weekend brunch. There's also private event space upstairs, so you can host your next event in style. Fuji Japanese cuisine offers an authentic taste of Japan without the hassle of a passport!

name: Jersey Mike's Subs Fall River
description: Jersey Mike's Subs has become a fan-favorite chain for subs since their opening in 1956. They offer a sub above - one that's measured in more than inches or seconds 'til served. They carefully consider every aspect of what they do - every slice, every sandwich, every store - and provide customers with sustenance and substance too.

name: Magnify Brewing Company
description: Magnify Brewing Company is a craft brewery focusing on hoppy IPAs, fruited sours, and sweet pastry stouts. They release new beers every week, so the lineup is constantly changing! They're always experimenting with new flavors and ingredients to bring their community a selection of fun and exciting beer.

name: Top Slice Pizzeria
description: The team behind Top Slice Pizzeria spent decades creating pizza in Manhattan before bringing their talents to St. Petersburg, and even brought the secret ingredient they believe makes New York-style pizza the best: New York water. Using New York water, prime ingredients, and tried and true recipes, Top Slice is creating delicious pies with that distinctive crust that is both chewy and crispy, cut into giant foldable slices that can just as easily be enjoyed while on the go as when relaxing at the table. Gourmet pizza options include chicken bacon ranch, Philly cheesesteak, meatball, meatlovers, chicken pesto, and bacon cheeseburger, or you can create your own with their selection of toppings. Also on the menu are subs, calzones, stromboli, wings, and shareable bites like fried ravioli, cheesy garlic bread, and their famous Bronx Bombers (jumbo garlic knots with ham, salami, pepperoni, provolone, and basil pesto). Their dining space evokes a classic New York pizzeria feel, with exposed brick walls, cozy seating, and a display case full of pizzas available by the slice, and takeout and delivery are available for when you prefer to dine from home. For a true New York pizza experience, stop by Top Slice Pizzeria and take your appetite on a culinary journey.

name: Jasmine Thai Restaurant
description: Are you in the mood for a classic and authentic Thai style dining experience? You have got to come on down to Jasmine Thai for some of the most delicious Asian cuisine in the area. They are known for their signature dishes like their delicious mango with sticky rice, their perfectly balanced curries, and of course their Pad Thai.

name: Campania Coal Fired Pizza
description: Now with several area locations, you can get your fill of scrumptious pizzas and other Italian dishes at Campania Coal Fired Pizza. Pizzas cooked in coal-fired ovens just taste better. There's a slight smokiness to them that adds a touch more flavor. And, the crusts cook up crispy with a slight chew, making them a crave-worthy dish. This Staten Island location is known for friendly service, great portions and a laid-back vibe. Go for lunch or dinner and feast on their made-to-order pizzas. The 12-inch pizzas are topped a variety of ways, or you can always build your own pizza with all your favorite toppings. There's more to try, including the pot of clams, eggplant Parmigiana, oven-baked sandwiches, and plenty of pastas. In fact, you simply must go on a Sunday and try the Campania Sunday Dinner. This is a feast of rigatoni, meatballs, sausage and braciole. Yum! There's also a full-service bar at this location, so go for drinks and snacks if you're not in the mood for a big meal. New York style Italian cuisine has never been tastier than it is at Campania -- check it out today!

name: McALISTER'S DELI  El Paso N Za
description: McAlister's Deli is a popular American chain known for its extensive menu featuring sandwiches, salads, soups, and signature sweet tea. Founded in 1989 in Oxford, Mississippi, the deli has grown to over 450 locations across the United States. McAlister's is celebrated for its friendly service and comfortable, casual dining atmosphere.

name: Motel No Tell
description: Motel No Tell is a unique and quirky spot known for its eclectic, 80's Palm Springs decor and vibrant atmosphere. Offering a range of craft cocktails and gourmet small plates, it provides a lively and unforgettable experience for its guests. With its playful vibe and attentive service, Motel No Tell is the perfect place for a fun night out in the city.

name: THE CODFATHER,PROPER FISH & CHIPS
description: The Codfather is a renowned fish and chips restaurant celebrated for its crispy, golden-battered fish and perfectly seasoned, hand-cut chips. Using only the freshest ingredients, the restaurant offers a traditional British culinary experience with a modern twist. With its welcoming atmosphere and commitment to quality, The Codfather provides a delightful dining destination for seafood enthusiasts.

name: Applebee's Grill + Bar
description: Applebee's Grill + Bar is a popular American casual dining restaurant chain known for its diverse menu and vibrant atmosphere. Offering a wide range of dishes, from signature burgers and appetizers to hearty steaks and salads, Applebee's caters to everyone's tastes. With a welcoming ambiance, friendly service, and locations across the United States, it has become a go-to destination for those seeking a relaxed dining experience with familiar favorites.

name: Lunella's Ristorante
description: A family-owned restaurant located in Little Italy, Lunella Ristorante offers homemade pasta dishes, fresh seafood, veal, poultry, and so much more. A warm and welcoming restaurant with charming Old World style, Lunella Ristorante is an excellent choice for any occasion. Begin with delicious appetizers like stuffed artichokes, hot antipasto, and bruschetta rustica. Popular entrees include coniglio alla caccitore (braised rabbit in red wine, tomato, and mushroom sauce), chicken Parmigiana with spaghetti, and lobster for two with whole Maine lobster, clams, mussels, and calamari in a spicy marinara sauce. The soups, salads, and pasta dishes here are also extraordinary. Complement your meal with a glass of wine or something from their full bar, and be sure to end on a sweet note with delectable desserts like tiramisu and lemon sorbet. Stop by today; the superb staff at Lunella Ristorante is waiting to welcome you to the family.

name: Hotpot Champ
description: In the mood for something delicious and authentic? Hotpot Champ is an authentic Szechuan hotpot restaurant in the heart of downtown San Francisco. They aim to bring delicious Chinese food fusion into the San Francisco local culture. Come join them in the vibe and enjoy hotpot made from the absolute best ingredients!

name: Rassame's Thai Quisine
description: Searching for some of the best authentic Thai cuisine in town? You should definitely give Rassame?s Thai Cuisine a try. This local restaurant is both casual and welcoming, known for their excellent service and family-friendly atmosphere. Their extensive menu includes a variety of tasty dishes made from the best quality ingredients.

name: The V Spot
description: You'll find the perfect spot to eat at VSpot, a Brooklyn restaurant that's known for its amazing Latin plant-based cuisine. Here, you'll find a great ambiance and a menu that's packed with flavor. Famous for hand-crafting unique empanadas, traditional Colombian dishes with a twist, and more, every meal here is a foodie-worthy adventure. Open for lunch and dinner, there's quite a variety on the menu. Enjoy vegan dishes like arepeas, creative tacos, their spicy Buffalo chk'n strips, and more. Brunch is also offered on the weekends, with even more delicious fare to try. Locally-owned and operated and with goodness in every bite, when you're in the mood for vegan dishes that are unbelievably good, check out VSpot! Please note: Catering services are also available. Call ahead for details.

name: Anantra Thai Woodland Hills
description: Anantra Thai Restaurant invites with its inviting atmosphere and delightful scents drifting through the air. Its menu presents a diverse selection of dishes that highlight the intricate and vibrant flavors of Thai cuisine. Featuring savory curries enriched with coconut milk and aromatic spices, as well as aromatic stir-fries brimming with fresh herbs and vegetables, every dish is meticulously prepared with genuine craftsmanship.

name: Delights of Beirut
description: Fried kibbe, shawarma, stuffed pitas...hungry yet? You'll find all this and more at Delights of Beirut, a friendly and casual spot that's hand-crafting seriously good eats. Stop by for lunch or dinner and feast on any of their authentic Lebanese dishes, or just stick with your favorites! Scratch-made from the best ingredients, it's all delish here!

name: Burgermania
description: A smash burger joint located in the heart of Times Square, Burgermania offers high quality burgers made with 100% fresh and never frozen grass-fed American beef sandwiched between golden brown and marshmallow soft buns and covered with high-quality toppings.

name: Mr. BBQ at Mystic Oak
description: Old School BBQ at its best. Some of the finest home cooking you will ever eat .Ribs, Pulled Pork, Snoots & Pork Steaks. Fried Chicken is available every day except Friday. Friday Special is Cod, Catfish & Jack Salmon along with all your BBQ favorites. Saturday is Steak night. Located inside the club house at Mystic Oak Golf Course, we offer full bar, restaurant, banquet facility, huge outdoor pavilion, patio seating and catering.

name: Franklin Mercantile Deli
description: Located in historic Franklin, the Franklin Mercantile Deli is open daily, except for Sunday, with deli and American-style cuisine. A reasonably priced breakfast, lunch, children's menu and dinner tapas makes this a great choice for families and mid-day diners. From specialty omelets to homemade tuna salad, there's something to please a diverse group. A variety of lattes and daily dessert selections pair nicely with any meal. Don't miss out on our "2 for 1 beer special" from 3PM to 6PM. Private parties and special occasions are welcome at the Franklin Mercantile Deli.

name: Shaking Crab - Hell's Kitchen
description:
Spreading the vision of messy eatin' since 2015, dive headfirst into their seafood boil and see why a meal at Shaking Crab is more than food, it's an experience to be shared with friends and family. Shake Together!

 Although they pride themselves on the freshest and finest just-from-the-water seafood and sauce that encompasses butter, garlic, and whole lot of Cajun spices; they want you to embark on the Shaking experience. The Shaking experience is more than just great service, flavorful and fresh food made to order, or their line of signature cocktails crafted for the experience. Shaking Crab is an experience unlike any other, as guests are encouraged to break away from any formal structures of dining, put on a bib, and dive in hands first into a buttery, garlicky, Cajun-spiced pile of seafood. Making a mess is not just expected, but encouraged, and it is the role of their excellent service team to foster a judgment-free atmosphere of community so that guests can be fully immersed in the rhythm of shelling and plucking their favorite shellfish and making a mess.

Who's ready to make a mess? Bibs Up, Phones Down. It's Shaking Time.

name: Señor Pollo
description: Senor Pollo is an authentic Mexican restaurant that specializes in mouth watering chicken entrees! Their juicy grilled chicken is a featured menu item. Marinated with their top secret recipe and grilled to perfection, diners rave about the delicious and savory chicken dishes. This locally owned establishment is proud to serve always fresh, always authentic, and always delicious meals!

name: Jersey Mike's Subs
description: Jersey Mike's offers a savory experience with its signature subs, freshly sliced meats, cheeses, and toppings piled high on freshly baked bread. Renowned for its commitment to quality ingredients and customizable sandwiches, it's a go-to destination for satisfying cravings with a delicious touch of East Coast flavor.

name: Breakfast House and Restaurant
description: Breakfast House Restaurant is an iconic spot to enjoy a hearty breakfast or lunch. They celebrate the most important meal of the day here, and with signature dishes on the menu along with a variety of tasty eats, there's always plenty of variety. Freshly squeezed juice, savory and fresh coffee, and more are also available at this trendy eatery.

name: Mesa Mexican Cuisine
description: With authentic Mexican dishes with a touch of Tex-Mex, the cuisine at Mesa Mexican Cuisine is deeply rooted in authentic Mexican tradition while other dishes have adventurous new Tex-Mex inspired flavors. Every dish tells a story of balance, texture and origin. Located in the heart of DFW in Grapevine (in the central Metroplex near the DFW airport), you can enrich yourself with a unique cultural experience. This is an ideal place for lunch or dinner. The rustic but still modern design is unpretentious and warm, featuring an ageless mix of earthy colors, distressed finishes, and warm textiles to create the perfect space. Unique fixtures and timeless art pieces surround the restaurant and allow the food to shine.

name: Kozaks
description: KoZak's Laketown Grill is a local eatery that's known for affordable, scratch-made, and delicious American cuisine. It's also an award-winning spot, and with plenty on the menu, there's truly something for everyone. In addition to the diverse menu there are locally crafted beers and wines, and don't forget about their amazing desserts.

name: Rooster's Chicken & Waffle
description: The golden fried chicken served at Roosters Chicken & Waffles is always fresh and delicious! You'll find quite a few tempting picks at this casual spot. Head over for a tasty meal and feast on picks like their famous tender and waffle, or get your hands on a delish sandwich. Wings, family meals, and salads are also offered at this popular eatery.

name: Original Sin Tavern
description: Original Sin Tavern is a cozy neighborhood dive bar and pub boasting a diverse menu of craft beers and inventive cocktails. It's a favorite welcoming space for locals and visitors alike with their jukebox and judgement-free atmosphere . With their pool tables and live music on weekends, Original Sin Tavern offers the perfect setting to unwind and socialize.

name: My Yard Live Beer Co.
description: My Yard Live Beer Co combines the elements of a community center, park, upscale beer garden/brewery, diverse eatery, and a one-of-a-kind live entertainment venue, as well as an arcade, an outdoor playground and plenty of TVs to watch your favorite sports. Sit by the fire pit, play corn hole, and enjoy a drink and a show outside!

name: Rosa Mexicano
description: Rosa Mexicano is renowned for their vibrant and authentic Mexican cuisine, infusing traditional flavors with contemporary twists. Their lively atmosphere and colorful decor transport diners to the heart of Mexico. From freshly made guacamole to sizzling fajitas, Rosa Mexicano tantalizes taste buds with a celebration of bold spices and rich textures.

name: Magpies Gourmet Pizza
description: Voted as having the best pizza in Tucson for more than 20 years in a row, Magpies Gourmet Pizza is unlike any other establishment of its kind in the area. Here the food is prepared fresh daily on the premises in order to ensure the ultimate in quality and satisfaction. Every ingredient used to create your pie is fresh, and the dough is even made by hand daily in order to guarantee that it is as fresh and delicious as possible. Featuring the original owners, ingredients and recipes, Magpies has created quality that simply cannot be matched. There are a wide variety of specialty pies to choose from (including ones featured every day of the week),as well as gluten-free pizzas. Customers can also create their own out of literally thousands of different combinations. You can choose from three different doughs (regular, sourdough, wheat), five sauces, nine cheeses, three fresh spices, 10 meats and 21 vegetables. All Magpies Gourmet Pizza locations also offer Vegan Pizza featuring Daiya vegan cheese as well as fresh vegetables. In addition, lite varieties are offered, as are salads, calzones, subs, wings and other great eats. Power hour, from 2-4 p.m. daily, features 20 percent of all take-and-bake pizzas. Pick up already created pies and cook them at home so they are hot, fresh and ready to eat without delay! Lunch specials range from $3.99-6.99 from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. and are a great choice in the middle of the workday. Dine in, take out and delivery are all available, making Magpies the go-to pizza place no matter the occasion! Noteworthy: Magpies Gourmet Pizza services beer and wine.

name: Tabla Fine Indian Cuisine
description: Tabla is a high-end Indian fine-dining restaurant nestled in the beautiful downtown of Ridgewood, New Jersey. At Tabla, the rich traditions and diverse culture of India are showcased through a menu featuring dishes like Chana Masala, Chicken Curry, and Lamb Vindaloo. Located on Broad Street near Van Neste Square Park, guests can stop by for a dine-in experience or order online for carryout or delivery.

name: Cobble Fish
description: Cobble Fish, located on Pier 16 in the South Street Seaport, is a new restaurant that's a symbol of New York City resilience and history. It's a spot where the locals (and some lucky tourists) go to meet friends, have a lobster roll and enjoy a drink out on the pier. As a completely outdoor location, hours are weather dependent.

name: Julio's Mexican Restaurant Rockdale
description: Julio's Mexican Restaurant offers a vibrant culinary journey through the heart of Mexico with its authentic flavors and festive ambiance. From sizzling fajitas to mouthwatering enchiladas, Julio's captures the essence of traditional Mexican cuisine with every savory bite.

name: Nori Thai And Sushi
description: Nori Thai and Sushi is a casual restaurant, offering a variety of Asian cuisine that is health-focused and made using only the freshest ingredients. Their unique specialty rolls, classic Thai dishes and inviting ambience meld together to form a truly eclectic dining experience. Make sure to try their Double Trouble roll!

name: Rose Marie Inn
description: Rose Marie Inn offers a delightful culinary experience with its diverse menu and inviting atmosphere. Guests can savor a fusion of flavors, from traditional favorites to innovative dishes crafted with fresh, local ingredients. Whether enjoying a leisurely meal or a quick bite, diners can expect exceptional service and a memorable dining experience at Rose Marie Inn.

name: Hook Fish & Chicken
description: Get your fresh food fix today at Hook Fish and Chicken! This is a locally owned spot where you can enjoy a great meal that's always made-to-order. It's a casual and lively restaurant, and with a great menu of tempting eats, you can go often to try it all. Hearty fish and chicken entrees, combos, and family meals are all offered here.

name: Amaze Fusion & Lounge
description: With a focus on Asian fusion cuisine, you can leave the busy streets of Manhattan and step into an oasis of calm at Amaze Fusion. This stunning bi-level eatery is modern and aesthetically pleasing, making dining here a joy. The food is the star of the show here; dishes are influenced by the various regions of Asia, and the menu is diverse. Thailand, Japan, Vietnam, China and Korea are all represented on the menu, along with some other favorites. Gyoza, shumai, and beef negamaki are among the starters, and for entrees, look to creations like the house duck, Malaysia chicken curry, and whole lobster in a black bean sauce. Craving sushi? Rolls, special rolls, sashimi and more are all available a la carte, or in their popular combo entrees which come with soup or salad. Lunch specials are also available, making this eatery with tall arched ceilings and fabulous lighting a must-try when dining out.

name: Lloyd's Bar & Grill
description: Go where the locals go and eat something delish and sip on a cold drink at Lloyd's Bar & Grill. This popular spot has a casual vibe and friendly service. Tasty pizzas, plump wings, and other tasty eats are made fresh and to-order. Or stop by to catch the big game. Cold beers, plenty of TVs, and a laid-back vibe make this a great spot any day.

name: La Casa De Frida
description: Experience the best Mexican, Dominican, and American cuisine at La Casa de Frieda. The welcoming restaurant refuses to skimp on quality and prepares each dish fresh daily in a decorative manner, served in generous portions at affordable prices. Stop by today and treat yourself to a meal that will have you coming back for more!

name: Jersey Mike's Subs - Pottsville
description: Jersey Mike's Subs has become a fan-favorite chain for subs since their opening in 1956. They offer a sub above - one that's measured in more than inches or seconds 'til served. They carefully consider every aspect of what they do - every slice, every sandwich, every store - and provide customers with sustenance and substance too.

name: The Club House Bites and Booze
description: The Club House Bites and Booze is a vibrant dining and social spot known for its lively atmosphere and diverse menu. Specializing in flavorful bites and a wide selection of beverages, the establishment offers a perfect setting for social gatherings, casual dinners, and night outs. The menu features a variety of appetizers, entrees, and desserts, all crafted with fresh ingredients and bold flavors. With its friendly service and energetic vibe, The Club House Bites and Booze ensures a memorable and enjoyable experience for all guests.

name: The Harold
description: The Harold is an American bistro with plenty of charm, character and flavor in every spectacular dish. This stunningly gorgeous and casual eatery dishes up fabulously delicious hand-crafted eats for breakfast, lunch and dinner, which makes it a great choice anytime you're dining out. Choose creations like the flight of dips (smoked eggplant, tzatziki, white bean & feta), chicken & gruyere croquettes, or lobster mac & cheese -- and those are just the starters! Heartier fare like chicken confit with wild mushroom spaetzle, pistachio crusted salmon, and steak frites will dazzle your taste buds and please your palate. And, if you're in the mood for a leisurely weekend brunch, stop by for equally amazing meals. Happy Hour (weekdays 4-6 p.m.) at this establishment is always cheerful, and with terrific food and drink specials, it is also a popular place to be. The Harold is also a great place for your next special event. From private celebrations to corporate meetings and parties of all kinds, your event will be all the more special if held here. There are a variety of catering packages to suit every need, and there's space on the mezzanine or on the main floor that's sure to be the ideal spot for your event. Enjoy the best of casual gourmet food in a comfortable, vibrant and all-around wonderful restaurant -- check out The Harold today! Please note: The Harold is located in Harold Square close to mass transit including the LIRR, NJ Path and most subway lines.

name: Dunville's powered by Little Pub
description: Located inside the iconic Dunville's building, Little Pub Westport presents a vibrant pub atmosphere, where patrons can relish in great food and generous drinks. This rustic neighborhood gathering place, under Chef Tim Passaro's helm, blends Old World and New World flavors, offering everything from fish & chips to falafels, including the renowned Graceland burger with grilled bananas and Thai peanut sauce, all with a relentless focus on customer service & value.

name: Loretta's Authentic Pralines
description: Loretta's Authentic Pralines is a quaint sweets shop offering local treats like pralines, pies, cookies and king cake. This local hotspot is known for serving up some of the best baked goods in their area, making all of their dishes using only the freshest ingredients. Their friendly service and welcoming ambience makes for a great experience!

name: 600 Degrees Pizzeria & Draft House - Round Rock
description: Slapbox Pizzicheria is the perfect destination for homemade pizza and excellent draft beers. Their exciting menu includes a variety of traditional and adventurous pizzas as well as some of the best wings in town. Stop by this casual and welcoming destination for excellent service and a satisfying meal.

name: Duo Taco & Bowls
description: In the mood for a meal that is both satisfying and refreshing? Be sure to stop by Duo Taco & Bowls, where they serve some of the tastiest Mexican street food around. You can count on them for a flavorful and vibrant meal that is made from the freshest ingredients and served in a casual and convenient setting.

name: El Cuscatleco
description: For a taste of something different, this Triangle area spot delivers an appetizing selection of original Salvadoran and Mexican foods. The creative dining choices are the big draw at the festive El Cuscatleco, letting diners savor the likes of shrimp quesadillas, deep fried yucca, nachos (bean, chicken, cheese, or beef), homemade sweet yellow corn tamales, and more, including tacos, burritos, chimichangas, and many other Mexican and vegetarian dishes. There are imported and domestic beers for diners to order, as well as fresh juices and soft drinks that go well with an appetizer or one of the combination plates. With its well-priced food, informal style, and authentic tastes, El Cuscatleco can make a flavorful find.

name: Tracks Raw Bar and Grill
description: Tracks Raw Bar and Grill in New York is a seafood-centric eatery offering a diverse menu of fresh raw bar selections, flavorful seafood dishes, and creative cocktails. Located near Madison Square Garden, the lively atmosphere and commitment to quality ingredients make it a popular destination for ocean-inspired dining in midtown Manhattan.

name: Empanadas Monumental
description: Every day at Empanadas Monumental starts with making fresh dough and fillings with quality ingredients. With over 20 tasty flavors including mixed seafood, pepperoni, and Philly cheese steak, you'll always find something to love at Empanadas Monumental.

name: Los Chilakillers
description: Los Chilakillers is a dynamic restaurant turning out Mexican grub, drinks, and more in an informal space with frequent events including live music. They have the best chilaquiles in Texas! They are the place to try for delicious Mexican food in Austin, and they are the house of the Killer Chilaquiles.

name: Round Table Pizza Richmond
description: Round Table Pizza serves up classic pies with a contemporary twist, crafting each pizza with fresh ingredients and a commitment to quality. From the savory sauce to the gooey cheese, every slice at Round Table is a flavorful celebration of the timeless appeal of this beloved Italian dish.

name: Happy Hours Bar & Grill on the Blvd
description: Looking for the perfect place to spend the evening? Come on down to Happy Hours Bar & Grill for a guaranteed great time! As the name suggests, they are known for their awesome happy hour specials and great vibes all the time. Stop by for taco Tuesday, weekly specials, and an awesome selection of music!

name: Frankie & Johnnie's Steak House
description: Frankie and Johnnie's Steakhouse started way back in 1926 as a speakeasy, but today it is an iconic steakhouse that's known for having some of the best steaks, chops, and more in the city. Legend has it that the original speakeasy patrons had to knock on an unmarked door and use the password "Frankie" to get in, and if the coast was clear to enter, the reply would be "Johnnie". Frankie and Johnnie stuck as a moniker, and at this location in the heart of the Theater District, you'll find plenty to love. It's a spacious spot with an elegant and polished interior, a long bar, and plenty of room for fabulous dining. Treat yourself to the prix fixe menu and enjoy a salad, entree, and dessert for a set price. Or, pick from USDA Prime dry-aged steaks like a juicy ribeye, filet mignon, or porterhouse for two. The chops are equally decadent, with picks like lamb and pork chops. Fresh-from-the-water seafood is also featured, and the filet mignon and lobster tail combo is not to be missed. Every dish is perfectly prepared and presented, and with world-class service, every meal at Frankie and Johnnie's Steakhouse is divine! Please note: Be sure to follow Frankie and Johnnie's Steakhouse on Instagram!

name: The Broadcast Booth
description: The Broadcast Booth is a sports bar that delivers an immersive game-watching experience with its state-of-the-art screens and sound system. Known for its extensive drink menu and classic bar bites, it's a favorite spot for fans to catch the latest action in a vibrant setting. The friendly atmosphere and comfortable seating make it an ideal place to gather with friends for any sporting event.

name: Crimson Coward
description: Crimson Coward is proud to bring the cooked-to-order Nashville hot chicken phenomenon to the great state of Texas. They dedicate their hot chicken expertise to producing top-notch, delicious food in Frisco that is also Halal. They only serve premium, reputably sourced, all-natural, non-GMO chicken free of hormones and antibiotics!

name: Culver's Venice
description: From a single family-owned restaurant in small-town rural Wisconsin, to a fast food empire stretching from coast-to-coast, Culver's has earned its reputation for deliciousness by cooking every ButterBurger to-order, and crafting every batch of Fresh Frozen Custard from the finest ingredients, just like they always have. For decades, this family friendly eatery has been the place to go for hot burger and cold custard. Each ButterBurger starts with 100% fresh, never frozen beef that's seared to perfection. Still made the same way as they did when they first opened, each burger is served on a buttered toasted bun. Sure, this might take a minute or two longer, but it is so worth it. Their commitment to crafting some of the finest Fresh Frozen Custard has also never wavered. From the very first scoop scooped up years ago to today's daily-made batches, this is some of the tastiest premium ice cream you'll ever taste. Check out the flavor of the day or go for your usual--it's up to you! Chicken sandwiches, seafood dinners, fresh salads, hearty soups, and more are on the menu, giving you plenty of choice.

name: Carniceria El Novillo
description: Carniceria El Novillo is your new go-to destination for top-notch groceries and great quality meats. They are a great spot whether you are looking to stock up on groceries at home or grab a quick meal that is made from the freshest ingredients. You can count on them for a convenient experience and excellent service.

name: Shinjuku Ramen
description: Shinjuku specializes in traditional Hakata-style ramen, full of the vibrant and exciting flavors of Japan. They are known for their delicious sauces, irresistible gyoza, and an impressive variety of fantastic sake. They use the best ingredients available to create their classic dishes, always served fresh and from a friendly staff.

name: Lobster House Joe's
description: Lobster House Joe's, nestled by the waterfront, offers a seafood haven with a focus on delectable lobster dishes. With a nautical-inspired ambiance, patrons can enjoy succulent lobster rolls, grilled lobster tails, and creamy lobster bisque. The dining experience at Lobster House Joe's is a maritime delight, combining fresh flavors with a cozy coastal charm.

name: LUX Lounge
description: Craving a sleek and sophisticated evening? Come check out LUX Lounge and discover the perfect hangout spot to meetup with friends or to enjoy a relaxing date night. In alluring and comfortable surrounds, they specialize in an impressive selection of craft cocktails curated by the best mixologists around.

name: 16 Handles
description: They're flaunting flavor over at 16 Handles, a NYC original fro-yo eatery that's taken the city by storm. Here, they celebrate individuality. That's why there are endless combinations of frozen yogurts and toppings, all so you can create exactly what you're looking for. Unleash your inner fro-yo chef and pick your favorite chef-inspired flavors and top it with candies, nuts, fruits, cookies, candy bars, sauces, and so much more. The selection of frozen yogurts is always rotating to keep things fresh and exciting, but you can look for flavors like American apple pie, blackberry addiction, cappuccino, cake cake cake batter, fudge brownie, and so many more. There are sorbets, too, and all are labeled to show if they're gluten-free, fat-free, low-fat, contains nuts, and other dietary features. There's more to love here, including fabulous frozen cakes and creamy smoothies. Always high-quality and always delicious, get the party started today at 16 Handles! Please note: Catering options are available; call ahead for details.

name: TGI Fridays
description: End your busy week in a place where everyone says, "Thank Goodness It's Friday!" T.G.I. Fridays is an American restaurant that prides itself on fun and friendly service while offering a great menu, full bar and relaxed atmosphere. Enjoy fried mac and cheese, loaded potato skins, boneless buffalo wings & their famous Jack Daniels Grill items.

name: Mala Project
description: Mala Project is renowned for its authentic Sichuan dry pot, offering a unique and customizable dining experience. The restaurant's atmosphere combines modern aesthetics with traditional Chinese elements, creating a vibrant and welcoming space. Their menu features a variety of flavorful ingredients and spice levels, catering to diverse palates and preferences.

name: Houston TX Hot Chicken - Green Valley
description: Houston Tx Hot Chicken Village serves mouthwatering Texas Hot Chicken sandwiches smothered in their signature house sauce, served on a brioche bun with fries, pickles, and slaw. Their mission is to serve the freshest and healthiest Texas Hot Chicken sandwiches in the world. Stop by today for a guaranteed great meal!

name: Porch Bar & Grill, The
description: Situated in the bustling heart of Lewisville, Texas, The Porch Bar & Kitchen emerges as a dynamic culinary hotspot, celebrated for its welcoming ambiance and irresistible dishes. Offering a diverse menu tailored to cater to a multitude of tastes, every dish, from the tantalizing appetizers to the robust main courses, is meticulously prepared with precision and care. Patrons are invited to relish in a myriad of culinary treasures, ranging from iconic burgers to savory sandwiches, crisp salads, and inventive entrees that seamlessly blend traditional flavors with contemporary flair.

name: El Patron Cocina Mexicana - Sand Springs
description: El Patron Cocina Mexicana is a hidden gem offering authentic Mexican cuisine with a modern twist. Nestled in a charming setting, this restaurant delights patrons with its flavorful tacos, enchiladas, and sizzling fajitas. With friendly service and a warm ambiance, El Patron Cocina Mexicana is a must-visit destination for those seeking a taste of Mexico in Oklahoma.

name: Casa Catrina Mexican Restauran
description: Looking for a stand out Mexican restaurant? Casa Catrina is more than your run-of-the-mill Mexican joint. They serve generous portions of fresh, authentic Mexican cuisine, all for a reasonable price. Their curated menu focuses on bringing new flavors to traditional dishes. Perfect for anyone looking for a unique and pleasant dining experience!

name: Azalea Ristorante
description: Azalea Ristorante is an urban ristorante inspired by the Italian luxe in the heart of the Theatre District. It wows with its eclectic décor and Italian cuisine wonders. Tuck in a hearty meal from their immersive Italian menu and enjoy their picturesque setting. Reserve your place and take a culinary tour of Italy!

name: Kabob's Indian Grill
description: Known for high-quality, fresh ingredients, Kabob's Indian Grill hits the mark for delicious Indian cuisine. This neighborhood gem prides itself on serving traditional dishes with a modern flare while preserving a heritage of rich and complex flavors. The menu is extensive with a variety of curry entrees for meat and veggie lovers alike. The rice dishes are bursting with flavor along with savory selections like the lamb tikka masala -- a creamy entree of tender, boneless lamb cooked to perfection in a decadent sauce made from tomatoes and herbs. Baked in a clay oven and served fresh, don't forget to order a slice of naan -- the perfect accompaniment to any meal. Every order is promptly prepared with the utmost care with every bite sure to delight.  Once inside, the ambiance here is pleasantly casual with plenty of seating and service that is welcoming above all else. If you simply have to grab a quick bite and run, place your order online for take-out.

name: Open Range
description: Open Range combines the great culinary traditions of the past as well as innovative and creative contemporary ideas in food and drink, providing guests with a unique and satisfying evening. They strive to offer the highest quality and freshest ingredients, locally sourced whenever available, in an unpretentious and friendly atmosphere.

name: Cococabana
description: Cococabana is a Caribbean-style cocktail bar with its own menu of delectable small bites. This upscale establishment provides guests with the quintessential southern California rooftop bar experience, and their high-energy, sexy atmosphere can't be beat. Enjoy good drinks and great vibes at Cococabana!

name: Brick Wine Bar
description: Brick Wine Bar, is celebrated for its welcoming atmosphere, as highlighted by visitors who appreciated the knowledgeable staff and their ability to make guests feel at ease, especially those unfamiliar with wine. The bar offers a variety of wines by the glass and bottle, featuring selections like Kumusha and Barcino Cava, alongside a menu of small plates such as Basque Anchovy Toast and Pulpo, providing a well-rounded dining and drinking experience. It's open late into the night, especially on weekends, making it a cozy spot for wine lovers in the Lower East Side to explore and enjoy a vast array of wines and delicious bites.​

name: Redeye Grill
description: Redeye Grill is a vibrant and upscale restaurant celebrated for its lively atmosphere and diverse menu. Located in a prime location, the restaurant offers a contemporary dining experience with a focus on fresh, high-quality ingredients. The menu features a variety of seafood, steaks, and innovative dishes, all crafted to perfection. With its stylish décor, live music, and attentive service, Redeye Grill provides a dynamic and enjoyable setting for both casual meals and special occasions, ensuring every visit is memorable.

name: File Gumbo Bar
description: Filé Gumbo Bar showcases Cajun and Creole classics made bar-side, combining slow-cooked and flavor-rich roux bases with your choice of proteins, simmered in a steam kettle. Their menu is based on seasonal catches and fresh ingredients, and their Seafood and Cajun sausages are shipped daily from Louisiana and the Gulf of Mexico.

name: El Cayo
description: Cayomango is a popular destination known for its vibrant seafood options and welcoming atmosphere. With a menu featuring a fusion of the traditional and the modern, Cayomango offers a culinary journey through the seafood, steak, and the flavors of Mexico. It's the ideal spot for locals and visitors alike to indulge in flavorful dishes crafted with passion and creativity.

name: Zoup
description: Soup isn't just a winter thing, and at this year-round tasty hot-spot, you can enjoy hundreds of varieties of tasty creations. Each day, there are 12 rotating, seasonal varieties to try, including choices that are low-fat, vegetarian, dairy-free, spicy, or gluten-free, and each is served with a warm hunk of freshly baked bread.

name: TGI Fridays
description: End your busy week in a place where everyone says, "Thank Goodness It's Friday!" T.G.I. Fridays is an American restaurant that prides itself on fun and friendly service while offering a great menu, full bar and relaxed atmosphere. Enjoy fried mac and cheese, loaded potato skins, boneless buffalo wings & their famous Jack Daniels Grill items.

name: Trattoria iL Gusto Wine Bar
description: Trattoria iL Gusto Wine Bar is a cozy and old-fashioned restaurant that serves simplistic and authentic Italian cuisine. They specialize in fresh seafood and homemade pasta, but also serve an impressive variety of other options. Stop by for an excellent meal, a glass of wine, and an atmosphere that is both charming and comfortable.

name: Sunnyside Diner
description: Sunnyside Diner is a locally-owned and operation spot that believes it's always Sunday morning. They provide a bright, lively atmosphere, where blue skies meet full tummies. Enjoy delicious food made with only the freshest ingredients available, great coffee, and a thick slice of home-cooked happiness at Sunnyside Diner.

name: Clove Indian Restaurant & Bar
description: Clove Indian Restaurant and Bar in New York City offers a delicious trek through the subcontinent's unique and exotic cuisine. It's a journey that also features an alluring range of signature cocktails and other drinks that mesh well with the food. Clove makes its home in the heart of trendy Hamilton Heights, and across from City College, making it a convenient stop. The famous lunch buffet is one of the biggest draws at Clove -- a stylishly presented spread that offers a pair of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes, as well as fresh naan, basmati rice, dessert, and Indian iced tea. Get it from 11 a.m. until 3 p.m. Monday through Friday for only $9.95. A Sunday brunch at the same time offers up a perfectly tasty weekend meal. Sample the beef masala, chicken tikka, shrimp bhuna, lamb rogan josh, and more. The outdoor seating is inviting, and Clove's location near the 1, A, and C subway lines makes it a cinch to swing by when great Indian food is on your radar.

name: Jersey Mike's Subs
description: Everything about Jersey Mike's is high quality. Their certified Angus beef top rounds are trimmed and cooked right in the store. The meats and cheeses are all top-quality premium brands, and the bread is baked fresh each day on the premises. Plus, everything's prepared right in front of you, exactly the way you want it.

name: La Lanterna
description: Trendy, chic and stylish dining has never been tastier than it is when you dine at La Lanterna, a pizzeria and bar that first opened in 1956. Now more than 40 years later, the family behind this eatery has reopened La Lanterna in Capitol Park, where it all began a generation ago. Located on the first floor of the Albert Building, the hand-crafted Neapolitan brick-oven pizzas made here are the star of the show. Each is made to-order from stunningly fresh ingredients, and they're always crafted with care and baked in the blisteringly hot oven. There are a variety of pizzas from which to choose, or go for a hearty pasta or meaty dish like petto di pollo alla Parmigiana. There are exceptional cocktails and wines as well, making sipping and nibbling at the 12-seat marble bar pure pleasure.  With courteous service, outstanding food and a vibe that's elegant but still casual, La Lanterna is not to be missed!

name: 16 Handles
description: They're flaunting flavor over at 16 Handles, a NYC original fro-yo eatery that's taken the city by storm. Here, they celebrate individuality. That's why there are endless combinations of frozen yogurts and toppings, all so you can create exactly what you're looking for. Unleash your inner fro-yo chef and pick your favorite chef-inspired flavors and top it with candies, nuts, fruits, cookies, candy bars, sauces, and so much more. The selection of frozen yogurts is always rotating to keep things fresh and exciting, but you can look for flavors like American apple pie, blackberry addiction, cappuccino, cake cake cake batter, fudge brownie, and so many more. There are sorbets, too, and all are labeled to show if they're gluten-free, fat-free, low-fat, contains nuts, and other dietary features. There's more to love here, including fabulous frozen cakes and creamy smoothies. Always high-quality and always delicious, get the party started today at 16 Handles! Please note: Catering options are available; call ahead for details.

name: Mi Pueblo Restaurant
description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant flavors of Mexican cuisine at Mi Pueblo, a culinary haven where tradition meets taste. With a diverse menu featuring authentic dishes prepared with care and expertise, Mi Pueblo invites you to savor the richness of Mexican culinary heritage in every bite.

name: CalaMillor Gourmet Experience
description: CalaMillor Gourmet Experience brings the vibrant flavors of Spain to Miami, offering an exquisite culinary journey through authentic Spanish cuisine. With a focus on quality ingredients and innovative twists on classic dishes, CalaMillor provides an upscale dining experience that transports guests to the heart of Spanish gastronomy.
